༄༅/ /phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor zab don don gyi chu bo skal ldan gyi gdul bya'i

tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor zab don don gyi chu bo skal ldan gyi gdul bya'i

yid mtshor 'jug pa'i 'bab stegs myur bde lam gyi snying po grub thob brgyud pa'i zhal lung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo mahā gu ru badzre shwa ra ma ti ratna ḍā ki nī dzwa la sa ma ba ra sarba bi ra yo gi nī ye/ chos rje bla ma de bzhin gshegs pa kun mkhyen dpa' bo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// khyab bdag rdo rje rdul bral spang min dus kyi rnam dbyer med chos skyob pa mchog de dang po'i mtshan// ji ltar snang dngos nyid las gzhan de rab phra'i cha rdul min phyir mngon sum nyid gyur zab rgyas dbyings// de chos yod med min gnyis gzhan min blos mtshon mngon par shes lngas kyang min ches gsang mchog gi sku// kha sbyor bde rgyas bde gshegs spro mdzad lhan skyes bla ma bdag snying dbus gnas gnyis med phyag gis mchod// bla med gsang don srid zhi mnyam sbyor zhi ba dam pa'i chos// gang gis drin gsal bdag blor nyer snang cha shas myong don 'di// skyes bu blo gros ldan min rjes dpag spang byed rab gsal tshig /mngon spro gang gis srid rgyud ye shes mchog tu snang byed 'tshal// ༈ de yang dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ ri rab rdul snyed kyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi yab yum gsang ba las mchog tu gsang ba'i lhan cig skyes pa yab yum de nyid ni/ sgrib gsum bdud sde'i dpung tshogs la ches cher rab tu khros shing*/ mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen pos yongs su gang ba/ gang dang gang la'ang lhan cig skyes par lhang nge lhan ne lham mer bzhugs pa'o// de nyid kyi don zab mo mngon du phyung bar mdzad pa o rgyan chos sku mkha' 'gro ma'i bka' rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tai lo pa chen po nas rim pa bzhin bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams zag med bde ba chen po'i dbyings su/ lhan cig skyes pa 'gyur med rdo rje'i sku brnyes par gyur pa'i snyan brgyud zhal gyi gdams pa phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi gdams pa bya ba zhig ston par byed pa yin te/

de la gdams pa dgos pa'i don bstan pa dang*/ gdams pa dngos so// de yang dang po ni/ 'di ltar snang ba'i chos thams cad khyab bdag he ru ka chen po gdod ma nas rnam par dag pa'i ngo bor bzhugs pa yin te/ 'khor lo bde mchog nges brjod bla ma las/ lus kun la ni gang gnas pa// de nyid sangs rgyas ye shes te// he ru ka dpal yin par bshad// ces pa dang*/ 'khor lo bde mchog khrag 'thung mngon 'byung las/ kun la khyab cing rtag tu stong*// srid pa bzung zhing dri ma med// ces gsungs pa'o// de ltar yin kyang glo bur ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis bdag gzhan gnyis 'dzin gyi blos phyin ci log 'khrul pa'i snang ba la longs spyod cing mig 'phrul lta bu'i skye rga na 'chi la longs spyod par gyur to// de ltar rmi lam lta bu'i 'khrul pa la longs spyod pa'i dus kyi tshe na'ang*/ rang byung lhan cig skyes pa'i ngo bo la phyin ci log 'khrul pa'i cha shas phra ba tsam gyis kyang gos pa med de/ bde mchog gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyud las/ rang byung ye shes yin pa'i phyir// 'dod chags la sogs skyon gyis kyang*// de la sgrib pa ma yin te// nam mkha' la ni sprin bzhin no// zhes dang*/ bde mchog ye shes mkha' 'gro gsang ba las/ chu khams gser dang nam mkha' bzhin// rang bzhin gyis ni dag par 'dod// ces gsungs pa'o// de'i phyir na lhan skyes rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa de nyid rang ngo rang gis ma rig pas 'khor ba'i rang bzhin sdug bsngal bar gyur la/ rang ngo rang gis rig cing rtogs pa'i tshe na mya ngan las 'das par 'gyur te de'i phyir/ dpal nā ro pa chen po'i zhal nas/ 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa gnyis// gnas skabs rig dang ma rig nyid// ces gsungs pa dang*/ 'khor lo bde mchog ye shes mkha' 'gro gsang ba las/ rang sems rang rig rtogs pa na// sems can gdod nas sangs rgyas so// zhes pa dang*/

'khor lo sdom pa ye shes rgyal po las/ 'khor ba yongs su shes pa nyid// mya ngan 'das par brjod pa la// sangs rgyas sems can rtog pas 'khrul// rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa las// rgyu dang rkyen gyis bskyed pas 'khrul// zhes pa dang*/ kyai'i rdo rje las/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid// 'on kyang glo bur dri mas bsgribs// de nyid bsal na sangs rgyas te// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ 'da' ka ye shes las/ sems rtogs na sangs rgyas yin te/ sangs rgyas gzhan nas mi tshol ba'i 'du shes rab tu bsgom par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ bram ze chen po'i zhal nas/ rtogs pa'i ye shes 'di las ma gtogs pa'i// sangs rgyas che bar 'dod na rmongs par shes par bya// zhes gsungs pa'i don 'di nyid ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa chos rje bla ma'i gsungs dang*/ bdag me nyag rnal 'byor mtshan nyid kyis kyang mngon sum par myong ba'i phyir na/ nges pa nas nges pa kho nar grub par rig par bya'o// de'i phyir na lhan cig skyes pa rang byung gi ye shes lhun grub bde ba chen po'i ngo bo la/ tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pa ma rig pa glo bur gyi dri ma rab rib lta bu de spangs nas/ dpal khrag 'thung bde chen mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i sku mngon du byed pa'i thabs/ zab lam phyag rgya chen po dang*/ mi zab pa'i lam rtsa rlung thig le gnyis las 'dir shin tu zab pa'i lam phyag rgya chen po'i gdams pa ston par byed pa'o// ༈ de lta bu'i phyag rgya chen po'i khrid rim snyan brgyud rin po che'i gdams pa grub chen nyid kyi gsung dang*/ brgyud pa rnams kyi bka' srol gyi phyag bzhes ji lta pa'i 'grig rim nyung tsam 'god par bya ba la/ sgrub pa'i bca' gzhi bstan pa/ gdams ngag gdab pa/ nyams len gnad nas bzung ba/ sgrub pa gong 'phel gyi nyams rtogs mthar 'don pa/ chos bzhin gyi spyod lam skyong tshul dang lnga/

dang po ni/ 'di lta bu'i tshul gyis gdams ngag zab mo gdab pa'i tshe na/ thog mar bla mas kyang tshe 'di'i chos brgyad kyis kun nas bslangs pa'i gtam grags 'dod dang*/ rnyed bkur bsags thabs dang*/ chos la bsnyad nas 'khor mang gi 'du longs byed thabs kyi chos bshad byed pa sogs dang*/ tha na rang gi lto gos phyid thabs sogs kyi chos bshad byed pa sogs/ blo tsam gyi'ang kun slong ngan pa'i lhad 'khris gtan nas ma zhugs par bya/ khyad par rang la gang yod kyi myong ba de gzhan la bstan pas nyams myong gi rtsi yal ba/ dran pa'i so shor ba sogs mi gang na rang stong pa'i dpe la ma shor bar bya/ yang gzhan la chos bshad byed pa dang ngo sprod btab pas rang gi dran bskul gsos thebs nas skyo shas nges 'byung nyams myong gi mdangs thon zhing mi la ngo sprod pas rang gi rtogs pa rdo rus 'phrod cing phra zhib kyi mtshang lon pa dang*/ tshe 'di'i bden zhen la blo sna thung sbud rtser 'gro ba zhig byung na khrid rkang der yang dpon slob gnyis ka'i don 'grub pa yin zhing*/ dus deng sang gi khrid 'debs pa'i gzhan don dus babs kyang de tsam zhig la 'jog thub bam snyam mo// yang*/ mi la phan thogs cung zad dang*/ rang la'ang chos kyi 'tsho bas 'byor zhing lus sems la gzi reg med pa'i dus su/ snang ba bde ging de ba/ nyams myong gsal phyal le ba/ chos mthong dang snyan grags rlung ltar 'phyo ba'i dus su/ dga' tshor skyid nyams za sar zug pa tsam yod cing*// yang*/ skyid sdug gi bag chags ldang zhing bzang ngan gyi rkyen byung ba'i tshe blo zhum khongs kyi rtog pas bzang rtog thams cad zil gyis mnan nas mthar mdo 'gag gi gal la thug dus sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba sa la thim rung lta bu'i/ ngal ba mi bzod pa shor ba'i tshor ba drag po 'byung sla zhing*/ rkyen de lta bu la ro snyoms mi nus na/ gong du byung ba'i yon tan ltar snang ba de dag sgrub pa mthar ma thon pa'i skyon du ngos bzung la/

bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i bya ba la rang dbang ma thob kyi bar du gnyis phung gi 'khor lo bskor re snyam pa'i zhe bcad kyi 'dun pa drag pos ri dwags mos ma ltar ri mtshams dang smra bcad dang 'dag sbyar gsum gyi sgo nas las ngan gyi rtog pa ther la 'don zhing*/ ro snyoms mthar 'don pa'i bogs kyi blo bde khong du chud pa zhig nus na grub pa'i rgyal sa zin zhing myur du rang gzhan la phan thogs nus pa 'byung ngo*// yang*/ yul ngan re na ro mi snyoms bzhin du yul bzang gzhan btsal nas rkyen med pa zhig tu skyid chos dang bsod nams sgrub snyam nas 'phral gyi chags sdang skyes pa des las ngan bag chags kyi nus pa gting nas bslang pa'i gong mi non par tshe 'di'i gtam zer lo dang grags ma grags cung zad kyi mtha' bda' nas chos brgyad dang gzhan don ltar snang ba de gtan nas spang mi nus na gsang sngags kyi bsnyen sgrub log pa'am smyon pa g.yang la mchong ba dang 'dra bas blo ngan 'di spang ci nus dgos te/ de'i phyir/ thugs rje thabs mkhas kyi kha rgyan can// gzhan don byed na dgos pa yin// zhes gsungs pa'i don la rgyal ba u rgyan pa'i zhal nas/ gzhan don byed pa rang la'ang rang 'dod kyi khong sran legs par thon pa zhig dgos pa yin/ stong nyid snying rje zung du chud pa zhig dgos pa yin/ de lta ma yin pa'i sems dpa' 'gro don mdzad pa rnams la phrag dog gi zur za mang po gtong*/ rang chen po ma song dwogs pa'i che thabs mang po bshad/ yon bdag dang slob ris rnams la nad pas sman pa'i ngo srung ba bzhin du sems 'dzin/ byin rlabs sam nus pa dum tsam zhig yod na de gzhan gyis ma mthong dogs/ chos dang mi mthun pa'i spyod pa tsho ma mthong bas chog par blta/ pho zo dang sgo drag gis 'khor dang longs spyod bsdu ba'i bsam pa des 'ong ba min/ 'o na ci lta bu zhig dgos na/ brgyud ldan gyi bla ma rnams las thob pa'i gdams ngag rnams rang byan tshud pa zhig byas/

byin rlabs stobs kyis 'khrul pa'i blo sna zlog thub pa zhig byas/ nyams myong rang la skyes pa'i drod tshad kyis gzhan rgyud 'khrid pa la mkhas pa zhig byas/ dran snang chos skur shar bas ci byas lam du 'gro ba zhig byas/ blos byas mkhan po zad pa'i dwangs chas legs tshogs rten 'brel la mkhas pa zhig byas/ rten 'brel nang nas shar ba'i stobs kyis gdul bya'i rgyud tshod 'dzin pa la mkhas pa zhig byas/ snang rtog gi rkyen la 'dres pas log sgrub la skyon du mi lta bar stong lam chen po lta bur song ba'i dus su rmi lam du chu la mi sgrol ba lta bu'i gzhan don la zhugs pa nor bu rin po che lta bur rang gzhan thams cad kyi dgos 'dod 'byung ba ste/ da gzod skye 'gro thams cad kyi don 'grub cing bya ba bshams kyang shom/ 'khor bsdus kyang 'du/ thab ka bskyangs kyang 'khyong ba zhig 'ong ba yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar shes par byas nas rang gi rgyud tshod la dpag ste skyid sdug phra chod spom chod du gtong ma thub kyang g.yo thabs kyi legs cha bsgrigs pa ma yin par theg chen byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang bslab bya gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig rtsa ba yan lag gi nyes ltung 'jug mi 'jug dang*/ nges parasgo bstun nas phug nyams myong dang gzhan phan mthar thon pa zhig gi sgo nas bsre tshugs na bsam sbyor lag tu len zhing de tsam na byang chub sems dpa' gzhan don byed tsa na mi kha dang gshe skur la mi 'dzem pa zhig dgos gsungs pa dang*/ sems can gdul dka' ba kho na'i don du lhag bsam gyi khur len dgos gsungs pa dang mtshungs par bsgrub dgos pa yin no// de lta bu'i chos ston mkhan gyi bla ma'i mtshan nyid kyang mdo sngags nas rgyas par 'byung bas shes la/ 'on kyang 'di tsho'i yon tan rang bzhin gyi tshang ba zhig la lung nas bshad tshod rnams kyang phal cher tshang ba 'byung ba chos nyid yin la/

rgyal ba'i dbang po'i gsung las/ mtshan nyid de dag thams cad dang ldan pa ma byung yang phyogs re tsam dang ldan pa dgos shing lhag par rang 'dod kyi 'khri ba gtan nas ma zhugs shing rab sdom gsum gyi yon tan yar ldan du tshang zhing tha na'ang pham pas ma gos par rang la ltos bcas kyi slob ma rnams dam pa'i chos la sbyor ba ma gtogs/ rang gi dgra 'dul gnyen skyong gi bran du mi bkol ba zhig dgos/ g.yo zol gyi rnyed pas rnyed pa bsdu ba dang*/ thob kyis 'jal ba dang g.yo rgyus gzhan mgo bskor nas rang gzhan thams cad sdig pa la sbyor ba'i bla ma ni bsten du mi rung ngo*// slob ma'i mtshan nyid kyang mang du gsungs kyang bsdu na bla ma la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas su thag chod cing ldog tu med pa'i dad pa dang mos gus phul du byung zhing tshe 'di'i don gnyer spu tsam yang med par 'gro drug pha mar shes te de la mi bzod pa'i snying rjes rgyud brlan pa dang*/ tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i gang zag tshe phyi ma don du gnyer ba zhig dgos kyi/ de lta ma yin pa'i lto rgyab kyi phyir tshe 'di'i khe grags dang mi tshe phyid thabs tsam du bla ma bsten pa bla ma'i 'khor g.yog bza' ba tsam yin gyi dpon slob mtshan nyid pa ma yin/ 'o na ji ltar bsten na bka' brgyud rin po che'i lugs la/ bla ma so so'i skye bo 'ching ba dang ldan pa zhig yin kyang sangs rgyas dngos kyi mos gus phul na/ slob ma dad ldan de rjes su bzung ba'i phyir du sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad bla ma de la zhugs te sangs rgyas dngos kyi mdzad pa ston nus par gsungs pa dang*/ yang sngar byon bka' brgyud gong ma'i bla ma'i bla ma gang dang gang la dad pa de yang rtsa ba'i bla mar bzung ste gsol ba btab na phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes sprin med kyi nam mkha' dwangs pa lta bu rgyud la myur bar byin rlabs shugs kyis skye bar nges so// zhes gsungs pa ltar shes par bya'o// de lta bu'i rten 'brel 'dzom pa'i rgyud ldan la slob mas gsol ba btab pa'i tshe bla slob kyi 'brel ba brtag tshul mang po bsgrigs dka' yang don gyi gtso bo nyams khrid zhu ba'i skabs don/

slob ma des rang rgyud kyi bsdus pa'i thog ma med pa'i las ngan myur du myong zhing tshe rabs kyi gtan skyid bsgrubs nas rang gzhan thar lam la 'god nus kyi bsam sbyor sgrub pa yin la/ 'phral du da res kyi lus sems rang dbang can 'dis skye 'chi'i 'jigs pa bsgral nas phyi ma phan chad skyid mgo 'jug pa dang*/ grub thob gong ma'i rnam thar bzung nas bka' brgyud kyi pha rabs mi gcod pas bstan pa la bya ba byed cing gzhan phan lag tu len pa dang*/ myong ba rgyud thog tu 'gel nas nyams myong mdzub tshugs su bsgom zhing ngo sprod rjen par btab pas 'bras bu phyi dus la mi 'jog pa zhig gang thub la thog 'gel dgos rgyu yin pas/ don gnyer gyi slob ma des kyang bla ma dang chos lugs de la 'phral dad pa skyes pa'am/ bzang bar shes pa'i mos pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas chos kyi 'brel 'jog tsam du bsams nas bsgom mi dgos par byed pa dang*/ snod rung gi chos ldan yin na'ang sngar rang lugs kyi chos rnam dag gcig thob pa des khongs nas bzhag thabs sogs dman pa'i sla chos su byas nas sgom rin mi chog par mnyam gzhag la blo phab mi thub pa'i rigs dang*/ lung rigs dang dgag bzhag gi 'gal 'brel dang lta grub kyi rnam bzhag mang po mthong bas 'jog mtshams kyi sa sne bzung mi nus par the tshom mang la yid ches mi skye ba'i rigs dang*/ the tshom med cing mos blo yod kyang rtsa rlung 'khrugs pa/ nad gzhi mang ba dang*/ 'tsho bas phongs pa/ gnyen dang grogs kyis bshol ba/ dgra dang gyod rkyen gyis non pa sogs la brten nas sgom sgrub la 'jigs pa skye ba dang*/ rgyud la len zhing gnad la phab nas gcun mi nus mi phod pa dang*/ gal te gcun yang rkyen khag chung ngu re nam ldang har 'don byed pa la nyam nga med pa'i rigs kyis gdan thog tu bsran mi bzod pas bar chad lag pas bzo ba dang*/ yang sngar yun ring gcun pa'i yus dang*/

nyams rtags cung zad yod par rlom pas da ngas dag gcun mi dgos snyam dus lam la spar tshod bzung ba'i rigs dang*/ bla ma la dad gus dang 'bul zhabs bzang pa'i byas yus bskyed nas bdag lta bu la ha cang rtsal 'don byed dgos pa'i khur mi gnang snyam pa dang*/ 'phral mdzes chos gzob pa dang phug thugs la mi bde ba med pa sogs kyis ra da ri de'i rgyud brid nas sgrub pa gnad la dbab pa'i khur len ma dgos pa'i dga' bsgom pa dang*/ bka' nan mi gnang ba la yi rang dang gnang ba la sems khur mi theg cing dang du len mi nus pa'i bsam pa dang*/ bya ba yid la 'jog nas thabs sna tshogs kyis sgrub pa la thang lhod byed pa'i mi des phug bla ma dang dkon mchog mgo bskor ba'i nyes pa dang*/ rang la'ang yon tan rlung la shor ba zhig las 'os med cing*/ 'phral du'ang gzhan thams cad kyi sgrub pa byed pa'i gral nas 'bud pa'i bya ba des/ rang gi dgos bya'i bya ba'ang 'di 'grub med pa/ bsdad pa'i nyams rtogs kyang ma skyes pa/ chos brgyag dang sgrub blo'i bsam bzang yang chud zos pa/ rtogs 'bul dang spyod lam gyi steng nas thams cad kyis khril rgod byed pa'i sgang zhig la khrid tshar ba zhig 'byung bas khrid kyi bca' gzhi nas mthar ma phyin gyi bar du/ gnam sa bla 'og 'gyur rung*/ lus srog rdul du song rung*/ nye du dang 'brel ba chad rung*/ 'chi ba srog la babs kyang dam pa'i chos sgrub pa la bar chadami byed par bya ba mthar 'don dgos pa'i dam bca' dang dga' ba drag po bsgoms la/ 'pho 'chug mi dgos pa'i gnas dang*/ 'bol stan sogs lus gnad chun sla ba'i mal sa gos gdan gang 'dzom dang*/ yol pa 'thug po mthong yul legs pa ha cang btud drag pa'ang ma yin pa dang*/ bde zhing 'jam pa'i gos dro la yang ba lus gnad bca' ba la bde zhing mi gnod pa dang*/ khrid rkang der ldang ba'i chas ka blo dang lus kyi gang 'byor tsam la khrid kyi rting bar sems las dang*/

nyo skyi dang*/ zhu zhu mang po mi dgos tsam ha cang 'dzom sha'i tshol khrol chen po'ang min pa'i yo byad thab cha mtshams g.yog dang bcas pa 'dzom zhing khrid la zhugs phyin chad mtshams 'don nas tshags su btsal mi dgos pa bya/ ji ltar nye zhing 'dris che yang*/ de'i ring la za res/ 'bod res/ gtam res/ chos gtam dang go bsdur mang pos zhag re'i dge sbyor gar song ma tshor bar byed pa'i skyid sha bskyed pa rnams dpon slob gang gis kyang bka' nan byas nas do bsdom ci thub kyis chos spong gi g.yeng ba sel ba'i thabs la 'bad/ bla ma dang khrid gnyer ba ma gtogs pa gzhan la rtogs 'bul dang rtog ngan gyi zi slong ba'i gleng mo mi byed/ sngon 'gro'am rgyab chos dus kyi dga' ston tshogs 'khor 'dra ma gtogs 'bul zhabs mang po'i 'grigs dang g.yeng ba 'phel ba'i tshogs sogs gtan nas bkag /khrid gral du 'ong dus ma gtogs mal stan gyi drod ma yal bar 'dug /mi dang gdong mi sprad/ grib can gyi zas mi za/ me dang nyi ma mi 'de/ gos gtsang rtsog mang po mi brje/ khrid gral du 'ong dus kyang zhwa gdong du phab pa sogs mtshams stabs gang byung la gzab/ nang nub kyi thun snga phyi la'ang snyom las dang nyal dad mi byed/ dngos gzhi la zin nas gsar pa tshur mi 'jud/ rnying pa phar mi 'gro/ mdor na khrid rkang 'dir sdod tshe gsang sngags kyi bsnyen sgrub gnyan po byed dus ltar thabs gzab ste/ grub chen gtsang pa rgya ras kyi man ngag khrid kyi rtsa ba las/ gnas ni dben par mtshams bcad bya// lus ngag yid gsum bya ba btang*// 'gro 'dug nad pa'i spyod lam bzhin// zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar shes par bya'o//

de rnams kyi bca' gzhi nges pa can phal cher grub nas/ spyi don gnyis pa gdams ngag gdab pa la/ spyir grub thob gong ma rnams kyi bka' srol gyi khrid yig mdo rgyud man ngag thams cad kyi gnad tshang zhing*/ khyad par rang nyid kyis grub pa'i rgyal sa tshe 'di la mngon sum du mdzad pa'i nyams myong dmar khrid du gdams pa'i lag len 'khrul med rnams kyi spros zur tsam yang ma nyams par gzhan rgyud la gdab cing slob ma la go nyams rtogs gsum ji ltar byung ba dang bstun nas go rim ma nor bar 'bog shes pas/ slob ma de skal rab yin na khrid rkang gcig po de la'ang lam gyi cha rkyen tshang la ma nor ba zhig rgyud la lon pa dang*/ 'bring gis kyang thabs shes kyi gnad 'gag gal gang che la go cha'i khur len nus pa dang*/ dbang po tha mas kyang lus snang sems gsum gnad gcig tu dril nas sems kyi bzhag thabs la nges pa gting tshugs pa'i lta sgom dang*/ zhar byung spyod lam la dran shes kyis skyong shes pa zhig 'byung yang 'byung la/ cis kyang tha ma de tsam ma byung na skabs don ci zhig bsgrub pa yin yid la bsams nas/ bla slob thams cad kyi 'bad pa don yod myong ba lag len rgyud thog tu khol gang thub ma gtogs pa/ byas chos kyi slad bsre gang thub kyis slob ma rang yang mgo 'khor zhing nyams len gyi 'jog so mi shes pas bla ma'ang thugs ngal ba'i las mi bya/ bla mas kyang bshad pa tsha ba'i snyan pa 'byung bar bzhed nas lung rigs man ngag yi ger gang thebs mang po'i rdo btsag bsgrigs kyi na yam bshad ci tsam mkhas kyang*/ gsar 'jug gi blun po ches rmongs pa shas che ba rnams la 'dra mthun mang po ci tsam bshad kyang mi go bar bla ma thugs ngal la slob ma rna ba gzir zhing chos thun gyis blo sun pa cig las mi 'ong bas/ gtso bor nges 'byung dang*/ phan sems dang*/ bzhag thabs gsum po rgyud la skye gang thub blo la 'phrig ci tshud sems rgyud ma rungs pa'i snang ba 'di 'gyur gang thub kho na dgos shing gal che bas blo skyed dang bstun pa'i khrid rkang snga phyi'i go rim ma 'chol bar/

nges 'byung 'jug pa la bskul/ dmigs rkang sngon 'gro la btsugs/ brtsad brdar dngos gzhi la gcod/ nges shes ngo sprod la bskyed/ bshad pa rgyab chos su btang*/ zhal gdams skyel chos su gdab pa ma gtogs go rim ma nges pa'i 'gal 'brel gyi the tshom dang log rtog khu 'phrig gi zi mang po bslangs nas skabs 'dir don chung la gyong che ba 'byung nyen yod pas gong ma rnams kyi/ 'chad bya 'chad byed kun spyod la mkhas pa'i shes rab dang brtse ba'i bsam pa sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus gsum dang ldan zhing rjod byed kyi brda dag pa gang nas bshad kyang 'brel/ ci tsam bshad kyang ran/ ci ltar bshad kyang 'thad pa'i ngag 'brel/ gzhan dga' bar byed pa'i gdangs snyan pa rnams kyis bshad par gsungs pa'ang*/ slob ma'i blo la phan zhing blo skyed dang go rtogs bzang po skye zhing rmongs pa dang log rtog sel ba'i don yin pas/ tshig nyung la go don gsal ba/ blo la phan zhing khyer bde ba/ de ring 'bog pa'i tshig don gyi rtsa ba do dgongs nges bzung thub pa/ rting la 'bab cing nges 'byung gi khu 'phrig bslang sla ba'i bshad pa gnad la gang 'gro dmigs su bkar nas sil bur bkol zhing mdzes gtam dang tshig rgyan gyis ha cang mi bsgrib pas tshig go sla zhing don rgyud la lon thub pa zhig bya dgos snyam pa'i go cha bgos la shes na bdud tshar gcod pa'i sngags dang*/ gtso bor stong nyid srung ba dang*/ sems bskyed bzang po re cis kyang 'chad gong du bsgom par bya'o// rang gis sems bskyed pa ltar slob mas kyang sems bskyed par gdams pa ni/ ༈ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du theg pa chen po'i dam pa'i chos mtha' dag gi snying por gyur pa phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag zab mo nyams su len snyam pa'i sems bskyed dang ldan pa'i ngang nas sgo gsum yengs med du gsan 'tshal/

de'ang dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i theg pa rgyud sde bla na med pa rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa rnams las/ rnyed par rab tu dka' zhing bla na med pa mchog tu gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i don/ sa dang lam la chags thogs med pa rdo rje'i gnas zab mo ston pa'i tshul ni 'di lta ste/ sbyor ba dang 'jug pa'o// dang po sbyor ba la drug ste/ ston byed slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid/ gdul bya slob ma'i mtshan nyid/ gnas dang*/ dus dang*/ grogs dang*/ dam rdzas kyi mtshan nyid do// de la dang po ni/ nyan sogs 'dod na gsol gsum gdab ces gsungs pas khyed rnams dal 'byor thob dka' dang mi rtag pas rgyud bskul zhing 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor rig ste/ tshe 'di blos btang 'gro drug pha ma sha stag yin pa'i nges shes gting tshugs su bskyed de/ de rnams kyi ched du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'dod cing*/ de'ang tshe gcig lus gcig la gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len mthar thug la brten nas sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i gang zag tshe phyi ma kho na don du gnyer nas 'ong zhing zab don gyi snying po nyams su len par 'dod pa de shin tu legs/ de la slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid ni/ ji skad du/ skyon dang yon tan 'dres pa la yon tan cung zad shas che ba'i bla ma bsten du rung zhes gsungs pa ni/ rgyud dang dbang gi don snod rung tsam thob par byed du rung la/ rang gi dag snang 'byongs na mtho ris kyi yon tan ster bar nus kyi sangs rgyas kyi byang chub ster bar nus pa ma yin no// de'i phyir 'dir ni 'dren mchog rdo rje slob dpon don gnyis kyi mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs par ldan pa bsten pa shin tu gal che ste/ dpal sdom pa rtsa rgyud las/ slob dpon mtshan nyid thams cad ldan// yang dag shes shing rgyud shes pa// dpal ldan khrag 'thung gsang sngags shes// khro med gtsang zhing mkhas pa dang*// sbyor shes ye shes pha rol son// zhes gsungs pa dang*/

yid bzhin nor bu rtsa ba'i gzhung las/ bslab pa gsum dang brgyud par ldan pa nyams su myong bas 'jug tshul shes pa bla ma dam par shes// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ dpal sdom pa 'byung ba las/ de nas slob dpon mtshan nyid ni// yang dag shes shing rgyud shes pa// zhi zhing dul ba'i cha lugs can// sems can kun rab mi 'jigs ster// sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes// bstan bcos rigs shing snying rjer ldan// sems can kun la bu bzhin blta// thams cad du ni snyan par smra// sbyin pa la sogs rtag tu dga'// bsam gtan rnal 'byor mngon par brtson// kun la mi 'tshe bden par smra// snying rje dang ni phan sems ldan// mnyam sems dang ni phyag rgyar ldan// sems can rnams kyi mgon gyur cing*// sems can bsam pa'i khyad par shes// mgon med pa ni rnams kyi mgon// dbang po yongs su rdzogs pa'i lus// gzugs dang ldan zhing blta na sdug /dbang bskur don gyi de nyid shes// tshig la yon tan rgya mtsho ste// rtag par rgyud du gnas bsten pa// de ni slob dpon rigs par bya// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ phyag rgya chen po ye shes thig le'i rgyud las/ bla ma rab kyi zhal nas blangs// gzhan du rtog ge'i tshig la mkhas// sgra'i bstan bcos rtag mos la// dbang gi mchog ni rnam pa gsum// blang bar mi bya sbyin mi bya// yang dag 'bras bu 'dod pa na// de ni ring du spang bar bya// de ltar yang bye ma du ma bsdus pa'i phung po 'bad de rnam par btsir bas mar khu'i thigs pa gcig kyang mi 'byung ngo*// de bzhin rtog ge mang ba dang ngag gi drwa ba dang ldan pa bsten pa'am mnyan pa la ni de la nyon mongs pa 'ba' zhig las gzhan 'bras bu ni rnyed pa med do// de bas na gcig nas gcig tu brgyud de rnyed pa'i dbang shes pa de ni rdo rje slob dpon bla ma chen po'o// zhes gsungs pas/ blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis legs par brtags shing dam pa ma yin pa spangs la/

bla ma dam pa yon tan gyi tshogs kyi nye bar brgyan pa bsten pas phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur zhing gzhan du na thob par mi 'gyur te/ sdom 'byung las/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub bde ba che// phyag rgya chen po mchog de bzhin// de nyid mchog la 'jug bya'i phyir// de rnams dbye ba rab bstan pa// bla ma dam pa'i man ngag gis// gsal bar 'gyur gyi gzhan du min// zhes gsungs pa'i don rtogs par bya'o// gnyis pa gdul bya slob ma'i mtshan nyid kyang*/ dpal sdom 'byung las/ slob ma rigs bzang chos la spro// slob dpon gyis ni yang dag sdud// snying rje med cing khro la gdug /khengs dang brkam chags rnam g.yeng can// grags dang rmongs dang snyom las can// gzhan gyi srog la snying brtse med// gzhan gyi nor la sred pa ni// bla mas rtag tu spang bar bya// brtan zhing dul la blo gros ldan// bzod ldan drang zhing g.yo sgyu med// mi dge bcu ni yongs su spangs// sems can rnams la byang sems ldan// 'bar ba'i me dang dug bzhin du// gzhan gyi nor la mi dga' zhing*// rtag par rgyun du bla ma ma mchod// dam chos lta bar spro ba dang*// rtag tu sbyin pa sogs la dga'// 'jig rten pha rol mngon par 'dod// de dag slob mar rab bsngags te// dkyil 'khor dge bar bstan par bya// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ bde mchog gsang ba dur khrod las/ phyi rabs dus kyi snyigs ma la// chags sems byed pa'i slob ma ni// gus pas mi zhu g.yo sgyu 'dod// thos nas khungs sub rang che 'byin// de la bstan na dam tshig nyam// nges par dad nas zhu ba yi// gcig nas gnyis su ma spel na// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rigs rgyud chad// ces pa dang*/ rdo rje phreng ba las/ ji ltar rin chen brdar ba dang*// gser ni bsregs dang bcas pas brtags// de bzhin du yang slob ma la// lo ni bcu gnyis bar du brtags// zhes gsungs pas legs par brtags shing snod dang ldan nges pa rjes su bzung ste/

snod dang mi ldan pa ni phung khrol kun gyi rtsa ba yin pas dug sbrul bzhin du spang bar bya'o// gsum pa gnas kyi mtshan nyid ni/ grub thob gong ma rnams bzhugs pa'i byin rlabs can gyi gnas sam gang yang rung ste/ phag mo mngon 'byung gi rgyud las/ ri sul tshang tshing phug rnams dang*// chu bo'i 'gram dang 'dus pa can// rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram dag dang*// shing gcig pa dang khang stong dang*// ma mo'i khyim dang dur khrod dang*// skyed mos tshal mchog sna tshogs dang*// lha khang dang ni mchod rten gnas// khyim mam yang na gzhi mdo ru// 'dod pa thams cad rab ster ba// sgrub pa po yi bsgrub par bya// zhes gsungs pa rnams su 'gro bar byas pas ting nge 'dzin myur du skye ba'i rgyu byed pa'o// bzhi pa dus kyi mtshan nyid ni gnyis las/ phyi 'byung ba cha snyoms pa'i dus te/ dar la snyoms pa ston zla 'bring po dang tha chung gi dus dang*/ dma' la snyoms pa dpyid zla tha chung dang*/ dbyar ra ba'i dus rnams la'o// gnyis pa nang gi 'byung ba lnga'i rlung snyoms pas lus la na tsha dang bying rmugs 'thib gsum med pa'i dus su bsgom par bya ste/ mdor na mnga' bdag mai tri pa'i zhal nas/ phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la// gza' dang rgyu skar rtsi mi dgos// 'chi ba mi rtag dran na yin// zhes gsungs pa bzhin du shes par bya'o// lnga pa grogs kyi mtshan nyid ni/ man ngag skor gsum ma rdzogs kyi bar du mthun rkyen bsgrub pa'i grogs cho ga mthun pa dam tshig gtsang ba bka' la nyan pa spyod lam dang thabs la mkhas pa/ gsang thub pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la 'grogs par bya'o// drug pa dam rdzas ni gnyis las/ mchod pa dang mkho ba'i yo byad do// mchod pa la gsum/ maṇḍal dang*/ tshogs gtor dga' ston/ khyad par gyi dam rdzas so// dang po maṇḍal ni/ bla ma mnyes pa'i yan lag gsum gyis bsgrub pa shin tu gal che bas/

las dang po pas longs spyod lus ngag gis mnyes pa sgrub dgos te/ sdom pa rtsa rgyud las/ de nas bla ma dag la yon// de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa 'bul// gser ni brgya stong 'bul ba dang*// rin chen rnam pa sna tshogs dang*// ras ni zung gyur brgya nyid dang*// glang po rta dang yul 'khor rnams// rna rgyan dang ni gdub bu dang*// mgul rgyan sor gdub dam pa dang*// gser las byas pa'i mchod phyir thogs// chung ma bzang po bu mo nyid// bran pho bran mo sring mo rnams// deng nas brtsams te bran du ni// khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags shes// blo ldan kun nas dang ba yi// bdag nyid kyang ni 'bul bar bya// zhes pa dang*/ phyag rgya chen po ye shes thig le las/ rgyud kyi don nam dbang gi don// shes nas bla ma mchod mi byed// sa steng nyi zla yod pa ru// de ni dkyil med pa ru 'gro// zhes gsungs pa'i tshul rtogs par bya'o// gnyis pa mchod pa dang tshogs gtor dga' ston gyi dam rdzas phun sum tshogs pa tshags su btsal ba gal che ste/ dpal sdom pa rtsa rgyud las/ gal te dngos grub mchog 'dod na// dri dang me tog bdug spos dang*// mar me brgya yang 'bul bya zhing*// dpal ldan khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor gnas// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma mchod bya// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ 'khor lo sdom pa khrag 'thung mngon 'byung las/ mkha' 'gro ma la gtor ma sbyin// mchog dang dman pa'i dngos grub ster// de yi rdzas kyi dngos grub bskyed// ces pa dang*/ yang de nyid las/ de nas gsang ba thams cad kyis// yid 'ong ston mo la 'dus pas// gang zhig yang dag shes pa ni// sha dang chang du ldan pa yi// ston mo sna tshogs kyis ni 'grub// ces gsungs pa dang*/ sdom 'byung las/ chang dang gtor ma med par ni// las rnams myur du 'grub mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa khyad par gyi dam rdzas ni/

rig ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa ste/ de'ang chags lam pa dngos kyi rten dang grol lam pa rdzas kyi rten gnyis las/ 'dir grol lam pa rdzas dang mchod pa'i rten du padma can dang dung can ri mo can la sogs pa'am/ gzhan yang gzugs dang lang tsho ldan pa dad pa dang snying rje gtong phod che ba theg pa chen po dang sngags la mos pa dag gzhug par bya ste/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ phyag rgya'i mchod pa 'di yis ni// myur du 'grub byed the tshom med// ces gsungs pa dang*/ khrag 'thung mngon 'byung las/ bu mo kun tu sgrub pa pos// de nas pho nya mchod par bya// dus mi ring bar rgyal po 'grub// ces pa dang*/ sambu tri las/ der ni rigs lnga las byung ba'i// rig ma bzang po gzhug par bya// zhes pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ de phyir rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi// mchod pa rnal 'byor ma yi bya// rdo rje 'chang chen go 'phang ni// de rnams mnyes pas thob par 'gyur// rmongs pa gang zhig smod byed pa// de yi dngos grub mchog med do// zhes gsungs shing gsang ba bla na med pa'i sngags kyi dam rdzas rten 'brel kun gyi gtso bo yin pas yon tan gyi tshogs myur du skye ba'i rgyu byed do// gzhan du dgag sgrub dang lung mang po yod kyang yi ges 'jigs pas spros pa bzhag go /gnyis pa mkho ba'i yo byad ni/ rang gi khams la ji ltar 'byor pa'i dad zas dkor zas grib zas ma 'dres pa tshags su btsal lo//

spyi don gnyis pa 'jug pa ni/ bka' brgyud rin po che'i chos 'di dag dpal ldan dwags po rin po che'i chos bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su blangs dgos te/ de yang blo chos su 'gro ba dang*/ chos lam du 'gro ba dang*/ lam 'khrul pa bsal ba dang*/ 'khrul pa ye shes su 'char ba dang bzhi'o// de la dang po blo chos su 'gro ba la bzhi ste/ dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ las rgyu 'bras/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs so// spyi don gnyis pa chos lam du 'gro ba la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba ni bdun te/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i go cha dang*/ dam tshig byung tshul/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ sgrib sbyong*/ tshogs bsags pa'i yan lag go /dang po ni/ rdo rje theg pa'i thos bsam bsgom pa'i yan lag 'di dag la go cha'i gnad 'di shin tu gal che ste/ phag mo mngon 'byung gi rgyud las/ kha sbubs zhabs rdol dri ma can// snod skyon gsum po spang byas la// rtse gcig sems kyis mnyan par gyis// zhes pas kha sbubs lta bu'i skyon spangs nas tshul bzhin du mnyan pa dang*/ zhabs rdol lta bu'i skyon spangs nas mnyan pa mi brjed par bya ba dang*/ dug can lta bu'i skyon spangs nas tshul bzhin du spyod pa ste/ mdor na chos brgyad la sogs rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi lam las log par 'gyur ba cha'i cha tsam yang ma 'dres par spyod dgos pa'o// des na ji srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du rig pa 'dzin pa'i go cha 'di nyid btang bar mi byed pa gal che'o// gnyis pa dam tshig gi yan lag ni/ 'dir gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i srung mtshams bye brag mi phyed pa dag chol mun du 'jug par mi bya ste/ 'khor lo sdom pa dam tshig chen po'i rgyud las/ dam tshig dag dang mi ldan na// bsgrubs kyang 'grub par mi 'gyur te// rgyu med pa yi 'bras bu bzhin// de yi dus byas dmyal bar 'gro// de phyir dam tshig shin tu srung*// sangs rgyas bla ma las thob phyir// thun mong ma yin bla ma la// lnga bcu'i bdag nyid srung ba dang*// thun mong brgya dang bcu gnyis te// de rnams nges par shes par bya// zhes gsungs pa dang*/

thog mar dam tshig bshad pa ni/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po dang ldan par bya ste/ bla na med pa spyi'i thun mong gi dam tshig la rtsa ba'i dam tshig bla ma lnga bcu pa/ yan lag gi dam tshig brgya dang bcu gnyis/ dam tshig rgya mtsho mtha' yas kyi sgo nas bshad pa ltar srung mtshams legs par shes shing lan gsum du khas blangs nus pa dag gzhug par bya la/ de lta ma yin na theg pa 'og ma'i bslab pa la gnas shing ji srid du khas blangs nus pa'i dus su gzhug par bya'o// de ltar ma yin pa'i skyon ni/ bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ slob dpon dang ni slob ma dag /mtshungs par dam tshig nyams skyon phyir// dpa' bos dang por slob dpon dang*// slob ma'i 'brel ba brtags par bya// zhes gsungs pas mtshungs par nyams pa'i rgyu ni/ slob dpon rang la dam tshig med pa'am/ 'jigs skyob snyan grags longs spyod kyi phyir bshad pa dang*/ slob ma la dam tshig gi srung mtshams ma bshad cing srung mtshams mi shes shing nyams pa ni dpon slob gnyis ka ltung bar 'gyur la/ ci lta ba bzhin du khas blangs pa'i rjes su nyams na slob ma rang nyid ltung bar 'gyur ro// des na blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyi don legs par rtogs par bya'o// de nas de ring gi bsgom bya dngos la/ rgyal ba'i dbang po'i zhal snga nas kyis bstsal ba'i khrid yig chen mo nges don rgya mtsho las/ phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor ston pa la// sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang rnam pa gsum// sngon 'gro la yang thun mong thun mong min// khyad par gyi ni sngon 'gro rnam pa gsum// dang po dal 'byor rnyed dka' mi rtag pa// las 'bras 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgom pa'o// zhes gsungs pas/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro'am blo chos su 'gro bar byed pa la/ rten dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che 'di shin tu rnyed par dka' zhing da lta phan yon gyi nus stobs yod kyang myur du nam 'chi cha med/

tshe phyi ma phan chad kyi bde sdug da lta'i las la rag las/ las ngan gyis bskyed pa'i khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal min pa med snyam pa'i blo bzhi po 'di nges par bzung la the tshom med par snying gi dkyil nas nges 'byung skyo shas kyi sems bzod blag med pa gcig bsgom mdzod/ de gsal 'debs pa'i phyir/ ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mdo las gsungs pa 'di rnams dran par gyis shig /de'ang snying rje padma dkar po las/ kye ma mir skye ba ni rnyed par dka'// dal ba phun sum tshogs pa'ang rnyed par dka'// sangs rgyas 'jig rten du 'byung ba'ang rnyed par dka'// dge ba'i chos la 'dun pa'ang rnyed par dka'// yang dag pa'i smon lam yang rnyed par dka' ba lags// zhes pa dang*/ gnyis pa mdo sil bu las/ srid gsum mi rtag ston ka'i sprin dang 'dra// 'gro ba'i skye 'chi gar la lta dang mtshungs// skyes bu'i tshe 'gro nam mkha'i glog 'dra ste// ri gzar 'bab chu bzhin du myur mgyogs 'gro// zhes dang*/ gsum pa/ dpal sbyin gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ pha ma spun dang bu dang chung ma dang*// bran dang nor rdzas rtsa lag tshogs rnams kyang*// shi ba'i rjes phyir de dag 'gro ba med// las rnams rjes su 'brang zhing de dag 'gro// zhes dang*/ bzhi pa/ rgya che rol pa las/ srid sred ma rig dbang gis skye bo rnams// mi dang lha gnas ngan song lam gsum po// 'gro ba lnga po dag tu mi mkhas 'khor// dper na rdza mkhan 'phang lo 'khor ba bzhin// zhes gsungs pas/ shes ldan dag 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las yid 'byung ba'i blos brtson 'grus drag po'i sgo nas nyams su len pa 'di shin tu gal che'o// des na/ chos rje bla ma chos dpal bzang po'i zhal nas/ tshe rabs kun tu dal 'byor thob nges med// tshe 'di'i tshad kyang ci yod mi shes shing*// tshe 'phos gyur nas byang chub bsgrub dka' bas// tshe 'dir brtson pas snying po blang bar bya// zhes gsungs pa'i tshul rtogs par bya'o// do dgongs nas de rnams bsgoms la mal sa non la sgrub pa dkyus su tshud par mdzod cig

/ ces pa dang 'dug tshul gyi zhal bsgos zhib pa dang rnying pa chos thun bzhi gzhung bzhin 'ong mdzod byas la/ bsod nams 'di yi sogs bya'o// chos thun nyi ma dang po'i bsgom bya dmigs thun dang bcas pa'o// de nas chos thun gnyis pa sogs la sems bskyed dang mtshams sbyor gang rung gi mgos drangs la tshig gi sbyor mtshams nas/ gsum pa zab mo'i byung tshul bstan pa ste/ 'di la dgos ched gnyis/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' phyin ci ma log pa nges pa'i don ston pas khungs btsun par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ rdo rje 'chang nas grub thob brgyud pa'i rim pa gcig nas gcig tu zhal nas zhal du brgyud pa/ snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa/ thugs nas thugs su byon pa/ rtogs pa'i drod tshad ma yal ba/ byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun ma chad pa/ zab lam bla na med cing kun la thun mong ma yin pa khyad par gyi dgos ched do// tshul de lta bu la dang po khungs btsun pa'i don ni/ bdag cag rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas gsungs sgros nor bu'i phreng ba bya ba'i bder gshegs rgyud chen las byung ba phal cher sor bzhag yin 00000255mchan00000000/ bcom ldan 'das 'dis dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed tshul/ bar du tshogs bsags tshul/ tha ma sangs rgyas tshul/ sangs rgyas nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor tshul dang bzhi las/ dang po sems bskyed tshul thun mong ba la/ ji skad du/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa nas// 'dren pa yul 'khor skyong gi bar// bdun khri lnga stong tshang ba yi// sangs rgyas rnams ni ngas mchod do// zhes de yan chad grangs med dang po rdzogs/ sangs rgyas legs mdzes nas bzung ste// dbang po'i rgyal mtshan thub pa'i bar// bdun khri drug stong tshang ba yi// sangs rgyas rnams ni ngas mchod do// zhes grangs med gnyis pa rdzogs/ sangs rgyas mar me mdzad nas ni// sangs rgyas 'od srung bar dag tu// bdun khri bdun stong tshang ba yi// sangs rgyas rnams ni ngas mchod do// zhes grangs med gsum pa rdzogs par byed/

tshul gnyis pa theg chen pa'i lugs la/ snying rje pad dkar las/ bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul gyis sems dang po bskyed par bzhed/ yang na rdza mkhan gyi bu khye'u snang ldan du gyur pa'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa chen po la khams sa'i bum pa gcig mgron bu lnga/ mchil lham zung gcig utpal lnga phul ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa khyed sku ci 'dra dang*// zhes sogs kyi smon lam btab ste sems dang po bskyed do// gnyis pa tshogs bsags tshul/ thog mar mos spyad kyi sa la zhugs pa'i tshe khye'u brtson 'grus spyod ces bya bar gyur pa na/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od 'phro'i phung po la bsnyen bkur ba nas bzung ste bskal pa grangs med pa gcig tu tshogs bsags pas sa dang po thob/ yang na tshong dpon shes rab bzang por gyur pa'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa dkon mchog yan lag 'jig rten du byon pa la bsnyen bkur ba nas bskal pa grangs med pa gcig tu tshogs bsags pas sa bdun bgrod/ bram ze khye'u sprin zhes bya bar gyur pa na sangs rgyas mar me mdzad la bsnyen bkur bas lung bstan pa nas bskal pa grangs med gcig tu tshogs gnyis bsags nas sa bcu rdzogs par mdzad do// de'ang theg chen pas pha rol tu phyin pa drug bsags pas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis rdzogs par 'dod de/ klu sgrub kyis/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun// bsod nams ye shes tshogs bsags shing*// bsod nams ye shes las byung ba// dam pa sku gnyis thob par shog /ces so// phar phyin drug tshogs gnyis su bsdu ba'i tshul/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sbyin dang tshul khrims bsod nams kyi// tshogs yin shes rab ye shes dang*// gsum po gzhan ni gnyis ka ste// zhes dang*/ sngags bla med las/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de tshad med bzhi bsgoms pa nas bskyed rim lha'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pa rnams bsod nams kyi tshogs yin la rdzogs rim rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pa ye shes kyi tshogs yin par bzhed/

de ltar grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags pa'i tha ma bram ze'i khye'u bla ma de nyid tshe 'phos pa dga' ldan du dam pa tog dkar por gyur nas 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med par mdzad do// de nas sngon gyi smon lam rjes su dran te 'dzam bu'i gling du gzigs pa rnam pa bzhi ste dus tshe lo brgya pa/ gling 'dzam bu'i gling*/ yul dbus/ rigs rgyal rigs te bzhi la gzigs so// gsum pa sangs rgyas tshul yang*/ rin po che'i cod pan byams pa'i dbu la bcings nas dga' ldan nas 'pho ba la grogs po dag kho bo dag 'dzam bu'i gling du sangs rgyas pa la 'gro gsungs nas dpyid zla tha chung skar ma sa ga la bab pa'i tshes bco lnga zla ba nya'i dus su yum gso sbyong la gnas pa'i tshe glang po che'i phru gu thal dkar mche ba drug ldan gser gyi drwa bas rgyab g.yogs pa'i tshul gyis lhums su zhugs so// de nas zla ba bcur zag med kyi bde ba la longs spyod nas lha dang mi'i don byas so// zla ba bcu rdzogs pa dang lum bi'i nags tshal du yum gyi phyag gis shing glag sha la 'jus te yum gyi glo g.yas nas yum la gnod pa med par bltams pa'i tshul mdzad pa na/ lhas me rtog dor/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin gyis ka shi ka'i ras kyis blangs/ klu dga' bo dang nyer dgas khrus gsol/ kau shi ka nga thong gsungs nas phyogs bzhir gom pa bdun bdun bor ba'i sar me tog skyes/ bkra shis pa'i rtags dpag tu med pa byung nas pang na 'tsho ba'i ma ma brgyad/ nu ma bsnun pa'i ma ma brgyad/ rnam par rtse ba'i ma ma brgyad/ dri ma 'phyi ba'i ma ma brgyad la gtad nas skyed bsring ngo*// de nas ser skya'i grong khyer du khye'u stong phrag bcu dang bcas pas yi ge bslab ste bzo'i gnas la mkhas/ de nas yab kyis rgyal po shākya lag na be con can la khyod kyi bu mo rgyal bu gzhon nu 'di la byin zhig ces gsungs pa dang*/

de na re sgyu rtsal mi shes na bdag gi bu mo mi sbyin gyi sgyu rtsal shes na gtong zer bas/ de nas rgyal bus shākya gzhon nu lnga brgya dang rtsal 'gran pas gang gis kyang ma thub nas rgyal bu don grub rgyal te btsun mo'i 'khor sa 'tsho ma khab tu bzhes/ spyir yang btsun mo'i 'khor khri drug stong yod par bshad/ de nas dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgu la babs pa'i tshe/ pho brang gi phyogs bzhir gzigs pas/ skye rga na 'chi la sogs pa'i tshul gyis 'khor ba'i bya ba la snying po med par dgongs te/ lha rnams kyis btsun mo'i tshogs rnams byin phab/ lha'i bu yang dag bskul ba pos bskul/ brgya byin gyis sgo phyes/ 'dun pas rta sngags ldan phul ba la bcibs te rgyal chen bzhis btegs nas nam mkha' la byon pa tshangs pa dang brgya byin gyis lam bstan 'od kyis mun pa bsal/ mchod pa dang rol mo sna tshogs dang bcas pas gyad kyi yul las 'das te mchod rten rnam dag gi drung du phyin nas nyid kyi gtsug phud bcad pa lhas khyer nas mchod rten byas shing de lta bu'i rab tu byung ba'i tshul mdzad/ de nas dka' ba spyad pa ni/ chu bo nai rañdza'i 'gram du phyin nas gang dag snyigs ma lnga'i dus su dman pa la mos pa brtul zhugs ngan pa dag 'dzin pa sun dbyung ba'i phyir brtul zhugs dang dka' thub brtsams te lo drug tu mkha' khyab kyi ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs nas til 'bru gcig /rgya shug gi 'bru gcig /'bras 'bru gcig la brten nas dka' ba spyad de dbugs rgyu ba bcad de bzhugs/ de nas zas rags pa zos la byang chub snying por 'gro'o snyam ste legs skyes ma'i bran mo zhes pas ro ras dkris pa blangs te lhas rdzing bur bkrus nas phyag dar khrod pa la snam sbyar drub pa gsol nas legs skyes mas ba stong gi 'o ma la 'bras dang 'bru gsar pa btab ste skol ba gsol nas byang chub tu ma ga dhar byon pa'i lam khar bkra shis rtswa 'tshong mas rtswa btsong ba'i sar/

bkra shis rtswa ni nga la myur du byin// de ring rtswa ni bdag la don chen 'gyur// dpung dang bcas pa'i bdud ni bcom nas su// byang chub dam pa zhi ba reg par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas des kyang rtswa sngo 'jam yid du 'ong ba phul te byang chub snying po'i shing la lan gsum bskor te rtswa rtse mo nang du bstan/ rtsa ba phyir bstan nas shar phyogs su bltas te 'dug nas lus drang por bsrang dran pa mngon du bzhag nas gsungs pa/ stan 'dir bdag gi lus ni skam yang rung*// pags pa rus pa sha rnams zhig kyang rung*// bskal mang rnyed dka'i byang chub ma thob bar// stan 'dir bdag gi 'gul bskyod mi bya'o// zhes dam bcas so// de nas bdud sde bcom pa na bdud kyis mtshon cha'i char phab pa me tog tu gyur te bdud mang po byang chub tu sems bskyed do// nam gung la mnyam par bzhag nas bsam gtan bzhi rig pa gsum bskyed de nam gyi cha smad skya rengs 'char ka rten 'brel bcu gnyis dang bden bzhi mngon du mdzad nas skad cig gcig dang ldan pa'i shes rab kyis mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so// de nas tshigs su bcad pa/ zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas// bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos ni thob par gyur// bdag gis bstan yang gzhan gyis mi shes te// mi smra nags 'dabs dag na gnas par bya// zhes gsungs nas dam bcas so// spyi don bzhi pa sangs rgyas nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshul yang*/ spyir chos kyi 'khor lo bskor tshul dang*/ bye brag tu bla na med pa'i rgyud sde ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshul gnyis/ spyir chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshul la/ lha tshangs pas gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong can phul nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba btab pa'i ngor zhal gyis bzhes nas yul wā rā ṇa sī drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi gnas su 'khor lnga sde la sogs nyan thos kyi rigs can rnams la bka' dang po bden bzhi gsungs te/

ji skad du/ 'khor lo dang po srid pa gsum po ni// mi rtag sdug bsngal stong pa bdag med ces// 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bshad nas nyan rang gi /zhi ba de la ni rim gyis 'god par byed// ces gsungs pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa ni/ bya rgod phung po'i ri la sogs par 'khor theg chen rnams la bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor bskor te/ ji skad du/ 'khor lo bar pa bden zhen dgag pa'i phyir// gzugs nas rnam mkhyen bar gyi chos rnams ni// stong pa rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu zhes// bstan nas theg pa mchog la 'god par byed// ces so// gsum pa don dam rnam par nges pa'i chos rnams ni yul yangs pa can la sogs par gdul bya sna tshogs pa la theg pa sna tshogs kyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bzhed de/ ji skad du/ 'khor lo tha ma kun rdzob 'khrul snang ni// dpyad na med cing don dam chos kyi dbyings// 'gyur med yongs grub mngon du gyur pa na// mthar thug rnam grol thob pa'i thabs mchog bstan// zhes so// bye brag tu bla na med pa'i rgyud sde ji ltar gsungs pa la/ spyir rgyud sde bzhi gsungs pa'i tshul dang*/ khyad par 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ dbang po brtul po la bya rgyud dang*/ cung zad rno ba la spyod rgyud ches rno ba la rnal 'byor rgyud shin tu rno ba rnams la rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud gsungs pa yin te/ ji skad du rdo rje gur la/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud// bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la// sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor bla med de ltag lags// zhes gsungs shing gnas kyi khyad par yang*/ gshin rje gshed las/ lha gnas mi dang mkha' 'gro dang*// gnas gzhan mkha' 'gro 'dul ba'i phyir// mthun pa'i sku gsum nyid bstan to// zhes so// de dag so so la brten nas sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i tshul yang*/

ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rgyud las/ ye shes sems dpa' bde ba med pa dang*/ bdag nyid lha'i snyems pa med pa dang*/ rmad du byung ba'i spyod yul ma yin pa dang*/ skyon gyi rgyu yis rtog par rab tu sgrub pas byed pa ni bya ba'i rgyud la bzhugs// zhes pa dang*/ gnyis pa la/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i rgyud las/ don dam rnam dag ye shes chen po las// sgyu ma'i skur ston grogs po'i tshul du bsgom// sgyu ma lta bu'i sngags kyi lam nyid kyis// thar pa chen po byang chub nyid du 'gyur// zhes dang*/ gsum pa la/ rdo rje dam tshig mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud las/ dam pa'i don gyi chos nyid las// rang rig ye shes lha'i sku// gser 'gyur rtsi'i rnam pa ltar// dbyer med bsgoms pas byang chub 'gyur// zhes dang*/ bzhi pa la/ pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa las/ mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni// sangs rgyas lngar ni rab tu grags// zhes sogs dang*/ phung po khams dang skye mched dang*// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs// chos bdag med pa mnyam pa nyid// rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa// stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no// zhes dang*/ ma rgyud brtag gnyis las/ rang bzhin gdod nas ma skyes pa// rdzun min bden min de bzhin du// thams cad chu yi zla ba ltar// 'dod pa rnal 'byor mas shes gyis// zhes sogs mtha' yas par gsungs pa ltar shes par bya'o// khyad par du bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa gsungs pa'i ston pa ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thabs mkhas la thugs rje che bas dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med pa longs spyod rdzogs pa rgyu'i he ru ka de nyid 'bras bu sprul pa'i skur bzhengs pa bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka khrag 'thung gi rgyal po sku gsung thugs yan lag bdun dbang phyug gi yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa rdo rje 'chang chen po de nyid kyis gsungs/

gnas ni chos kyi dbyings rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga'i klong de nyid du gsungs/ 'khor ni chos sku ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams la gsungs/ dus ni dus gsum rgyun mi 'chad par gsungs/ chos ni snyan brgyud yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'di gsungs/ gang zag ni chos sku ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma de nyid kyis thugs nyams su bzhes/ yul ni nub phyogs o rgyan gandho lar dar/ dgos ched ni mchog thun mong gnyis kyi dngos grub ma lus pa bde blag tu thob pa'i ched du gsungs/ 'jig rten mi yul du dar tshul rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tai lo pa de nyid chos sku ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i drung dru byon nas dpa' bo 'gying bags kyi tshul du bzhugs shing nor dang bdag po'i tshul gyis mnos nas 'jig rten mi yul du dar bar mdzad do// de ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam grangs du ma'i sgo nas chos kyi 'khor lo sna tshogs pa bskor ba'i dgos pa ni/ gdul bya rnams gnas skabs byang chub gsum dang mthar thug phyag rgya chen po don dam lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po nyid rtogs pa'i ched kho nar gsungs pa yin pas/ gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal pos zhus pa'i mdo las/ nor bu mkhan gyis phyi ba gsum dang bkru ba gsum gyi sgo nas nor bu rin po che'i dri ma sbyong ba'i dpe bkod nas/ rigs kyi bu de bzhin du/ de bzhin gshegs pa yang yongs su ma dag pa'i sems can gyi khams mkhyen nas/ mi rtag pa dang*/ sdug bsngal ba dang bdag med pa dang mi gtsang bas yid dbyung ba'i gtam gyis 'khor ba la dga' ba'i sems can rnams skyo ba bskyed de/ 'phags pa'i chos 'dul ba la 'dzud par mdzad do// de'i 'og tu stong pa nyid dang*/ mtshan ma med pa dang smon pa med pa'i gtam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshul rtogs par mdzad do// de'i 'og tu phyir mi ldog pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo'i gtam 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i gtam gyis rang bzhin sna tshogs pa'i rgyu rkyen gyis sems can de dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul la 'dzud par mdzad do// zhugs par gyur cing*/

de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos nyid rtogs na ni/ bla na med pa'i yon gnas shes brjod do// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ ji skad du/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong gsungs pa thams cad kyang*// stong nyid 'di la gzhol zhing 'bab// ces dang*/ mdo ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ 'jig rten khams ni stong dag tu// ngas ni mdo sde gang bshad pa// tshig 'bru tha dad don gcig ste// tshig gcig rnam par bsgoms na yang*// de dag thams cad bsgom par 'gyur// zhes sogs mtha' yas par gsungs pa'i don gyi gnad shes par byas la gnas skabs 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang 'di las blo bzlog cing mthar thug phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dam pa tshe 'dir sgrub snyam pa'i sgo nas de ring gi bsgom bya dngos la thog mar khar sang bshad pa'i thun mong gi sngon 'gro de rnams la gzhig 'grel bya ste/ dal 'byor mi lus rin po che 'di thob par dka' zhing 'jig par sla bas nyi ma de ring nas dge sbyor la ltem rkyang med pa 'khor yug tu bya/ skyes pa'i tha ma shi ba ma gtogs med/ de'ang nam 'chi cha ma mchis shing shi tshe chos ma gtogs gang gis kyang mi phan snyam zhing skabs tsa na rang nyid nad kyis btab ste shi phung po dur khrod du bskyal keng rus su gyur rnam shes bya spu rlung khyer ltar dbang med du 'phyo ba la sems gtad de skyo shas dang long med kyi blo sna thung sbud pa bya'o// yang shi nas gar skye rang dbang 'dus pa zhig yin na dang de kas chog ste rang gis byas pa'i las la rag las pas las rgyu 'bras kyi blang dor tshul bzhin ma 'chol bar nyams su len snyam pa byas te rang rgyud la gzhig 'grel byed cing sdig spong dge ba bsgrub pa la brtson pa bskyed do// yang 'khor ba 'di nas srid rtse nas mnar med yan chad sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das pas 'khor ba'i gnas grogs longs spyod thams cad gsod sar khrid pa'i gshed ma'i dga' ston ltar mthong nas 'khor ba 'di me 'ob bam btson ra lta bur bltas te dgos med kyi blo bskyed la 'khor ba'i bshal thag ci chod dang thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang bdag gis ci nas kyang sgrub snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po bya dgos pas shin tu gdung shugs drag po'i sgo nas sbyor ba'i don bzhi pa skyabs su 'gro bar bya'o// de'ang rtsa'i gnad yin pas lus drang por bsrang*/

rlung gi gnad yin pas skad dpang cung zad bstod/ thig le'i gnad yin pas byin rlabs dbab cing rang rang gi lus rdul phra rab kyi grangs dang mnyam par sprul pa dang*/ sems can thams cad kyis kyang tshul de bzhin du skyabs su 'gro bar dmigs la mdun gyi nam mkha' la steng gi char bla ma rdo rje 'chang la bka' brgyud bla ma rnams dang grub thob pho mo thams cad sprin bzhin du gtibs pa de'i g.yas su sangs rgyas dkon mchog rgyab tu chos dkon mchog /g.yon du dge 'dun dkon mchog mdun du yi dam rgyud sde'i lha tshogs/ 'og tu dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams dpung nge thibs se byin gyis rlabs pa'i tshul du bzhugs par bsams la snying thag pa rus pa'i gting nas 'gro drug sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub la mchis kyi bar du skyabs dang mgon dang dpung gnyen dam par bla ma dkon mchog khyed mkhyen snyam pa'i sgo nas bdag gzhan mar gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// chos la skyabs su mchi'o// dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// rje bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum la gsol ba 'debs so// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum la gsol ba 'debs// gnas 'og min bde ba chen po'i pho brang na// chos sku drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po la gsol ba 'debs so// rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ti lo pa la gsol ba 'debs so// rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug nā ro pa la gsol ba 'debs so//

zhes sogs nas/ sems la rtogs pa 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// ces pa'i bar brjod/ lnga pa sems bskyed la/ sngon la tshad med bzhi bsgom pa ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sogs gzhung ltar ro// de nas 'dir smon 'jug gi sems bskyed ngag 'don rgyun khyer gang rung ngam/ yang na shin tu bsdus pa sgrub yig nas 'byung blta/ mchan/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god pa'i phyir bdag gis bla ma'i rnal 'byor ram gang rung gi dmigs pa gang byed kyi 'don pa bsgyur la/ mchan/ bsgom par bya'o// zhes sogs rgyud la 'dres shing blo gshar du ma yin par skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi dmigs pa'i rim pa dus bzhi la mdzod/ thun mtshams su'ang skyabs yul rnams bzhugs yod snyam pa'i dmigs 'dun gyi ngang nas sems 'phro 'du ma mang bar ma bcos pa'i ngang la klod kyis zhog mdzod/ ces dang dmigs pa rnams go nges su gsal gdab pa'i zhal bsgos byas la/ maṇḍal gtor 'bul smon lam sogs gdab bo// nyi ma gnyis pa'i chos thun dmigs thun dang bcas pa'o/// / de nas yang chos thun gsum pa la sngar bzhin tshig gi mtshams sbyor ba sogs byas pa'i skabs nas/ dgos ched gnyis pa grub thob brgyud pa'i rim pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i tshul gyis yid ches par bya ba la/ ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka' de rnams gdams ngag tu bsdu nas skal bzang brtson ldan gyi skyes bu rang don tshe 'di'i don gnyer spu tsam med par 'gro drug drin can pha mar shes nas de rnams kyi ched du rdzogs sangs sgrub pa la ches rings pa'i gang zag gis nyams su len bya'i dbang du byas nas/ theg chen gyi chos rnams tshang la ma nor ba rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang 'bras bu lam byed gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa gnyis la brten te de dag kyang snying po nyams len gyi chos su bsdu nas tshe gcig lus gcig la mchog gi dngos grub bsgrubs nas rang gzhan gyi don 'grub pa la bka' brgyud rin po che'i zab khrid nyams su len par byed pa la gang zag dbang po'i rim pa dang bstun nas khrid tshul du ma yod pa las/

rje dwags po rin po ches ni slob ma snod ldan rnams la rje mi la nas brgyud pa'i thabs lam gyi khrid/ tshogs pa phal mo che ni bka' gdams nas brgyud pa'i lam rim gyi sgo nas khrid par mdzad cing bka' srol 'di thams cad de'i rjes su 'brang dgos/ bka' gdams nas brgyud pa la'ang rgya chen spyod pa'i brgyud pa/ zab mo lta ba'i brgyud pa/ nyams len byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa gsum du yod pa las phyi ma 'di tai lo nā ro nas brgyud pas don gyi gnad gcig tu nges shing*/ dang po rgya chen spyod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rgyal tshab byams pa/ 'phags pa thogs med/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen/ rnam par grol sde/ btsun pa grol sde/ mchog gi sde/ mkhas mchog dul ba'i sde/ rnam snang mdzad bzang po/ slob dpon seng ge bzang po/ ku su lu che chung gnyis/ mgon po gser gling pa/ jo bo rje mar me mdzad bzang po'o// gnyis pa zab mo lta ba'i brgyud pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal/ klu sgrub snying po/ ārya de wa/ zla ba grags pa/ rig pa'i khu byug che chung gnyis/ jo bo rje'o// gsum pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ te lo/ nā ro/ ḍom bi pa/ jo bo rje chen po'o// jo bo 'di za hor rgyal po dge ba dpal gyi sras bar pa yin/ khong la 'bangs grong khyer mi khyim 'bum tsho nyer bdun yod/ longs spyod rgya nag tang kun dang mnyam/ 'khrungs ma thag tu sgrol mas zhal gzigs/ bla ma ra hu la ghu ṇa mi tra la dgyes rdor gyi dbang zhus pas zhal mthong*/ lo nyer dgu'i bar du rig pa'i gnas dang*/ rgyud sde bzhi la mkhas par sbyangs shing grub pa brnyes ting nge 'dzin dang mngon shes lnga sogs thob/ da ni gsang sngags kyi sgo nas sangs rgyas thob pa gcig bya dgos dgongs pa la bla ma ra hu las khyod rab tu byung zhing yi dam thugs rje chen po gyis la snying rje 'ba' zhig sgom/

'bras bra phyed sbyin par btang ba'i 'bras bu la longs spyod pa'i mi gcig gis khyod 'bod par 'dug pas der gdul bya mang po yod gsungs/ rmi lam du thub pa 'khor bcas kyis bskul ba gzigs nas phal chen sder chig rdzogs mdzad/ bla ma dharmā rakṣi ta bya ba la blo sbyong zhus pas byang chub kyi sems la nges shes skyes/ bla ma de'i nye 'khor du mi zhig nad drag pos thebs pa la sman pas mi gson po'i sha rnyed na phan par lung bstan pas khong gi sbyin gsungs nas brla sha las bcad nas byin/ zug che yang snying rje che bas 'gyod pa ma skyes pas rmi lam du thugs rje chen pos legs so gnang nas rma phan par mdzad cing de tsam na stong nyid kyi don rtogs shing sngar ma thos kyang dbu ma rigs tshogs rnams shar gyis 'don pa byung*/ dang po lta ba nyan thos bye brag tu smra ba yin/ 'di la spyod pa snying rje dang byang sems 'byongs shing tshogs bsags na lta ba dma' yang gong du 'gyur bar bka' gdams pa rnams bzhed de/ jo bo la bod ston rnams kyi lta ba mchog dman mang po'i rtogs pa phul bas/ lta ba de rnams zung la spyod pa snying rje dang byang chub kyi sems sbyong dang don 'grub pa 'ong gsungs pa dang*/ rnal 'byor pa chen po'i lta ba lhas ston gsungs skad/ jo bos bla ma de la rtogs pa 'khrungs pa'i tshigs bcad gsungs pa/ kho bos rgyal srid spangs nas dka' ba spyad pa'i tshe// bsod nams bsags pas bla ma mchog dang mjal// dam chos bdud rtsi 'di bstan chos dbang bskur// deng sang gnyen po thob nas chig skya bzung*// grub pa'i mtha' la phyogs ris ma mchis pas// blo gros bkram nas kun la bslab pa'i tshe// ya mtshan dpag med bdag gis mthong mod kyi// snyigs ma'i dus 'dir chos 'dis phan par byung*// zhes gsungs pas rje btsun sgrol ma la sogs yi dam dpag tu med pas lung bstan pa'i slob ma u pa si ka dang*/

bod mtha' 'khob kyi gdul bya ma rungs pa rnams 'dul ba'i chos su gnang ba lags/ yang bla ma byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa bya ba la'ang zhus pas sngar bas kyang nges shes skyes/ bla ma de'i zhal nas/ kwa ye/ pha mar gyur pa'i 'gro ba ma lus drangs pa'i phyir// bdag la yod pa'i nyon mongs dug lnga gang dag gis// sems can rnams kyi dug lnga ma lus drang bar bya// 'dod chags la sogs med pa'i dge ba gang yod rnams// 'gro drug sems can rnams la snyoms par brim par bya// zhes sogs byams snying rje byang sems kyi gyer bsgom glu ru blangs pas/ rje btsun byams pa shin tu dgyes pa'i sgo nas rdo rje'i tshig gis lan gsungs pa/ thos pa tsam gyis ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal sel ba'i glu// bsam pa tsam gyis 'khor ba'i ljon pa gcod pa'i glu// bsgoms pa tsam gyis byang chub myu gu 'byin pa'i glu// byams pa snying rje byang chub sems kyi glu 'di mtshar// zhes gsungs pa dang yang zhus pa/ thog med dus nas nye bar 'brel ba yi// pha mar gyur pa'i sems can ma lus pa// byang chub mchog la 'god pa'i yi dam bsgom// chos 'di byams pa mgon la mchod par bgyi// zhes sogs sgrub par dam bcas pa'i mchod pa phul skad/ bla ma 'dis chos gsungs pa'i rtsar mi zhig gi khyi la dbyug pa brgyab pas a na gsungs nas 'gyel ba la/ gzhan dag khyi la ci yang mi lto ba la tshul 'chos red snyam pa de mkhyen nas sku rgyab bstan pas khyi la brgyab pa'i thad skrang 'dug pas kun yid ches pa byung*/ de nas jo bos myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par 'dod nas chos gang la bslab par bgyi dgongs shing rdo rje gdan gyi shar phyogs na mngon par byang chub pa'i mchod rten la phyi skor mdzad pas/ nub phyogs na bdud 'dul mchod rten yod pa'i nang nas sangs rgyas kyi sku phyung nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pas byang chub kyi sems la slobs shig gsungs/

yang dus bzang la skor ba mdzad pas/ bud med mi'i lus las mtshar ba gnyis skar khung rer bzhugs nas dris lan mdzad 'dug pa'ang de bzhin du gsungs/ yang klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i rdo rje'i ra ba yod pa'i nang na sku 'chag pas bud med rgan mo gnyis kyis sngar ltar gsungs/ gandho la'i steng na sprul pa'i bu mo gnyis dris lan dang*/ nang skor la thib pa'i nang nas mi zhig gis kyang myur du 'tshang rgya bar 'dod na byang chub kyi sems slobs shig gsungs pa sogs lung bstan mang du byung*/ grub thob ku su lu la mjal ba'i tshe/ de la paṇḍi ta mang pos myur du 'tshang rgya bar 'dod na gang la bslab zhus pas byang chub kyi sems la slob gsungs/ khong rnams yid ma ches nas khye'u gtsang ma la lha mo tsundha'i pra phab nas me long nang du de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa spyan drangs nas myur du 'tshang rgya bar 'dod na gang la bslab zhus shig byas pas/ byang chub kyi sems la slobs shig gsungs zer/ de nas rigs gsum mgon po dang sgrol ma rnams rim bzhin spyan drangs nas zhus pas kyang sngar bzhin gsungs/ slar phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams spyan drangs nas zhus pas thams cad mthun par gsungs kyang khong rnams da rung yid ma ches sam cha med gsungs skad/ jo bo yid ches nas myur du sangs rgyas pa la byang chub kyi sems gal che bar dgongs nas/ dus de tsam na gser gling pa kho na byang chub kyi sems kyi bdag por byed kyin 'dug pas khong la zhu ru 'gro dgongs nas slob ma mang po khrid de gling mi gcig kyang nan tan gyis gser gling du byon nas bla ma dang mjal bas tshe snga ma'i bla mar shes/ bla mas kyang bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol ba'i rten 'brel byed gsungs/ kho rang byis pa'i dus rnyed pa'i thub pa'i gser sku gcig gnang bas khyod ci la 'ong gsungs pas/ bdag byang chub kyi sems zhu ru 'ong ba lags zhus pas lo bcu gnyis sdod nus sam gsungs/

nus lags zhus nas lo bcu gnyis dbu sngas sbrel te gdams ngag bum pa gang byor gnang bdag bas gzhan gces kyi lhag bsam rnam dag 'khrungs/ de nas tshur rgya gar du byon rdo rje gdan na kha sar pā ṇi'i sku gcig bzhugs pa des/ khyod kyi rnyed pa legs par rnyed do// da ni sems can la phan pa rgya chen po bsgrubs la bod du song sgrol ma khyod kyi yi dam yang der 'gro don mdzad kyin yod gsungs/ jo bos thugs dam gyi snying por mdzad nas thugs nyams su bzhes pas bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems thugs la 'khrungs nas gser gling pa la mi phyed pa'i dad gus drag po rgyun du mdzad pas/ nyid kyi bla ma rnams grub thob tu gda' ba la gser gling pa la de tsam gus pa'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ bla ma rnams la yon tan bzang ngan med kyang khong nga la bka' drin che ba yin gsungs/ drin ci bdog zhus pas bdag la yon tan du byas pa bsam pa bzang po sprig tsam zhig bdog 'di gser gling pa'i bka' drin yin/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems 'di khong min pa las ma byung gsungs/ 'di dge bshes ston pa kho na'i thugs dam snying por gnang nas gzhan la ma gnang*/ der ston pas 'di bdag kho na la gnang ba ji ltar lags zhus pas/ ngas khyod min pa ston sa ma rnyed pa yin gsungs/ dge bshes ston pas thugs nyams su bzhes pas bdag bas gzhan gces kyi byang sems rnam dag 'khrungs pa'i stobs kyis rang gi mal nas bzhengs te bzhugs nas bdag gis sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ zhes dgongs shing thugs bskyed pa'i tshe mdun du spyan ras gzigs lam gyis gzigs skud/ sku 'da' kha dge bshes pa thugs dam cha bsri bar zhu zer ma ldang nyan gda' zhus pas/ thugs dam cha bsri ba'i thabs med ngas sems can thams cad kyi slob dpon bya bar khas blangs pa yin gsungs/ 'di pa'i byang chub sems kyi rlabs 'dra ba deng sang rgya gar na'ang dkon zhes jo bos gsungs dge bshes ston pa'i sras kyi thu bo sku mched gsum la gnang ba yin pas spyan snga ba'i zhal nas/

jo bos bla ma gser gling pa la zhus lugs kyi chos 'di da lta rgya gar na'ang med dam snyam gsungs/ pu to bas de kho na gsungs/ phu chung bas chos 'di nyams su blangs pas chos gzhan gyi grogs su 'gro la gzhan rnams 'di yi grogs su 'gro ba bya ba yin gsungs/ khong gsum ka dang lhag par spyan snga ba'i slob ma bya yul ba yin/ de dang ston pa man chad la thug pa sne zur ba/ sgre pa dang*/ snyug rum pa dang*/ dge bshes rgya lcags ri gang ka pa dang*/ sha ba gling pa sogs sku mched gsum gyi thugs sras grags che ba thams cad kyi gdams pa ma lus pa mnga' ba rje dwags po rin po che bsod nams rin chen lags so// khong gi bka' gdams lam rim nyams len du dril ba'i bstan bcos thar pa rin po che'i rgyan la sogs pa mdzad cing mi mang po la rnga brdungs pa dang ri dwags mang po la 'o ma thod phor gang 'gyed pa'i rmi lam gyi brda' dang jo bo'i ring bsrel gyi za ma tog kha bye ba la sogs pa'i rmi lam ltar bka' gdams pa'i chos kyi'ang 'gro ba mang po la phan thogs gsungs/ nyid kyang byang chub kyi sems kho na bskyangs pas dge bshes khams pas nyid kyi 'gro ba'i don du ci tsam sprul pa mdzad zhus pa/ ngas sems can re re'i drung du re re sprul nus gsung*/ slob ma grags che ba khams pa rin po ches sku lus de nyid kyi rnam thar de dag dang rgya bod du sku'i bkod pa bcu gnyis sogs sprul pa mang po dang*/ dngos su'ang de tsam gyi phrin las skyong zhing rje dus gsum mkhyen pa nas bzung ste karma pa na rim bcu gcig zhal gyi bkod pas jo bo thugs rje chen po'i phrin las spel zhing dgongs pa rdzogs par mdzad pa'i 'gro don rlabs po che 'di lta bu dang*/ gzhan yang skyob pa rin po ches bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i thugs 'khrungs ma thag sku lus mdzer gyur pa'i nad bdag dngos su thon nas song bas/

zhag phyed dang gsum gyi nangs par nas// mi kho bo'i las ngan rang sar dag /gsungs shing phyis mdze po kho na la 'di gdams pas mdze 'ur 'ded par grags pa dang*/ zhang 'tshal pas 'bu srin yan chad na kha dmar nyog gi phyag gis bsgral ba sogs las bzhi'i 'gro don rlabs po che mdzad pa dang*/ gling ras rgya ras rnams kyi'ang gzhan mi dga' ba mi mdzad pa sogs gzhan don dang 'bral ba'i rnam thar gsum sogs thugs dam bcu gnyis dang*/ rgod tshang pas gnod lan du phan 'dogs pa/ 'khor ba ma stong bar gzhan don mdzad pa/ sdug bsngal bdag la len pa/ bde dge gzhan la ster ba/ le lor ma lus par gzhan don du tshogs gnyis bsags pa sogs thugs dam bcu gnyis dang de mtshungs kyi dam bca' rnams dang*/ lo ras kyi srog la bab kyang gnod lan mi mdzad pa sogs dam bca' bcu gsum mdzad pa sogs bka' brgyud kyi dam pa rnams kyi jo bo'i man ngag chud mi za ba'i 'gro ba'i don rlabs po che mdzad pa yin no// yang pu to bas slob ma sha'o sgang pa glang ri thang pa dang zhang sha ra ba gsum la gnang*/ sha'o sgang pas chos gzhan nyams su len pa ni rkang thang du 'gro ba dang 'dra la 'di nyams su len pa rta bzang po zhon nas 'gro ba dang 'dra gsung*/ glang thang pas rang bas gzhan gces kyi blo sbyong ba la kun gyi 'og tu bsdad nas khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la ster/ gyong dang pham kha thams cad rang gi len nges shig dgos gsungs/ khong gi nyams len bsdus pa'i gnad tshig bcad brgyad ma mdzad/ zhang sha ra ba'i zhal nas blo sbyong bsgom pa la bsam pa thag chod pa ngag bcos mar ma song ba/ gze rig chung la rkyen bzang ngan thams cad 'di'i grogs su 'gro ba zhig dgos gsungs/ khong dang kra ra ba sogs la rje dus gsum mkhyen pas brten nas gdams ngag rdzogs par zhus/ phag grus kyang bya yul ba don steng ba yang gad pa dang 'di rnams la bka' gdams zhus/ sha ra ba'i rtsa ba'i slob ma bya 'chad dka' ba yin te khong gi tshigs bcad brgyad ma la nges shes drag po skyes nas de'i rtsad gcod mang po byas pa'i mthar khong dang mjal nas grwa pa nyis stong brgyad brgya re 'tshogs pas ma tshor ba'i lkog khrid lo drug la tshar/

spyir lo ngo dgur rtsad bcad nas bdag gces 'dzin gyi lta ba gtan nas chod pa'i byang chub kyi sems 'khrungs/ khong la'ang dang po sus rtsad ma chod/ phyis mdze po kha yar la gnang nas bsgom du bcug pas sangs sangs phan pa byung bas mdze chos su grags/ phyis nas 'di tshogs bshad kyi 'os min zhing btub pa kha yar gyi lkog khrid yin kyang su la 'ong mi shes par gda' gsungs nas tshogs su gsungs/ chos gcig la 'di las zab pa rgya che ba med/ ngas bla ma brgyad cu tsam bsten pa'i gdams pa thob kyang*/ kho thag chod pa ma byung*/ sha ra ba la 'di'i rtsad chod pas kho thag chod/ 'gram chu mi ldang*/ gzhan nyan snying mi 'dod par lhod song gsungs/ 'di la bdag gces 'dzin 'dor ba dang sems can la gces 'dzin skye ba gnyis yin pas theg chen gyi chos rnams 'du zhing*/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po nas kyang bshad 'dug /'di byung na gzhan gyi bltas na tha mal pa 'dra ba la rang ci byed thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyu 'ba' zhig tu 'gro ba rlabs chen sha stag gcig 'ong gsungs/ sku 'da' ka 'jig rten na sgra gcig la blo sbyong gi sgra 'di las snyan pa med pas khyed kyis nga'i rna bar sgrogs dang gsungs/ gsal 'debs zhus pas 'di'i tshig kha yar gsungs skad/ khong gi bka' gdams snyan brgyud du grags pa'i blo sbyong gi rtsa tshig mdzad par grags shing 'di'i gdams pa rnams tshang bar dge ba'i bshes gnyen se spyil phu ba la gnang*/ khong gi gsungs nas/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa gsha' mar skyes nas ngan song gsum las thar 'dod kyi tshe dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa rgyud la skye/ skyes bu chung ngu'i tshod yin/ 'khor ba mtha' dag la yid dbyung ba skyes pas dge tshul gyi sdom pa rgyud la skye/ 'bring gi tshod yin/ rang zhi bde'i blo med par sems can gyi don du rnam mkhyen gyi sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i blo bcos min skyes tshe byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa skye/

skyes bu chen por slebs pa zhig blo sbyong gi sngon 'gror dgos pa yin gsungs/ khong gi lha spyil phu ba la gnang*/ des ram pa lha lding ba la/ des sangs rgyas dbon la/ des tshogs pa'i slob dpon yon tan dpal la/ des mkhan chen bde ba dpal la/ des bka' bzhi pa la/ des mkhan po bsod nams grags pa la/ des rgyal sras thogs med rin po che la gnang*/ khong gi rtsa tshig 'di don bdun du bsdus nas khrid yig gsal po mdzad cing*/ khong gi slob ma mang pos de'ang rgyas su btang ba sogs blo sbyong gi bka' srol shin tu dar bar mdzad/ de la byams chos pa byang chub rgyal mtshan dang*/ grub chen rin po che dang*/ lha g.yag chos dpal rin chen sogs las kyang brgyud cing phyis bya btang rin po ches 'di kho na 'chad cing de phyis bka' phyag gnyis med kyi khrid srol lag len du mdzad// rgyal sras pa nas/ nya dbon kun dga' dpal/ des snyag phu mkhan chen bsod nams bzang po/ des 'phags chen bsod nams dar/ des kun mkhyen 'jam dpal bzang po/ des dpal 'byor don 'grub dang chos grags rgya mtsho/ des sangs rgyas mnyan pa/ de la mi bskyod rdo rjes gsan te khrid yig rgyas bsdus rnams mdzad/ de la rgyal ba dkon mchog yan lag gi gsan nas rtsa tshig gi 'grel ba'i khrid yig dang*/ de la'ang legs bshad pas mchan bu mdzad/ rgyal ba de dag la rgyal ba'i dbang po nyid dang rgyal tshab sprul pa'i skus gsan cing dpon slob gsum ka'i zhal snga nas rang re rnams la bka' drin du stsal to// de dag ni gtso bor rgya chen spyod rgyud kho na'o// zab mo lta ba'i brgyud tshul gsum yod pa'i dang po ni sang 'chad cing*/ gnyis pa ni/ rig pa'i khu byug nas brgyud pa bshad pa ltar yin la/ gsum pa ni/ zla ba grags pa nas/ de'i dngos slob 'jam dpal grags pa/ de nas de wa tsanḍa/ bram ze rin chen rdo rje/ pa ra hi ta/ ba su ma ti/ pa tshab lo tstsha/
rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'o//

mchan/ yang dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i bklag lung dang 'bru sbyor 'god pa gang las brgyud pa'ang pa tshab nas zhang thang sag pa sogs rgyal ba'i dpang po'i bar dbu ma'i ka lta bu'o// de nas de ring gi bsgom bya dngos la/ sngon la dal 'byor rnyed dka' mi rtag pa las rgyu 'bras 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs rnams tshig gi grangs dang yin rgyu go ba tsam gyis mi chog skyes bu chung 'bring gi blo ma skyes kyi bar du bsgom/ 'o skol nyams su len mkhan gyi rgyud la ma skyes na gzhan sus bsgom zhing su la skye ba'ang nges dgos shing rang la skye 'chi'i sdug bsngal mi 'byung ba'i gdeng ci yod la bsams nas sla chos min par de rnams rgyud la 'dres nges su bsgoms pa'i mthar/ skyabs yul gsal btab la/ myur la yun thung slob pa'i dus// yun ring 'dod na chun chung 'khor// zhes pa'i skabs ltar/ phra zhib kyi dmigs pa ma zin yang skyabs yul du bzhugs nas yod nges snyam pa'i dmigs 'dun rgyun chags su mthud pa la rtog pa gzhan gyis bar ma chod par skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rnams sngar sprod pa ltar bya/ de nas sbyor ba'i don drug pa sgrib sbyong ni/ rang nyid tha mal du gnas pa'i spyi bor padma dang zla ba'i gdan la bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa yum rdo rje snyem ma sku mdog dmar mo gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum la 'khor sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ badzra satwa sa pa ri wā ra sa ma dzaḥdzaḥbadzra satwa sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ

la sogs pas mchod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥzhes gnyis su med par bsams nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes pa dang ltung ba dam tshig dang 'gal ba'i nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab pas rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi sku gsung thugs las ye shes kyi chu rgyun dkar dmar sngon po dpag tu med pa babs pas rang nyid kyi spyi gtsug tu zhugs nas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par bsam/ yang yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas byang sems dkar dmar babs pas lus thams cad gang nas bde stong phril phril rgyud la skyes par bsam/ de nas bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du sku dkar po'i mtha' mar sngags gyi phreng bas bskor ba la dmigs nas/ badzra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ badzra he ru ka twe no pa tiṣṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha/ a nu rakto me bha/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ sarba siddhimme pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me cittaṃ shre yaṃḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān badzra he ru ka mā me muñtsa badzra he ru ko bha wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bzla/ de nas thun 'jog pa'i dus su/ badzra satwa sa pā ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod nas/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yi// dam tshig la ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyobs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// sku gsung thugs rtsa ba yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so// sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum rang la thim par

bsam mo // de'i ngang la sems las ma mang bar dmigs pa gang bde gcig la sems gtad nas mos pa rgyun chags 'dun pa rjes 'brel gyi ngang nas thun bar yang gtad yal du ma song bar sems nang du khug la ci gnas su dmigs 'dun gtod cig / ces bsgom tshul slob pa dang maṇḍal gtor 'bul smon lam gdab par bya'o// nyi ma gsum pa'i chos thun bsgom bya dmigs thun dang bcas pa'o// bzhi pa la tshig mtshams sbyor ba'i skabs nas/ yang sngon du smos pa rje dwags po'i bka' srol slob ma snod ldan rnams la mi la nas brgyud pa'i khrid srol 'di rdo rje theg pa bla med kyi lam srol phyin ci ma log pa yin zhing 'di la'ang*/ spros med lhan cig skyes sbyor dang spros bcas thabs lam rtsa rlung gi gdams pa gnyis su yod cing*/ dang po ni/ rgya gar gyi lugs la sa ra ha rjes 'brang gi bka' srol dang spros med rdo rje'i sde mchan 'di te lo'i gaṅgā ma la sogs yin/ 'di dang mtshungs pa grub pa sde bdun do ha mdzod brgyad snying po skor drug a ma ṇa si ka ra'i chos skor sogs/ mchan/ bdun gyi rjes su 'brangs nas phyag rgya chen po'i nyams khrid la brten nas rang sems ngo sprod pa la gzhi khrid dam rgyu dus kyi gdams pa'i ming du byas nas rgan gzhon rtsa rlung dar rgud thams cad la gdab pa'i bka' srol dang*/ rtogs pa de gong 'phel du bogs dbyung zhing mthar 'don pa la na tshod dang lang tsho smin pa dbang po dar zhing lus stobs rgyas pa la rtsa rlung gi gdams pa dang*/ brgyud pa'i bka' srol 'dzin nus pa la snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa ster ba'i lam khrid kyi srol gnyis ka rje dwags po'i phyag bzhes su nges pas/ gdams pa de dag gi brgyud pa'i bka' bab ji ltar byung ba la gsum/ smin grol tshang la ma nor ba'i don brgyud tai lo nā ro nas brgyud pa dang*/ spros med phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes kho na ngo sprod pa sa ra ha nas brgyud pa dang*/

de dang tshul mtshungs pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i brgyud rim gzhan smros pa'o// dang po ni/ chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen po he ru ka de nyid kyi drung du yum chos sku ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mas gsol ba btab cing gdams ngag zhus pas/ rdo rje 'chang gi zhal nas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi yang dag gsang ba'i mchog /ces pa nas/ gus btud nas ni ye shes mkha' 'gro nyon// zhes sogs gsungs nas gdams ngag ma lus pa gnang*/ de nas bde mchog rdo rje phreng ba'i rgyud le'u drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i le'u bcu gsum pa las/ bden gnyis mtha' dang bral ba'i tai lo pa// rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la mkhas pa ni// de bzhin gshegs pas sprul sku khyod lung bstan// khyod kyi bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa yin// zhes lung bstan pa'i dpal bde mchog 'khor lo'i sprul pa'i sku de nyid shar phyogs dza gor bya bar yab bram ze gsal ba yum bram ze gsal ldan ma bya ba la sku 'khrungs te bltams ma thag tu dza gor gyi yul de nyi ma shar ba lta bu'i 'od kyi nyin mtshan med par gyur to// de'i phyir mtshan du gsal 'od ces gsol nas yum gyis bskyangs te sku nar son nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas lung bstan te nub phyogs o rgyan du byon zhing sprul pa brgyad bstan nas gcig 'og min du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang la chos thams cad zung 'jug ngo bo nyid du zhus/ gcig rdo rje snying po la gsang sngags kyi chos zung 'jug ngo bo nyid du zhu/ gcig bya rgod phung po'i ri la rgyal ba shākya thub pa la pha rol tu phyin pa zung 'jug ngo bo nyid du zhus/ rtsa ba'i sprul sku nyid ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma la bsten pa ste 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bla ma bzhi/ yang bzhi sprul te/ byang phyogs ri ma la yar tsārya pa la 'pho ba'i bka' bab/ nub phyogs o rgyan du la ba pa la 'od gsal gyi bka' bab/
