mdor na rang gis blangs pa'i so thar dang byang sems dang sngags kyi sdom pa nyams len rnams tshe 'di pa'i chags sdang gi dbang du ma song ba zhig dgos/ tshe 'di'i bya bzhag thams cad ci red red du btang nas las kyi rnam smin mi bsags pa zhig dgos/ de rnams byung na tshe blos thengs pa yin no// de theng na las rgyu 'bras kyi blang dor lag thog tu lon pa yin no// de ltar gdams ngag gi sngon 'gro dal 'byor rnyed dka' 'chi ba mi rtag pa 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs las rgyu 'bras kyi blang dor 'di rnams sgom byed pa'i bya bral ku su lu rnams kyis kyang zhib par shes dgos/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos bla ma'i man ngag las gsungs pa rnams bla ma'i zhal nas rgyas par thos par bya/ mched grogs la rtsad gcod/ rang gi yi ger blta/ blo la bzung sems la bkod la go ba dang nges shes gting tshugs pa gcig bya dgos te/ 'di rnams sngon 'gro zer nas dang po zhig dgos phyis nas mi dgos pa min/ khang mkhar gyi rming sngon la bting kyang phyis khang mkhar mthar phyin pa'i tshe na rming la 'chug 'gul med pa zhig ma byung na khang pa mi brtan pa dang 'dra/ sngon 'gro 'di rnams kyang dang po chos thams cad kyi sngon du dgos kyang phyis chos pa mthar thug byung ba'i tshe na sngon 'gro 'di rnams kyi go rtogs gong nas gong du 'phel zhing brtan pa zhig dgos/ de ma byung na chos pa chen por grags pa rnams kyang sngon 'gro'i chos 'di rnams la nges shes ma skyes pa dang*/ skyes kyang dran shes bzhin ma bsrung bas so thar gyi sdom pa shor ba byang sems kyi bslab pa dral ba sngags kyi dam tshig nyams pa 'jig rten gyi dmag dpon sogs sdig pa'i las la zhugs pa sa steng 'dir byung ngo cog rnams sngon 'gro'i chos 'di rnams la dang po nges shes ma skyes pa dang skyes kyang phyin chad gnyen po ma brten pa las byung ba yin pas sngon 'gro dal 'byor rnyed dka' sogs 'di rnams re re la'ang nges shes drag po snying nas skyes pa'i chos mdzad kun tshe gcig gis sku don grub pa sha stag byung*/

dman pa'i sa bzung*/ hrul po'i gos gyon/ ri'i bu byas/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba thams cad rgyab tu skyur/ brtson 'grus yengs med kyi 'khor los mnyam bzhag rjes thob kyi nyams len rnams la skad cig kyang 'da' ba med par nyams su blangs pas tshe gcig gis sangs rgyas thob pa bod kyi mi la ras pa dang rgyal ba lo rgod gnyis lta bu'am pu to ba rin chen gsal dang kha rag sgom chung lta bu yin no// de yang sngon 'gro rgyud la skyes pa'i tshad ji tsam la 'jog na/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' go bas lus 'di'i steng nas dus gtan gyi 'dun ma bsgrub pa gcig dgos/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa rgyud la skyes pas le lo dang rnam g.yeng dang snang shas dang bag med pa thams cad rgyab tu dor nas long med kyi brtson 'grus drag pos nyams len gyi drod myur du skye ba zhig dgos/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang las rgyu 'bras kyi blang dor rgyud la skyes pas khams gsum 'khor ba'i bde 'byor thams cad skyug nad can gyis zas mthong ba ltar dor zhing skye 'chis gting nas 'jigs pas sha btson dong nas bros pa lta bu'i nges 'byung drag pos rgyud bskul ba zhig dgos/ de'i phyir sdig to mi dge ba'i las thams cad 'chi ba srog la bab kyang spyad mi phod pa zhig dgos/ de rnams byung na sngon 'gro rgyud la skyes pa yin no// chos kyi gzhi thengs pa yin no// thar lam gyi srog shing tshugs pa yin no// de lta bu'i nges 'byung gi sdud so ji ltar byed snyam na/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tai lo pa chen po'i zhal nas/ kye ma 'jig rten chos la legs rtog dang*// brtag mi thub ste rmi lam sgyu ma 'dra// rmi lam sgyu ma don la yod ma yin// des na skyo ba bskyed la 'jig rten bya ba thong*// 'khor yul chags sdang 'brel ba kun chod la// gcig pur nags kyi 'dabs sam ri khrod dgon par bsgoms// bsgom du med pa'i ngang la gnas par gyis// thob med thob na phyag rgya chen po thob// ces gsungs pas mdo don snying por bsdu na/

thabs shes zung 'brel du nyams su len pa pi'u wang gi sgra lta bu'i gdams ngag la don rnam pa bzhi/ 'khor ba 'di sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du khyer shes pa gcig gal che/ sdug bsngal de lam du 'khyer shes pa gcig gal che/ lam dngos po dang mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i blo dang bral ba gcig gal che/ blo bral gyi don de ka mthar thug 'bras bu chos kyi sku yin par ngo shes par bya ba gal che'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar man ngag nyams len du dril nas sgrub pa lag tu blangs pa'i tshul la/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro gsal btab la/ kun rdzob byang sems kyi skabs su blo sbyong gi spyi don gsum pa rkyen ngan byang chub kyi lam du bsgyur ba la bsam sbyor gnyis kyi dang po la kun rdzob byang sems kyis bsgyur ba ni/ 'di ltar sdig las kyi 'bras bu snod kyi 'jig rten 'byor ba nyams pa bcud kyi sems can ma rungs par gyur nas chos kyi gegs dang sgrub pa'i bar chad bsam sbyor bzang po'i 'gal rkyen du gyur nas sdug bsngal gnad la bab pa'i tshe lam du 'khyer tshul la/ skyon de thams cad rang gi don du med pa la yod par bzung ba'i ngar 'dzin gyi 'gong po 'dis chags sdang gi phyogs ris mang po bcad pa las byung ste/ spyod 'jug las/ 'jig rten dag na 'tshe ba gang yod dang*// 'jigs dang sdug bsngal ji snyed yod gyur pa// de kun bdag tu 'dzin pa las byung na// 'dre chen de ko bdag la ci zhig bya// zhes gsungs pas/ bdag 'dzin dang yul mi 'dod pa skyes ma thag rang gi ngar 'dzin brtul ba gal che zhing*/ nga bden gyi steng na yus che 'byung*// pho snying rus can yod na ngar 'dzin thul// zhes pa ltar rang rgyud kyi 'dzin stangs lhod kyis btang la spyir sems can thams cad thog ma med pa'i pha ma drin can yin la de bas kyang kho la brten nas sbyin pa btang ba bzod pa bsgom pa byang chub tu sems bskyed pa sogs thar pa'i cha rkyen tshang la ma nor ba'i mthun rkyen 'grub pa'i bka' drin can kho nar nges 'dug pas drin lan dngos su phan ma nus kyang byams pa dang snying rje drag po'i sgo nas bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i gtong len dang bsam sbyor bzang po bya dgos snyam du bsam mo//

chos thun mang po sogs dgos pa yod na skabs 'dir thar rgyan gyi byams snying rje'i le'u dang khrid yig chen snying rje'i skabs sogs bshad nas sems can drin che bar blta'o// 'di la brten nas rgyal ba rnams kyang sangs rgyas pa'i rgyu byung bas bdag la'ang sangs rgyas kyi rgyur bka' drin che ste/ spyod 'jug las/ sems can rnams dang rgyal ba las// sangs rgyas chos 'grub 'dra ba la// rgyal la gus byed de bzhin du// sems can la min ci'i tshul// zhes gsungs/ 'di rnams rtsa tshig las/ snod bcud sdig pas gang ba'i tshe// rkyen ngan byang chub lam du bsgyur// le len thams cad gcig la bda'// kun la bka' drin che bar bsgoms// zhes pa'i don rnams bsgoms/ de nas sngar bzhin gnad gsum gyi srang la 'grim zhing dmigs pa ting nge 'dzin gyi gnad la/ rgyal ba u rgyan pa'i zhal nas/ rtog pa mang yang sems kyi rang gzugs yin pas ci yang mi lto/ rtog pa skyon du bltas na sgom su la 'ong*/ rtog pa sngar bas mang ba skyes na dga' snyam pa gyis la skyes tshad ngos zung la rgya yan du ma shor bgyis/ de'ang rtog pa gcig skyes gnyis skyes ngos 'dzin pa min pa bzo bcos gang yang mi dgos/ rtog pa mang ba de sgom skye ba'i snga ltas yin/ rtog pa nyams su len mi shes pa'i sgom chen de me mdag thal bas g.yog pa dang 'dra/ chos rje rgod tshang pas/ ngas dang po nas rtog pa 'ba' zhig la nyams len byas zhi gnas kyi rlan rang chen po ma byung gsungs pas rtog pa la skyon du ma lta bar g.yo skol za dus thams cad lus gnad lta stangs ma 'chug pa gyis gsungs/ de la mus pa rin yes/ bdag gi rdo rje skyil krung yun ring mi zug par gda'/ lta stangs la'ang mig tsha ba dang mig nas mchi ma mang po 'ong zhing en tsam las mi zug snying rus byas kyang rtogs pa la phan rgyu rang ma byung zhu ba la 'di skad gsungs/

kho de/ 'o na gzhan tshos lus gnad lta stangs la sogs pa'i ju gal tsho byas na khyod la rtsol med du 'ong ba'i sgom bzang po gtang mkhan mi 'ong las che/ rje btsun chen po mi la ras pa'i zhal nas/ gnad du ma song ba'i sems 'dzin dka'// rlan las ma skyes pa'i me tog dka'// zhes gsungs shing khong gis kyang zwa tshwa med gsol nas spre'u'i 'phong bzhin song song du bsgom pa yin/ 'phong du ma tsam na ba dang*/ mig dam dum tsha ba dang*/ rked pa dam dum na bas de'i steng du bsgom mi nus pa'i bem po zur gsum zhig gyon/ gru thum zhig rgyab tu khur/ rgyal khams rang 'thag bzhin du bskor nas sangs rgyas thob pa'i gdams pa de dka' ba yin pas tshol dang*/ gal te ma rnyed par song na grub thob gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar la nyon/ mdzad spyod la som/ khyod snyam na phyag rgya chen po de sla mo zhig yin snyam yang pha rol tu phyin par bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags sgrib pa sbyang dgos par bshad pa yin/ bcom ldan 'das kyi skyes rabs mdzad pa bcu gnyis de kun dam dum thos thang ba yin/ byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus chos tshol bar ju gal tsam byas 'dug bka' brgyud gong ma rnams kyis ci tshug mdzad 'dug /khyod mig tsha ba dang 'phong na bas 'chi dwogs med/ blo 'khris med du bsgyur nas zug gi steng na rdzi nus na lus gnad bcas pa'i na zug kun ar sang la 'gro/ blo 'khris med du skyur mi nus pa'i gces 'dzin can yus po che de tsher ma re zug kyang 'o brgyal po 'ong*/ gsang spyod 'ong mi 'ong gi khyad par yang blo 'khris med du skyur nus mi nus kyi khyad par yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar lus sems ma bde ba'i nyams la thog 'gel byas la blo de nyid kyi steng du spang blang med par 'jog shes pa'i nyams len mdzod cig / byas la brda bkrol zhing maṇḍal gtor 'bul smon lam gdab pa sogs bya'o// nyin ya byas pa'i nyi ma bcu gsum chos thun dgu yin no//

༈ chos thun bcu pa la 'di yan gyi skabs su lhag par khrid gnyer gyi nan tan du nyams lta nyul ma byas pas gsar rnying gang la'ang lus sems kyi gze reg mang po ldang ba'i dus yin la/ lhag par gsar pa bsgrim pa la col 'don drag po byas pa rnams rang dpang mi 'du ba'i 'phro rgod kyi slong 'byung skabs yin pas de gcun pa'i rtags snang shin tu bzang ba'i rtsub 'di la sprad nas bzhag thabs kyi so bsgyur ba'i 'jog lugs bslab pas 'jur mdud kyi rtsub zing rang sar zhi nas nyams la rang byan chog pa 'byung ba'i man ngag dam pa yin no// de nas sngar bzhin tshig gi mtshams sbyor byas pa'i skabs nas/ gnyis pa yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis zin pa bdag po'i rkyen gyi man ngag bla ma brten tshul la bzhi/ gang zag brgyud pa'i bla ma/ bde gshegs bka'i bla ma/ snang ba brda'i bla ma/ rang rig pa chos nyid kyi bla ma ste/ khrid yig chen mor/ bla ma bzhi yis zin pa bdag po'i rkyen// zhes gsungs pa'i thog mar gang zag brgyud pa'i bla ma la bzhi/ gsol 'debs nus pa/ 'gal bsgyur nus pa/ ma 'khrul pa/ go 'byed nus pa'o// bla ma de dag gi gdams pa la bde gshegs bka'i bla ma gtso bor bzung nas ma 'khrul ba dmigs pa'i rkyen gyi man ngag la gnyis te/ chos spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid do// de'ang khrid yig chen mor/ dmigs rkyen bsgom bya'i dmigs pa ma 'khrul pa// zhes gsungs pas/ chos spyi dang mi 'gal ba rang gi mtshan nyid nyams su len pa la/ sngar dmigs thun du smos pa'i spyi don gnyis pa chos lam du 'gro ba la sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi sbyor ba ni bdun las/ dang po gsum cung zad bshad zin nas bzhi pa thun mong du skyabs su 'gro ba'i yan lag ni bzhi ste/ yul gang la/ gang zag gang gis/ tshul ji ltar/ dgos ched ci'i phyir ro// de la dang po yul ni dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum/

gang zag ni lam tshol ba po rnams so// tshul ni las dang po pa la bslab bya dang bcas pa bstan/ de ltar ma yin na dben pa'i gnas su gzhan phan kho na'i blos mdun gyi nam mkhar rten bde bar gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor sprul te/ bdun rnam dag bya zhing skyabs su 'gro ba ni dad pa brtan po dang ldan pa gal che ste/ chos bcu pa'i mdo las/ dad pa med pa'i mi rnams la// dkar po'i yon tan mi 'byung ste// sa bon me yis 'tshig pa la// myu gu sngon mo mi 'byung ltar// zhes gsungs pas shin tu gdung shugs drag po'i sgo nas skyabs su 'gro bar bya'o// dgos ched ni/ dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ ma rig pas slar nges par ni// 'gro ba dmyal sogs 'jigs pa che// de phyir sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun// rdzu 'phrul chen 'dir rjes chags bya// zhes gsungs pas/ spyir 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po la 'jigs pas sangs rgyas la ston pa/ chos la lam/ dge 'dun la lam bsgrub pa'i zla grogs btsal ba'o// bye brag tu sngon gyi las dang 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i bdud dang bdud kyi rigs su gyur pa dag gi bar chad kyis mi tshugs shing yon tan gyi tshogs gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i dgos pa'o// chos thun mang po dgos pa'i long skabs long na 'di nas thar rgyan gyi skyabs 'gro'i le'u dang khrid yig chen mo'i skyabs 'gro'i thun dmigs sogs skabs la gang bab bshad nas 'di rnams re re la'ang chos thun byas pas chog / lnga pa thun mong du sems bskyed pa'i yan lag ni bzhi ste/ yul gang la/ gang zag gang gis/ tshul ji ltar/ dgos ched ci'i phyir du'o// de la dang po yul ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las/ las dang po pa'i byams pa ni sems can la dmigs pa'o// zhes gsungs pa'o// gang zag ni/ theg pa chen po'i lam tshol ba po rnams so// tshul ji ltar du sems bskyed pa ni/

mgon po byams pa'i zhal nas/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir// yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod// ces gsungs pas 'di ltar khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur pa'i sems can thams cad thog ma med pa'i dus nas 'o skol rnams kyi pha ma drin can yin pas/ de'ang pha ma drin can de rnams kyi byas pa drin du gzo bar bya dgos te/ bdag cag rnams kyi dus da lta'i pha ma 'di dag ji ltar drin che ba de bzhin du thog ma med pa'i dus kyi pha ma rnams kyang de ltar drin che bas/ thog ma med pa'i mdo las/ sems can re re thams cad kyis// yang du yang du ma byas shing*// nu zho blud pa bsags na yang*// phyi'i rgya mtsho bas kyang mang*// sems can re re thams cad kyis// yang dang yang du pha byas shing*// rta dang glang po byin pa yang*// 'jig rten khams su shong mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas pha ma drin can de dag gis gdod ma nas chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa yin pa la de ltar ma rtogs pas 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen por 'khyams pa ye ma rung snyam pa'i blos drin can 'di rnams gnas skabs su bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral/ chags sdang nye ring med pa'i btang snyoms la gnas par bya zhing*/ mthar thug bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god par bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pas bdag gi bde dge gzhan la sbyin pa dang gzhan gyi sdug bsngal bdag la len pa sogs byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa tshad med pa la gnas par bya ste/ phyag rgya chen po ye shes thig le las/ sems can don du bsod nams gzhan// che ba gang ni yang ni med// rang don sgrub pa bsod nams min// skyes bu chen po 'di lta bus// rang don ma rungs pa ni dor// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs rgyal po nam mkhar gyur pa'i tshe/ bdag gis byang chub rings tshul du// 'tshangs rgyar mos shing spro ba med// phyi mtha' thug gi bar du yang*/

sems can gcig phyir spyad par bgyi// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis mgon po 'od dpag tu med pa'i drung du/ dam bcas pa ltar rang don du yang dmigs pa med pas gzhan don kho na'i spyad pa spyod pa la brtson par bya'o// dgos ched ni/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyi zhal nas/ bdag nyid dang ni 'jig rten 'dir// bla med byang chub thob 'dod na// de'i rtsa ba byang chub sems// zhes gsungs pas theg pa chen po'i rigs su 'gyur zhing don gnyis kyi dpal la spyod pa'i phyir ro// mchan/ dgos na 'dir yang thar rgyan gyi sems bskyed le'u dang khrid yig chin mo'i sems bskyed kyi thun dmigs bshad do // drug pa sgrib sbyong gi cho ga ni/ bdag cag rnams kyi thog ma med pa'i dus nas da lta 'di nyid kyi bar du mtshams med pa lnga la sogs pa rang bzhin dang bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba las gyur pa'i rnam par smin pa'i las ji ltar yod mi shes te de dag sbyang bar ma byas na 'dir rdo rje theg pa bla na med pa'i lam gyi bar du gcod cing yon tan gyi tshogs mi skye ba'i rgyu byed pas de dag bshags shing sbyang ba ni thog mar dkon mchog gi mchod pa dang stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags shing rjes su rdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor bya ste/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ rig pa'i rgyal po 'di bzlas pas// ltung dang dri ma thams cad kun// lan gcig tsam gyis dag par byed// ces gsungs pas na thun bzhi'i mnyam par bzhag cing rtags dang mtshan ma thams cad brnyes par bya'o// mchan/ dgos na skabs 'dir yang khrid yig chen mo'i sgrib sbyong gi thun dmigs bshad do // bdun pa tshogs bsags pa'i yan lag ni/ yul gang la/ gang zag gang gis/ tshul ji ltar/ dgos ched ci'i phyir/ de la dang po yul ni dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la'o// gang zag ni gsang ba bla na med pa'i lam rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i dngos grub thob par 'dod pa dag gi'o// gsum pa tshul ni gnyis te/

rgyud dag par byed pa dang sngags kyi rten du byed pa'o// thog mar rgyud dag par byed pa'i yan lag bdun te/ de'ang bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po bde bar gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor du nye bar sprul pa'i mdun du nga rgyal dang khengs pa spang bar bya ba'i phyir phyag 'tshal ba'i yan lag ni/ lus dag par bya ba'i phyir/ phyag dang bskor ba bya/ ngag dag pa bstod dbyangs rgya mtshos bstod cing gsol ba gdab/ yid dag par byed pa ser sna dang zhen chags spang bar bya ba'i phyir mchod pa 'bul ba'i yan lag ste/ dngos 'byor yid kyi sprul pa la sogs lus dang longs spyod kha rje dbang thang cung zad phra ba'i cha tsam la'ang ltos pa med par bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor la mchod par bya zhing khyad par du sngags kyi rten 'brel gyi gnad yin pas rig ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa drug cu rtsa bzhis mchod cing me tog dor zhing smon lam gdab bo// zhe sdang dang khong khro spang bar bya ba'i phyir sdig pa bshags pa'i yan lag dang*/ phrag dog dang 'gran sems spang bar bya ba'i phyir bdag gzhan gyi dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ gti mug dang rmongs pa spang bar bya ba'i phyir chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba dang*/ phyin ci log dang lta log spang bar bya ba'i phyir mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs su gsol ba dang*/ bla na med pa'i byang chub tu 'gro bar bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo ba'o// gzhan yang dkon mchog gi mchod pa rgya chen po dang*/ rten gsum byin rlabs can gyi mdun du smon lam gdab/ dge 'dun la chos ston dang*/ 'gro drug la sbyin gtong dang*/ 'byung po la gtor sbyin rgya chen po bya/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i thun bzung ba dang*/ tsha tsha 'debs pa la sogs bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po spel lo// mchan/ skabs 'dir dgos pa yod na khrid yig chen mo'i maṇḍal gyi thun dmigs btsud nas 'chad/

sngags kyi rten du byed pa ni/ thog mar so sor thar pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya dang*/ bya spyod rnal 'byor gyi sdom pa rnams rim pa ltar bskyed cing tshul bzhin du bzung bar bya'o// sngar thos pa rnams kyang dri ma med par byas la bzung ngo*// de ltar yang*/ dgyes pa rdo rje las/ thog mar gso sbyong sbyin par bya// de nas bslab pa'i gnas bcu dang*// de la bye brag smra ba bstan// mdo sde pa yang de bzhin no// sngags kyi rim pa kun shes nas// de rjes kye yi rdo rje bslab// ces gsungs pa'i don no// bzhi pa dgos ched ni gang dag sngon gyi bsod nams rab tu dman pas zab mo 'di nyid du 'jug pa'i skal ba dang mi ldan pas bar chad chen po'i rkyen byed pas te/ de dag bsod nams dang ldan pa dang bstan du rung zhing skal ba dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir te/ dgyes pa rdo rje las/ gzhan du brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus thabs bstan pa dang*// bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes gsungs pa dang ston pa bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi shing drung du srod la bdud btul/ gung la mnyam par gzhag /tho rangs la sangs rgyas pa'i skad cig la shing ta la bdun srid kyi nam mkha' la 'phags te ched du brjod pa ni/ bsod nams rnam smin bde ste sdug bsngal thams cad sel// bsod nams ldan pa'i mi la bsam pa rnams kyang 'grub// bdud bcom nas ni myur du byang chub reg par 'gyur// mya ngan 'das pa zhi ba'i dngos po'ang thob par 'gyur// des na bsod nams bya bar chog par su zhig 'dzin// zhes rgya cher gsungs pa'i don no// de ltar rgyud sbyang ba'i sngon 'gro thun mong pa dang theg pa rim 'jug gi sngon 'gro thun mong ma yin pa de dag gi rtsa ba mdo 'gag gi sdud po ji ltar byed na/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pa'i 'jug 'grel du/

lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo drangs par/ ji ltar nad pa na ba la// sman pas sman ni bstan pa ltar// de bzhin sangs rgyas sems can la// ji tsam bzod pa'i chos bstan te// zhes dang*/ rin chen phreng ba las/ brda sprod pa dag 'jig rten na// yi ge'i phyi mo klog 'jug ltar// de bzhin sangs rgyas sems can la// ci tsam bzod pa'i chos bstan to// kha cig la ni sdig pa las// rnam par bzlog pa'i chos bstan to// kha cig bsod nams gsog bya'i phyir// kha cig la ni gnyis bstan te// kha cig la ni gnyis med bstan// stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can// zab mo khu mkhrig can 'jigs pa// byang chub sems dpa' kha cig la'o// zhes dang*/ bzhi brgya par/ bsod nams ma yin dang po bzlog /bar du bdag ni bzlog pa ste// tha ma lta ba kun bzlog pa// gang gis shes de mkhas pa yin// zhes gsungs pas mdo don snying por bsdu na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa la thun mong gi drod tshad 'dzin pa sman pa lta bu'i gdams ngag la don bzhi/ tshe 'di las blo sna 'gyur nas 'jig rten chos brgyad dang bral dgos pa yin// 'khor ba las blo sna 'gyur nas 'dod yon gyi bde ba la ro mi myong ba dgos pa yin/ rang don las blo 'gyur nas gzhan don gtso bor byed pa zhig dgos pa yin/ 'khrul pa'i gzhi rtsa chod nas dngos po dang mtshan mar 'dzin pa thams cad las grol dgos pa yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar sngon 'gro bzhi pa de ma thag pa'i rkyen ni gnyis te/ khrid yig chen mor/ de ma thag rkyen re dwogs spang blang dang*// dgag sgrub med par gang shar skyong ba'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar man ngag nyams len du dril nas sgrub pa lag tu blang ba'i tshul la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro gsal btab la kun rdzob byang sems kyi skabs so// gnyis pa don dam byang sems kyi sgo nas rkyen ngan lam du bsgyur ba ni/

yul yid du mi 'ong ba'i sdug bsngal dang rkyen ngan thams cad rang sems 'khrul pa'i snang ba yin la de nyid kyang rang bzhin ma grub pas ye shes yin te/ ngo bo la bltas pas skye med chos sku 'gag med longs sku gnas med sprul sku/ de rnams dbyer med de ngo bo nyid kyi sku yin pas mi spong bar ro snyoms shing lam du khyer ba yin te/ rtsa tshig las/ 'khrul snang sku bzhir bsgom pa yi// stong nyid srung ba bla na med// ces gsungs pa'i don dang*/ gnyis pa sbyor ba khyad par can bsags sbyong gi rkyen ngan lam du bsgyur ba ni bzhi las/ rang la sdig sdug gi khur gyis dub nas bde skyid la smon pa'i sems skyes na bde ba'i rgyu tshogs bsags pa'i thabs la 'bad cing dngos po gang yod kyi yo byad la chags sems med par mchod pa dang*/ tshogs bsags bya zhing dge ba'i phyogs su gtong*/ maṇḍal gyi cho ga bya/ sdig sdug la sun pa'i blo skyes na gnyen po stobs bzhi'i sgo nas nyes pa ma dag gi bar du sdig bshags tshad du longs pa dang sgrib sbyong gi cho ga bya/ lhag par gdon gyis nyen par gyur na rang gis byas pa'i sngon bsags ngan pa'i las ngan sor chud thub pa'i gtong len dang*/ snying rje sgom zhing gang 'os kyi gtor ma 'bul/ rgyu 'bras bslu med ston zhing rang nyid kyang chos la blo khel ba'i dpang por chos skyong srung ma rnams la gtor ma 'bul/ sbyor ba bzhi po kun la thun mong gi 'dod gsol du rab gtong len kyi nus pa slar yang smin thub pa'i gsol ba gdab/ 'bring bdag na ba sos pa shi ba gang legs mdzod ces re dwogs 'gog pa'i gsol ba gdab/ tha ma lam gyi sgrub pa mthar phyin zhing bar chad sel nas phyin chad gnod len du phan 'dogs nus pa'i gsol ba gdab bo// yang 'phral du yid la mi 'dod pa'i nad gdon dgra rnams shar ba'i tshe de rnams 'ub kyis rang la bsdu zhing gzhan la snying rje bsgom/

spyod lam rnam bzhi kun slong dag pa'i dge rtsas sbyong*/ re dwogs kyi blo nam skyes dgra zin gyi tshul du sbyang ba 'dis shing gi 'khyog bsrang ba dang 'dra zhes glang ri thang pas gsungs so// de ni rtsa tshig las/ sbyor ba bzhi ldan thabs kyi mchog /'phral du gang thub sgom du sbyar// zhes pa'i don rnams bsgom mo// de nas sngar bzhin gnad gsum gyi srang la 'grim zhing dmigs pa ting nge 'dzin gyi gnad ni/ de ring phan chad ma zin pa zin par byed pa'i thabs spros bcas thams cad kyi tshabs su dus gsum spros med du dril nas ngos zin par bya phyir gang shar gyi ngo bo la sgrim par byed pa'i dmigs pa bslab pa de ltar yin/ de'ang snyan brgyud rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ sgo gsum g.yo med sgo lnga rang thang bzhag /bltas pas mthong med sems kyi mtshan nyid ltos// dmigs su med pa ma bcos rang sar zhog /gzhan du ma tshol ngo bo mthong bar gyis// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// de ltar sems kyi yon tan dmigs bcas bla ma la brten nas sems 'dzin pas rtsa rlung thig le gsum la bar chad mi 'byung zhing thig le la brten pas rlung sems kyi gnad kyis lus la bde ba phebs shing mnyen pa dang*/ mi dmigs pa la sems 'dzin pa'i yon tan sbyang ba la brten pas dngos 'dzin gyi 'khrul pa mi skye zhing stong pa la brten pas sems ngal sos zhing rang gnas su gnas par byed de dbus mtha' las/ dmigs pa la ni brten nas kyang*// mi dmigs pa nyid rab tu skye// zhes pa dang*/ tai lo pas/ lta stangs sems 'dzin yan lag du ma yis// rig pa ngang la mi gnas bar du gcun// zhes dang*/ blo 'das dbyer med don de rtogs 'dod na// rang sems rtsa ba chod la rig pa gcer bur zhog /rtog pa dri ma'i chu de dwangs su chug /ces gsungs pa'i don no// da ni spyi don gnyis pa zin pa brtan par byed pa'i rim pa bsgom par bya ste/

'di la'ang sngar bshad pa ltar bye brag gi dmigs pa mang du 'byung ba'i rnam grangs rgyal ba'i dbang po'i khrid yig chen mor 'byung ba ltar te/ rtsa tshig tu/ zin pa brtan byed snying por padma ni// dkar nag gnyis la thig le dkar nag gnyis// bying rgod dang bstun ci rigs bsgom pa'am// rgyun du spel nas bsgom par bya ba'o// yang na 'jog dang kun 'jog nges 'jog dang*// nye bar 'jog dang dul byed nyer zhi byed// rgyud gcig byed dang mnyam 'jog gnas thabs dgu// ces gsungs pa ci lta ba khrid rim rnams la yod cing de'i dang po'i dmigs pa steng du bcing pa tshangs pa gtsug rgyan gyi ting nge 'dzin dang 'og tu bcing pa sa 'og spyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang spel ma'i rnal 'byor sogs gtso bor de rnams bying rgod kyi gegs sel kho na yin zhing rgya ras kyi man ngag rtsa tshig las/ bying na 'dug sa bsil bar bya// zhes sogs thabs kyi cha nas kyang bcos thabs mang po 'byung zhing grub chen nyid kyi rtsa ba'i khrid yig las skabs 'dir bying rgod kyi gegs sel dang rlung bum pa can dang rdor bzlas kyang gsungs shing*/ gzhan yang sems gnas pa'i thabs dgu dang*/ nyes pa lnga'i gnyen por spang ba'i 'du byed brgyad/ stobs drug yid byed bzhi'i sgrub pa rnams dang mthun pa sogs ni mdo sde las 'byung ba'i bsgom tshul mdo sde rgyan dang dbus mtha' dang nyan sa sogs nas bshad pa yin zhing skabs don de thams cad kyi gnad tshang zhing yon tan thams cad bskyed pa'i thabs sngar smros pa'i gegs sel bogs 'don thams cad kyi mchog klod pa 'di ston pas shes par bya'o// de'ang sa ra ha'i zhal nas/ bcing pa dag ni phyogs bcur 'gro bar brtsam// btang bar gyur na mi g.yo brtan par gnas// go ldog rnga mong lta bur bdag gis rtogs// zhes dang*/ rje tai lo pas/ ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang du klod la zhog

/bcings pa klod na grol bar the tshom med// ces gsungs pa dang*/ 'jur bus bcings pa'i sems nyid 'di// klod na grol bar the tshom med// ces dang*/ sems nyid ngal gso las/ dang po lhod kyi klod la zhog /bsam gtan dri ma bsal ba'i phyir// bar du hrig ge ye re ltos// mnyam rjes 'dres par bya ba'i phyir// tha ma tshom tser btang bar bya// zhes dang*/ rje dwags po rin po ches/ e ma rang rig ye shes rtogs 'dod na// ras bal 'dab ma bzhin du klod la zhog /bya ba thong la sems kyi rten ma bca'// shes pa ma dgug rang gar thong la zhog /bying rgod byung na de ga rang la ltos// sems la gnod pa'i las rnams khad kyis spangs// zhe 'dod byung na bdud du shes par gyis// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i don snga rabs kyi gsung rgyun zab mo'i khrid yig las/ gnyis pa klod pa ni/ 'khrul 'khor lta stangs sngar dang 'dra ba la lus sems lhod de klod shes pa rang lugs su ci yang mi byed pa'i ngang nas lhod de shig ge bzhag /de'i ngang las ma yengs pa'i dran pa yud de byas pas gsal la rtog pa med pa'i nyams skye ste de'i ngang nas yang rnam rtog gcig khrol gyi skyes pa dang de kho rang gi thog tu klod kyis 'jog pa ste/ rje rgod tshang pas/ yang gcig rnam rtog skyes pa na// ngo yis tsir gyis bzung mdzod la// kho rang thog tu klod la zhog /rang sar grol ba the tshom med// ces gsungs pa dang*/ ma jo mos/ grim gyis bsgrim la lhod gyis klod// shigs kyis bshig la 'bol le bzhag /ces gsungs pa ltar 'di dag ni dmigs pa'i skabs thams cad du nyams len bya zhing rnam par rtog pa gang skyes kyang de ka'i ngo bo la bltas te ma bcos par 'jog pa ma gtogs spang blang re dwogs kyis ma bcings par lhod klod nas 'jog pa gal che'o//

zhes byas la gdams/ yang bying rgod can la de'i gegs sel ni/ rje rang byung rdo rje'i zhal nas/ sems bying na yul snang gi steng du spros// yul de snang stong gi ngo bor ltos// rmugs na rnam rtog yan par thong*// btang sa ru ma yengs dran pas zungs// nyams brgyal na snang ba rlung dang bsres// 'gro 'ong mkha' dang gcig tu bsres// 'thor na rnam rtog dran pas zung*// gang gsal de yi thog tu zhog /nan ltar 'phro na 'phro sar thong*// 'gro sa ma rnyed klod la zhog /rgod na gnyen po'i shes pa de// sdug btsir ma byed klod la zhog /rtog med btang snyoms sgom pa'i mchog /sems kyi gegs sel bsdus pa lags// 'di dag dang rje tai lo pa'i gnyug ma'i lam skyong ba'i gegs sel gnyis gang la gang dgos kyi don bkrol nas bslab la/ zhes gsungs pa 'dis 'byung ba lus 'khrug ma gtogs pa ting nge 'dzin gyi gegs thams cad sel nus par nges so// yang rlung 'dzin pa dang bgrang ba'i don la rlung gi sems zin par bzhed pa la/ rje tai lo pas/ rlung gi gnad bzung rig pa gcud la 'bor// zhes sogs dang*/ sems nyid ngal bsor/ rlung ni gar 'gro der sems 'gro// de lus khyim nang brtson bzung nas// yid kyi skyes bu bsad byas na// de med sems ni gang du 'gro// zhes sogs bzhed tshul mang ba ltar mtshan bcas thabs kyi lam khrid las shes par bya zhing*/ 'dir sems kyi rlung zin par bzhed pa'ang shin tu mang ste/ dpal sa ra ha'i zhal nas/ mkha' 'dra byas na rlung ni rnam par 'ching*// mnyam nyid yongs su shes pa rab tu thim// mda' bsnun gyis smras nam zhig nus ldan na// mi rtag g.yo ba myur du spang bar 'gyur// zhes sogs dang*/ chos grags rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i khrid yig nas 'byung*/ mchan/ gzhan yang dngos po gsal ba'i rjes su 'gro ba las kyang 'di bzhin gsungs shing*/ lhan cig skyes grub sogs grub pa sde bdun las nang gi snying rje gsum la brten nas 'jog lugs 'dis rlung dbu mar sdud cing zhu bde bskyed pa'i dga' bzhi'i ye shes dmigs bcas la ma ltos pa skye bas ma rgyud kyi gnad mthar thug 'grub pa dang*/

jo bo rje'i lta sgom spyod gsum do ha mdzod kyi 'grel pa mthar 'byung sbas pas mdzad pa dang*/ rim lnga'i 'od gsal gyi skabs su'ang 'jog tshul 'dis rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa rang sar dag par gsungs pa sogs pha rgyud pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba bden gnyis kyi dgongs don 'di kas 'grub pa'i tshul rgyas par yod pa de dag rnams su rtogs shing shes par bya ste/ gsang 'dus las/ dam pa'i don la dngos po rnams// srid gsum dngos po med par bsgom// dngos po med la bsgom pa dngos// bsgom pa dmigs su med pa'o// zhes dang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnal 'byor du byed pa ni nam mkha' rnal 'byor du byed pa'o// zhes rgyal ba'i yum las kyang gsungs shing*/ tai lo pa chen pos/ sems ni nam mkha' 'dra bar bzung bar bya// zhes kyang gsungs pas na mi rtog rgya yan du bcing tshul 'di dag zab pa kho na rje dwags po rin po che sogs gong ma rnams kyis bzhed pas re zhig 'di ltar bsgom tshul bslab pa'i bzhag thabs 'di ci lta ba bzhin du gang shar klod kyin 'jog pa de kho na yid la nges shing ma brjed par skyong mdzod// byas la brda' bkrol zhing maṇḍal gtor 'bul smon lam gdab pa sogs bya'o// nyin ya byas pa'i nyi ma bco lnga chos thun bcu yin no// ༈ chos thun bcu gcig pa la sngar bzhin tshig gis mtshams sbyor byas nas/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i don bshad pa la gnyis/ skabs 'dir chos lam du 'gro ba'i dngos gzhi ni sngags kyi lam yin pas 'di nyid lam 'khrul pa sel ba'i thabs su phyis byung rnams kyis bzhed cing de ltar bkral ba rgya cher mang yang gzhung 'di nyid kyi dgongs pa dngos la lam 'grul pa sel ba ni rtse gcig dang spros bral gyi rtogs pa mthar phyin pa'o// zhes lan mang du bstan pa ltar rtogs pa ci lta ba bzhin ngo 'phrod cing de goms par byed pa lam gyi 'khrul pa bsal ba yin pas don la bsgom pa'i lam yin pas/

'khrul pa ye shes su shar ba ni ro gcig sgom med kyi rtogs pa mthar phyin pa zhes gsungs pas 'khrul pa'i bag chags rtsad nas spong ba'i rnam grol gyi lam yin no// 'di mtshungs med rje dwags po rang bzhed tshul 'og nas ston to// mchan/ ma smin pa smin par byed pa'i dbang dang*/ smin pa grol bar byed pa'i gdams pa ste/ dang po smin byed dbang ni gnyis las/ rgyud dang 'brel ba gzhung gi dbang dang*/ byin rlabs dang 'brel ba man ngag gi dbang bskur ba'o// dang po ni/ snyan brgyud rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ bslab gsum rgyud ldan nyams myong bla ma la// dad brtson shes rab snying brtse slob ma yis// nyes dmigs dran pas tshe 'di'i bya ba btang*// thog mar 'khor lo sdom pa la brten nas// drug cu rtsa gnyis dkyil 'khor dbang bzhi bskur// lha mo bco lnga'i dbang bzhi brda' yis mtshon// smin par byas la thabs shes zung du sbrel// zhes gsungs pas snyan brgyud rin po che'i skabs don dang 'brel ba bde mchog yab yum gyi dbang bzhi bskur bar bya ste/ de'ang dbang don gyi ye shes bskyed pa'i cha nas rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs thob pa gang yang rung mod kyi rgyud 'di nyid kyi dbang thob na gzhan thob par 'gyur te/ dkyil 'khor 'di ru dbang bskur ba// rgyud rnams kun gyi sgrub por gsungs// zhes so// de'ang sngags kyi dgongs pas tshogs lam nas mthar thug gi bar du gal che bas dbang thams cad lam gyi gzhi yin la/ lam la 'jug par brtsams pa'i lam yang yin no// de lta bu'i spros bcas kyi dbang ni/ rje tai lo pas/ sa'i cho ga lhag par gnas pa rigs dbang slob dpon rigs sbyor rdzogs kyi bum pa'i dbang bskur bya// bslab pas rgyud mdzes thos bsam nor ldan bla mar 'os pa phul la gsang ba la sogs bskur// nyer lnga lhag spang rigs ldan rgyan spras zag bcas bskul sogs gsum las byin rlabs brtul zhugs brten par bya// dga' ba gsum son lhan cig skyes pa rtog pa dang bral yul du byas sogs 'bras bu shes par gyis// zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar sbyang gzhi phung khams skye mched dang bstun nas lus sems 'grub pa'i rim pas skye nas 'chi ba'i bar rnams dang rjes su mthun pa/

'jig rten pa'i dbang bcu dang 'jig rten las 'das pa phyag rgya chen po'i dbang ste/ dang po ni/ 'bum lngar/ byis pa skyes pa ma yis ni// 'khrud byed chu yis dbang bskur ro// de'i gtsug phud rab bzhag pa// dbu rgyan du ni yang dag btags// zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar dang po 'og min gyi srid pa'i mthar thug pa'i dngos grub thob par byed pa bskyed rim bsod nams kyi tshogs la dbang ba'i sngags dang phyag rgya'i cho ga dang ldan pa byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang sngon du 'gro bas mchog gi dngos grub phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes rim bzhin thob par byed pa rdzogs rim ye shes kyi tshogs la dbang ba'i sngags phyag rgya'i cho ga dang ldan pa'i dbang gong ma rnams rim gyis bskur bas brda' thabs de la brten nas sbyang gzhi phung po lnga'i chos nyid kyi steng du sbyang bya nyon mongs pa lnga'i dri ma dag par bya ba'i phyir sbyong byed ye shes lngar ngo sprod nas sangs rgyas rigs lnga'i sngags dang phyag rgya'i tshogs la brten nas lus kyi sgrib pa mtha' dag sbyangs pas sbyangs 'bras sprul sku thob pa bum dbang 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ gnas skabs bzhi'i sgrib pa dag par bya ba'i don du rdzas dang dam tshig dang brda'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas rtsa rlung dang 'bar 'dzag dang ting nge 'dzin rnams bsgom pa la dbang ba'i sngags dang phyag rgya'i cho gas 'bras bu longs sku dang*/ chos sku 'grub pa la dbang ba dbang gong ma rnams bskur la dbang don ngo sprad nas lam la tshul bzhin gzhug par bya ba yin te/ man snyer/ slob dpon slob ma'i bsam shes shing*// rjes su bsten pas sbyin par nus// de'i slob ma bsdu bya yis// rmongs pas slob ma bsdu ba min// zhes gsungs pas slob mas tha mal gyi snang zhen bzlog ste lha sku sgyu ma lta bur bsgoms nas slob dpon gdan gsum tshang ba'i lhas bum dbang bskur ba rgyud la thob shes tsam gyi bum dbang thob la/

slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang dbyer med pa'i snyoms 'jug gi rdzas myong bas tha mal gyi ngag gi zhen pa bral nas grags stong brag cha ltar shes pas gsang dbang thob la phyag rgya gsum gyis bskyed pa'i yas babs kyi dga' bzhi'i ye shes ngos zin nas de la 'jog pas sher dbang thob la/ sgo gsum dang dus gsum rtog bral du bzhag pas gnas lugs ngo 'phrod pas bzhi pa thob pa yin no// 'di la brten nas grol byed kyi lam bum dbang dang 'brel ba brgyud pa yid bzhin nor bu/ gsang dbang dang 'brel ba thabs bzhi'i gnad bzhi sogs bsre ba dgu skor rnams dang*/ sher dbang dang 'brel ba 'og sgo rnam par grol ba/ tshig dbang dang 'brel ba man ngag rtsa ba'i gnad rnams bsgom pa la brten nas rab phrin las bzhi sgrub nus pa/ 'bring lha skur ldang zhing ston nus pa/ tha ma lha'i nga rgyal dang mi 'brel ba bum dbang gi lam dang*/ rab sems can rang rang gi skad du chos ston nus pa/ 'bring sgra skad sna tshogs so sor shes pa/ tha ma ngag nyams skye ba gsang dbang gi lam dang*/ 'jigs smyo de bzhin sdug bsngal dang*// mya ngan gdung bas 'tshe ba dang*// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug ches// sgrub pa po nyid nyon mi mongs// phan dang gnod pa'i 'bras 'byung ba// zhes brtag gnyis las bshad pa lta bu'i drod thob nas rab gnas rigs zhing gsum gyi mi mo dbang du bsdu nus pa/ 'bring dam rgya dang chos kyi phyag rgya la brten nas bde stong gi rtogs pa mnyam rjes med pa/ tha ma bde stong khyad par can mnyam gzhag la yod pas sher dbang gi lam thob la/ rab zad par dang zil gnon mthar phyin te sgom med chen po'i ye shes skyes pa/ 'bring zung 'jug gi rtogs pa brtan pa'am skyes pa ro gcig dang spros bral rtogs pa/ tha ma bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin rtse gcig skyes pas bzhi pa tshig dbang gi lam thob la/

phung khams skye mched la 'du shes 'jug cing sems mngon par 'du byed pa'i bye brag thams cad dang rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyi sbyangs 'bras mngon du gyur pa'i tshogs lam bum dbang dang*/ drod kyi ye shes gsang dbang*/ rtse mo shes rab ye shes chos mchog dbang po lnga'i sgrib pa zil gyis gnon pas bzod pa'ang yin la tshig dbang rnams la'ang sbyar rung ste/ lam la mthong lam la sbyor ba'i phyir dang 'bras bu'i dbang la sbyor ba'i phyir lam gyi dbang zhes bshad do// de nas lus kyi 'khor lo lnga'i rtsa mdud grol/ las rlung brgya phrag bco brgyad pa tshan pa nyi shu 'gags/ thig le thams cad zag med ye shes su gyur nas sku'i sgo dgu 'gag pas yan lag gi rlung lnga la dbang thob/ ro rkyang gnyis dang snying kha'i dbang po'i sgo brgyad kyi rtsa mdud grol bas gsung gi sgo bzhi las su rung bas mgon po dpe med thob/ rlung sems thams cad a wa dhū tir dag pas thugs kyi sgo gnyis bye nas rtsa ba'i rlung ye shes su dag ste dbang phyug gam 'od ldan gyi sar sangs rgyas pa sogs rgyas par thob pa lta bu ni dbang bzhi rdzogs thob pa ste/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ go rim ma nor nyams su blangs gyur na// skad cig bzhi la dga' ba gsum son te// dwangs ma yas byon 'gyur ba mas brten pas// rtsa mdud rim par dral nas ju tir 'gyur// nyi khri gcig stong drug brgya rtsa ba lnga// rlung dang nyon mongs 'gag nas ye shes 'gyur// gnas dang nye gnas nyi shu bzhi la sogs// pu li ma la ya sogs gang bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa'i don lta bu ste rgyas par zab mo thabs kyi lam khrid 'chad pa na zab mo nang don sogs las bshad pa ltar shes par bya'o// de lta bu'i gzhung gi dbang bskur ba de la/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi rgyud las/ dkyil 'khor dag dang mi ldan na// sngags kyi dngos grub grub pa med// ces sogs gsungs pas kun rdzob brda'i dkyil 'khor la brten dgos par bzhed pa'i dbang du na dkyil 'khor la'ang*/

mngon brjod bla ma las/ bri ba'i dkyil 'khor dang po ste// gnyis pa mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor ro// zhes sogs gzugs can gyi dkyil 'khor drug dang*/ slob dpon klu'i blos/ slob ma'i don du 'grub bya'i phyir// dkyil 'khor brgyad rnams bri bar bya// zhes dang*/ rgyud ye shes rgya mtsho las/ dbang bskur dbang po'i bye brag gi /ting 'dzin me tog rdul mtshon rim// zhes dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud las/ dkyil 'khor slob ma rab 'bring tha// ting 'dzin me tog rdul tshon rim// zhes rab ting 'dzin 'bring tshom bu/ tha ma dbang rtul la rdul tshon te/ de'i tshad kyang man snyer/ khru gang dang ni khru do dang*// dpag tshad bye ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*// lag pa'i mthil la bri bas kyang*// slob ma rjes su bzung bar bya// zhes gsungs pas nges par rdul tshon dang sgo 'gyur can kho na dgos pa'i mtha' gcig tu ma nges shing*/ gzugs med kyi dkyil 'khor yang gsum ste/ lus sems bha ga dang byang sems dang chos kyi dkyil 'khor te/ man snye las/ dag pa rdul tshon dag pa dang*// bha ga dag ni byang chub sems// de bzhin chos nyid dkyil 'khor ro// zhes gsungs pas 'byor pa dang ldan na rang gzhan tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i yo byad dang bcas te slob dpon de nyid bcu la mkhas pas cho ga ngag sems 'bral ba'i sgo nas slob ma dbang rtul dad pa'i rjes 'brang la rdul tshon sogs dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i sgo nas tshig don go bar byas nas dbang bskur ba ni sngags kyi bstan rgyun la phan pa sogs kyi dgos pa dang bcas pa'o// yang longs spyod med pa'i snod ldan la dkyil 'khor mchod gtor med kyang sbyin rung ste/ dus kyi 'khor lo las/ longs spyod med pa'i a wa dhū ti la ni dbang bskur rgyal ba'i bdag pos tshig gi sbyin par bya// zhes gsungs pas so// de ltar dbang bskur tshul bzhin byas nas dbang don ngo 'phrod pa ni dbang bskur nas thob pa zhes bya'o// dbang don gyi ye shes la go rtogs ma byung na bskur yang ma thob pa zhes bya'o// dpal sa ra has mda' mkhan mo'i brda' la dbang bzhi rtogs pa dang mai tri pas phag dang sha ba bsad pa'i brda' mthong ba dang*/

tai lo pas nā ro pa la ras yug gcig bsregs nas thal bar song bas dbang bzhi rdzogs pa dang*/ bdag med mas bir wa pa la dbang bskur tshul dang*/ rje dwags pos rten 'brel cung zad re la brten nas slob ma'i dbang don bskyed tshul bstan rim dar dmar mar bshad pa de rnams lta bu ni kun rdzob brda la brten pa dbang ma bskur yang thob pa zhes bya/ tha mal pa rnams ma bskur la ma thob pa ste/ zhang rin po che sogs kyi dbang bskur mu bzhir gsungs so// gnyis pa byin rlabs dang 'brel ba man ngag gi dbang bskur ba ni/ lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor la brten nas byin rlabs kyi dbang bzhi len pa yin te/ thog mar nges pa bsam gyi mi khyab pa rjes su dran par bya ste/ he badzra las/ gzhan gyi brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus thabs bstan pa dang*// bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes dang*/ bla ma dang ni rdo rje 'chang*// tha dad par ni mi brtag go /zhes dang*/ dpal mchog dang po'i rgyud las/ bla ma dpag bsam shing dang ni// bla ma yid bzhin nor bu ltar// gang 'dod pa yi 'bras bu 'byung*// de bas de la dam par byos// zhes dang*/ bde mchog sdom 'byung las/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos// de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te// kun gyi byed po bla ma yin// zhes dang*/ ḍā ki ma rdo rje gur las/ gang zhig rdo rje sems dpa' zhes// rdo rje slob dpon gzugs su gnas// sems can phan gdags dmigs nas kyang*// tha mal pa yi gzugs su su ston// zhes dang*/ sam bhu ṭi las/ yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs kyang*// bla ma med na srid mthar min// zhes dang*/ gnyis med rnam rgyal gyi rgyud las/ lha dang mi'i ston pa gang*// rkang gnyis gtso bo thams cad mkhyen// ma 'ongs bla ma'i gzugs kyi gnas// de nyid tshul 'di ston pa'o// zhes dang*/ ba tshwa can gyi chu klung gi mdor/

lnga brgya tha mar gyur pa na// nga nyid slob dpon gzugs kyi gnas// nga yin snyam du sems byos la// de tshe de la gus pa bskyed// ces gsungs pas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub mtha' dag bla na med pa'i bla ma bsgoms pa las gzhan du 'byung ba ma yin te/ rgyal ba dgongs pa 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ bskal pa stong gi sangs rgyas kyang*// bla ma dag la brten nas 'byung*// bla ma med pa'i gong rol tu// sangs rgyas bya ba'i ming yang med// ces gsungs pas na rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i rim pa yang*/ a ti bkod pa'i rgyud las/ drin dang ldan pa'i bla ma de// spyi bo'i gtsug gam snying gi dkyil// yan lag mthil sogs gang bsgom pa// sangs rgyas stong gi yon tan ni// gang zag de yis 'dzin par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom zhing rtsa 'khor lo drug tu bla ma'i rnal 'byor kho na gnad du bya zhing thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor gyi dus su byin rlabs kyi dbab zlog la brten nas dbang bzhi len zhing drod rtags thob par bya'o// gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi man ngag rnams la brten nas dbang bzhis sgrib pa sbyang ba gsal gdab pa gsang lam bgrod pa ngo sprod pa'i man ngag rnams byas pas byin rlabs snying la zhugs na rang sems grol bar 'gyur/ zhes rje tai lo pas gsungs pa ltar 'byung ba the tshom med do// 'on te byin rlabs 'byung yang dbang bzhi thob pa'i go chod dam snyam na nges par go chod de/ pha rgyud rdo rje phreng ba'i le'u drug cu pa las/ rdo rje slob dpon lus 'di la// rgyal ba'i sku ni rim bzhin gnas// dang po sku yi rdo rje ni// gzugs phung la ni yang dag bzhugs// rjes su chags pa'i rdo rje ni// tshor ba yi ni phung por bzhugs// zhes sogs dang*/ khrag sogs chu yi khams la ni// bcom ldan 'das yum mā ki// dro ba la sogs me khams la// bcom ldan 'das yum gos dkar bzhugs// bskyod pa la sogs rlung khams la// bcom ldan 'das yum sgrol ma bzhugs// de'i mig dbang gnyis la ni// de bzhin gshegs pa sa'i snying po// zhes sogs byang sems brgyad dang*/

lag pa g.yas pa'i rtsa bar ni// de bzhin gshegs pa gshin rje gshed// ces sogs khro bo bcu dang*/ sku'i dkyil 'khor zhes brjod pa// rdo rje slob dpon nyid kyi lus// sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku rdzogs pa// 'di dag ma lus rdzogs sangs rgyas// rdo rje lag gnas bstan pa ni// mya ngan 'das la 'jug par 'gyur// mya ngan 'das pa myur thob pa// khyed kyi dge ba yongs smin pa// de bas rdo rje slob dpon gyi// lus la rgyal ba thams cad bzhugs// mthong ba don ni yod pa skye// phyi ma'i dus na sems dpa' che// de yang sems can thams cad kyi// rab tu 'bad de bla ma bsten// zhes sogs mang du 'byung ba dang*/ lus ni gzhal yas khang du 'gyur// sangs rgyas kun gyi yang dag brten// zur bzhi pa ni mdun rgyab dang*// g.yas dang g.yon gyi dbye bas so// steng 'og sgo yi dbye ba yis// sgo bzhi zhes ni bshad pa yin// zhes sogs dkyil 'khor tshang ba dang sbyar ba 'byung zhing*/ kun spyod las/ pu li ra ma la ya mgo /zhes sogs dang*/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ he ru ka dpal sku yan lag /rten g.yo kun gyi bdag nyid can// zhes dang*/ dpal ldan khrag 'thung rgyal po che// 'dod pa kun gyi dbang phyug gis// kun tu phyag dang zhabs ldan zhing*// thams cad du ni spyan zhal dbu// kun tu thos ldan 'jig rten na// thams cad g.yogs te rnam par bzhugs// zhes dang*/ klu sgrub kyis/ sems can mos pa sna tshogs la// tha dad pa yi lhar dmigs pas// rin chen sems ni rnam grol las// lha gzhan sgrub tu yod ma yin// zhes gsungs pas bla ma dkyil 'khor kun 'dus kyi bdag nyid la dbang bzhi len pa yin no//

gzhan yang sa brgyad rnam par dag pa'i bum pa'i dbang la bzhi/ dri med gtsang ma rin chen mchog gi bum dbang dang*/ rnam rgyal chen po bdud rtsi dung phor dang bcas pa'i bum dbang dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon lus kyi bum dbang dang*/ shes rab ma'i dkar 'dzin nu ma'i bum dbang zhes rgyud kyi rgyal po sogs kyi dgongs par bzhed do// mchan/ de'ang mos pa gtsor byed kho na yin nam brgyud pa'i phyag len yod ce na/ spyir gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa 'di byin rlabs mos gus kyi lam pa yin pas/ sdom pa'i rtsa ba'ang bla ma'i dam tshig la bzhag cing khyad par brgyud pa 'di'i ti lo pa'i drung du nā ro pas ci gsungs tshad mar 'dzin pa'i dka' ba bcu gnyis spyad pa nas brtsams te mos gus kho na la brten nas rtogs goms brtan pa mthar phyin pa kho na'i bka' bab yin la/ gzhan yang bla ma phyi nang gsang gsum bsgrub pa'i rgya gzhung tai lo pa dang klu sgrub sogs kyis mdzad pa bhi bhu ti'i 'gyur sogs bsam gyis mi khyab cing ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur yang de mtshungs yod pa las sa ra ha pa'i lugs dpal rta mgrin gyis byin rlabs bla ma'i 'bral 'jug ces pa do ha'i khrid la yod pa dang*/ gzhan yang ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi man ngag gi brgyud pa thams cad la yod cing kye rdor la slob dpon gyi lus dkyil du lam dus kyi dbang len pa dang*/ gnyos lo'i dam tshig skyon sel gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta btsun mo can la thob nas sa chen dang phag gru la brgyud pa dang*/ tshar gsum khug pa gzhan du ma dang rga lo'i lugs kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang rgyal ba yang dgon pa sogs kyi thugs dam dang grub chen mi tra'i lugs kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang gnubs khro los bsgyur ba sogs mang du yod cing*/ lhan cig skyes grub sogs kyi gnyug ma ngo sprod kyi gdams pa de dag rnams kyang don gyi dbang bzhi'i byin rlabs kyi brda' rgyud du 'gyur la gtso bor ind+ra bho ti'i ye shes grub pa la tshul 'di gsal bar bstan nas yid ches dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan mang du gsungs shing*/

mchan/ de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyi// brtul zhugs can gyi bla ma mchod// de mnyam 'gro ba 'jig rten na// khams gsum na ni gzhan med de// rdo rje sems nyid 'jig rten na// phun tshogs kun phyir bzhugs pa yin// slob ma phun sum tshogs 'dod cing*// bsod nams mi zad 'dod pa dang*// gegs kun rnam par bzlog byed cing*// rnam pa du mas mnyes par byed// dam tshig dag ni thams cad kyi// bla med dam tshig 'di yin te// phun sum tshogs kun ster ba'o// bcom ldan rnams kyis rtag tu srung*// rtog pa thams cad rnam spangs pa'i// ye shes mchog bzang thob pa yi// rdo rje ye shes dbang bskur bas// dngos grub mchog ni sgrub par bya// yang dag ye shes kun ldan pas// bri ba'i dkyil 'khor las gzhan du// dbang bskur ba ni min zhe na// 'di ni dam tshig nyams par 'gyur// dam tshig nyams pas sdug bsngal ni// lus dang de bzhin yid dang ni// de yi don rnams nyams 'gyur zhing*// myur ba nyid du 'chi bar 'gyur// 'di nas dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal ni// bskal pa bye ba brgya phrag tu// myong nas las la 'pho 'gyur na'ang*// gdol pa'am dman pa'i rigs su skye// lkugs pa'am yang na 'on pa'am// skye zhing skye bar dmus long du// skye bar 'gyur la the tshom med// de bzhin gshegs kun ye shes ni// rdo rje ye shes zhes byar bshad// blo ldan de yis dbang bskur ba// dbang bskur bar ni shes par bya// rnal 'byor sangs rgyas kun bdag nyid// 'gro ba'i bdag po la sogs pa'i// tshogs kyi thal mo sbyar ba ni// byas nas mngon par phyag byed 'gyur// byang chub sems dpa' stobs chen dang*// bdag nyid chen po sangs rgyas kyang*// dpal chen srung bar mdzad 'gyur te// rdo rje sku yi rtag tu bzhugs// bde ba'i chos 'dzin mi 'khrul zhing*// sangs rgyas gsung ni rab 'jug pa// byin gyis brlabs dang ldan pa rnams// gus dang bcas pas bsngags par mdzad// 'jig rten skyong dang de bzhin gzhan// stobs chen pha rol gnon pa rnams// gnas rnams kun tu rtog pa na'ang*// bsrung bzhin du ni rab tu gnas// gang yang sems can thams cad la// bdud dang bgegs su gnas pa rnams// de yang de la mi byed de// bgegs rnams skrag nas 'byer bar byed// lha la sogs dang gus pa rnams// mkha' la rgyu dang mi rgyu kun// ngan 'gror 'gro bas 'jigs pas na// de yang de la 'gom mi byed// ces sogs dang*/

yang dag chos mchog 'dzin pa ste// khams gsum gyi ni phyag byas pa// dbang bskur khyod kyis thob pas na// 'di las mchog gzhan yod ma yin// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// ye shes mchog gi dbang bskur ba'i// rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi bdag nyid 'chang ba ni dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las gsungs te/ 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsang ba mngon par rtogs pa'i dbang bskur ba'i slob dpon la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ji ltar blta bar bgyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu byang chub kyi sems rdo rje lta bur de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi blta bar bya'o// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub kyi sems dang rdo rje slob dpon 'di gnyis ni gnyis su med cing gnyis su byar med/ rigs kyi bu mdor byas nas bstan par bya ste/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams nas dang byang chub sems dpa' ci snyed 'khod cing 'tsho la dang skyong ba de dag dus gsum du lhag nas slob dpon de la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mchod pas yang dag par mchod de sangs rgyas kyi zhing der 'gro'o// ngag rdo rje'i yi ge yang 'di skad brjod de/ bdag cag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi pha'o// bdag cag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ma'o// zhes bya ba na/ thugs rdo rje'i bsod nams kyi phung po pas kyang slob dpon gyi ba spu'i bu ga 'phags so// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu byang chub kyi sems ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi snying por gyur pa dang*/ skye ba'i gnas su gyur pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi 'byung gnas yin pa'i phyir du'o// zhes sogs gsungs shing rdo rje ye shes kyi dbang bskur tshul dang bcas pa gsal bar bstan to// rang lugs kyi gzhung zab mo lam gyi khrid 'chad pa na dbang rgyas pa bskur ba'ang yin la chos drug mkhar khang ma'i shog dril bco lnga'i dang po zab mo bla ma'i dpang yin pas de ltar shes par bya'o// man ngag la ni mang du snang ba rgyud tshod dang bstun par ston par bya'o// rje dwags pos kyang phyag rgya chen po rdo rje ye shes kyi dbang zhes pa'i phyag len mdzad snang ba ni yum bka' dang 'brel ba'o//

rang re rnams kyang zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor la brten nas phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dang thun mong gi rgyu 'bras rten 'brel gyi khrid du 'byung ngo*/ mchan/ phrin las bzhi yang bsgrub dgos pa yin no// de lta bu'i dbang de thob pa'i nyams myong ngos 'dzin gyi sdud po ji ltar byed snyam na/ nā ro pa'i zhal nas/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes che// mchog gi dbang po sgo phye nas// 'khor lo bzhi la brgyud pa ni// nyams myong 'di ltar rgyud la skye// dga' ba dang po skyes dus su// chu 'dzin bum pa'i dbang du 'dod// mchog dga' rgyud la skyes dus su// bde ba 'dzin pa gsang ba'i dbang*// lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba ni// gsum pa shes rab ye shes te// dga' bral rgyud la skyes pa na// bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che// dbang bzhi bskur bas lam bzhi bsgom// smin grol dbyer med lam 'di ltos// zhes dang*/ yang bla ma'i sku gsung thugs gsum gyis// slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum la// yi dam lha yi sku gsung thugs// spyan drangs nas ni bstim pa yi// smin lam dbang bzhi de thob nas// grol ba'i lam bzhi bsgom pa ni// rnam pa gsal la ngo bo stong*// mtshan nyid gnyis med zung 'jug ste// nyams myong bde stong nyid du 'char// zhes kyang gsungs la/ gzhan yang*/ lta na rang gi sems la ltos// sems nyid ci yang ma grub pa// brjod du med cing yul las 'das// spros bral nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// bzhi pa bskur ba'i rnal 'byor pa// de ltar rtogs na go ba yin// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ slob dpon bi bhu tis/ bla ma cho ga tshad ldan pas// nam mkha' ji srid gnas bar du// lhan skyes ye shes brda' don 'phrod// rnam rtog dri ma kun la bsdom// rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa'o// zhes pa'ang zhar las go bar byas nas mdo don snying por bsdu na/ rin po che'i gter kha 'byed pa lta bu'i gdams ngag la don bzhi/

gsang sngags byin rlabs kyis lam pa yin pas dang po bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs pa zhig dgos/ byin rlabs gus pa las 'byung bas gsol ba rgyun chad med par 'debs pa zhig dgos// gus pa de nges shes skyes pa la 'byung bas gdams pa gnad du theb pa zhig dgos/ gdams pa bla ma las 'byung bas yun ring bsten zhing yang yang nan tan byed pa zhig dgos/ zhes gsungs pa ltar man ngag nyams len du dril nas sgrub pa lag tu len pa'i tshul la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro gsal btab la kun rdzob byang sems kyi skabs la bzhi pa tshe gcig gi nyams len dril nas bstan pa ni/ stobs lnga ste/ dus da nas bzung ste/ zhag zla ba lo ma shi'i bar ji srid sangs rgyas ma thob bar rnams kyi dam bca'i blo spar nas gtsigs bzung ste/ 'jig rten tshe 'di'i bya ba ci shol yang byang chub kyi sems rin po che gnyis dang mi 'bral bar bya snyam du 'phen pa'i stobs dang*/ rkyen de chung rim nas sbyang zhing ma brjed par byed pa goms pa'i stobs dang*/ byang chub kyi sems skye zhing 'phel ba'i phyir tshogs bsags shing spobs pa bskyed pa dkar po sa bon gyi stobs dang*/ sngar bshad pa ltar bdag gces 'dzin skyes dus sdug bsngal gyi le gyod kho la brdar nas khong shed skyung ba sun 'byin pa'i stobs dang*/ byang chub sems dang mi 'bral zhing*// zhes sogs zab la rgya che ba'i smon pa dge sbyor gsham du 'debs pa smon lam gyi stobs so// shi yang dkar po'i stobs yo byad la chags zhen med par gtong zhing lus bcos te 'pho bas khyad par du byas pa tsam las 'dun pa 'di lnga gsal gdab pa las gzhan med de/ 'di rnams rtsa tshig las/ man ngag snying po mdor bsdus pas// stobs lnga dag dang sbyar bar bya// theg chen 'pho ba'i gdams ngag ni// stobs lnga nyid yin spyod lam gces// zhes pa'i don rnams bsgom/

de nas sngar bzhin gnad gsum gyi srang la 'grim zhing dmigs pa ting nge 'dzin gyi gnad la/ rje rgod tshang pa'i zhal nas/ phyag rgya chen po'i don hril gyis dril na 'di las med/ dang po bla ma la gsol ba gdab nas de nas bla ma rang la bstims nas bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi sems chu la chu bzhag pa ltar bsres la de'i ngang la sems so mar bzhag go /sgom yong la re ba dang ma byung gi dwogs pa mi bya/ sems gang ltar 'dug pa de ga ltar bzhag go /stong par mi bsgom dngos por mi 'dzin par bzhag go /dmigs med du bde bde po gsal gsal po gcig 'dod pa'i zhe 'dod med par bzhag go /dmigs pa med par cham me bzhag go /sems nang du mi bsdu bar rgya bskyed la bzhag go /sems la las ma bcol/ lar gang la'ang 'dzin pa med par phyod de bzhag go /zhes dang*/ tai lo pas/ lus la snying po med de snyug ma'i sdong po 'dra// sems ni nam mkha'i dkyil ltar bsam pa'i yul las 'das// de'i ngang la btang bzhag med par klod la zhog /ces gsungs pa ltar bka' brgyud kyi rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi gsung dri ma med pa rnams la nan tan snying por byas la nyams su long mdzod cig / byas la brda' bkrol zhing maṇḍal gtor 'bul smon lam gdab pa sogs bya'o// nyin ya byas pa'i nyi ma bcu bdun chos thun bcu gcig yin no// ༈ chos thun bcu gnyis pa la sngar bzhin tshig gi mtshams sbyor byas nas/ gnyis pa smin pa grol bar byed pa'i gdams pa ni bskyed rdzogs gnyis las/ thog mar bskyed rim lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni/ de'ang bskyed pa'i rim pa nyid dang ni// rdzogs pa yi ni rim pa gnyis// rim pa gnyis la brten nas ni// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir bskyed pa'i rim pa la phyi bskyed pa'i rim pa dang nang bskyed pa'i rim pa'o// rdzogs pa'i rim pa la rdzogs pa'i rim pa dang*/ yongs su rdzogs pa'i rim pa dang*/

ngo bo nyid kyi rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o// de'ang rim pa lnga'i bdag nyid du shes par byas la/ e waṃ ma ya'i mtshan nyid can gyi las kyi phyag rgya dang*/ chos kyi phyag rgya dang phyag rgya chen po dang*/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya rnams kyi bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa rnams mtshan bcas thabs kyi lam du ston par bya'o// 'dir bskyed rim mdor bsdus te bsgom pa'i don la/ rje dwags po rin po che'i zhal nas/ de'ang bskyed rim bsgom pa la chos drug yin te/ bskyed rim gyi dbye ba ngo bo nges tshig dgos pa brtan pa'i tshad 'bras bu dang drug yin te/ dbye ba la sgrub thabs rim gyis bskyed pa dang*/ cho ga gsum gyis bskyed pa dang*/ skad cig dran rdzogs su bskyed pa dang gsum yin/ ngo bo ni tha mal gyi rnam rtog bzlog nas zung 'jug lha'i skur gsal ba/ nges tshig ni lus lhar bskyed pa dang*/ sems lhar bskyed pa dang*/ sems tshig tu brjod pa lhar bskyed pa dang gsum/ de la lus lhar bskyed pa ni/ tha mal gyi sha khrag gdos pa can 'di mi dmigs pa lha'i skur gsal ba de yin/ sems lhar bskyed pa ni lha'i sku de yang sems kyi snang ba sgyu ma'am/ mchan/ de'ang sbyang gzhi bya ba'i rkyen can skye ba rnam bzhi la sbyong byed byed pa'i rkyen can bskyed tshul rnam bzhi 'byung gsungs/ 'ja' tshon lta bur shes pa de yin/ sems tshig tu brjod pa lhar bskyed pa ni/ lha'i sku sgyu ma lta bu de yang ming tsam brda' tsam btags pa tsam tha snyad tsam du rang bzhin gzhi bral du shes par bya'o// dgos pa la spyir dgos pa dang bye brag tu dgos pa rnam pa gnyis/ de la spyir dgos pa ni rab zung 'jug gi rtogs pa bsgrub/ 'bring dang tha mas tha mal pa'i zhen pa bzlog /bye brag tu dgos pa la dam tshig sems dpa' bskyed pa la dgos pa gsum/ tha mal gyi 'khrul pa zhig pa'i dgos pa yod/

rang dang lhag pa'i lha tha mi dad du shes pa'i dgos pa yod/ rang gi rigs kyi dam tshig srung bar 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod/ ye shes sems dpa' la dgos pa gsum/ rang lhag pa'i lha dang tha mi dad du shes pa'i dgos pa yod/ tha mi dad du shes pas lhas byin gyis brlabs pa'i dgos pa yod/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub myur du 'grub pa'i dgos pa yod/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlabs pa la dgos pa gsum/ tha mal gyi lus ngag yid gsum de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs rnam par dag par 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa srung ba'i 'khor lo mchog tu 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod/ lha'i sku yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod/ dbang bskur ba la dgos pa gsum/ rgyu'i chos pha rol tu phyin pa las khyad par du 'phags pa'i dgos pa yod/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa thams cad byang bar 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su chos kyi rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur ba'i dgos pa yod/ de ltar bcu gnyis kyi bye brag tu dgos pa'o// brtan pa'i tshad la rang gi cha nas bzhag pa gsum te/ 'gro nyal 'dug sdod gsum du rang lhar gsal na brtan pa tha ma/ phyi snod gzhal yas khang nang bcud yi dam gyi lhar gsal na brtan pa 'bring*/ de ltar gsal ba'i lha thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma chu zla lta bur gsal na brtan pa rab/ gzhan gyi cha nas bzhag pa gsum ste/ rang 'gro ba gzhan gyis lhar mthong na brtan pa rab/ rang la dus thams cad du lhar gsal na brtan pa 'bring*/ yid dag la lhar gsal na brtan pa tha ma'o// 'bras bu la gnas skabs dang mthar thug gnyis/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu la gzugs sku rnam pa gnyis 'byung*/ gnas skabs la rab tshe 'di la bden pa mthong*/ 'bring skye ba phyi ma la 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur/ tha ma lha mi'i lus rnam par dag pa thob/ de ltar drug gis bskyed pa'i rim pa bstan nas chos de rnams dang ldan pa yin gsungs/

gnyis pa grol byed kyi gdams pa rdzogs rim gyi rtsa ba dang yan lag gnyis las thog mar rtsa ba ni bla ma la mos gus kyi gnad kho na yin pas sngar ji ltar bshad pa de rnams nges shes gting tshugs par byas nas tshul bzhin bsgrub pa dang*/

khrid yig chen mo dang rje gong ma'i mos gus kyi khrid rnams dang mos gus byed tshul bla ma mchod par yang*/ 'byung ba rnams kyis mos gus bskyed cing gsal gdab bo // gnyis pa gdams pa'i yan lag re zhig shes rab gtso bor ston pa spros med phyag rgya chen po'i gdams pa gzhi khrid du bstan gyin yod pa 'di'i gzhung don phal cher rim bzhin 'chad pas shes par bya la da lta'i lag len gnad gsum gyi srang la 'grim pa'i bca' ba lus kyi gnad ni/ bskyed rim lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i ngang nas bca' ba lus kyi gnad gal che ste/ rdo rje phreng ba'i rgyud las/ sgrub po bde ba'i stan 'dug ste// mig ni sna rtser gtad byas la// sna mthong lta ba'i tshad du zhog /'phrag dpung mnyam la lce rkan sbyar// so dang mchu ni bde bar bzhag /dbugs kyi 'byung rngub glod nas ni// cung zad rtsol ba bral ba yi// rdo rje skyil krung legs gnas shing*// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ dpal nā ro pa'i chos drug ka dpe las/ de la lus kyi gnad bshad pa// rin chen rtsar la brgyus pa ltar// shin tu bsrang la dgug par bya// li ri bzhin du khong sgrim bya// rgya mdud lta bu'i tshul du gnas// 'phel ka shin tu bskyed par bya// mnyam bzhag rgya yis btsir bya zhing*// re mig ltar ni bsnol bya zhing*// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ gsang 'dus las/ dben par 'bol ba'i stan la 'dug /lhar gsal nga rgyal mos par bya// rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung bca'// rgal tshig gser gyi tong rtse bsrang*// seng ltar stod 'gying yid dgye bya// rma bya'i mgrin bzhin yid dgug la// lag gnyis mnyam bzhag 'der so 'dra// mig gnyis sna yi rtse la dbab// ces dang*/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ 'du 'dzi med pa'i gnas gtsang mar// der ni skyil krung bca' bar bya// ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' yi// byang chub snying por bzhugs pa bzhin// mig btsum so la so bzhag ste// lus bsrang phyag rgya byas nas ni// dran pa rtse gcig phyag rgya che// zhes dang*/

rgyal ba mchog gi khrid yig chen mo las/ rnam snang gi chos bdun ni/ rkang pa skyil krung lag pa mnyam bzhag byas la lte 'og sor bzhi'i mtshams su bzhag ste/ gru mo ma dgug par bsrang*/ dpung pa rgod gshog ltar brgyang*/ mgrin pa lcags kyu ltar ol mas ol mdud non par dgug /rgal tshig mda' ltar bsrang*/ mig sna rtse'i sor bzhi'i thad kyi nam mkha' la rdzi ma mi g.yob cing ya yo khyar khyur med par gtad/ mchu cung zad 'byar ba so la bar bag tsam/ lce ya rkan la sbyar la bde ba'i stan la 'khod de/ de dag gi dgos pa ni rkang pa skyil krung bcas pas thur sel gyi rlung dbu mar tshud cing nyon mongs pa phrag dog zhi ba dang bar chad kyis mi tshugs pa'o// lag pa mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya lte 'og sor bzhir bcas pas chu rlung dbu mar tshud de zhe sdang zhi/ rgal tshig mda' ltar bsrang zhing dpung pa rgod gshog ltar gdengs pas sa rlung dbu mar tshud de gti mug zhi/ mgrin pa brang la gug tsam byas pas me rlung dbu mar tshud de 'dod chags zhi/ mig mi btsum par sna rtse nas sor bzhi'i thad du lta ba dang lce ya rkan la sbyar bas rlung gi rlung dbu mar tshud de nga rgyal zhi shes pa gsal bar byed/ de'ang sems gnad rlung*/ rlung gnad rtsa/ rtsa gnad mig la yod pas lta stangs ma 'chug pa gal che/ de ltar lus bsam gtan gyi chos lnga'am bdun legs par bcas pas dug lnga rang zhir 'gro zhing rlung sems rang bzhin gyi dhu tir tshud nas rtog pa thams cad rang 'gag la 'bol shig ge dwangs seng nge 'gro zhing rtogs pa myur du 'char bas lus gnad gal che/ lus bsnyes pa dang 'khyog 'khyog sogs gnad du ma long na rtog pa 'phros nas sems mi zin zhing 'khrul 'khor g.yas su yo na dang por gsal nyams skye de nas zhe sdang rang rgyud pa 'byung zhing gdon rgyal po la sogs gnod pa'i nyen yod/ g.yon du yo na dang po bde ba dang de nas 'dod chags drag po 'byung klu dang mo rigs sogs gdon/

mdun du gug na dang po mi rtog pa rtse gcig tu skye rjes su gti mug tu 'gyur zhing gdon sa bdag la sogs pas gnod/ khyad par du'ang mi gnyis la sogs pas gros byas pa mthong na 'di gnyis nga la kha zer bar 'dug snyam pa dang mi dga' ba la sogs srog 'dzin gyi rlung log pa'i nyes pa du ma 'byung*/ lus gnad rgyab tu dgyes na dang por stong nyams rtsol med du skye de nas nga rgyal la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa 'byung*/ gong gi gdon rnams kyi rtog pa'ang 'char/ khyad par sems mi gnas shing rtog pa 'phro/ lus sngo skam du 'gro ba dang khams 'dzag pa la sogs pa'i nyes pa 'byung ngo*// des na nyes pa gang yang mi 'byung zhing yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa'i gnad lus gnad yin pas 'khrul 'khor ma 'chug pa gal che'o// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ bla ma zhang gi /lus kyi gnad la lnga ste mda' ltar bsrang ba dang*/ re mig ltar bsnol ba dang*/ lcags kyu ltar dgug pa dang*/ lcags sgrogs ltar bsdam pa dang*/ li ri ltar bsgrim pa'o// zhes sogs gsungs shing*/ de lta bu'i lus kyi gnad lnga po 'di la/ rje btsun mar pa lho brag pa'i zhal nas/ bod kyi gdams ngag thams cad phyogs gcig tu bzhag pa bas nga'i lus gnad lnga po 'di gdams ngag che ba yin/ de ci ste zhe na nga'i lus gnad lnga po 'di bcas pa'i gnad kyis rlung dhū tir rang tshud la 'gro ba yin/ de'i gnad kyis lte ba nas gtum mo rang 'bar la 'gro ba yin/ de'i gnad kyis spyi bo nas byang sems rang 'bab tu 'bab pa yin/ des bde ba ngang gi skye ba yin/ des rnam rtog ched du dgag mi dgos par mi rtog pa dbang med du 'char ba yin/ zhes gsungs pa lus kyi bzhag thabs gal che zhing 'di nyid la yun ring du goms pas nang gi 'byung ba cha snyoms par 'gyur te tshe ring ba dang nad sngar yod pa sos shing phyis mi 'byung ba dang*/ rtsa rlung dwangs ma stobs su gyur pas steng gi ljid kyi 'og tu mi gnod pa dang*/

rtsa rlung thig gsum tshogs pa gcig pas lo zla'i bar du gnas kyang mi bde ba med pa dang*/ dwangs ma'i dwangs ma shin tu smin pas rig pa rang gsal rtogs pa rtsol med du skye bar 'gyur ro// de'i phyir/ sambu ṭi las/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong gi ni cho gas ni// lus kyi de nyid mi shes pas// de dag thams cad 'bras bu med// ces dang*/ brtag gnyis las/ lus la ye shes chen po gnas// rtog pa thams cad yang dag spang*// dngos po kun la khyab pa po// lus gnas lus las ma skyes pa'o// zhes dang*/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pas/ pha ri lta na tshu ri nas ltos/ stong pa 'dod na snang ba gtan la phob/ sems gnas par 'dod na lus 'khrul 'khor gyis chun/ zhes dang*/ 'dul ba lung las kyang*/ phyi rol pa'i drang srong lnga brgya la rang sangs rgyas mthong ba'i spre'u zhig gis lus gnad bstan pas mngon par shes pa lnga thob cing rang byang chub kyang thob pa'i gtam rgyud gsungs pa dang*/ man ngag du ma las kyang*/ lus drang bas rtsa drang rtsa drang bas rlung drang*/ rtsa rlung gnad du chun pas sems zin pa yin/ lus kyog po gcig byas nas bsgoms na ci tsug byas kyang sems zin pa mi 'ong*/ rnam rtog gi rta rlung yin/ rlung tshul bzhin rgyu zhing zin pas sems zin pa yin gsungs la/ rje btsun mi la ras pas lus po sgom thag dang ma bral bar mi lo bzhi bcu bsgom pa yin gsungs shing*/ sgrub brgyud rin po che'i rtogs pa mchog skyong ba'i sgom chen mi tshe bsgrub pa la bskyal ba thams cad kyang lus gnad gcig tu bzhugs nas chu bo'i rgyun gyi rnal 'byor mdzad pa yin/ rje rgod tshang pa rgya gar du byon dus kha rag pa bya ba'i grub thob dgung lo brgyad cu tsam zhig mal sa gcig na lo sum cu la ma 'phags par lus gnad gcig la bzhugs gda' gsungs pa sogs rgyu mtshan mang po yod pas khyed rnams kyang zhag grangs de tsam la lus gnad bcas yod pas da de'i rgyu mtshan bshad pa la dgos pa ci yod snyam du ma sems par dus rtag tu mnyam bzhag la gnas tsam na lus gnad dang ma bral ba mdzad par bskul ba dang sngar gyi de dag gi 'phros don yang yin pas de ltar dgos ched kyi don de rnams dang ldan pa'i phyir rtsa rlung thig le dbang du 'dus pa bca' ba lus kyi gnad ces gsungs pa yin no// gnad gnyis pa/

bde mchog gi rtsa rgyud las/ gang gi 'khor ba'i nyes pa ni// dran pa tsam gyis 'joms mdzad cing*// bla med byang chub thob mdzad pa// zhes dang*/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// zhes pas dran pa tsam gyis sgrib gnyis sel zhing tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i phan yon dang ldan pa'i phyir ye shes myur du rtogs par byed pa bla ma la mos gus kyi gnad ces gsungs pa yin no// gnad gsum pa ni/ 'phags pa lha'i zhabs kyis/ stong nyid bag chags goms pa yis// dngos po'i bag chags spong 'gyur zhing*// ci yang med ces bsgom pa yis// phyis nas de yang spong bar 'gyur// zhes pa dang bka' brgyud gong ma'i gsungs las rang sems rang ngo shes shing dge sdig gi rtog pa gang shar bzo med kyi ngo bo la rang sar 'jog pas tshogs gnyis gong du 'phel zhing glo bur gyi dri ma yul 'bud ces gsungs pa'i don dang ldan pa'i phyir yang dag pa'i lam du 'gro ba dmigs pa ting nge 'dzin gyi gnad ces gsungs pa yin no// grol byed lam gyi gdams pa de rnams kyi mdo don 'ga' zhig gi sdud po ji ltar byed snyam na/ rje mi las mdzad pa'i phyag rgya chen po ye shes gsal byed las/ sgom byed longs spyod rdzogs sku'i bya ba bstan pa la spyi dang khyad par gnyis las spyi'i bya ba bstan pa la gsum/ tshad med pa bzhi la brten te byang chub tu dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang la brten nas mos gus dang gsol 'debs la 'bad pa'i byin rlabs kyi chos sku phyag rgya chen po rtogs pa'i dgos pa dang*/ bskyed rim rgyas bsdus la brten nas rje btsun ma bsgoms pas rnam smin lus kyi bag chags 'gags nas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ru 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod/ khyad par gyi bya ba bstan pa ni/ lus kyi bya ba sku'i sgo dgu rang bzhin gyis 'gags pas 'bad pa dang rtsol ba med par gnas pa dang*/

ngag gi bya ba gsung gi sgo bzhi rang gnas su thim pas sgra thams cad thabs dang shes rab kyi rang bzhin du gnas pa dang*/ sems kyi bya ba thugs kyi sgo gnyis bye bas longs sku'i rnam par rang grol nas 'bad rtsol gyi 'jug pa thams cad dang bral nas lhun grub tu gnas pas phyag rgya chen po la 'jug pa'o// zhes gsungs pas mdo don snying por bsdu na bsgom pa thabs kyis zin pa gser la rgyan du brdungs pa lta bu'i gdams ngag la don bzhi/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom zhing rang lus sbyin par btang zhing sems kyi de nyid bsgom pa dang*/ bla ma'i bka' drin rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas rang lus mchod par 'bul zhing sems kyi de nyid bsgom pa dang*/ gsol ba btab pas bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs pas rang lus sbyin sreg tu btang zhing sems kyi de nyid bsgom pa dang*/ sems nyid skye ba med pa'i don bsgom pa de yang dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med du nyams su len par byed pa'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar man ngag nyams len du dril nas sgrub pa lag tu len pa'i tshul thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro gsal btab la kun rdzob byang sems kyi skabs su chos thams cad bdag 'dzin 'dul ba'i gnyen por gsungs pa yid ches nas rnam rtog thams cad stong nyid kyi lta sgom gyi non pa dang chags sdang 'khor ba'i rtsa ba mtha' dag bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i sems bskyed kyis thul nges pa zhig ma byung na chos byas tshad don med yin pas de lta bu la phyi mthong thos rtogs gsum gyi skye bos ma khrel zhing*/ nang rang sems kyi rang gi byas tshad smras tshad bsam tshad la gzhig nas lung man ngag zhal gdams dang 'gal lam mthun/ zhib par brtags nas g.yo sgyus 'gebs pa ma yin par dge sems dang las dkar sogs pas yid tshim pa/ rkyen ngan byang chub kyi lam du slong bas sdug bsngal sel ba/

dus gtan gyi 'dun ma grub pas blo sems bde ba/ lus longs spyod la dga' gdung chung bas sems khral med pa/ thams cad chos nyid du shar bas nyam nga med pa'i gdeng thob pa gcig gi ngang nas yul rkyen ngan pa'i chags sdang dang thug pa'i tshe bden yus kyi kun slong ngan pa mi skye zhing skyes kyang byang chub sems gnyis kyi grogs su song na blo 'byongs pa'i tshad yin gsungs te 'di rnams rtsa tshig las/ chos kun dgongs pa gcig tu 'dus// dpang po gnyis kyi gtso bo bzung*// yid bde 'ba' zhig rgyun du bsten// yengs kyang thub na 'byongs pa yin// zhes pa'i don rnams bsgom mo// de nas sngar bzhin gnad gsum gyi srang la 'grim zhing dmigs pa ting nge 'dzin gyi gnad ni/ grub chen o rgyan pas/ ma bcos so mar bzhag pa ni// bram ze skud pa khel ba bzhin du lhod de bzhag /sog ma'i phon thag chad pa bzhin du shigs se bzhag /bal gyi steng du brdzis pa bzhin du 'bol le bzhag /de ltar ma yin par srin bu kha chus 'thum pa bzhin du rang gis rang bcings/ brag rked kyi shing thun bzhin du lus sems bsdams kyang sems kho sdod du mi 'dod/ bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral ba'i ngang nas sems kho sun thug tu ma bcug par ma yengs tsam gyi rgyang so btsugs nas gar 'gro sar chal te rgya yan du btang nas rnge'u bzung nas rnga mong btang ba bzhin du rang mal du 'khor nas 'ong ba yin/ des na sems 'dzin pa'i gnad la mi yengs pa'i ngang du mi bsgom par klod shes pa zhig kho na zab pa yin/ zhes dang*/ de'i ngang la dus gsum spros pa bcad nas ma bcos par 'jog pa 'di sems gnas chol ba'i mchog yin/ de lta ma yin par gzhan las lhag pa'i zhe 'dod kyis kun nas bslang*/ bsgom bya sgom byed kyi spro bsdus nang nas dkrug /lus gnad lta stangs srol du ma chud/ mos gus kyi gdung shugs kyi rgyud ma khul spom me yor re bsdad kyang sems kho sdod du mi 'dod/

spyir rang sems kyi mtshan nyid ni bzung na mi zin btang na 'gro sa med pa gcig tu gda'/ re dwogs kyi mtshan ma thams cad kyi gnas lugs de la thug pas sems rang thog tu klod ma shes na bsgom mi 'ong bas klod shes pa gcig zab pa yin/ zhes dang*/ pha dam pa sangs rgyas kyis/ thol gyi skyes pa la gcer gyis bltas nas// lhod kyi klod pas bun gyis zhig ste// lhag ge 'char ba chos nyid yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar gang shar gyi thog tu ngos zin ma thag 'dzin med du klod mdzod cig / byas la brda bkrol zhing maṇḍal gtor 'bul smon lam gdab pa sogs bya'o// nyin ya byas pa'i nyi ma bcu dgu chos thun bcu gnyis yin no// ༈ chos thun bcu gsum pa la sngar bzhin tshig gi mtshams sbyor byas nas/ de ltar chos spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid mi 'gal zhing yar ldan du tshang bar theg pa rim 'jug gi sgo nas blo sbyong zhing sngags kyi rten du rung bar byas pa la brten nas smin grol gyi gdams ngag tshul bzhin du bstan pa yin te/ rje rang byung zhabs kyi lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid yig las/ sngon 'gro la bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pas slob ma tshul bzhin du nyams su len zhing tshe 'di'i bya ba spangs nas bla na med pa'i byang chub don du gnyer ba la bstan par bya ste thog mar tshul khrims kyi sdom pa dang byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa thob cing dbang gi rgyud yongs su smin par byas la dben zhing nyams dga' ba'i gnas su nyams su blang bar bya'o// zhes dang*/ zhang rin po ches/ rim gyis pa yi gang zag gis// dang po dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsam// zhes dang*/ de rjes gtan khrims rnam pa// dge tshul dge slong rim bzhin bslab// ces dang*/ byams dang snying rje bsgom pa yi// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed na// zhes dang*/ de rjes rnal 'byor bla med kyi// rgyud dang smin pa'i dbang mnos nas// dam tshig gtsang ma srung ldan pas// bskyed pa'i rim pa sbyang bar bya// de rjes gsang ba'i dbang dag gis// rtsa rlung rtsol bas bdag byin rlabs// de rjes gsum pa'i bde stong bsgom// bzhi pa mthar thug bsgom par bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar theg pa gsum la 'jug par byas nas so so'i sdom pa dang dam tshig thob par byas nas/

de ni de dag gi bslab bya la tshul bzhin du slob dgos pa yin no// bslab bya gang zhe na/ ji skad du/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bslab pa gsum// de nyid ston pa sde snod gsum// lta sgom spyod pa de yin te// bslab pa yang dag sku gsum yin// zhes bstan pa mtha' dag gi brjod bya'i gtso bo'ang yin te/ bslab pa gsum ni rab ston la// phyag rgya bzhi dang yang dag ldan// thog ma bar dang mthar dge bas// sangs rgyas gsung du mkhas pas rtogs// zhes gsungs te/ de la mgon po zla 'od gzhon nu'i zhal nas/ ston pa bde bar gshegs pas gsungs pa'i chos thams cad bslab pa rnam pa gsum du ma 'dus pa med de/ de'ang bslab pa rnam pa gsum ni lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa/ lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa'o// tshul khrims gang zhe na/ mkhan po dang slob dpon la so sor thar pa'i sdom pa blangs nas ji lta ba bzhin du bsrung ba ni sdom pa'i tshul khrims/ de nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas bslab bya la slob pa'i tshul khrims/ de nas gsang sngags kyi dbang bskur zhus nas dam tshig ji lta ba bzhin srung ba ni sdom pa'i tshul khrims/ des na rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byed pa la sdom pa gsum dang ldan dgos/ sdom pa gsum dang ldan dgos pa gang nas bshad na/ rgyud rdo rje rtse mo las/ byang chub sems 'dzin gyur nas ni/ lha gzhan la ni mi mos pa// dkon mchog gsum la dad pa dang*// de la gzhol zhing 'bab pa yin// gsod dang spyug dang 'khrig pa dang*// rdzun dang chang ni rnam par spang*// khyim pa'i tshul du gnas pa yis// gsang sngags rgyal po rab tu bsgrub// gal te de ni rab byung na// sdom pa gsum la gnas par bya// so sor thar dang byang chub sems// rig 'dzin nang gi sdom pa'o// gnyis po rig 'dzin rten yin te// yang na rig 'dzin nang du 'dus// zhes gsungs pas na de nas bshad/

de'ang so sor thar pa'i dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa ni grogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa thob pa yan dang 'bral/ cho ga skyabs su 'gro ba yan chad dang 'bral/ bslab bya rtsa ba bzhi chang dang bcas pa srung*/ dge tshul gyi sdom pa ni grogs slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dang 'bral/ cho ga skyabs su 'gro ba dang 'bral/ bslab bya rtsa ba bzhi yan lag drug mkhan po las thob pa gsum srung*/ dge slong gi sdom pa ni grogs mkhan po dang slob dpon gnyis/ dge 'dun mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dang 'bral/ cho ga gsol ba dang bzhi'i las la sogs pa dang 'bral/ bslab bya khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum la sogs phran tshegs dang bcas pa bsrung bar bya/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa ni/ yul bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dang 'bral/ cho ga smon 'jug don dam byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang 'bral/ bslab bya ni rang gi srog la bab kyang byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems mi gtong zhing pha rol tu phyin pa drug la sogs pa mdor na sdom pa nyi shu pa dang tshul khrims kyi le'u la sogs pa nas gsungs pa bzhin bslab par bya/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi sdom pa ni/ yul rdo rje slob dpon dang 'bral/ cho ga dbang dang byin rlabs kyi rim pa dang 'bral/ bslab bya rtsa ltung yan lag dang bcas pa spang ba la bslab par bya'o// de lta bu'i sdom pa gsum gyi ngo bo ni rnam snang mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud las so sor thar pa'i sdom pa'i ngo bo ni gzhan la gnod pa gzhi dang bcas pa las rnam pa thams cad du log pa zhig yin la/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i ngo bo ni de'i steng du phan 'dogs pa'o// zhes pa dang*/ yang*/ rdo rje gur las/ phung po sangs rgyas lnga bdag nyid// de la brnyas pa brgyad pa yin// zhes gsungs pas gsang sngags kyi sdom pa'i ngo bo ni rnam pa lhar gsal ba/ nyams myong bde ba/ rang bzhin mi rtog pa gsum ni dbyer med pa'o// de'ang rten gyi gang zag gcig gi rgyud la sdom pa gsum po gnas na ji ltar gnas/
