srung na ji ltar srung*/ ldan na ji ltar ldan/ phyir bcos na ji ltar bcos/ mi 'gal bar srung na ji ltar srung zhe na/ de la sdom pa gsum gyi ngo bo ni gcig tu gnas pa'ang ma yin te/ dang po skye ba'i rgyu phyogs gcig med la tha dad du bshad pa dang*/ grub pa'i sde mi gcig ste dang po thob pa'i dus gcig pa med de rim pa bzhin du thob dgos pa dang*/ gnas pa'i rgyu gcig pa med de so sor thar pa ni ji srid 'tsho bar yin la/ sdom pa gnyis po ni dus snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar yin pa dang*/ gtong ba'i rgyu mi gcig ste so sor thar pa'i rtsa bzhi shor na gtong bar bshad la byang chub sems dpa'i dbang du byas na mi dge ba bcu las yid kyi gsum po ma gtogs pa bdun po sems can gyi don du gyur na bya bar bshad pa dang*/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg par ni de dag nyid lam du gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang na rten dang ngo bo'ang tha dad de/ so sor thar pa ni gling gsum gyi skyes pa dang bud med las mi skye bar bshad pa la sdom pa gnyis po ni skyes pa dang ma ning dang mtshan gnyis pa dang*/ byang gi sgra mi snyan dang lha dang klu la sogs pa mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad spangs pa thams cad la skye bar bshad pa dang*/ sdom pa rang gi ngo bo 'gal te so so thar pa'i sdom pa'i ngo bo ni sems ma yin te/ sems las byung ba yul dang dbang po lnga dang bcu ste rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs bstan du med cing thogs pa med pa'i gzugs su 'dod pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' ni sems kyi khyad par la 'dod pa dang*/ gsang sngags ni lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes la 'dod pas ngo bo 'gal bar gnas pa dang*/ yang sdom pa gnyis po phul yang so sor thar pa gnas par bshad pa dang*/ so sor thar pa phul yang gnyis po mi gtong bar bshad pas/ des na sdom pa gcig pa'ang mi btub bo// sdom pa gsum po'i ngo bo de gnas skabs thams cad du tha dad du'ang mi btub ste tha dad na rang rig mngon sum las 'di ni so sor thar pa'i sdom pa/

'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa/ 'di ni gsang sngags kyi sdom pa yin zhes tha dad gsum du snang bar rig pa la sems rtse gcig las med pa'i phyir thams cad du tha dad pa'ang mi 'thad do// 'o na ji ltar gnas she na/ sdom pa gsum ngo bo shin tu tha dad gnas skabs 'dres pa'i tshul du gnas pa yin te/ dper na chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa tha dad med kyang ngang pas chu bzhag nas 'o ma len du gtub pa bzhin du sdom pa gsum po 'di'ang gang rung zhig phul na'ang gnyis po gnas su gtub pas des na ngo bo tha dad gnas skabs 'dres pa'i tshul du gnas so// srung na ji ltar srung zhe na/ srung na 'chol bar srung ste sdom pa gsum po de na ba la sogs pa srog gi bar chad du 'gro ba dang*/ sdom pa gnyis po'i bar chad du gang 'gro ba dang lam gong ma rgyud la mi skye ba'i bar chad dang*/ bar chad gsum po de dang sdom pa gsum po de 'dam thug byung na bar chad du gang 'gro ba de ma bsrungs kyang nyes pa med pas bsrungs na de ltar mchol bar srung ba dang*/ ldan na yar ldan te/ theg pa gsum gyi nges 'byung la// theg pa gcig gi 'bras bur gnas// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ chung ngu'i ngor chen po mi gtong ba ste/ so so thar pa dang byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa nang thug byung na byang chub sems dpa' ltar spyad nas so sor thar pa yal bar 'dor na nyes pa med do// byang chub sems dpa' dang gsang sngags 'dom thug byung na gsang sngags ltar spyad nas byang chub sems dpa' yal bar dor ba la nyes pa med pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gong ma bsrung bas nyes pa med/ 'og ma gnang bas nyes pa med/ nyes pa gnyis po gang med pa cho ga btsan po thabs bzang po theg pa'i go rim sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa yin gsungs/ de lta ma yin par gong ma dor nas 'og ma bsrung na 'og ma bsrung bas nyes pa bskyed/ gong ma dor bas nyes pa bskyed/ nyes pa gnyis gang bskyed pa de cho ga dman pa thabs dman pa la zhugs pa theg pa'i go rim nor ba sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa ma lon pa ste chung ngu'i ngor chen po btang ba'i phyir ro// de bas na ldan na yar ldan no// phyis 'chos na grub mtha' bzhin du phyir 'chos te so sor thar pa dang 'gal na bsam pa dang sbyor ba'i sgo nas mkhan po la sogs pa la bshags dgos na bshags/

bskyar dgos na bskyar/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang 'gal na sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags dgos na bshags/ bskyar dgos na bskyar/ gsang sngags kyi sdom pa dang 'gal na bshags sdom dbang rim gyi sgo nas phyir 'chos de'ang de gsum dang chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur rtogs pa la ni bshags pa la'ang tshegs med do// de ltar yang*/ bshags bya bshags byed bshags pa rnams// gang tshe rnal 'byor pas ma mthong*// rang bzhin dag pas yongs su mthong*// de ni bshags pa'i sdom pa'o// zhes gsungs// sdom pa gsum po de ngo bo gcig gam gnas skabs tha dad gong gi 'gal ba ltar snang ba de rnams mi 'gal bar bsrung na ji ltar srung zhe na/ de la mi 'gal ba rnam pa drug ste/ dus mi 'gal ba ni/ nyin mo so so thar pa dang mi 'gal/ mtshan mo gsang sngags kyi dam tshig dang mi 'gal/ gnyis kar byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang mi 'gal bar bya'o// gnas mi 'gal ba ni/ grong khyer du so sor thar pa dang mi 'gal/ dgon pa dang dben par gsang sngags kyi dam tshig dang mi 'gal/ gnyis kar byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang mi 'gal bar bya'o// grogs mi 'gal ba ni/ nyan thos kyi nang du so sor thar pa dang mi 'gal/ theg pa chen po'i rigs can gyi nang na byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang mi 'gal/ rgyud smin grol dang ldan pa'i nang du gsang sngags kyi dam tshig dang mi 'gal bar bya'o// rkyen mi 'gal ba ni/ na ba la sogs srog gi bar chad du 'gro ba dang lam gong ma'i bar chad du 'gro na de mi bya ste ma bsrung kyang 'gal ba med do// bsam pa mi 'gal ba ni/ gzhan don du 'gyur ba dang lam gong ma rang gi rgyudal brten na srog gcod pa la sogs byas kyang mi 'gal lo// gang zag gi gnas pas mi 'gal ba ni/ bsad pa gso nus/ rig ma dgug nus/ dngos po sbed nus pas de ltar byas kyang 'gal ba med do// de ltar bslab pa gsum po de dag thams cad kyang 'dam thug byung ba'i dus su shes rab kyi srang la dbab/

dgag dgos kyi yang ljid bsdur la/ dgag bya che shos spang ba'i don du chung shos gnang*/ che shos spangs pas nyes pa med// chung shos gnang bas nyes pa med// shes rab thabs dang ldan pa yi// dus tshod gtso bor khyer ba gces// zhes gsungs pas bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod pa'i gang zag gi rgyud sdom pa gsum dang ldan par bya gsungs/ lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa ni/ sdom pa rnams la bsngo bsgrang byed cing rang gi sems nyid glang chen smyos pa lta bu de lhag pa tshul khrims kyi dmigs pa'i ka ba la dran pa'i zhags thag gis dam du bcings/ shes rab kyi lcags kyus bzung nas blo rim gyis bsgom par byed pa ni zhi gnas so// de ltar zhi gnas kyi sems rtse gcig tu bzhag nas lhag mthong gi dpyad gzhig byed de sdom pa la rtog dpyod btang bas ji srid rtog dpyod 'dug phan chad bsam pa'i shes rab la rtog dpyod las 'das na bsgom pa'i shes rab bo// lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa ni chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin spros pa thams cad dang bral ba de goms shing rtogs pa de yin gsungs/ de lta bu'i bslab bya'i snud po ji ltar byed snyam na/ dpal tai lo pa chen po'i zhal nas/ yid la mi byed zhe 'dod kun dang bral// rang byung rang zhi chu yi pa tra 'dra// mi gnas mi dmigs don la mi 'da' na// dam tshig mi 'da' mun pa'i sgron me yin// zhe 'dod kun bral mtha' la mi gnas la// sde snod chos rnams ma lus mthong bar 'gyur// don 'dir gzhol na 'khor ba'i btson las thar// don 'dir mnyam bzhag sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs// bstan pa'i sgron me zhes su bshad pa yin// zhes gsungs pas mdo don snying por bsdu na man ngag bzhi sgroms su bcug nas lam gyi srol 'byed pa shing rta'i 'khor lo lta bu la don bzhi dang po lta ba chos nyid kyi don la phu thag bsring ba dang*/ gnyis pa sgom pa 'od gsal gyi don la gol sgrib kyi 'khyog bsrang ba dang*/

gsum pa spyod pa rgyu 'bras kyi don la lus ngag gi tshad sdom pa dang*/ bzhi pa 'bras bu lhun grub kyi don la re dwogs kyi blo dang bral ba'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar man ngag nyams len du dril nas sgrub pa lag tu len pa'i tshul la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro gsal btab la/ kun rdzob byang sems kyi skabs su/ drug pa blo sbyong gi dam tshig bstan pa la/ spyi don gsum la bslab pa'i dang po khas blang dang ma 'gal ba ni/ nga blo sbyong ba dang sgom chen sogs yin zer nas bslab bya phra mo khyad du mi gsod par so thar nas rdo rje theg pa'i bar gyi khas blang gi bslab bya rnams ma nyams par bsrung ste de'ang bcas pa'i bslab bya phra mo chab len lham phud ma byas pa sogs las rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba tshig rtsub pho rus kyi gtam sogs bag med pa'i bya byed dang smra brjod rnams sgo gsum gyi nyes par che bas ma shor bar srung zhing*/ gnyis pa tho cor ma shor ba ni/ bdag gces 'dzin med pa gzhan gyi go ba'i phyir shing gnyan gcod pa mdze pho dang 'gos nad can dang 'grogs pa/ dur khrod du ro 'bog cing ro gos gyon pa/ sha khrag gis byug pa dang mi gtsang ba'i zas dang mdzub mo la mar me 'bul ba dang lhog dgag la sgrub grwar 'dug pa dang*/ gcer bu rkang rgyan sogs yo byad med par byas nas bla ma mched grogs kyi ngo mtshar gyi mthong dang*/ yul 'brog pho mos grub thob tu mthong bar re ba'i dka' spyad la don mgo med pas tho co'i spyod pa rnams spang ngo*// gsum pa phyogs rer ma ltung ba ni/ mi'i gnod pa bzod la lha 'dre la mi bzod pa/ de bzhin du lha 'dre la bzod cing byang sems bsgom kyang mi la mi bzod pa/ hor sog po sogs la bzod kyang nye log gi ngan byed la mi bzod pa/ che ba la gus shing chung ba la brnyas pa lta bu rang gi nye ba mdza' bshes yang nye/

'khor g.yog rta nor sgo khyi rang phyogs kyi sprang po yan la byams snying rje ngang gis skye ba la dgra phyogs su gyur pa kun dang*/ gzhan yang rang dang gnyen bshes dang mi mthun pa dang kha smras ngan btags byed mkhan kyi rigs thams cad la byang sems kyi yul du mi 'ong bar sdang ba sogs phyogs re ba spangs la sbyangs te/ rtogs ldan mgon yes/ rgyud yo ba'i phyogs nas drang por bsrang*// mdo rgyud man ngag gi tshangs thig thob// blo ngan dred kyi bzod rgya ras su bor// mdo la gyis dril na mngon lkog spangs// zhes gsungs pa ltar byas nas bdag gces 'dzin gzhan gces su bsgyur la lus ngag gi spyod pa chos mthun rang so thub par bya/ mi sngon gyi mngon tshan chung la dge sems dang nyams len gyi sa chod che ba zhig bya ste/ dam pa so yi zhal nas/ chos pa'i rtags med pa/ sdig pa'i las mi byed pa/ sgrub pa mis mi tshor ba/ ci byed don dang 'brel ba dgos gsungs te/ 'di rnams rtsa tshig las/ spyi don gsum la rtag tu bslab// 'dun pa bsgyur la rang sor bzhag /ces pa'i don rnams bsgom/ de nas sngar bzhin gnad gsum gyi srang la 'grim zhing dmigs pa ting nge 'dzin gyi gnad la/ de'ang sems gnas par byed pa la sems gnas gnas po gsal gsal po bde bde po 'ong bar re ba dang*/ rnam rtog 'phros kyi dwogs pa'i bsgrim drag na sems mi gnas pa'i rkyen byed pas re dwogs gang yang mi bya bar 'bol le shig ger 'jog pa gal che ste/ skye med zhang gis phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa ni bcos ma dang dmigs gtad dang zhe 'dod dang rtsol bas rtogs par mi 'gyur te/ 'dod dang rtsol ba yod na 'tshang mi rgya// zhes dang*/ sems ma bcos na gsal/ chu ma brnyogs na dwangs/ zhes gsungs pas lus dang sems kyi rtsol ba thams cad dor la ched du bya ba med par bzhag ste/ ma bcos par bzhag /rang gar bzhag /klod la bzhag

/lhug par bzhag /spro bsdu med par bzhag /dmigs pa med par bzhag /gza' gtad med par bzhag /rang babs su bzhag /ci bder bzhag /rtsol sgrub med pa'i nyams cir yang mi rtog par 'char zhes dang*/ sems phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa ni gang du'ang dmigs gtad dang zhe 'dod med par sems rang gar klod kyis glod la tsen gyis bzhag /de ltar klod shes na gsal la rtog pa med pa nam mkha' rnam par dag pa'i dbyings lta bu 'char yun ring ba la yon tan du mi lta/ yun thung ba la skyon du mi lta bar skad cig tsam du 'khyer zhing bsgom pas dus ci zhig tsam na rtogs pa'i rang bzhin shes te rnam rtog 'od gsal du shar nas rgyun chad med par phril gyis 'char ba la the tshom med de sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa la lhan gyis sleb bo// zhes gsungs pa ltar sems rang shar gyi rig pa ngos zin pa de'i steng du bcas bcos med par lhod kyis glod la shigs kyis zhog mdzod cig /

byas la brda' bkrol zhing maṇḍal gtor 'bul smon lam gdab pa sogs bya'o// nyin ya byas pa'i nyi ma nyer gcig chos thun bcu gsum yin no// ༈ chos thun bcu bzhi pa ni/ 'dir snga nas phyag len du chos thun la thar rgyan gyi phar phyin drug yan chad 'chad nas bslab bya'i spyod lam shugs kyis go ba'i lugs byas nas ngo sprod gdab ma ran gyi bar nges don gyi bshad pa gtan nas mi 'chad cing do dgong nges bzung thub pa'i dmigs pa nyams su len bya'i bzhag thabs 'di kho na spod pa zhi gnas gtan la phab tsam nas zhi gnas kyi khrid rkang 'gro bar byas te/ rtogs 'bul zin pa dang lhag mthong bskyed pa'i rtsad gcod dang ngos 'dzin ngo sprad mdzad nas nges don bshad pa gang rig gi ngo sprod dang rgyab chos byed par gda' bas de'i phyag len gyi dbang gi 'di skabs theg pa spyi'i bslab bya mdor bsdus mgo smos re byas nas slar dpyod ldan la rgyumatshan zhib tu bshad pas thabs sna tshogs kyi slob ma'i rgyud 'dul zhing lta spyod gnyis ka'am gang rung la 'phrig zos nas phan thogs cung zad 'byung bar re nas 'di ltar 'grig rim bgyid pa lags pas rtsa 'thu sar skam pa 'khyer ba rgyu mtshan chung snyam du mi dgongs par mkhyen ldan rnams kyis cung zad dbye ba dang bcas pas don go bar bshad cing go rim gyis nges pa sogs ni ci 'thad bya'o// yang sngar bzhin tshig gi mtshams sbyor byas nas/ de ltar lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa sdom pa gsum po de dag gi rang rang gi ngo bo ngos bzung zhing skabs don byang sems kyi bslab bya rgyas par bshad pa la/ thog ma kho nar skyabs su 'gro ba'i bslab bya ni bcu gcig ste/ thun mong gi bslab bya lnga/ so so'i bslab bya drug go /thun mong gi bslab bya lnga ni/ phyogs gang dang gang du 'gro ba de dang de'i lha la skyabs su mi 'gro ba ma yin pa dang gcig /dgos pa gal che yang skyabs 'gro las thabs gzhan mi btsal ba dang gnyis/

srog dang bya dga'i ched du'ang dkon mchog gsum mi dpang ba dang gsum/ ci za ci 'thung gi phud kyis mchod cing dus kyi mchod pa bya ba dang bzhi/ phan yon dran pa'i sgo nas yang dang yang du skyabs su 'gro ba la bslab pa'o// so so'i bslab bya drug ni/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song nas 'jig rten pa'i lha la phyag mi 'tshal/ chos la skyabs su song nas sems can la gnod 'tshe spangs/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song nas grogs mu stegs pa la rten mi bca'/ sangs rgyas la gus pa bsgrub cing ma gus pa spang*/ chos la gus pa bsgrub cing ma gus pa spang*/ dge 'dun la gus pa bsgrub cing ma gus pa spang ba dang drug go /de nas so thar gyi sdom pa ris brgyad de/ dge slong pha ma gnyis dang*/ dge tshul pha ma gnyis dang*/ dge bsnyen pha ma gnyis dang*/ dge slob ma dang bdun/ bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa dang brgyad/ de'i nang nas dge tshul gyi bslab bya bcu gsum ni/ slob dpon las thob pa bcu ste/ rtsa ba bzhi yan lag drug go /rtsa ba bzhi ni/ srog gcod pa/ ma byin pa len pa/ mi tshangs pa spyod pa/ mi chos bla ma'i rdzun spang ba'o// yan lag drug ni/ chang dang*/ gar sogs dang*/ phreng sogs dang*/ mal stan mtho ba dang*/ phri dro'i kha zas dang*/ gser dngul len pa spang ba rnams so// mkhan po las thob pa gsum te/ khyim pa'i rtags spang ba nyams pa/ rab tu byung ba'i rtags rab tu len pa las nyams pa/ bla mar gsol ba btab pa las nyams pa spang ba'o// dge slong rnams ni ltung ba sde lngas bsdus pa spang ba'o// spyir dge sbyong gi chos bzhi ni/ gshe ba la slar mi gshe/ khro ba la slar mi khro/ brdeg pa la slar mi brdeg /mtshang 'bru ba la slar mi 'bru ba'o// de nas byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya la gsum ste/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims so// de la sdom pa'i tshul khrims ni/

mi dge ba bcu sdom pa'o// mi dge ba bcu ni/ srog gcod pa ma byin pa len pa 'dod pas log par g.yem pa ste lus kyi sgo nas gsum/ rdzun dang phra ma dang ngag 'khyal dang tshig rtsub ste ngag gi sgo nas bzhi/ brnab sems gnod sems log par lta ba ste yid kyi gsum dang bcu'o// dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug bsgrub pa'o// pha rol tu phyin pa drug ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phrin pa dang*/ tshul khrims/ bzod pa/ brtson 'grus/ bsam gtan/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o// de re re la ngo bo gsum du dbye ba'i lag len 'og nas bshad do// sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims ni bsdu ba rnam pa bzhi la sogs pa sems can rnams la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phan phyogs sgrub pa'o// bsdu ba rnam pa bzhi ni/ sbyin pas bde ba dang*/ snyan par smra bas dga' ba dang*/ don spyod pas bag phebs pa dang*/ don dang mthun pa'i gros chen gdab par bya'o// de dag ji ltar bslab pa'i tshul ni/ bslab btus las/ bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*// dge ba dus su bsags pa kun// sems can kun la gtong ba dang*/ de srung dag pa spel ba'o// zhes dang*/ gzhan rnams dang ni bdag la'ang rung*// sdug bsngal yin yang gang phan dang*// phan dang bde ba rnams bya ste// bde yang mi phan mi bya'o// zhes sdom pa nyi shu par gsungs pa ltar shes par bya'o// de'i mi mthun phyogs ngos bzung ba ni gnyis te/ sdom pa gtong bar byed pa rtsa ba'i ltung ba dang*/ bslab pa dang 'gal ba nyes byas kyi ltung ba'o// dang po bslab btus su bstan pa ni/ rgyal po byang chub sems dpa'i rtsa ltung lnga/ blon po byang chub sems dpa'i rtsa ltung lnga/ phal pa'i rtsa ltung brgyad/ thun mong du smon pa btang ba dang bcu dgu yin no// yang sdom pa nyi shu par bstan pa ni/ nyan thos kyi pham pa dang 'dra ba sdom pa gtong bar byed pa'i rtsa ltung bzhi/

bslab pa dang 'gal ba nyes byas kyi ltung ba bzhi bcu zhe lnga bstan te lugs gnyis ka'i rkang grang grangs tshul khrims le'ur bshad do// de nas gsang sngags kyi dam tshig ni/ dang po bslab pa'i gzhi lnga la bslab pa dang*/ thun mong rigs kyi dam tshig bcu bzhi bzung ba dang*/ khyad par dgongs te gsungs pa'i lnga srung ba'o// dang po lnga ni// srog gcod pa dang ma byin pa len pa dang 'dod log spyod pa dang rdzun du smra ba dang chang rnams spang ba la bslab pa'o// yang dus 'khor gyi rjes su 'brang nas srung bar bya ba lnga/ mi bya ba lnga/ mi bsnun pa/ mi 'khu ba lnga/ mi zhen pa lnga'o// bsrung ba lnga ni bslab pa'i gzhi lnga'o// mi bya ba lnga ni rgyan po dang kha na ma tho ba'i bza' ba dang*/ ngan tshig smra ba dang*/ bstan bcos ngan pa smra ba dang*/ mu stegs la sogs kyi chos smra bar byed pa rnams so// mi bsnun pa lnga ni/ ba glang*/ byis pa/ skyes pa/ bud med/ mchod rten la mi bsnun pa'o// mi 'khu ba lnga ni/ grogs dang rje bo dang sangs rgyas dang dge 'dun dang blo gtad pa la mi 'khu ba'o// mi zhen pa lnga ni/ gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro dang reg bya la mi zhen par bya'o// thun mong rigs kyi dam tshig bcu bzhi bzung ba ni/ gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'i bslab bya dang*/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims dang sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims brtan par 'dzin pa ni 'khor lo'i rigs kyi bzhi'o// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya'i de kho na nyid dang*/ slob dpon gyi dam tshig 'dzin pa ni rdo rje rigs kyi gnyis so// nyin re bzhin du chos kyi sbyin pa dang*/ zang zing gi sbyin pa dang*/ mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa dang*/ byams pa'i sbyin pa dang bzhi dus drug tu sbyin pa ni rin chen rigs kyi bzhi'o// phyi nyan rang gi theg pa dang*/ nang pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang*/

gsang ba rdo rje'i theg pa gsum 'dzin pa ni padma rigs kyi gsum mo// mchod pa'i las thams cad byed pa ni las kyi rigs kyi gcig go /khyad par dgongs te gsungs pa'i dam tshig lnga bsrung ba ni/ rdo rje rigs kyi srog gcod pa dang*/ rin chen rigs kyi ma byin pa len pa dang padma rigs kyi bud med bsten pa dang*/ las kyi rigs kyi rdzun smra ba dang*/ 'khor lo'i rigs kyi sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga chang bsten pa'o// de la srog gcod pa la gsum ste/ phyi sems ldan gyi dgra bo zhing bcu tshang ba/ nang rlung bcu'i bgrod pa/ gsang ba rnam par rtog pa'i 'ching ba gcod pa'o// yang ma byin pa len pa la gsum ste/ phyi phan bya'i longs spyod don gyi yod par bya ba/ nang bud med bkug la shu tra blang ba/ gsang ba theg chen gyi dge ba la mnyam par 'jog pa'o// yang gzhan gyi bud med bsten pa ni gsum ste/ phyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bud med bsten pa/ nang 'od rigs ye shes kyi phyag rgya bsten pa/ gsang ba rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid dang sbyor ba'o// yang rdzun smra ba ni gsum ste/ phyi sems can la phan pa'i rdzun gnas skabs su smra ba dang*/ nang drang don gyi gsung gis nges don la sbyar ba dang*/ gsang ba brjod med rtogs pas brjod pa la dbang thob par bya ba'o// yang sha chang la sogs bsten pa ni gsum ste/ phyi sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga dang chang thabs mkhas pas yongs su bsten pa dang*/ nang 'bar 'dzag gi bde bas lus dag cing byang sems la dbang thob pa dang*/ gsang ba stong nyid snying rje dbyer med du bsgom pa phyag rgya'i dam tshig /de dag gi mi mthun phyogs ngos bzung ba ni/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi/ yan lag gi sbom po brgyad dang de'i phyogs mthun la sogs pa'o// rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi ni/ rdo rje slob dpon la brnyas pa dang gcig /bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' las 'das pa dang gnyis/

rdo rje spun la khros pa dang gsum/ sems can la byams pa spang ba dang bzhi/ rdzas dang bsam pa'i byang chub kyi sems spang ba dang*/ dam pa'i chos la smad pa dang drug /ma smin pa la gsang ba bsgrags pa dang bdun/ phung khams sangs rgyas kyi bdag nyid can la brnyas pa dang brgyad/ rang bzhin dag pa'i bden gnyis kyi chos la the tshom za ba dang dgu/ gdug pa can la rtag tu byams pa dang bcu/ ming sogs bral ba'i chos dbyings la der 'dzin du rtog pa dang bcu gcig /dad pa can sun 'byin pa dang bcu gnyis/ bza' sogs dam tshig mi bsten pa dang bcu gsum/ shes rab ma bud med la smod pa dang bcu bzhi'o// yan lag gi sbom po brgyad ni/ dam tshig dang dad pa med pa'i rig ma bsten pa dang gcig /tshogs kyi 'khor lo rtsod pa dang gnyis/ sangs rgyas kyis ma gsungs pa'i rig ma las bdud rtsi len pa dang gsum/ gsang spyod kyi yan lag shes kyang gzhan la ston mi nus pa dang bzhi/ chos la dad pa'i sems can la chos ma yin pa'i gtam byed pa dang lnga/ nyan thos kyi nang du zhag bdun 'das pa dang drug /rnal 'byor gyi ye shes mi shes par sngags pa yin zer ba dang bdun/ phyi'i chos bshad dgos pa'i sems can la nang gi chos bshad pa dang brgyad do// gzhan yang thun mong gi dam tshig rtsa ltung gi phyogs mthun bco lnga ni/ bskyed rdzogs la gnas kyang mchod bstod zhag las 'das pa/ rang gi yi dam spang len byed pa/ mu stegs sogs kyi lha nus pa che bar bzung ba/ bskyed rim la rdzogs rim gyi rgyas mi 'debs pa/ dbang gong ma ma thob kyang gzhan la rdzogs par bskur ba/ zab mo'i don tshe 'di'i don du ston pa/ 'dom thug min par 'og ma'i bslab pa dral ba/ rnyed pa'i phyir yon tan gong ma yod tshul ston pa/ nus pa med kyang phrin las bzhi brtsom pa/ dgos ched med pa'i snyom las kyi rang gzhan smin mi nus pa/ nad pa dang log spyod la mi brtse ba/

rnal 'byor che la gnas kyang 'og ma'i spyod pa byed pa/ 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi g.yeng ba kho na sgrub pa/ theg gsum gyi sdom pa zhig pa'i gdul bya yal bar 'dor ba/ theg pa rang rgyud dang mthun pa'i spyod pa mi byed pa'o// gzhan yang yan lag gi ltung ba phyogs mthun bdun ni/ dam min gyi bla ma bsten pa/ snod min gyi slob ma bsdu ba/ 'dod pas gzhan srog la 'tshe ba/ dkon mchog gi dkor la spyad pa/ gzhan don gyi sems bskyed 'dor ba/ dge rtsa byang chub tu mi bsngo ba/ 'pho ba'i de nyid mi shes pa'o// de thams cad kyang nyon mongs bslang ba/ shes bzhin dang ldan pa/ lus ngag gi spyad pa/ rkyen gyi ma yin pa/ shes pa ma 'khrul ba/ 'gyod pa med pa/ lo las 'das pa de tshang na bdun ldan gyi pham pa yin pa/ dngos gzhi med cing tshad las ma 'das na ltung ba/ de bas bsam sbyor chung ba dang yan lag gi ltung ba brgyad sbom po/ de las chung zhing bco lnga pa la sogs pa ni ltung byed/ lus ngag gi sbyor ba phra'us ni nyes byas dang mtshungs pa lta bu ste/ bla ma'i bka' sogs dge ba'i don dang 'brel ba ni nyes med ltung ba'i gzugs brnyan yin gsungs/ gzhan yang dbang bzhi la mnyam bzhag gi dam tshig /rjes spyod kyi dam tshig /bza' ba'i dam tshig /bsrung ba'i dam tshig /mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig ste nyi shu pa dang*/ snyan brgyud rin po che las yongs su bstan pa'i dam tshig yid bzhin nor bu la thun mong khyad par mchog gi dam tshig gsungs pa rnams man ngag ltar shes par bya'o// gnyis pa skabs don byang sems kyi bslab bya rgyas par bshad pa la thams cad kyi sngon du skyabs su 'gro ba'i bslab bya gal che ste/ rje dwags pos/ skyabs 'gro ni sdom pa'i gzhi'i ngo bo yin/ rgyud las/ sdom pa kun la yod mod kyi// skyabs su ma song ba la med// ces gsungs pas/ skyabs 'gro ma btang na rtsa ba bzhi shor yang sdom pa'i bslab bya nyams pa las gzhi ma shor bas sdom pa'i ro dper na sbang ma btsir ba dang 'dra/

phyis bskyar na'ang skyabs 'gro bskyar dgos/ rtsa ba bzhi bslab bya yin pas bshags pas chog /skyabs 'gro shor na sdom pa'ang dung gi rdul phyis pa bzhin 'gro/ skyabs 'gro nyams pa'i rgyu dang 'chor ba'i rgyu gnyis yin/ nyams pa ni sha gcod sna 'bigs pa dang spu 'bal ba dang skra can go rar 'jug pa dang 'chor ba dang lnga'o// 'chor ba'i rgyu ni dkon mchog gsum gyi skyabs mi 'dod byas te btang na 'chor ma btang na mi 'chor/ zhes gsungs so// kun rdzob byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i ngo bo smon pa sems bskyed dang 'jug pa sems bskyed gnyis kyi dang po smon pa byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i bslab bya ni/ thar pa rin po che'i rgyan las/ sems can blo yis mi gtong dang*// sems bskyed phan yon dran bya dang*// tshogs gnyis bsags par bya ba dang*// yang yang byang sems sbyang ba dang*// dkar nag chos bzhi'i blang dor bslab// lnga pos smon pa'i bslab bya bsdus// zhes gsungs pa'i dang po sems can blos mi btang bas byang chub tu sems mi 'chor ba'i thabs ni/ sems can gang yang rung ba gcig gis bdag gi sems sun phyung ba'i tshe ngas khyod la nam yang phan mi btags gnod pa las mi bzlog 'phrad du mi rung snyam nas thun tshod la gnyen pos ma sleb na byang sems 'chor bas gnod len du phan 'dogs nus pa gcig dgos gsungs te/ phan btags len du gnod byas na// yang len snying rje chen pos brlan// 'dzam bu gling gi skyes mchog ni// nyes pa'i len yang legs par gdon// zhes so// gnyis pa phan yon dran pas byang chub kyi sems mi nyams pa'i thabs ni smon sems bskyed pas rang don 'byung ba/ gzhan don 'byung ba/ mi mthun phyogs gcod pa/ mthun phyogs 'grub pa'i dpe nyis brgya dang sum cu tsam sdong po bkod pa'i mdo las gsungs shing*/ gang la sems kyi dam pa rin chen de// skyes pa de yi sku la phyag 'tshal zhing*// zhes pa jo bo rjes rtag tu shar shar gsungs par grags pa lta bu'o// gsum pa tshogs gnyis rdzogs par bya bas byang chub sems kyi stobs bskyed pa'i thabs ni/

tshogs kyi gtam las/ de ring bdag gi bsod nams dang*// ye shes tshogs ni gang bya dang*// sems can phan pa gang bya zhes// byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu bas// zhes gsungs pas sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims rnams stong nyid kyi 'khor gsum yang dag tu shes pa'i thabs shes kyi sgo nas tshogs gnyis bsags pa ste tha na thun tshod re la'ang lan re bsags gsungs pa dang*/ bzhi pa yang yang sbyang bas byang chub kyi sems 'phel ba'i thabs ni/

mchan/ 'di man chad lag len du 'khyer bde ba'i phyir rnam grangs sdoms su bsdu ba la thar rgyan gyi rnam grangs bsdus nas tshigs bcad du sdeb pa dpa' bo'i spyod 'jug gi ṭīka nas 'byung ba bzhin phal cher du yod pa bzung bde zhing zhib tu go ba rnams la thar rgyan dngos dang spyod 'jug sogs ltar lag len yid ches kyi lung dang bcas cung zad rgyas par bshad do // de la rgyu dang dngos dang spyod pa'i sems sbyang ba gsum du gsungs pa'i mdo don lag len la/ rgyu yi byams dang snying rje bsgom// nyin mtshan thun drug sems bskyed blang*// bdag gzhan brje ba'i gtong len sbyang*// 'di ni byang sems sbyang ba'o// zhes pa sngar chos thun bdun par bshad pa'i blo sbyong gi dmigs thun gnyis pa ji lta ba bzhin dus rtag tu sbyang ba'o// lnga pa dkar nag chos bzhi'i blang dor gyi byang chub kyi sems mi brjed pa'i thabs ni/ dang po nag po'i chos bzhi spang ba ni/ bla ma dang ni mchod 'os bslu// 'gyod gnas min la gzhan 'gyod bskyed// rgyal sras gzhan la khro bas bskur// sems can la ni g.yo sgyus spyod// 'di rnams nag po'i chos bzhi ste// byang sems nyams dang brjed pa'i rgyu// bzlog pa dkar po'i chos bzhi ste// rtag par mi brjed rgyu yin no// de rnams las bzlog pa dkar po'i chos bzhi ni/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ 'od srung byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na skye ba thams cad du skyes ma thag tu byang chub kyi sems mngon du 'gyur te byang chub snying po la thug gi bar du bar ma dor brjed par mi 'gyur ro// bzhi gang zhe na srog gi phyir ram tha na bzhad gad kyi phyir yang shes bzhin du rdzun gyi tshig mi smra ba dang*/ sgyu dang g.yo med pas sems can gyi drung na lhag pa'i bsam pas gnas pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed cing de'i yon tan bsngags pa phyogs bzhir brjod pa dang*/

sems can gang dag yongs su smin par byed la de dag kyang nyi tshe ba'i theg pa mi 'dod pas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug pas te 'od srung bzhi po 'di dag go /zhes gsungs pas de rnams smon pa'i bslab bya'o// 'chor rgyu bcos thabs 'og nas 'chad do// de ltar theg pa gsum gyi bstan pa la bcas pa'i sdom pa'i rnam grangs mdo tsam smos pa de dag tshul bzhin nyams su blangs na/ bstan pa mchog la gnas shing 'dzin pa'ang yin la de dag gi mdo don gyi sdud po la/ ji skad du sambu ṭi las/ stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa// gang la sems ni sgom byed pa// de nyid sangs rgyas chos dang ni// dge 'dun gyi ni bstan pa'o// zhes bstan pa'i snying po ni stong nyid snying rjer 'du bar gsungs pa dang*/ rab tu mi gnas pa'i rgyud las/ ma bcos rnal ma'i zas shig zos gyur na// grub mtha' ma lus kun kyang tshim par 'gyur// byis sba ma rtogs tha snyad tshig la brten// thams cad rang gi sems kyi mtshan nyid yin// zhes gsungs pas/ mdo don snying por bsdu na/ don lam du khyer ba dbul po gter dang 'phrad pa lta bu'i gdams ngag la don bzhi/ 'gro drug pha ma ru ngo sprad la byams pa lam du khyer ba'i gdams ngag /'khor ba sdug bsngal du ngo sprad la snying rje lam du khyer ba'i gdams ngag /rgyu 'bras rten 'brel du ngo sprad la sems bskyed lam du khyer ba'i gdams ngag /snang grags chos sku ru ngo sprad la brjod du med pa'i don lam du khyer ba'i gdams ngag /ces gsungs pa ltar man ngag nyams len du dril nas sgrub pa lag tu len pa'i tshul la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro gsal btab la/ kun rdzob byang sems kyi skabs su gzhan la 'jig rten gyi skyon yod tshul dang chos kyi tshul khrims 'chal ba sogs mi snyan pa'i tshig mi bsgrags/

khyad par chos sgor zhugs pa rnams la skyon mthong na rang snang ma dag par bzung la yon tan ci 'dug la spyad/ snod bcud ma dag pa'i snang ba rang gi 'khrul pa'i gzugs su thag bcad la rtog ngan gyi rjes su mi 'brang zhing ngo bo la blta/ kun rdzob tu'ang pha mas bu rgyud kyi skyon yon tan du bzung zhing skyon la mi bsam yon tan bsgrags pa ltar byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje'i gnas kyi bu rgyud dang chung ma sems can yin par gsungs la/ theg dman du'ang gzhan 'chal ba'i skyon gleng bas bsod nams 'joms par bshad pa bzhin du gzhan skyon bsam shing gleng ba gzhan la bsgrag cing 'phya ba sogs rang sems g.yo sgyu che na gzhan la yid mi ches pa'i dpe lta bu 'dis legs byas thams cad gting nas zad pas mchog dman su la'ang log rtog mi bya zhing*/ yang rang rgyud la brtags nas bdag sdom gsum rdzogs par blang*/ zab don gyi man ngag 'di tsam gcun chos la bag chags de tsam bzhag kyang gzung 'dzin rang sar gnas pa ma gtogs ngan song gi sgo kheg tsam gyi nges pa rnyed pa'i chos ma byung ba 'di cis len/ chags zhen ser sna le lo gti mug sdang sems gang gi dbang du gyur nas 'dug /legs par brtags nas ngos zin ma thag der ma legs snyam du thabs shes thams cad de'i steng du dpung nas phyis yid ches kyi dga' ba ma skyes kyi bar du phur tshugs su rang rgyud 'dul/ de'ang byang chub kyi lam ma gtogs tshe 'di'i rnyed bkur phyi ma lha mi'i bde skyid dang rang kho na'i myang 'das thob pa sogs mdor na rang nyid kho na'i gces 'dzin gyi sems bskyed dang dge sbyor spang*/ gnod len mkhon du bzung nas brjed med kyi zhe bzhag dam po mi bya/ pha rol gyi tshig ngan lan du sma 'beb mtshang sgrogs ku re kyal ka'i tshul sogs su la'ang smra ba dang gzhan skyon bcos pa'i tshig gnad la phab pa'i gyod kha gdab pa sogs kyi slar dug gsum bskyed pa'i thabs mi bya/

gnod len zhe la bzhag nas 'gag la thug pa'i stabs byung dus gnod pa skyel ba dang*/ bran gyi dpon la brkus pa sogs dngos kyi bdag po la smra zhing skyon bslang ba dang*/ bla ma slob dpon bzang brdzu mkhan gyi rgyu mtshan yon bdag la bshad pa sogs rting ma la gnod pa 'byung ba dang*/ 'brel grogs gzhan gyi snying sun 'byin cing gnad la dbab pa'i ngan shes rnams dang*/ lha 'dre'i srog sngags zla zhing gnad la dbab pa sogs mi bya/ rang la bab pa'i le gyod dang khag ngan g.yo sgyu'i thabs kyi gnod pa gzhan la bsgyur ba/ chos 'jig rten gyi bya ba legs pa mang po mnyam du byas kyang rang kho nas byas pa'i snyan grags bsgrub pa/ longs spyod grwa pa yon bdag thun mong ba rnams kyang rang gcig pu'i bsdu thabs de rnams spang ngo*// 'di rnams rtsa tshig las/ yan lag nyams pa brjod mi bya// gzhan phyogs gang yang mi bsam mo// nyon mongs gang che sngon la sbyang*// 'bras bu re ba thams cad spang*// dug chen gyi zas spang*/ gzhung bzang po ma bsten/ shag ngan ma rgod/ 'phrang ma sgug /gnad la mi dbab/ mdzo khal glang la mi byo/ mgyogs kyi rtse ma gtod/ ces pa rnams kyi don no// mchan/ 'dir tshig mang yang phal cher gong du bshad pa'i nag po'i chos bzhi dang 'bral zhing 'byung nye bar bsam nas bshad pa yin gyi gzhan tshig grangs nyung na go sla ba dang cung zad blo la nges par dga'o// de nas sngar bzhin gnad gsum gyi srang la 'grim zhing dmigs pa ting nge 'dzin gyi gnad la sngar ltar rig pa bcas bcos med par rang babs su lhod kyis glod la bzhag go /glod ma shes na shes pa rnal du mi phebs shing ye shes mi 'char te/ dper na lcags su bcug pa'i mi la 'bros pa'i bsam pa las med pa dang 'dra/ grub chen o rgyan pas/ sems nyid gar yang ma shor bar bzung dgos snyam pa'i bsam pa'i gzugs de rang 'phro ba'i rkyen du 'gyur ba ste/

dper na gnas gzhi gcig tu mi gcig 'ong ba de la dpon po'i gsung gi khyod gzhan du ma 'gro gsung gin 'dug pas de ring 'dir sdod gcig byas na sngar sdod pa la spro nas 'ong ba yin kyang rkyen des bskul nas bya dka' 'di dang 'di bkod pa las 'os med pas bzur ba drag /snyam du 'bros pa'i chas byed pa dang 'dra/ de'ang dpon po'i gsung de med na sdod du byung tshad du zo bder sdod pa gcig 'ong ba yin/ de bas na sems la las mi 'chol bar lhod kyis glod nas ma yengs tsam gyi ngang la ci yang mi bsgom zhing*/ bzo bcos gang yang med par lhod de shig ge 'bol le bzhag /re dwogs dang rtsis gdab med pa'i ngang du gu yangs par bya zhes dang*/ ḍom bi he ru ka'i dgongs pa dwags po rin po ches gsungs pa ni/ chu ma rnyogs na dwangs pa bzhin du tshul ma bcos par bzhag go /nyi ma sprin gyis mi bsgrib pa bzhin du tshogs drug mi dgag par rang lugs su bzhag go /dus dang spyod lam thams cad du ma yengs par bzhag go /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar rtog pa gang shar la lhod kyis glod la zhog mdzod cig / byas la brda bkrol zhing maṇḍal gtor 'bul smon lam gdab pa sogs bya'o// nyin ya byas pa'i nyi ma nyer gsum chos thun bcu bzhi yin no// ༈ chos thun bco lnga pa la sngar bzhin tshig gi mtshams sbyor byas nas/ gnyis pa 'jug pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i bslab bya la/ bsdom bya sdom pa'i tshul khrims su bshad pa'i dgag bya rnams spang ba yin la/ sgrub bya dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims pha rol tu phyin pa drug ste/ de dag la bslab bya gsum mam tshul khrims gsum sogs byang chub sems dpas spyad par bya ba mtha' dag tshang zhing de dag rab tu dbye bsdu'i sdom ni/ rgyan las/ grangs dang de yi mtshan nyid go rim dang*// nges pa'i tshig dang goms dang yon tan dang*// de dag rab dbye bsdu dang mi mthun phyogs// yon tan phan tshun rnam nges yin zhes bya// zhes gsungs pa'i rnam grangs dang mthun par thar rgyan gyi bsdus don rnam par bzhag pa'i le'u las 'byung ba

cung zad spro dgos na skabs 'dir phar phyin drug gi lus rnam bzhag la chos thun gcig byas kyang 'ong*/ sogs rgyas par bshad kyang rung la sbyor ba lag tu len phyir so so'i ngo bo bshad pa la/ thar rgyan las/ skyon yon rnam gnyis bsam pa dang*// ngo bo dang ni dbye ba dang*// phye ba so so'i mtshan nyid dang*// spel dang dag par bya ba dang*// 'bras bu dang ni don bdun gyi// sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin bsdus so// zhes phar phyin gzhan rnams kyi mdor bstan sa bcad kyang 'dis 'gres nas gsungs pa de dag gi'ang rnam grangs rgyas pa thar rgyan nyid ltar ram gang 'thad bshad pa de lag len du 'dus par byed pa gal che ste/ ji srid dge ba'i bya ba thams cad phar phyin drug po 'di la 'dus shing tshang ba'i phyir/ dkar po'i chos kun rnam g.yengs dang*// mnyam bzhag gnyis kar shes par bya// pha rol phyin pa gnyis dang gnyis// gnyis kyis yongs su bsdus pa yin// zhes dang*/ rje dwags po'i chos bzhi chen mor/ 'jug pa'i bslab bya tshad rgya ma chad// sems can kun la kun tu phan bde// ltos med mi rtog brtse ba'i sems kyis// nam mkha' 'byung ba chen po bzhi ltar// dngos sam brgyud de ji ltar rigs par// rnam smin bcas pa btang zhing 'bad bya// zhes dang*/ zhang rin po ches/ sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyis// zin pa'i pha rol phyin pa drug /tshogs gnyis dag tu bsdu byas nas// stong pa snying rje zung 'brel bas// zhi gnas lhag mthong bsgom bya zhing*// rang rgyud legs par sbyang bya zhing*// rgyun chad med pa'i gzhan don 'bad// ces sogs rnam grangs rgya cher bstan pa'i don sgrub par bya phyir mtshan nyid dngos bshad pa la/ de la dang po sbyin pa ni/ bsam dngos zhing thabs ma dag spongs// bsam pa log dang dman pa gnyis// gzhan gnod phyir dang grags phyir dang*// 'gran phyir len la re ba ni// log pa'i bsam pa zhes bya'o// 'khor bar longs spyod 'dod phyir dang*// nyan rang du bsngo dman pa'i sems// chang dug mtshon cha gnod pa'i zas// rgya rnyi rngon gyi 'khrul 'khor dang*// mthu dang byad kyi thabs la sogs// ma dag pa yi dngos po yin// bdud ris tho 'tshams bdud kyi brloms// spyos dang sems 'khrug lus bslad dang*// 'grang zhing ngom la bza' btung dang*// dad pa med la dam chos sogs// ma dag pa yi zhing yin no// mi dga' khros 'khrug brnyas dang smad// brdeg dang ma gus yun ring du// brgyangs sogs sbyin thabs ma dag pa'o// de sogs ma dag sbyin pa spang*// de las bzlog pa dag pa ste// bsam pa snying rjes sems can skyobs// byang chub 'dod phyir sbyin par brtsam// de yang gzhan la dngos dang brgyud// gang du'ang mi gnod phan 'gyur ba// 'di ni dngos po dag pa ste// byang chub sems dpa' thabs mkhas pas// mi gtong ba ni ci yang med// dkon mchog bla ma yon tan zhing*// pha ma mkhan slob phan btags zhing*// mgon med la sogs sdug bsngal zhing*// dgra la sogs pa gnod byed zhing*// de ltar rnam bzhi gtso bo ste// mdor na 'gro kun sbyin pa'i zhing*// sbyin pa'i yul la dga' ba dang*// bzhin 'dzum 'ong ba legs zhes brjod// bkur sti zhe sar ldan pa yi// myur bar rang gi lag brdar te// mi gnod dus la phan par sbyin// yid dga' sems ni 'gyod med pas// dge ba byang chub mchog tu bsngo// 'di ni sbyin pa'i thabs dag pas// sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa'o// 'bru nor rin chen rgyan dang gos// bzhon pa khang bzang sa gzhi sogs// phyi'i dngos po ji snyed dang*// rang lus su gtogs nang gi dngos// bu smad dag ni gnyis ka'i dngos// tshe 'di'i pha ma ma gtogs pa// mdor na bdog pa ma lus gtong*// byang chub sems dpa' rab byung gi

/chos gos gsum las gzhan pa dang*// bsod snyoms zas la bgo bsha' bya// yi ge bri dang bri yo byad// gtso bor dkon pa'i dam chos sbyin// gang zhig dgra dang chom rkun dang*// me chu gcan gzan nad sogs kyis// mnar rnams snying rjes 'jigs skyob bya// chos 'dod chos dang chos smra la// gus la zang zing med pa'i sems// dag cing byams brtser ldan pa yi// 'chad po kun spyod rnam dag pas// yul dang 'tshams pa'i dam chos bstan// 'di ni sbyin pa'i nang nas mchog /ces sbyin pa'i rnams grangs kyi rtsa tshig yin la/ de yang ma dag pa'i sbyin pa ni nam yang spangs dgos te/ mdo las/ khe drag dang ni dbang med dang*// len la re ba phan yon dang*// 'gyod pa dang ni phrag dog dang*// brlom pa ma dag dri ma brgyad// 'di brgyad sbyin pa'i dri ma yin// zhes gsungs pa'i ma dag pa spang zhing 'khor gsum yongs su dag pas sbyin pa'i pha rol du phyin pa nyid du'ang 'gyur zhing*/ de'ang longs spyod zang zing gi sbyin pa de la phyi tshis dang*/ mchan/ 'di phyin gyi phar phyin lnga ka'i skabs su las dang po'i gsar 'jug rnams kyi lag len theb cing go sla ba kho na la bsam nas gong ma rnams kyi tshogs chos mang po nas btus pa lags pas slar dpyod ldan la 'chad nyan byed dus dgos ched cher yod na lhan thabs su gang la gang 'os bshad par bya'o // rtsis gdab med pa gcig gi 'grub ste/ gong ma'i gsungs las/ longs spyod can spong dag byed tsam na/ phyi tshis kyi rtsis gdab mi gtang ba gcig dgos gsung ste de la spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyams dma' ba'i dus 'dir dge ba'i las gang byed kyang mi dang mi ma yin gyi bar chad 'byung srid pas bsam ma thag myur du bsgrub dgos pa yin/ mi yi bar chad gnyen nye 'brel/ dga' grogs la sogs pa su nye ba rnams kyis phyi bshol dang bsam pa thog tu mi gtong ba'i 'gal rkyen byed nas 'ong bas de la mi nyan pa yin/

de'ang mdo las/ bdud la la ni pha'i cha byad du/ la la ni ma'i cha byad du/ la la ni mkhan po dang slob dpon gyi cha byad du song zhes bshad pas chos dang rnam par dkar ba'i dge ba la gegs byed pa thams cad bdud du ngos bzung nas phyi bshol dang rkyen dbang du skad cig kyang mi gtong bar blo thag rbad lings kyis bcad nas sngar bas kyang snying khams bskyed nas che zhing lhag par gtong dgos pa yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan longs spyod 'di sbyin pa'i 'bras bu yin pas btang ba bzhin du lhag par 'phel ba yin/ da lta longs spyod cung zad yod pa 'di'ang phyi tshis dang ser snas byung ba min/ skye ba snga ma sbyin pa btang ba las byung ba yin mod/ phyi tshis dang ser sna yi dwags kho na mkhas te/ des gyong btang gda' ba/ de bzhin song tsa na ser sna byed pa'i mkhan po su 'ong*/ skye ba phyi ma'ang bkres skom gyis gzir ba bas longs spyod yod pa grags lags mod/ gnas skabs kyi phan yon yang*/ ji skad du/ sbyin pas 'byung po dbang du 'gyur// sbyin pas dgra rnams med par byed// sbyin pa mtho ris skas yin pas// sbyin pa ngan 'gro bzlog byed yin// sbyin pa 'jig rten rgyan yin te// sbyin pa zhi byed dge ba'o// zhes gsungs pas tshe 'di'i rim gro phyi ma'i brgyag phye nam zhig gtan gyi so nam/ byang chub kyi lam stegs yin snyam du bsams la zhing bsam dngos gsum gyi rten 'brel bsgrigs nas longs spyod btang ba'i dus la bab pa yin te/ spyod 'jug las/ thams cad 'jog par mnyam pa la// sems can rnams la gtong ba mchog /ces bshad pas sang dus don med pa'i mi rnams kyi longs spyod pa bas da lta rang gi brgyag phye grabs su bcug pa drag snyam du 'phangs pa med par gtong ba'i dus la bab pa yin gsungs/ chos kyi sbyin pa la/ rnyed pa dang bkur sti la sogs pa don du mi gnyer bar rnam par dag pa chos kyi sbyin pa btang ba ste/

tshogs chos rgya che ba/ zab chos gnad 'dril ba/ man ngag zab mo byin rlabs dang ldan pa'i sgo nas sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi la sogs pa gang la gang mkho ba gtong ba ste/ mdo las/ 'jig rten gyi khams rin po che sna tshogs kyis bkang ste dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa phul ba bas chos rnam par dag pa tshig bzhi pa gcig sems can la bstan pa bsod nams che bar gsungs pas thos bsam sgom gsum la brtson zhing chos kyi sbyin pa la 'bad par bya'o// de'ang rang rgyud la brtags nas chos dang mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa sogs kyis gzhan skyob pa'i nus pa yod na de'i tshe snying stobs bskyed par bya ste/ byang chub sems dpa' gzhan don byed tsa na mi kha dang gshe skur la mi 'jigs pa cig dgos pa yin gsungs pas/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ theg pa chen por khas blangs/ 'gro ba sems can gyi don la zhugs pa'i dus su/ phyi'i gshe skur dang ngan smras/ nang gi bde sdug gi rkyen la sogs la 'jigs na theg pa chen por mi yong bas bde sdug dang mtho dman gang byung yang chos nyid kyi klong du bsgyur ba cig dgos/ gzhan gyi log sgrub byung tsa na rang nyid gu yangs su 'gro ba gcig dgos/ de'i rgyu mtshan theg pa chen po zer ba'i ming de ga mod/ byang chub sems dpa' byang chub sems dpa' zer ba de'ang sems can dpag tu med pa'i don 'grub pa la zer ba yin mod/ sems can gyi don ma grub na sems bskyed la don ci yod/ nyan thos kyi lta spyod dang mthun pa'i spyil chung rer zhugs nas ngag tu sems bskyed pa skad zer/ 'gro don la shi bzur ko bzur du bzur/ bde sdug la skyon yon du lta/ 'gal rkyen dum tsam byung tsa na bya 'jol mo bzhin dus phyogs gzhan du bzur nas 'gro ba de la gshe skur dang log sgrub ga na 'ong*/ dper na mgo chag dang rmas ma'i rigs tsho dpa' bo g.yul du zhugs pa la 'ong ba lags mod/

sdar ma wa bros byed pa la rmas nas gar 'chi/ dpe de bzhin du bstod smad dang sgro skur byed pa la sogs pa thams cad theg pa chen pos gzhan don byed pa'i dus su 'ong ba yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang ma rungs pa 'dul ba la phrin las bzhi kas skyong dgos/ sdod sa nges med du sdod dgos/ zla'o sems can dang 'grogs dgos/ su ma rungs pa rnams dang snang ba bstun dgos pa yin/ phyug rdzi byol song dang 'dris drag pas blo blun por song ba dang 'dra/ dper na sman pa mkhas pa'ang dus rtag tu nad pa dang 'grogs dgos/ brtags pa mkhan po dus rtag tu mdze pho dang 'grogs dgos/ de la gzhan gyis bltas na nad pa dang mdze pho skyong ba de la'ang 'brang gtsang po dang yid pheb po mi 'ong las che ste/ de dang 'grogs ma nus gtsang btsog mi bzod na sman pa'i bya ba mi 'grub pa dang 'dra/ de bzhin du 'gro don byed pa'i dus su log sgrub mi yong ba la re ma re med/ de byung ba thams cad chos nyid kyi steng du ro snyoms pa lags mod/ de ro mi snyoms na sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi rnam thar la bltas nas pho zo bskyed kyang mig thag chad pas da rung gnas ri khrod kyi dgon par dben pa bsten pa drag pa yin/ mtho dman gyi log sgrub mi bzod na chos brgyad rang gar spyad pas gzhan don bas rang don yang mi 'grub ste/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyi zhal nas/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa rnyed dang ma rnyed dang*// snyan dang mi snyan grags dang ma grags dang*// bstod smad ces bgyi 'jig rten chos brgyad po// bdag gi yid yul min par mgo snyoms mdzod// ces gsungs pas/ 'jig rten chos brgyad mgo snyoms dgos pa'i gnad kas 'gro don pher ba 'di ka las che ba lags mod/ 'gro don 'grub pa la stong nyid snying rje zung du chud nas legs tshogs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs pa la mkhas pa gcig dgos par gda' bas chos brgyad kyi dbang du 'gro zhing sems can gyi log sgrub mi bzod na da rung sgrub pa byed pa rang bzang*/

sems can 'dzad rgyu med pas ha cang ring rgyu tsam med/ 'gro don la zhugs phyin chad nas sgro skur la 'jigs ma 'jigs med de sems can la gshis ngan de ka las ma grub pa'i phyir/ sngon bcom ldan 'das dka' thub la bzhugs dus bdud kyi zan skam dang rus pa dang sbang skam spyil po'i mthar gtor ba dang*/ thugs bskyed gsungs pa'i dus bdud kyi bu mos bu chung gtod du byung ba sogs dang*/ slob dpon klu sgrub gser khar byon pas 'dre can du btags pa dang*/ zhi ba lha nā len drar byon pa la ma he'i zho skam zer nas phud pa sogs byung ba lta bu ngan pa'i thabs mi chag pa bshad kyis mi longs pa yod pas de 'dra la ro snyoms zhing dgag sgrub med pa gcig dgos pa yin gsungs/ dngos po dag pa'i skabs su/ gser gling pa'i zhal nas/ rgyal bu thams cad sgrol du gyur pa na// bu dang bu mo rgyal srid byin pa ltar// shin tu 'phreng ba'i nor dang 'khor la sogs// phongs pa med par yongs su btang bar bya// rgyal bu snying stobs chen por gyur pa na// stag mo rang gi sha yis gsos pa ltar// shin tu gces pa'i sgyu lus phung po 'di// sha za'i tshogs la dga' bas sbyin par bya// rgyal po byams pa'i stobs su gyur pa na// gnod sbyin rang gi khrag gis gsos pa ltar// spyad par dka' ba'i snying khrag dron mo 'di// khrag 'thung dag la brtse bas sbyin par bya// tshong dpon khye'u chu 'bebs gyur pa na// bder gshegs mtshan brjod nya rnams gsos pa ltar// chos kyis phongs pa'i skye bo thams cad la// dam pa'i chos kyi sbyin pas tshim par bya// rgyal bu dge don chen por gyur pa na// 'khor ngan log sgrub thugs rjes bzod pa ltar// 'khor gyi log sgrub gshis ngan 'khrug pa la// snying rje chen pos lhag par brtse bar bya// byang chub sems dpa' spre'ur gyur pa na// sdig can khron pa'i nang nas drangs pa ltar// ngan pa rnams la phan gdags mi shes kyang*// bzang len mi 'dod snying rjes drang bar bya// kyi hud pha mar ma gyur su yang med// 'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba skad cig med// ngan pa'i tshogs la bzang len bor ba 'dra// da ni thub chen dpa' bo'i rnam thar ni// gus pas blangs nas skye bo ma bsrungs na// dpa' bo 'jug pa'i lag len 'ong mi srid// de phyir srog la bsdos la dka' spyad bstan// bde bar gshegs pa 'das tshul bstan rjes su// de yi rjes su bslab par 'dod pa rnams// 'di 'dra'i lag len rgyud la mi bsten na// skye bo yongs kyi bde skyid zad dwogs yod// de phyir dpa' bo rnams kyi skyid chos 'di// ci la thug kyang dka' spyad srog la bsdos// 'di ni dpa' bo 'jug pa'i lag len no// zhes gsungs pa ltar shes par bya'o// dngos po med pa'i bya bral dang dge sbyong rnams ni gtong ba'i mchog zhen log nang nas skyes pa'i spang dag gal che ste/

gong ma'i gsung las/ sbyin pa'i rgyal po chags med yin pas longs spyod bdag tu ma bzung zhes pa dang*/ dngos po bdag tu mi bzung ba zang zing gi zhabs tog /ci byed chos dang bstun pa longs spyod kyi zhabs tog /ces mchod pa'i mchog yin pas rgya ras pas/ zhen pa log pa skyug nad can gyi khar zas bzhag pa 'dra zhig dgos gsungs pa lta bu bya ba dang nang nub tu lus sha khrag gi mchod sbyin 'bul ba blo sbyang dang gcod kyi lugs yin zhing dmigs yul lhar bskyed pa nā ro gsang spyod kyi lugs yin pas gang yin kyang 'dre 'dul dang srog glud du gtong ba ma yin par tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa dang rnam smin byang zhing yi dwags bkres skom tshim pa'i snying rjes sbyin pa ni zang zing gi sbyin pa la gtong ba dang*/ shin tu gtong ba dang yongs su gtong ba dang gsum gsungs pa'i phyi ma'o// de ltar sbyin pa'i bye brag thams cad kyang rtsa ba sems kyi byed pa kho na ste/ spyod 'jug las/ gal te 'gro ba dbul bor ba// sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin gsungs te// da dung 'gro bkren yod na sngon// skyob pa ji ltar pha rol phyin// bdog pa thams cad 'bras bcas te// skye bo kun la btang sems kyi// sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin gsungs te// de ltas de ni sems nyid do// zhes gsungs pas sems kyi byed pa de dag dmigs med du 'jog pas bden pa mthong ba na sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa nyid du 'gyur ba ste/ mdo las/ sbyin pa byin nas dngos la gnas pa med par byed// de ni nam du'ang rnam par smin la re ba med// de ltar btang ba mkhas pas thams cad btang ba ste// chung ngu btang bas mang po dpag tu med par 'gyur// zhes sogs dang*/ bye brag tu gal che ba/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo las/ stong pa nyid las ma g.yos na// pha rol phyin pa drug 'dus so// zhes sogs spyir btang du'ang 'di nyid rag las te/

mdo las/ sbyin pa sbyin pa'i sngon du 'gro ba shes rab ste// tshul khrims bzod dang brtson 'grus bsam gtan de bzhin no// ces dang*/ shes rab med na mig med pha rol phyin lnga 'dis/ dmigs bu med pas byang chub reg par nus ma yin// zhes dang*/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'ang mi dmigs pa'i tshul lam mtshan ma med pa'i tshul gyis spyod/ ces drug ka la sbyar nas gsungs pas de ltar stong pa rgya bzhis gdab pa dang snying rjes zin pas sbyin pa dag par byed pa sogs mang du 'byung bas mdo don snying por bsdu na/ gdams pa gnad du theb pa long ba mig 'byed pa lta bu'i gdams ngag la don bzhi/ snang ba gzugs la dmigs pa'i bsam gtan snang stong dbyer med du gtan la phab nas smig rgyu ltar nyams su len pa'i gdams ngag dang*/ brjod pa sgra la dmigs pa'i bsam gtan grags stong gnyis med du gtan la phab nas brag cha lta bur nyams su len pa'i gdams ngag /myong ba ro la dmigs pa'i bsam gtan myong stong gnyis med du gtan la dbab pa smyon pa'i kha zas lta bur nyams su len pa'i gdams ngag /tshor ba reg bya la dmigs pa'i bsam gtan bde sdug gnyis med du gtan la dbab pa rmi lam lta bur nyams su len pa'i gdams ngag ces gsungs pa ltar man ngag nyams len du dril nas sgrub pa lag tu len pa'i tshul thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro gsal btab la/ kun rdzob byang sems kyi skabs su rang bzang por grags pa'i snyan pa dang rgyal kha 'dod nas mchod sbyin nor zas mang po gtong ba/ pha rol dgra la pham kha len pa nad gdon zhi ba'i phyir blo sbyong byed pa lto chos lta bu dang*/ lhag par 'dis snyem phog pa ltar rlom sems dang nga rgyal che ru song nas bzang 'dod dang gces 'dzin drag po skyes pa dang*/ nye du grogs mched yon bdag la na tsha shi chad byung na rten mchod dpe cha dang zas nor gyi tshogs sogs 'ong ba'i rlom pa dang*/

rang dang 'dra mnyam gyi dge bshes sgom chen shi na rang gcig pu la sku bsod dang*/ dgra shi na gnod byed mi 'ong snyam pa sogs rang skyid thabs la gzhan sdug par 'dod pa spang ngo*/ 'di rnams rtsa tshig las/ lta log mi bya/ lha bdud du mi dbab/ skyid kyi yan lag tu sdug mi tshol/ zhes pa rnams kyi don no// de nas sngar bzhin gnad gsum gyi srang la 'grim zhing dmigs pa ting nge 'dzin gyi gnad la/ de ring phan zin pa brtan par byed pa'i dmigs pa gang shar rang thog tu klod tshul bstan pa yin te/ de dag gi don yang*/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ gzhi nas ma bcos ye nas lhun grub la// tha mal rang lhug chen por bzhag pa ni// 'pho 'gyur med pa nam mkha'i klong yangs su// skye 'chi med pa chos sku'i lus thob 'gyur// zhes dang*/ tai lo pas/ phyag rgya chen po bstan du med kyis kyang*// dper na nam mkha' gang gi gang la brten// de bzhin rang sems phyag rgya che la brten yul med// ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang du klod la zhog /bcings pa klod na grol bar the tshom med// ces gsungs pa'i don no// spyi don gsum pa brtan pa bogs dbyung ba'i dmigs pa yul kun dang bsre zhing rtsal sbyang ba zhes bya ba'i don la/ rgyal ba'i dbang po'i khrid yig chen mor 'byung ba'i rtsa tshig /brtan pa bogs dbyung yul drug so so dang*// yid yul dge dang mi dge gang skyes pa// de la dgag sgrub med par so sor 'dzin// thun thung grangs mang klod kyi klod la 'bad// ces gsungs pa ji lta ba bzhin du khrid yig 'di nyid kyi gzhung nas 'byung ba ltar bsgom par bya ste/ de'ang brtan pa dbang 'byor bar byed pa la gnyis/ sgo lnga'i snang ba dang bsre zhing bsgom pa dang*/ yid kyi chos la bsre zhing bsgom pa'o// de la dang po sgo lnga'i snang ba dang bsre zhing bsgom par bya ste/ de'ang bca' ba lus kyi gnad/

bla ma mos gus kyi gnad snga ma ltar shes par byas la/ dmigs pa ting nge 'dzin gyi gnad ni/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gnas pa'i ngang nas yul gzugs ri ra ba khang khyim mun pa dang snang ba shing rdil sku gzugs sam/ yul dang grong khyer dang tshong dus dang khrom chen po la sogs te gang la mig gi dbang pos mthong zhing bdag rkyen byed pa'am/ rkyen byed pa ma yin na'ang ched du mig gi dbang po'i gzugs de lta bu la gtad cing thun chung grangs mang du gsal 'debs la yul de las gzhan du skad cig kyang ma yengs par nyams len dang gzugs gnyis dbyer med/ gzugs su gsal bar 'dzin pa'i shes pa de thog tu klod kyi 'jog cing yang shes pa cung zad yengs nas slar glod kyin bshigs pa snon la de rang phur tshugs su gsal 'debs la sgom gyi 'ben du bya zhing gzugs snang ma 'gag pa sems dang dbyer med cing yul la der 'dzin gyi mtshan ma mi brtags par glod kyis 'jog par bya ste/ rje rgod tshang pas/ phyi yi yul la gcer gyis ltos// yul snang sgyu ma lta bu yin// gang shar thog tu 'dzin med zhog /ces gsungs pa lta bu'o// de bzhin du rna ba'i sgra dang*/ sna yi dri dang*/ lce yi ro dang*/ lus kyi reg bya 'jam rtsub la sogs tshur la rnam rtog 'phro ba'i rkyen byed pa de la/ de skyur nas rnam rtog gzhan zhig btsal nas de thog la 'jog pa ma yin par 'phro rkyen nam byung ba'i sgo lnga'i snang ba dngos bzung la de'i thog la 'jog la sngar bzhin ma yengs par sems gtad la bsgom/ de la goms nas spobs pa skyes pa bzhin tshur la rkyen byed pa ma yin na'ang de lta bu yod pa'i sar 'gro ba'am khyad par du'ang gsal snang bskyed cing bsgom/

de ltar bsgom pa'i dus su sgo lnga'i snang ba de dang dmigs pa nyams len 'dres nas ji lta ba bzhin du snang zhing tshor ba ma 'gag la bzang por 'dzin pa dang ngan par 'dzin pa'i chags sdang mi skye ba'i nyams bzang po 'byung ngo*// mchan/ rjes spyod du'ang snga ma ltar yin la khyad par spyod lam rnam bzhi'i bya ba de nyid nyams len gyi 'ben du bya zhing lam du khyer gang thub kho na la rtsal sbyong ba dang*/ bogs 'don sngas na sa mi zin zhes bshad pa'ang 'byung bas/ rgyun du 'dug pa'i tshe sngar bzhin bzhag thabs byed pa dang gang la'ang rang sar glod shes pa'i ngang nas nyams su longs mdzod cig / byas la brda' bkrol zhing maṇḍal gtor 'bul smon lam gdab pa sogs bya'o// nyin ya byas pa'i nyi ma nyer lnga chos thun bco lnga yin no// ༈ chos thun bcu drug pa la sngar bzhin tshig gi mtshams sbyor byas nas/ gnyis pa tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sdom ni/ skyon yon rnam gnyis bsam pa dang*// ngo bo dang ni dbye ba dang*// phye ba so so'i mtshan nyid dang*// spel dang dag par bya ba dang*// 'bras bu dang ni don bdun gyis// tshul khrims pha rol phyin pa bsdus// zhes pa ltar rgyas pa thar rgyan sogs ltar bshad pa las shes shing mtshan nyid lag len du bsdu ba la/ tshul khrims legs blang bsam pa dag /nyams na phyir gso mi nyams phyir// lus gnas yon tan bzhi dang ldan// khyad par sdom pa'i tshul khrims la// thun mong so thar ris bdun te// gzhan don byang chub rgyur blangs phyir// theg chen sdom pa'i tshul khrims yin// thun mong min pa byang sdom nyid// blangs te tshul bzhin blang dor bya// gzhan yang lus kyi mchong rgyugs sogs// rmu rgod rtsab hral spyod pa dang*// smra ba mang dang smra ba rno// rnyed bkur 'du 'dzir chags pa sogs// sgo gsum 'du byed ma dag spong*// gnyid dang rmugs la zhen mi bya// byang sdom ldan pas dge ba'i chos// ci spyad dge ba chos sdud nyid// gzhan la phan par byed pa ni// sems can don byed tshul khrims te// bsdu na dge ba'i grogs byed dang*// sdug bsngal can gyi sdug bsngal sel// thabs mi shes la rig pa ston// byas pa bzo dang 'jigs las srung*// mya ngan sel dang yo byad stobs// chos kyi 'khor sdud gzhan sems srung*// yon tan mchog gi gzhan dga' byed// chos bzhin tshar gcod rdzu 'phrul gyis// skrag dang 'dun par byed pa'o// de ltar tshul khrims rnam gsum 'bad// bsdu na thos bsam sgom la brtson// bla ma rnams la bkur stis bsten// nad pa'i don du snying rjes 'bad// sbyin zhing gzhan gyi yon tan bsgrags// gzhan dger yi rang brnyas pa spang*// mchod dang bsngo ba smon lam 'bad// brtson ldan bag yod dran shes bsrung*// zas kyi tshod rig dbang po sdom// srod thor mi nyal rnal 'byor brtson// dge ba'i bshes dang dam pa bsten// rang gi 'khrul pa brtags nas spong*// de ltar dge ba bsgrub dang bsrung*// 'phel bar byed pa nyams su blangs// zhes tshul khrims gsum gyi rtsa tshig yin la/

sdom pa'i tshul khrims kyi mi mthun phyogs bsdam bya rtsa ba dang yan lag gi ltung ba gnyis las/ dang po bslab btus su bstan pa'i rgyal po byang chub sems dpa'i rtsa ltung lnga ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi dkor 'phrog pa dang*/ nges 'byung gi chos spang ba dang*/ rab tu byung ba la chad pa gcod pa dang*/ mtshams med kyi las byed pa dang*/ log ltas dge bcu spang ba'o// blon po byang chub sems dpa'i rtsa ltung lnga ni/ dkon mchog gi dkor 'phrog pa la sogs snga ma ltar dge bcu spang ba'i tshabs su grong dang grong khyer la sogs gzhom pa dang lnga'o// phal pa'i rtsa ltung brgyad ni/ lta ba zab mo bstan pas 'jigs nas theg pa chen po las ldog pa dang*/ spyod pa rgya chen po bstan pas theg pa chen po las ldog pa dang*/ nyan thos kyi theg pa spangs pa dang*/ so sor thar pa spangs pa dang*/ bdag bstod gzhan la smod pa dang*/ mi chos bla ma'i rdzun smra ba dang*/ rngan gyi rgyu la dkon mchog gi rdzas ster ba dang*/ sgrub pa'i 'tsho ba klog pa la sbyin pa'o// byang sa'i don bsdus pa sdom pa nyi shu par bstan pa ni/ rnyed dang bkur sti la chags pas bdag bstod gzhan la smad pa dang*/ sdug bsngal mgon med la ser snas chos nor la sogs mi ster ba dang*/ nyes pa can gyi bshags kyang mi nyan pas khros nas 'tshogs pa la sogs pa byed pa dang*/ theg pa chen po spangs shing chos ltar bcos pa ston pa dang bzhi ni sdom pa gtong byed rtsa ba'i ltung ba nyan thos kyi pham pa dang 'dra ba'o// gnyis pa bslab pa dang 'gal ba'i nyes byas kyi ltung ba sdom pa nyi shu par bzhi bcu rtsa lnga bstan te/ dkon mchog gsum la sgo gsum gyi mchod pa sna gcig tsam yang mi byed par nyin mtshan 'da' ba dang gcig /rnyed pa bkur sti la chags nas de dag dang du len pa dang gnyis/ rang bas rgan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la mi gus shing mi 'dud pa dang gsum/ dris pa'i lan rnal mar mi 'debs pa dang bzhi/

bos pa'i mgron la mi 'gro ba dang*/ gser la sogs pa byin pa mi len pa dang drug /chos 'dod pa la phrag dog gis mi bstan pa dang bdun/ tshul khrims 'chal ba la phan mi 'dogs pa dang brgyad/ pha rol dad pa'i phyir nyan thos kyi bslab pa la mi slob pa dang dgu/ sems can gyi don la bya ba chung ngu blor mi 'dzin pa dang bcu/ snying brtse yod kyang gzhan phan gyi mi dge ba la 'jug mi nus pa dang bcu gcig skabs 'dir snying brtse bas gzhan don du rang gi rgyud la dpag pa'i nyes pa spyad pas mi dge ba med pa ni 'og tu 'byung ba ltung ba'i gzugs brnyan no// 'di sems dge ba la nyes med ltung ba'i gzugs brnyan du bsdu nas logs su mi brtsi bas zhe lnga byed pa rang byung pa sogs bzhed/ rtsi na 'di dang zhe drug go /mchan/ log pa'i 'tsho ba lngas 'tsho ba dang bcu gcig /ma zhi ba'i sems kyis rab tu g.yeng bar byed pa dang bcu gnyis/ 'khor ba las mngon par dga' ba'i lam bgrod par 'dod pa dang bcu gsum/ rang gi gtam ngan sel bar mi byed pa dang bcu bzhi/ gzhan nyon mongs dang bcas pa mi 'chos pa dang bco lda/ gshe ba la slar gshe khro ba la slar khro brdeg pa la slar brdeg mtshang 'bru ba la slar 'bru ba dang bcu drug gzhan khros pa la bshags sbyong mi byed pa dang bcu bdun/ pha rol gzhan gyi bshags pa mi len pa dang bco brgyad/ rang gzhan la khros pa'i sems bskyed nas de'i rjes su 'brang ba dang bcu dgu/ bsnyen bkur 'dod pa'i phyir 'khor sdud pa dang nyi shu/ le lo la sogs sel bar mi byed pa dang nyer gcig /'du 'dzi la chags pas bre mo'i gtam byed pa dang nyer gnyis/ sems gnas pa'i thabs dgos bzhin du mi tshol ba dang nyer gsum/ bsam gtan gyi sgrib pa mi spong ba dang nyer bzhi/ bsam gtan gyi ro la chags pa dang nyer lnga/ nyan thos kyi theg pa la lhag par mos pa dang nyer drug /theg chen la mi brtson theg chung la brtson pa dang nyer bdun/

nang pa la mi brtson phyi pa mu stegs kyi bstan bcos la brtson pa dang nyer brgyad/ phyi rol pa la brtson zhing lhag par dga' ba dang nyer dgu/ chos zab mo la bskur pa 'debs pa dang sum cu/ rlom sems kyis bdag bstod gzhan la smod pa dang so gcig /chos nyan du mi 'gro ba dang so gnyis/ smra ba khyad du gsod cing don la mi sems tshig 'bru tsam la ston pa dang so gsum/ gzhan la dgos pa'i grogs mi byed pa dang so bzhi/ nad pa'i rim gro mi byed pa dang so lnga/ gzhan gyi sdug bsngal mi sel ba dang so drug /bag med pa'i mi la rig pa mi ston pa dang so bdun/ byams pa'i lan du phan mi 'dogs pa dang so brgyad/ gzhan gyi mya ngan mi sel ba dang so dgu/ nor 'dod pa la mi ster ba dang bzhi bcu/ 'khor 'dus pa rnams kyi don legs par mi byed pa dang zhe gcig /gzhan gyi blo dang mthun 'jug mi byed pa dang zhe gnyis/ gzhan gyi yon tan sbed pa dang zhe gsum/ nyes pa can rnams tshar mi gcod pa dang zhe bzhi/ rang rdzu 'phrul dang ldan bzhin du bsdig mo'i cho 'phrul mi byed pa dang zhe lnga ste tshul khrims 'di dag kyang nang 'dzom pa'i tshe na sdom pa dang dge ba chos sdud 'dzom dus dge ba chos sdud gtso bor bya/ chos sdud dang sems can don byed 'dzom na sems can don byed gtso bor spyad/ gzhan mtshams med la sogs pa'i nyes pa chen po la 'jug pa mthong nas bya thabs gzhan med na rang ngan 'gror 'gro ba'i sdig pa khyad du bsad nas gzhan sdig pa las bsgral phyir bsad par bya ba ni ded dpon snying rje chen po lta bu'o// mi dge ba gzhan yang de ltar gzhan phan dang 'bral na rung ste rgyal po gser mdog dang bram ze'i khye'u karma dang drang srong mes byin lta bu ni ltung ba'i gzugs brnyan skabs 'di'i spyad bya nyes med kho na yin gsungs/ thabs gzhan yod nas de ltar spyad na sbyor ba bag yangs kyi nyes pa/

thabs kyang med la rang gi sdig pa khyad du'ang ma bsad na ltung ba med pa'i gzugs brnyan skabs 'dir spang bya yin la/ gzhi med pa la rang gis byas na ltung ba nyid yin no// de dag kyang byang sems kyi sdom pa thob pa/ shes pa rang bzhin du gnas pa/ thun mong gi yan lag gnyis dang nyon mongs pa drag pos bslangs nas pham 'dra gcig spyad kyang byang sdom btang zhing*/ nyon mongs pa drag po ni pham pa'i gnas lta bu la rgyun ma chad par spyad na bdag gi bya ba ma yin pa/ chos ldan gyi ngo tsha khrel 'dzem la mi brtsi ba/ des dga' zhing mgu bar spyad pa ni kun dkris chen po zhes gsungs la nyon mongs 'bring dang chung ngus ni sdom pa mi gtong na'ang nyan thos kyi lhag ma dang ltung byed bzhin du nyes byas su 'gyur gsungs/ smon pa sogs btang na'ang rtsa ba'i pham pa dang 'dra zhing*/ de'ang sngar bshad pa ltar thun tshod las 'das pa ste/ nye ba 'khor gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ nye bar 'khor 'di la theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gal te snga dro'i dus su ltung ba byung yang phyed kyi dus su thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems dang ma bral bar gnas te de ltar theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa'i tshul khrims kyi phung po mtha' med do// zhes pa nas phyi 'phred dang*/ srod dang*/ nam phyed dang*/ tho rangs sogs la sbyar te gsungs pa'o// kun dkris chen pos sdom pa btang ba la'ang slar len du yod de/ sdom pa slar yang blang bar bya// zhes dang*/ 'bring la sems bskyed pa'i byang sems nyan thos kyi dge 'dun brda sprod cing 'dzin nus pa gsum la bshags pa ste/ zag pa 'bring ni gsum la gshags// zhes pa dang*/ tha ma gcig la bshags pa'i lag len cho ga ltar bya ste/ gcig gi mdun du lhag ma rnams// zhes so// bdag sems kyi rjes su bshags pa ni rang gi yid la 'gyod cing sdom par byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi ma mo las gsungs so// yang rmi lam 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po'i mdun du 'dug la bshags par bya/

zhes pa'i don spyod 'jug nas gsungs pa ltar bya ba'am yang na de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma'i snying po 'od zer dri ma med pa bstan pa las gsungs pa ltar te/ sngon dge slong dpal sbyin la nyes pa chen po byung nas sdug bsngal ba la/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jigs sgrol gyis bka' stsal pa/ chos rnams 'di dag gzugs brnyan 'dra ba ste// chu nang zla ba snang la med pa bzhin// 'dod chags dug dang de bzhin zhe sdang sogs// thams cad mkha' 'dra dag cing zhi ba yin// 'jig rten 'di dag thams cad rmi lam bzhin// chos rnams gsob ste stong zhing snying po med// smig rgyu 'dra zhing sprin dang mtshungs pa ste// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dngos po med// chos rnams 'di dag rgyu dang rkyen las grub// rgyu dang rkyen ni ngo bo nyid kyis stong*// rtsa ba mi dmigs bzod nas rab tu zhi// thog mtha' dbus med dben zhing snying po med// chos 'di thams cad gdod nas zhi ba ste// thams cad ma skyes rang bzhin 'od gsal ba// zhi zhing mi gnas mya ngan 'das par mthong*// de ltar shes pa'i chos rnams rnam par grol// zhes gsungs pa thos pas lha yi bu khri stong gi mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob ste dge slong dpal sbyin yang kun dkris las grol nas bzod pa thob par bshad do// de lta bu'ang rgyu mtshan gyi go bas rgyas btab lta bu'i mi phan te dang po rgyu 'bras la yid ches drag po'i sgo nas blang dor mig 'bras bzhin bsrung zhing gzhan phan dang bstan pa'i bya ba la brtson pas rang gi tshogs gong 'phel du rdzogs mthar nyes ltung phra mo byung ba na 'jig rten gyi mig nam la spyad pa lta bu dang chos nas lung 'di yod kyi khung bda' ba sogs gang 'thad kyi mtha' mang po brtags pa'i a 'thas ther zug byed pa ma yin par chos thams cad sgyu ma dang rmi lam lta bur shes pa'i ngang nas stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can bsgom pas nyes ltung dag par bshad pa yin/

de'ang thog ma nas gzhi stong nyid yin par rtsi nas rjud lam mthur bde ba ma yin par rgyu 'bras kyi blang dor phra zhib srung dgos te/ rgyal ba u rgyan pa la dge bshes gcig na re/ dkon mchog gi skyabs 'gro dang tshogs bsags dang bsod nams la blo bkal yang mi phan par bar chad la shor ba mang po 'ong gin gda' lags zhus pas/ de ka dkon mchog la blo ma khel bas shor ba yin mod/ dkon mchog la blo legs par 'gel na bka' dang bstan bcos rnams nas bshad pa bzhin byed dgos pa yin/ gzhan mi dgos skyabs 'gro rkyang pa la bslab bya ci tsam bshad/ mdor bsdu na brgyad du 'du bas brgyad po 'di la tshul bzhin du 'bad nas der bar chad la ma shor ba'i mi gang na 'dug /de 'dug na khyod bden pas tshol dang*/ bar chad ma sel ba thams cad bslab bya ma thub pas len pa yin/ de thams cad nya ma lha khang du phyin pa bzhin du tshig gi skyabs 'gro kha'i skyabs 'gro ltar snang gi skyabs 'gro song bas len pa yin/ bslab bya mi slob pa'i skyabs 'gro dkon mchog la co 'dri byed pa bzhin song ba yin/ srog mkhar gzhan gyis bzung nas lam kha'i mgron po la skyabs pa dang 'dra/ bslab bya bsrungs nas phan yon mi 'ong ba sangs rgyas kyis nges pa'i don la rdzun gang na gsungs/ bslab bya dang phan yon la mo ma'am mig mthong ba'i ngag tsam yang mi rtsi zhing dkon mchog la blo skad cig kyang mi 'gel bar kha gsag gi skyabs 'gro sogs byas pas 'khor ba las grol na dag sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis sems can gcig kyang mi 'jog par sgrol te/ de lta min pas kho rang gi las la sdug rkyen bzang pos ma chun pas 'phags pa rnams kyi'ang mdzad pa'i thabs la sdug pa yin/ des na sangs rgyas la snying thag pa rus pa'i gting nas blo khel gyis legs par bkal nas/ sangs rgyas kyis ji skad gsungs pa bzhin nyams su len dgos pa yin/

zhes gsungs te/ 'od phreng la/ sdom gsum gang yang mi ldan na// lha mi'i lus kyang rnyed pa dka'// zhes dang*/ byang sems nyams na 'gro ba kun// bslus pas gnod pa shin tu mang*// rgyal dang de sras thams cad dang*// 'gro ba kun gyis shin tu khrel// pham pa lci yang bye brag gi /bskal pa'i grangs bzhin dmyal bar gnas// rig 'dzin sdom pa nyams pa ni// yid du mi 'ong sna tshogs dang*// rgyal dang de sras kun brnyas pas// mi 'jigs mnar med gnas dag tu// sdug bsngal chen po de yis myong*// zhes sogs nas/ bskal pa ther 'bum la sogs su// de ni thon par ma gsungs so// zhes gsungs shing phan yon yang de dang mtshungs pa gsungs pas 'di ltar bslab bya thams cad la mtshon nas khyad par khe che la nyan che ba'i theg pa chen po'i bslab bya rnams mig 'bras bzhin du bsrung zhing yid ches bskyed/ ngo srung ma yin pa'i mos gus tshad dang ldan pa gcig gis thog drang*/ tshe 'di blos btang nas 'dod 'dun gyi 'khri ba bcad/ skyid gsog dang snyom las rgyab tu skyur ba'i go cha gyon/ grub thob gong ma'i rnam thar bsam zhing de dag gi rjes su bslab/ yon bdag dang gru pa sogs gzhan zer gyi g.yam la mi rgyugs par dka' thub snying rus la spro ba bskyed/ mthun 'jug dang g.yeng ba spangs te dman pa'i sa bzung ste rab rtse gcig tu sgrub pa nyams su len pas spang gnyen gyi mtshan ma bral ba'i rtogs pa 'byung*/ de lta min yang dman pa'i sa bzung nas rtag tu dran shes kyi gnyen pos bag med la skad cig kyang mi btang bar dge ba chos sdud dang sems can don byed kyang yar ldan du tshang bar khas blang gis bslab pa bsrung bar bya ste/

mchan/ tshul khrims gsum po 'di dag theg chen thun mong pa'i lam las gsungs pa ltar yin la/ bla na med pa sngags kyi nyams len ltar na spang bya drung nas 'byin pa'i tshul khrims rnam pa gsum ni/ phyi tshangs spyod kyi mchog tu gyur pa spang sems kyi sdom pa nges 'byung gi tshul khrims dang*/ nang tshangs spyod kyi srog dang ma bral pa gsang chen gyi sdom pa 'dzag bral gyi tshul khrims/ gsang ba tshangs spyod kyi ngo bo ma 'khrul ba rang byung gi sdom pa zag pa med pa'i tshul khrims zhes rje btsun gong ma rnams bzhed do // rje dwags po rin po ches nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa ni bslab pa gsum gyis rtsad nas gcod/ las kyi sgrib pa ni stobs bzhis dag par byed/ ces gsungs pa ltar las nyon gyi sgrib pa spangs shing dag pa la sems rnal du phab nas shes bzhin srung dgos te/ spyod 'jug las/ bslab pa srung bar 'dod pa yis// rab tu 'bad de sems bsrung bya// sems 'di srung bar ma byas na// bslab pa srung bar yang mi nus// zhes dang*/ bzlas brjod dang ni dka' thub kun// yun ring dus su spyad byas kyang*// sems gzhan g.yengs par byas pa ni// de nyid rig pas don med gsungs// zhes dang*/ sems srung brtul zhugs ma gtogs pa'i// brtul zhugs mang pos ci zhig bya// ma grong grol ba'i khrod gnas na// bsgrims te rma yi bag byed bzhin// skye bo ngan khrod gnas pas kyang*// sems kyi rma yang rtag tu bsrungs// zhes dang*/ spyod pa 'di 'dras gnas byed na// skye bo ngan pa'i khrod gnas sam// bud med khrod na gnas kyang rung*// sdom brtson brtan pa nyams mi 'gyur// sems srung 'dod pa rnams la ni// dran pa dang ni shes bzhin dag /srog la bab kyang srungs shig ces// bdag gis de ltar thal mo sbyar// zhes dang*/ shes bzhin med pa'i sems ldan pa'i// thos dang bsam dang sgom pa yang*// glo rdol bum pa'i chu bzhin du// dran pa la ni de mi gnas// zhes sogs bsrung sems gnyen po'i sgo nas kyang dran shes bzhin srung ba gal che la/

bsrung bya tshul khrims nyid kyang sems kyis byed pa ste/ de nyid la/ nya la sogs pa gang zhig tu// de dag gsod mi 'gyur bar bskrad// spangs pa'i sems ni thob pa las// tshul khrims pha rol phyin par bshad// ces gsungs shing de dag kyang spang gnyen gyi 'du shes dang bral bar 'jog pa pha rol tu phyin pa'i dngos rgyur 'gyur te/ mdo las/ gang la bdag gi 'du shes sems can 'du shes med// 'du shes 'dod chags bral la sdom min ga la yod// gang la sdom dang sdom pa ma yin rlom sems med// 'di ni tshul khrims sdom par rnam par 'dren pas gsungs// zhes dang*/ blo gros rab gsal gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ bslab pa dang tshul khrims ji ltar srung bar bgyi/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ dge slong rnal 'byor spyod pas tshul khrims dang tshul khrims 'chal ba dang tshul khrims srung ba la sogs pa'i 'du shes sna tshogs dang ldan pa ni lha yi bde ba myong nas slar yang ngan song du 'khor bar 'gyur ro// gang la sdom pa dang sdom pa ma yin pa'i rlom sems med cing rtog pa med pa de ni mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul khrims rnam par dag pa yin no// zhes dang*/ ched du brjod pa'i mdo las/ dge slong dag mgo brag pa la byang chub ga la yod/ ces sogs la dge slong rnams the tshom du gyur pa'i tshe/ bka' stsal pa/ ye shes kyi spu gris rnam rtog gi skra brag par bya'o// stong nyid kyi gos kyis nyon mongs pa'i tshad pa las skyobs par bya'o// ye shes kyi chus ma rig pa'i dri ma bkru bar bya'o// bsam gtan gyi zas kyis 'dod pa'i bkres pa sel bar bya'o// zhes gsungs pas stong nyid dang snying rjes zin pas tshul khrims dag par 'gyur te/ mdo don snying por bsdu na/ lta sgom spyod 'bras don las mi 'da' ba gangs kyi thigs pa lta bu'i gdams ngag la don bzhi ste/ lta ba la yin pa med de mtha' dang bral ba/

bsgom pa la min pa med de dmigs gtad med pa/ spyod pa la gnyis su med de blang dor med pa/ 'bras bu ro gcig tu go bas re dwogs med pa'o// zhes gsungs pa'i don ltar man ngag nyams len du dril nas sgrub pa lag tu len pa'i tshul la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro gsal btab la kun rdzob byang sems kyi skabs su/ bdun pa blo sbyong gi bslab bya bstan pa ni/ bza' btung spyod lam thams cad dngos gzhi byang sems bzung zhing sbyor ba gzhan phan 'ba' zhig gi bya ba dang lus 'tsho zhing dge sbyor thams cad kyang nam zhig gzhan phan nus pa'i 'dun pas dge blo bya/ blo sbyong sogs bsgom bzhin du na tsha 'dre gdon mi rnams kyis sdang ba mtshan ltas ngan pa sogs dang*/ yul gyi dus ngan gyi rtags snod kyi 'byor rgud dang sems can dge blo can la'ang sdug bsngal 'byung lugs// chos byed la mthun rkyen med cing 'gal rkyen dang bslang 'debs sogs lus kyi na tsha sems kyi sdug bsngal 'byung zhing chos min rnams tshe ring zhing longs spyod 'phel ba lta bu blo chung gi chos pa yid pham nus pa dang*/ rang gi mthong thos kyi 'brel grogs rnams lhag par sdug bsngal ba dang*/ dge ba'i blo dad brtson nges 'byung khrel ngo tsha dang bral zhing g.yo sgyu dang zol sbyor dang mgo skor bslu brid dang bla ma mched grogs gnyen bshes rnams kyang gcig gis gcig la ngan sems 'phya sems log rtog sna tshogs pas g.yengs shing thams cad bdud kyis blo bsgyur nas thabs sna tshogs kyis rang gzhan thar lam nas phyin ci log tu khrid pa'i tshe 'di 'dra na gnas skabs su'ang chos kyis ma phan pas mthar thug kyang phan ci thogs mi shes snyam pa'i bdud kyis bslu ba'i the tshom dang log rtog skyes na de'i tshe bdag gis sems bskyed dang stong nyid snying rje bsgoms pas bskal pa dpag med kyi las sgrib bslangs nas ngan song du 'gro nges pa'i skye sgo kheg pa'i snga ltas yin snyam du blo thag bcad la ngan rtog zil gyis gnon pa'i stong nyid snying rje slar shugs phyung la bsgom/

snga dro thun las langs dus nas de ring sems bskyed dang dge sbyor rkyen dbang du mi gtong bsam pa dang do dgong de ring gi dge sdig gang byas bsgrangs la sdig la bshags sdom dang dge la yi rang byed de/ rtogs ldan mgon yes/ rtag tu dran shes kyi bya ra thongs// khas blangs la nyams pa phog gam ltos// rang sems la rang khrel 'dug gam ltos// dam tshig la g.yo zol 'dug gam ltos// zhes dang*/ rgyas sras thogs med pas/ rang gi 'khrul pa rang gis ma brtags na// chos pa'i gzugs kyis chos min byed srid pas// de phyir rgyun du rang rgyud 'khrul pa la// brtags nas spangs pa rgyal sras lag len yin// zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o// 'di rnams rtsa tshig las/ rnal 'byor thams cad gcig gis bya// log non thams cad gcig gis bya// thog mtha' gnyis la bya ba gnyis// zhes pa rnams kyi don no// de nas sngar bzhin gnad gsum gyi srang la 'grim zhing dmigs pa ting nge 'dzin gyi gnad la/ gnyis pa yid kyi chos la bsre zhing sgom pa ni/ thog mar yid byed kyi 'phro rgod rkyang pa dang bzang rtog sogs la bsre zhing ro snyoms pa la/ sngar bshad pa'i rkyen de lta bu'i gzhan yang snying rlung na tsha cho 'phrul sogs la brten nas sems rtog pa'i yo langs mnan gyis mi non pa 'byung ba'am lar yang 'phro rgod shas che ba rnams la kun gzhi'i steng na tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bag chags ngan pa'i sa bon yod pa de dge sbyor byas pa'i stobs kyis bag la nyal du bsdad dbang med par bslangs nas mngon sum du ther la bton pa yin te/ rje btsun chen po la bkra shis tshe ring ma spun gyis dmag rgyab pa'am chos rje 'brug pa la lho brag tu 'dre dmag byung ba'am rje rgod tshang pa la rma mdze byung ba lta bu yin/ de rnams thams cad nyams su blangs pa'i drod rtags yin pas de tsho la skyon du ma bzung bar yon tan du bltas na ro snyoms kyi dgongs pa bzlog bsgom gnad du bsnun pa yin te/

rgod pa'i dus su grub thob gong ma rnams kyis bzod blag med pa'i rkyen drag po re la bsres pas der grub pa thob pa sha stag 'dug pa dang yang 'di bas rgod tshabs che ba zhig byung na de thog tu nyams su blang dgos/ shi bar song yang de ka sgrub pa mtha' ru thon pas bka' brgyud kyi zhabs tog grub pa yin snyam du bsams nas gsol 'debs drag la thung ba re byas kyin rgod pa'i yul dang rgod mkhan gyi ngo bo de'i steng du mi bsgom pa'i ngang du ma yengs tsam gyis lhod kyis glod nas yul gzhan la ma yengs par rgod pa de rang gi steng du rgyun bsrings nas bsdad pas ci zhig ltar na sbrul gyi mdud pa bzhin du ma bkrol bar shigs kyis grol nas a ba na ning nas glod pa yin kyang glod ma shes pas len pa yin par 'dug snyam nas gu yangs thing gis byas/ sha lpags thams cad lhod kyis song*/ da gzod nyams len gyi gnad de shes par 'dug snyam pa gcig gi kha la rgod pa'i ma bde ba de grol 'gro ba yin/ yul la 'phro ba de sems kyi mtshan nyid yin pas de la skyon du bltas na sgom gar yong*/ ji ltar 'phro yang ngo shes dang ma bral bar 'phro nus tshad 'phros su bcug pas gar yang 'phro mi nus par rang thog tu 'gug yong*/ de yang rang thog tu 'gug tu re nas 'phro bcug kyang 'gug tu mi 'dod/ 'phros pa la skyon du mi lta ba'i ngang nas 'phro ru 'jug la glod kyin 'jog pa yin/ de bzhin du bsgrub 'bras ma byung ba'i sems pham dang lhag par bzang rtog gi dad pa dag snang mos gus snying rje sbyin pa tshul khrims sogs dge ba'i rtog pa thams cad kyang lam du nges par gtong dgos te/ ji ltar dug dang 'dres pa'i kha zas bzang za ba// dkar po'i chos la dmigs pa'ang de 'dra rgyal bas gsungs// zhes gsungs pas de'ang gtong tshul khyad par med de bzang rtog shar ba'i sems kyi skad cig ma la sems kyi rtsal rdzogs yod pa de rang ngos tsir gyis bzung nas de nyid rang gi steng du gzung 'dzin dang bral ba'i ngang du ma yengs tsam du glod nas de ga'i ngang las rgyun bsring ba yin la nyams len mthon por song nas bzang rtog la ro snyoms pa rgyu 'bras rten 'brel gyi lag len yang 'ong ba yin pas bka' brgyud kyi dgongs don de rnams la yid ches par nyams su longs mdzod cig
