/ byas la brda bkrol zhing maṇḍal gtor 'bul smon lam gdab pa sogs bya'o// nyin ya byas pa'i nyi ma nyer bdun chos thun bcu drug yin no// ༈ chos thun bcu bdun pa la'ang sngar bzhin tshig gi mtshams sbyor byas nas/ gsum pa bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sdom ni/ skyon yon rnam gnyis bsam pa dang*// ngo bo dang ni dbye ba dang*// phye ba so so'i mtshan nyid dang*// spel dang dag par bya ba dang*// 'bras bu dang ni don bdun gyis// bzod pa'i pha rol phyin pa bsdus// zhes pa ltar rgyas pa thar rgyan sogs ltar bshad pa las shes shing mtshan nyid lag len du bsdu ba la/ bzod par bya ba'i yul rnams la// ji mi snyam phyir bzod pa ste// gzhan gyi gnod pas sems mi 'khrugs// gnod len mi byed khon mi 'dzin// 'di ni bzod pa dang po ste// gnod byed nyid la'ang dbang med dang*// las dang lus dang sems kyis nyes// skyon can khyad med gyur pa dang*// phan 'dogs drin che sangs rgyas mnyes// phan yon che bar brtags pa ste// rgyu mtshan dgu yis bzod par bya// yang na yid du 'ong ba dang*// chos tsam dang ni mi rtag dang*// sdug bsngal ba dang yongs bzung ste// 'du shes lnga yis bzod par bya// chos dbyings ngal bas mi g.yo ba// sdug bsngal dang len bzod pa ste// sman spyad rtsub mo bzod pa ltar// gtso bor tshul khrims rnam gsum gyi// dka' ba thams cad bzod par bya// yang na gnas la dad pa dang*// 'jig rten chos dang spyod lam dang*// chos yongs 'dzin dang slong mos 'tsho// brtson pas dub dang gzhan don dang*// 'phral gyi bya ba la brten pa'i// sdug bsngal dang len bzod pa brgyad// zab mo'i chos kyi mi skrag pa// chos la nges sems bzod pa ste// dkon mchog yon tan de bzhin nyid// rgyal sras mthu dang rgyu dang 'bras// thob bya'i don dang 'thob pa'i thabs// shes par bya ba'i spyod yul te// mos bya'i yul gyi phye bas brgyad// ces bzod pa gsum gyi rtsa tshig yin la dang po bzod yul bcu gsum sogs la brten nas ji mi snyam pa'i bzod pa bsgom pa ni/

'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ ma yi thug mtha' rgya shug tshig gu tsam// ril bur bsgrang yang sa yis long mi 'gyur// zhes pas sems can rnams mar shes pa'i 'du shes la brten nas gnod pa bzod pa'i phyir bzod pa ste/ zhi ba lhas/ de bar du ni sdang sems la// brten nas bzod pa skye bas na// de nyid bzod pa'i rgyu yin pas// dam pa'i chos bzhin mchod par 'os// zhes gsungs pas ma yi bka' drin dran pas byas shes drin du bzo ba byas la bsgom ste/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa la// don dam byang chub sems bskyed dgos// de yang kun rdzob sems las// de nyid skye bar byed pa la// smon 'jug gnyis dang ldan pa dgos// smon pa la brten 'jug pa skye// de gnyis skye bar byed pa la// lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam dag dgos// de la snying rje chen po dgos// de la byams pa chen po dgos// de nyid skye bar byed pa la// byas pa shes shing drin du bzo// de nyid phan pa btags las skye// mdor na sems can sangs rgyas la// rag las par ni shes par bya// sems can med na sangs rgyas med// des na byams dang snying rje yi// sems ni bsgom pa shin tu gces// zhes gsungs pas khong khro'i dngos gnyen bzod pa bsgom pa la yul yid du 'ong ba bya/ snod kyi 'jig rten la'ang 'tshig pa 'khrug pa'i snang log mi bsgom zhing ye nas bka' drin can du bsgom pas zhing khams rnam par dag pa'i rgyu byed/ bcud kyi sems can la dang po rang lus bka' drin can du bltas la sems bskyed dang smon lam gdab/ de nas gzhan la sbyar ba'i ma la snying du sdug par bltas la thugs yid bsre zhing byang chub kyi sems sbyong*/ de nas 'gro ba gzhan dang phyogs gzhan dang ngan song dang gling gzhan sogs skye sla ba dang*/ dka' ba la blo rim gyis brtse ba'i ma la dpag nas de'i sdug bsngal la brten nas bsgom/ rang la dpag ste rang gi sdug bsngal la brten nas bsgom/

sems bskyed la dpag ste rgyal ba sras bcas kyi dgongs don rdzogs pa la brten nas bsgom/ phan yon la dpag ste sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu thob nges pa la brten nas bsgom pa byams khrid dang 'dra'o// gzhan yang spyod 'jug dang byang sa nas bsgom lugs gsungs pa ltar gnad du 'gro bar byas nas blo 'byongs par bsgom dgos te/ bzod pa'i ting nge 'dzin ma 'byongs pas lus kyi rkyen la cham pa tshab che ba re byung yang mi theg /nor gyi rkyen bra re'i mtho dman yang mi bzod/ sems kyi rkyen tshig ngan gyi mdel rtse cung zad re yang mi bzod par blo 'du 'phro ru tshubs tshub lus rnam 'gyur du log log yong ba de bzod pa ma rdzogs pa'i rtags yin pas bzod pa la nan tan bskyed pa gal che gsungs/ des bsran tshugs pa'i bzod pa de yang dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen pos kun nas bslangs nas gzhan don la zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' des pha rol la phan btags sam gnod pa byas kyang rung la/ de la pha rol pos bsnyen bkur byas sam gnod pa bskyal yang rung ste dngos su gnod pa ltar snang yang brgyud nas phan pa chen por 'gyur ba dgos te/ gang la gnod pa byas kyang bder 'brel ba// bde ba'i 'byung gnas de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa'i don yang zhe 'dod gting nas med pa'i snying rje chen po 'ba' zhig gis sems can gyi phan bde'i dbang du gyur pa'i byang chub sems dpa' des gdul bya tshar gcod rjes 'dzin gyi bya ba'ang gnod pa rtsa ba nas med cing phan pa 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur la nyes pa med cing legs tshogs su 'gyur ba de lta bu 'byung ba'i rgyu la'ang thog mar phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa phyin ci ma log pa zhig skyes na rang nyid 'ching ba mtha' dag gi sgrog las thar bas 'khor ba'i nyes skyon gyi sa bon ma lus pa bcad cing rtsa ba drung nas 'byin pas dmigs med kyi snying rje skyes pa'i mthus 'khor ba'i spyod pa ji ltar spyad pa bzhin byang chub kyi sems kyis tshogs rgya chen po 'phel zhing de nyid ye shes kyi tshogs su shar ba de chos thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid yin pa'i phyir sus kyang bcing bar mi nus shing gnod par yang mi nus la sgrib par bya ba'i yul dang bral bas skye rga na 'chi rgyun bcad nas ye shes kyi snang ba rgyas pas gting skyon med pa'i skyes bu de la nyes pa sna tshogs snang yang de yi dri mas mi gos shing legs pa'i yon tan rgya chen po 'byung ba yin la mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa de srid kyi bar du gting skyon 'byung bas brnab sems yid kyi re ba 'joms shing rgyu 'bras mi bslu ba'i sa bon ngan par 'gyur bas rang gi ngar 'dzin 'dul zhing snang log gi sgra mi 'byung bar dag snang sbyang zhing rkyen thog tu bsran tshugs pa'i gnyen po bzod pa'i go chas khong khro'i dbang du mi gtong bar bya gsungs/

sdug bsngal dang len gyi bzod pa la/ thog mar sbyangs pa dang shes rab yod pa gcig gis snying rus dang nan tan bskyed nas thos pas phyi'i sgro 'dogs gcod pa yin/ de chod nas shin tu dben pa'i gnas su thos pa'i don legs par bsam/ de rjes bsgom pa la blo gzhol nas lus dang srog la thug kyang sems kyi dam bca' brten pos tshul khrims gsum la 'bad cing dka' spyad la bzod nus par blo thag bcad la 'jig rten gyi bya ba thams cad blos btang ste mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma btsal nas de nyid kyi bka' bzhin bsgrub ste lus sems kyi dka' ba thams cad bzod par byas nas brtson 'grus drag pos nyin mtshan med par sgrub pa gnyugs su bsring nas bsgom pa'i tshe lus snang sems gsum gyi steng du las ngan gyi slong dang rnam smin gyi 'bras bu la mi bzod pa'i sdug bsngal drag po ci byung yang bar chad la mi 'chol bar bzod nus pa gcig dgos gsung*/ chos la nges par sems pa'i skabs su gong ma'i gsungs las nyams len pha rol tu phyin pa la 'ub kyis dril na tshig gnyis te/ ji ltar 'dzin pa de ltar kun nas nyon mongs bstan// bdag dang bdag gir mi dmigs rnam par byang bar gsungs// zhes pa ste/ ji ltar 'dzin pa yod ring la kun nas nyon mongs pa yod/ de'ang bdag 'dzin las chags pa skye/ gzhan 'dzin las sdang ba skye/ bur 'dzin pa la chags pa dgrar 'dzin pa la sdang ba snyan par 'dzin pa la chags pa mi snyan par 'dzin pa la sdang ba de la sogs te stong pa la snang bar 'dzin cing gnyis snang gi shes pa sna tshogs su bzung bas 'khor ba las mi thar te/ gtan du sdug bsngal ba'i gnas su 'gro ba yin pas de las bzlog la bdag dang bdag gir mi dmigs rnam par byang bar gsungs/ de bzhin du nyams su len pa la bdag bden nam mi bden blta/ bdag rtag gam mi rtag blta/ bdag la rang bzhin 'dug gam mi 'dug blta/

de bzhin du bltas pas bdag mi rtag par mthong bas bdag gi chags pa dang bral/ bdag gzhan mi 'dug na zhen pa thams cad dang bral/ de snga phan chad du bdag tu bzung bas bdag gi ba 'byung*/ bdag dang bdag gir byung byung bas 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin/ bdag gi bu/ bdag gi dgra/ bdag gi nor/ de la sogs pa bdag byung bas bdag gi ba mang po byung ba yin/ des 'khor bar 'khyams pa lags/ bdag ni rmi lam sgyu ma tsam du shes par bya/ bdag mi rtag par shes par bya/ de bzhin gshegs pas bdag mi dmigs te/ bdag mi dmigs pas bdag gi ba thams cad mi dmigs pa yin pas/ bdag dang bdag gir mi dmigs rnam par byang bar gsungs// zhes lung las bshad/ de bzhin du yin pas bdag 'dzin thams cad spangs la 'khor ba hrul por gtong ba yin pas bdag gi ba yang mi dmigs par nyams su blang dgos/ de ji ltar blangs na/ rnam par byang ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos yin pas de bzhin du me dang chu nas sbyin pa la bslab la bdag gi ba yi zhen pa thams cad spang dgos/ me dang chu yin yang gtong blo med par bsams na 'gyur geg gi yi dwags su skye bas/ chung ngu la goms pas mjug chen po mgo dang mig dang rkang lag gtong ba 'ong ba la tshegs med/ de bzhin tsam na 'khor ba dang 'gyes byas pa yin/ des na dngos po dman pa chung rim nas bslab cing rang la dgos dgos pa'i zhen pa thams cad btang*/ chags pa thams cad spang*/ skyon thams cad ngos bzung zhing spang*/ mtshang thams cad gang 'dug blta zhing yul 'don/ phyi ma nam 'ong mi shes pas na ba glo rgyag 'chi ba thog babs byung dus 'gyod pa las ngan yin pas da lta rang la 'bad nas nyams su len dgos gsungs/ des na dal 'byor dbang po tshang ba thob dus 'di la byang chub kyi lam sna zhig ma zin na mi 'tshings/ sangs rgyas par byed pa la rgyu tshang la ma nor ba zhig byed dgos te/ rgyu med pa dang nor ba dang dman pa las mi 'byung bas/

mu stegs pa dang theg pa chung ngu'i chos rnams la sangs rgyas mi 'byung*/ 'o na nyan rang gis sangs rgyas ma thob pa ci'i phyir zhe na/ sems can gyi don du sems mi bskyed par rang gcig pu zhi bde thob par 'dod pas gzhan du ma dmigs pas thams cad mkhyen pa mi 'byung*/ 'o na sangs rgyas thob pa la ji lta bu nyams su len dgos na/ rgyu med pa'i mthar ma shor bar nyams su blangs/ lam nor ba dang dman pa ma yin par nyams su blangs/ de ltar nyams su len pa la mi phod pa la thog rdzis bya/ 'khri ba bcad/ zhen pa bzlog /skyon ngos bzung*/ mtshang yul nas 'don/ bde sdug thams cad chos nyid du khyer/ de la dang po mi phod pa la thog rdzis bya ba ni/ gang la'ang chags pa spang*/ ngo tsha la sogs gang dgar btang*/ de nas 'khri ba bcad pa ni bu nor la sogs pa thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur 'dug /mi rtag mi bden par 'dug /rang bzhin med par 'dug snyam pa gal che/ de nas zhen pa zlog pa ni/ lung las/ gang la zhen pa 'dug na de yang thong*// gsungs pas gang la zhen pa 'dug pa thams cad spangs shing gtong ba'o// skyon ngos bzung ba ni/ dug gsum la skyon du mi lta ba bdag 'dzin gyi skyon yin pas spang*/ mtshang yul nas 'don pa ni/ dug gsum gyis ngan song gsum du 'tshod dwogs yod pas yul kun gzhi las 'don no// de rnams spang byar byas nas theg pa chen po'i blo sna dang ldan par byas la sems can thams cad byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis bzung la/ sems can thams cad la de kho na bzhin pas bde ba dang ldan sdug bsngal dang bral rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob na ci ma rung snyam pa snying phugs su bcug la rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol ba yin pas nangs par mal nas langs dus su sems can gyi don du sems bskyed bzang po'i dam bcas nas de'i nyin par ci byas dge bar 'gyur zhing chos thams cad sems bskyed kyis bsgyur ba gtso che bas nub nyal kha yan lus ngag yid gsum dge zhing de'ang sems can gyi don du 'go ba gal che/

sems bskyed ngan na sdig par 'gro bas zhe thag pa nas rang 'dod med par sems can la dmigs dgos/ de spangs na theg chen gyi chos dang yongs 'dzin gnyis ka dang bral ba yin pas rang 'dod dang dgra zin du byar mi rung*/ gsang sngags pa'i dbang du na sems can thams cad lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin yin pas lha la nyon mongs pa skye ga na rung*/ phyag rgya chen po'i dbang du byas na rang sems snang ba don dam chos sku'i 'od dam rgyan nam che ba'i rol pa yin pas rang sems chos sku'i rgyan la nyon mongs pa skye ga na rung*/ des na rang gcig pu'i don ma yin sems can thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyang ba'i phyir dge ba ci byed 'gro ba'i don du dril dgos pa la bag chags 'di 'grogs yun ring bas cir snang sgyu mar ma shes bar du nyams len la bsgrim dgos/ dug lnga rang chas su yod pas nyon mongs pa lam du ma slong bar du'ang nyams len la bsgrim dgos/ dus kyi mtha' yun ring bas 'khor ba ma stong bar du nyams su blangs dgos/ de'ang bag chags kyi las kyis sngon bsu rjes su 'brang 'phral du 'grogs te bag chags dus gsum du rgyu bas cir snang thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma'i rang bzhin du 'khyer bas snang ba la bden 'dzin na bun bzhin du yal nas 'gro ba yin/ dug lnga la'ang dang po zhe sdang rang chas su yod pa la skye med kyang rang chas su yod pas zhe sdang skyes tsam na skye med skye bar byas la bsgoms pas zhe sdang mi skye ba dang*/ rmi lam sgyu mar shes shing dug lngas ma gos par shes tsam na lam du slong ba yin/ de bzhin du nyon mongs pa lnga ka la shes par bya/ dus kyi mtha' rgyun ring bas 'khor ba ma stongs bar du bsgrim pa na/ khams gsum spyi btsan la 'khor ba thog mtha' med la gang zag dgos btsan la sangs rgyas pa'i dus 'khor ba'i mtha' yin pas rang btsan sa ma zin bar du bsgom dgos pa yin/

gnas skabs su sems la bzang ngan 'ong na ngan pa la yengs pas de'i phyir kha khrid nyen yod/ dper na glang chen thon yang mjug ma ma thon pa yin/ mjug ma'i phyir ldog dwogs yod pas 'khor ba'i 'bral thag ma chod kyi bar bsgom dgos zhes dwags po rin po ches gsungs// de ltar phyogs thams cad nas bsran tshugs pa/ bdag 'dzin gyi bag chags zad pa/ dge ba 'phel ba gsum char du pha rol tu phrin pa'i don 'grub dgos pas bzod pa'i phan yon che ba la dgongs nas zhi ba lhas/ zhe sdang lta bu'i sdig pa med// bzod pa lta bu'i dka' thub med// ces dang*/ mgon po gser gling pas/ bdag ni las ngan gyi rtsa ba ste// rgyangs kyis skyur ba'i chos shig yin// gzhan ni byang chub kyi 'byung khungs te// cangs kyis len pa'i chos gcig yin// spang gnyen mjug sdud kyi chos gnyis te// mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin// 'khor ngan log bsgrub bzod pa la// snyigs ma'i dus su bsngags pa yin// zhes dang*/ rtog pa thams cad 'bur 'joms te// gnyen po thams cad bcom brdeg yin// 'dun ma thams cad chig dril te// lam rnams thams cad gcig chod yin// gnyen po rnam byang gi chos bzhi ste// mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin// 'khor ngan log bsgrub bzod pa la// snyigs ma'i dus su bsngags pa yin// rkyen ngan dge ba'i bshes gnyen te// 'dre gdon rgyal ba'i sprul pa yin// na tsha sdig sgrib kyi phyags ma ste// sdug bsngal chos nyid kyi yo langs yin// kun nas nyon mongs kyi chos bzhi ste// mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin// 'khor ngan log bsgrub bzod pa la// snyigs ma'i dus su bsngags pa yin// skyid kyi kha non chen po ste// sdug gi mjug sdud chen po yin// na na ba'i nad g.yog ste// gcig pur sdod na skyo rog yin// gnyen po log non gyi chos bzhi ste// mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin// 'khor ngan log bsgrub bzod pa la// snyigs ma'i dus su bsngags pa yin// zhes gsungs pas/

rang sems gcig pu bsrung zhing rgyud 'dul ba'i sems de nyid bzod pa nyid yin te/ zhi ba lhas/ sems can mi srun nam mkha' bzhin// de dag gzhom gyis yang mi lang*// khro ba'i sems ni gcig bcom na// dgra de thams cad chom dang mtshungs// sa steng 'di dag ko g.yog tu// de snyed ko bas ga la lang*// lham mthil tsam gyi ko bas ni// sa steng thams cad g.yogs dang mtshungs// de bzhin pha rol dngos po yang*// bdag gi phyir zlog mi lang gi /bdag gi sems 'di phyir zlog bya'i// gzhan rnams zlog go ci phyir dgos// zhes dang*/ sems de'ang 'dzin med du 'jog pa pha rol tu phyin pa'i rgyur 'gyur te/ tshangs pa khyad par sems kyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ bye brag mi 'byed pa ni bzod pa'o// zhes sogs mang du gsungs pa'i don stong pa nyid dang snying rjes zin na bzod pa dag par yang 'gyur bas/ mdo don snying por bsdu na byang chub kyi sems gnyis la brten nas bdag med kyi don bsgom pa brda' rim gyis sprod pa lta bu'i gdams ngag la don bzhi/ dang po bdag dang gzhan mnyam par bsgom pa/ bdag bas gzhan gces par bsgom pa/ bdag ma grub par bsgom pa/ gzhan ma grub par bsgom pa/ zhes gsungs pa'i don ltar man ngag /nyams len du dril nas sgrub pa lag tu len pa'i tshul la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro gsal btab la/ kun rdzob byang sems kyi skabs su/ rgyal sras thogs med pas/ 'tsho bas phongs shing rtag tu mi yis brnyas// tshabs chen nad dang gdon gyis btab kyang slar// 'gro kun sdig sdug bdag la len byed cing*// zhum pa med pa rgyal sras lag len yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar shin tu rgud nas 'og tu 'gro ba chu las med pa byung yang mi zhum zhing sgyu ma lta bur bsams nas gnad du bsnun pas sdug bsngal yun ring na las ngan 'dzad stobs che/ tshabs che na yengs mi khom pas gong ma rnams kyang nad dang sdug bsngal la brten nas sgrib pa'i thog thag bcad pa'i rnam thar la bsam/

yang 'khor longs spyod mnga' thang phun sum tshogs pa byung yang khengs shing dregs pa spangs nas bla ma dkon mchog la 'bul/ sems can la bsngo/ ma chags ma zhen pa sgyu ma lta bur bsam mo// sdom pa gsum sogs chos spyi'i dam tshig dang khyad par blo sbyong gi dam tshig srog dang 'dra bar bsrung*/ nyon mongs pa skyes dus dang po dran dka'/ bar du bzlog dka'/ tha ma rgyun chod dka' bas/ dang po nam skyes ngos zin pa/ bar du gnyen pos non pa/ phyis mi 'byung bar bsdam pa la 'bad par bya ba 'di ni lam gyi srog shing yin no gsungs/ 'di rnams rtsa tshig las/ gnyis po gang byung bzod par bya// gnyis po srog dang bsdos nas srung*// dka' ba rnams la bslab par bya// zhes pa rnams kyi don no// de nas sngar bzhin gnad gsum gyi srang la 'grim zhing dmigs pa ting nge 'dzin gyi gnad la yid kyis chos la bsre ba'i gnyis pa ngan rtog 'khrul pa dang nyon mongs dang sdug bsngal la bsre zhing bsgom pa ni/ dang po 'khrul pa'i rnam par rtog pa gang shar de ga la bltas pas rnam rtog de ga ngos bzung mid pa gsal stong du shar tsa na snying rtsa dga' yal yal 'ong ste/ rtog pa ngan pa zhig logs su spang mi dgos/ gnyen po ye shes logs nas btsal mi dgos te/ gang dang gang gis 'ching ba rnams// de nyid shes na grol 'gyur te// khyad par lam 'di rtogs pas ni// tshe 'dir sangs rgyas gnas su 'gro// zhes gsungs pas/ 'dod chags kyi rtog pa thul thul ba zhig skyes na de'i rjes su mi 'brang gnyen pos mi bcom par kho rang gi ngo bo de ga la cer gyis bltas te de las gzhan du ma yengs par lhod kyis bzhag pas 'dod chags gzhi med rtsa bral du lhang lhang shar tsa na 'dod chags ma spangs gnas su dag pa'am rang sar grol bas 'bras bu so sor rtog pa'i ye shes dang rgyal ba 'od dpag tu med pa'i sku 'grub pa'o// de bzhin du nyon mongs pa lnga ka la ngo bo la blta zhing klod la ma yengs par rgyun bsring bas lam du slong ste sku lnga ye shes lnga 'grub par gsungs pa dang*/

dug la sngags kyis theb pa bzhin// dug lnga lam khyer gyi gdams ngag yod// ces gsungs de ltar spang bya'i rtog pa mtha' dag la de ltar nyams su len pa ste ro snyom gyi dgongs pa mthar thug pa yin no// mchan/ yang skabs 'dir cung zad gegs byung ba 'dra la rkyen nas shin tu rnam par rtog pa non dka' ba'i rigs sogs la zlog sgom gyi gnad nas bzung ba 'di ston zhing spyi khyab tu bshad dgos rgyu chung bas blo'i 'phen pa gtong lugs ma gtogs dmigs pa la khyad med pas// de'ang zlog bsgom gyi gnad nas bzung na thog mar blo stobs kyi 'dun pa btang ba gal che ba yin te/ na tsha dang lha 'dre la sogs pa'i gnod pa gang mi 'dod pa byung na dga' snyam pa'i 'phen pa drag po btang na/ cis kyang dgos pa med/ ci 'ong ba shog /gang ltar 'gro bar song*/ zhes pa'i re re gsum brdab tu byas pa'i drag sngags brgya rtsa re bzla/ de ltar 'dun pa btang nas rkyen dang thug pa'i dus su rkyen la byur du mi lta bar de thog tu sems la dpa' skyed/ dngos gzhi la/ chos rje rgya ras pa'i zhal nas/ ma legs pa la gnyen pos bzlog sgom thong*// kun rdzob rdzun phug gtib pa'i gdams ngag yin// zhes gsungs pas/ sngon gyi grub thob gong ma thams cad kyis kyang lto 'grangs nyi mas dros pa/ 'gal rkyen gang yang ma byung ba/ gu yangs mos bde'i ngang nas grub pa thob pa'i skad rang mi 'dug /sdod glag med pa'i rkyen drag po re la bsdos pas da gzod don 'grub pa sha stag 'dug pas nga yang da res kyi 'gal rkyen 'di'i steng du 'khor 'das kyi ru shan phyed pa gcig bya dgos snyam du blo thag legs par bcad/ lus sems la sogs pa'i bdag 'dzin thams cad rgyangs kyis bor/ re dogs kyi thag pa rbad kyis bcad/ bya mos lud pa thob pa bzhin du 'gal rkyen de 'dod thog tu togs kyis blangs la ma yengs tsam gyi ngang nas dran 'dzin gyi rtsol ba 'gal rkyen de'i steng du rgyangs kyis skyur nas nyams len gyi ngo bo rkyen snang de rang la byas nas/

de thog tu re btsug pa bzhin bsdad pas da gzod rkyen snang de grogs su 'char ba yin/ 'jog thabs la rkyen de rang gi steng du lhod kyis glod nas 'jog /bdag med mi ro bzhin du 'jog /'dzin med sa rdo bzhin du 'jog /mtha' med rlung khyer gcig la gtad nas 'jog /gtad sa don med gcig la gtad nas 'jog /mgo na oṃ med/ mjug na swā hā med pa'i drag sngags 'di las zab pa'i sngags med/ ces gsungs/ rjes kyi don de ltar nyams su blang ba'i dus su rkyen ngan de ma grol bar khos ltem par song na rig pa sdar ma shor bar bya/ bla ma gong ma'i rnam thar la bsam/ rkyen ngan des bdag 'dzin yul 'don pa'i slob dpon du blta/ 'khor bar 'khyams pa bdag 'dzin gyis len pa go bar bya/ mtshan med dang mtshan bcas gnyis ka'i sgo nas bdag 'dzin btang ste phung po'i tshogs 'khor yang yang bya/ rkyen ngan de mi spang bar de rang gi steng du ri btsug pa bzhin zug pa gcig byung na bar chad la 'chor mi srid cing rkyen ngan kha 'khyag /gdams pa chud ma zo/ bka' brgyud kyi pha rabs ma bcad pa yin pas rab sgrub pa'i zhabs tog zer bde grub pa yin gsungs/ rje dam pa rgya gar ba'i zhal nas/ bod kyi chos pa 'di rnams dang mi mthun pa gcig byung gsung*/ de ci lags zhus pa/ mi mthun pa lam du khyer ba gsang sngags kyi thabs khyad par can yin te khong rnams yul ngan pa la byol/ zhes gsungs/ bzlog sgom 'di yang rdo rje theg pa'i dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa yin te phyag len du blangs pa mi la ras pa dang chos rje 'brug pa dang lo rgod gnyis lta bu yin gsungs/ de ltar skabs dang bstun pa'i dmigs pa gang 'gab bstan pa de ltar nyams su long mdzod cig /

byas la brda bkrol zhing maṇḍal gtor 'bul smon lam gdab pa sogs bya'o// ༈ nyin ya byas pa'i nyi ma nyer dgu chos thun bcu bdun nam/ chos thun bco brgyad pa la'ang sngar bzhin tshig gi mtshams sbyor byas nas/ bzhi pa brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sdom ni/ skyon yon rnam gnyis bsam pa dang*// ngo bo dang ni dbye ba dang*// phye ba so so'i mtshan nyid dang*// spel dang dag par bya ba dang*// 'bras bu dang ni don bdun gyis// brtson 'grus pha rol phyin pa bsdus// zhes pa ltar rgyas pa thar rgyan sogs gong ltar bshad pa las shes shing mtshan nyid lag len du bsdu ba la/ de la spro ba'i brtson 'grus kyis// le lo'i gnyen por 'bad par bya// nyal bsnyes gnyid sogs snyom las kyi// gnyen por mi rtag 'chi ba bsam// bdag 'dras byang chub mi thob ces// sgyid lug gnyen por snying stobs bskyed// lung ma bstan dang mi dge ba'i// bya ba ngan la zhen pa spang*// bdag gis dge la brtson bya zhes// thog mar 'phen pa'i go cha bgo /sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus rnam gsum ste// nyon mongs spang phyir rtse gcig 'bad// dge ba yang dag bsgrub pa'i phyir// rtag par byed dang gus pas dang*// mi g.yo mi ldog nga rgyal med// lnga yi phar phyin drug la 'bad// sems can don byed brtson 'grus ni// gzhan don bcu gnyis 'bad pa'o// dge bas ngom mi shes pa dang*// chog par mi 'dzin brtson 'grus so// zhes brtson 'grus gsum gyi rtsa tshig yin la/ dang po go cha'i brtson 'grus kyi skabs su/ snying po nye bar bsdus pa las/ go cha chen po bgos shing bdud kyi rgyu 'dul ba// de'i phyir na sems dpa' che zhes rab tu brjod// ces gsungs pas sems can gyi don du bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod pas bsam pa rgya chen po nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can bsgral ba'i don du sbyor ba rlabs po che bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bsags pa'i go cha bgos nas dus 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stongs kyi bar du 'bras bu rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi sar smon lam rgya chen pos kha lo bsgyur zhing de'ang chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa'i shes rab chen pos srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas par bya ba ste/

'phags pa thogs med kyis/ thabs chen dang ni ldan pa la// nyon mongs byang chub yan lag 'gyur// 'khor ba zhi ba'i thabs nyid de// de phyir rgyal sras bsam mi khyab// ces sogs gsungs/ 'o na de lta bu'i snying stobs de bdag gis ci ltar 'grub/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i 'byor ba tsam yod na dge ba'i stobs chen po sgrub pa yin mod snyam na/ 'o skol bsam pa rgya chen po byang chub tu sems bskyed nas sems can gyi skyabs mgon du dam bcas/ 'phags pa'i nor dang bslab pa gsum la brten nas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rgya chen po zung 'jug tu bskrun zhing myur du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyal sa sgrub tu yod pa 'di 'jig rten pa'i che 'byor gyi do zla ma yin te sems can skyob par nus pa'i phan bde ma lus pa sgrub tu yod pa'i phyir/ don chen po de lta bu bgyid pa la go cha bgo dgos te/ byang chub sems dpas sems can rnams// bsdu phyir go cha bgo bar bya// sems can tshad ni med pa'i phyir// go cha bgo ba tshad med do// zhes so// de lta bu'i go cha bgos nas rang gzhan smin cing grol ba'i 'bras bu ma thob kyi bar du sgrub pa nyams su len pa ma gtogs dngos kyi bsags sbyong kho nas bsgrub pa'ang dka' ba/ gong ma'i gsungs las/ go cha sdug sran gyi kha rgyan can// bsgrub pa dkyus su bsring na dgos pa yin// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ mdo las/ 'jam dpal sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i sa yongs su sbyong bar 'dod pas stong pa nyid la bslab par bya'o// stong pa nyid la bslabs na sangs rgyas kyi zhing ji ltar smon pa de ltar thob bo// ces dang*/ dam pa 'jug pa'i mdo las/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad la ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar du 'tsho ba'i yo byad sbyar te tshogs bsags pa bas rnal 'byor pas stong pa nyid thun gcig bsgom pa bsod nams mchog go

/ces gsungs pas dad ldan skye 'chi'i 'jigs pas tshe 'di blos thengs pa/ nyams len gnad du tshud cing nyams rtogs gong du spel nus pa/ thos pas go cha chod cing skye 'jig gi nyam nga med pa/ 'gro don snying phug tu bcug cing sems bskyed kyi rlabs dang ldan pa/ sgrub pa lhur len zhing brgyud pa'i rnam thar 'dzin pa de bstan pa'i srog shing ma nor ba'i ded dpon/ ma rig pa'i mun sel/ dgos 'dod kyi bang mdzod yin pas de lta bu gcig byas nas sangs rgyas bsgrub pa la tshig dang go yul dang rtog dpyod ma yin par rgyud la len dgos te/ phal po che'i mdo las/ ji ltar bu ram mngar ba'i ro// thos pas ro ni mi myong ste// zos pas ro ni myong bar 'gyur// de bzhin stong pa nyid kyi ro// brjod pas ro ni mi myong ste// bsgom pas ro ni myong bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas stong nyid rgyud la skye ba la bsgom dgos// bsgom pa la 'jig rten blos btang dgos/ de la tshe 'di'i gdos thag bcad/ lto rgyab la rgyong skyur/ lus srog thad la 'bor/ go cha dang sdug sran bskyed/ gnas ri khrod kyi dgon pa 'grim zhing sgrub pa gnyugs su bsring ba'i dus su nang nas nyams rtogs kyi skye tshul zhig 'ong ba yin/ snying nas chos gcig byed pa la bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi thugs dgongs bsnyags dgos/ bka' brgyud grub thob rnams kyi rnam thar skyong dgos/ rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab dgos/ spyir mi tshe phyid pa'i chos dang mi rjes bsnyegs pa'i chos gcig yin na/ de la skra re bcad/ gos re bsgyur/ ming re spos/ gzugs brnyan zob ma/ rta ltar za/ bong ltar 'dre/ dga' mgur spyod/ 'dod dgur rol/ nyi ma dros/ grod pa 'grangs pa'i chos/ bza' btung gang mos gong kha gang che'i chos des rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don 'grub pa de shin tu dka'/ rje mi la ras pas zwa tshwa med thal med du gsol nas 'phang spre'u'i 'phang bzhin bsgom pas yon tan rnyed pa yin/

slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med kyis byams pa bsgrub pa la dka' las ci tsam byas thos sam/ 'o skol chos kyi phyogs su nub gcig gi gnyid dam nangs gcig gi zan nam dal gcig gi bya byed kyi thabs chags mi nus par sgrub bya tshe 'di la bya/ byed snying 'dod na ni byed/ stabs su bden ni byed/ ma 'dod ma bde na ni 'jog /nyan long med par bsgom 'dod/ bsgom long med par grub rtags 'dod/ chos byed long med par grub thob bam rtogs ldan nam rdzu 'phrul mngon shes can du 'dod/ de tsam ma byung na de 'dras mi yong bar 'dug snyam sems zhum nas byed 'phro bshol/ 'ga' zhig nyan 'jug tsa na bsgom pa tsug byed/ bsgom pa la 'jug tsa nyan pa skad byed/ snying rus med par snying nas arghaṃ mi bca' bar ra bcom zan ma 'dra ba'i mi de la sa zin gcig mi 'ong*/ ma bsgom ma bsgrub pa'i sangs rgyas gcig 'o skol la dmar bar 'dug ste rgyu ngan la lag byad ngan zhing 'bras bu re ba che bas mi phan/ brkos par song na brag la chu yang 'byung*// rtsub par gyur na shing la me yang 'byung*// sems can mis ni rtsol ba byas gyur na// mi 'grub pa yi las ni gang yang med// ces gsungs pas kha za 'dod byin pa 'dar ba wa mi ro la 'jab pa 'dra ba'i chos pa ngas mi 'ong ngas mi bya snyam nas 'phong bcum pas mi phan zhing snying stobs chen po bskyed de rgya ras kyis/ blo ngan goms gyis bag chags shog dril 'dra// nyams gsar bu zhig skyes kyang rkyen gyis 'jig /dus yun thung gi 'khrul pa mi chod kyi// bsgom yun du bsring dang sgom chen kun// gsungs/ zhang rin po ches/ de ma thag tu drod rtags 'dod// bshol la khad kyi snga ltas yin// gnyug bsring bsgom na ci tshug mchi// zhes dang*/ gnyug bsring 'dod thag ma nye mdzod// la 'ur phye gtor ma 'gom mdzod// tshig 'di phugs su gnad ka che// zhes dang*/

ma tshor nyon mongs shugs kyis 'gag /ma shor ye shes shugs kyis skye/ ma tshor srid pa'i 'phrang las thar// zhes gsungs pa lta bu'i yon tan skye ba'i sgom byed pa la gcig pur zug dgos/ stan la chags dgos/ sgom tshang ra la rag las/ rkang pa la bab pas mi 'ong*/ shes pa sgab rdzis khyer/ grong kha chu bzhin nyug /srang kha'i rgyan du byed pa'i mi la yon tan mi 'ong*/ rig pa'i bzhugs sa snying kha/ chos pa'i so nam stan thog nas grub dgos/ 'o skol gyi lo du lon/ bla ma ci bsten/ chos sgor ci zhugs/ sgrub pa byed lo dang thos bsam gang byas la bltas na snying po 'bru 'bras til tsam ma byung zhing yar skyed med pa'i steng du slar thu ru song ste dang po dad pa'ang 'di bas drag mos gus dag snang bya blo thams cad la 'jug thub tsam yod pa la da ni ma tshor phug tu dred pa'i rgyu bzhi tshang ste bla ma la mig 'dris khyer/ gdams ngag la sna dred khyer/ dam tshig la tshod yod khyer/ dad pa la snum dred khyer/ go dred du dred/ go 'thas su 'thas/ go yul du lus nas chos spyi'i rnam par bzhag nas don rang rgyud dang cung zad mi bsre bar chos dang gang zag 'dzol 'dug pa tshor ram/ phyi na tshul chos legs kyang nang na khu 'phrig g.yang za se mi 'dug gam/ na ning dang da lo'i bar la 'jug ldog gi blo skyed ci 'dug soms dang*/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pas na ning nyon mongs pa mgo non tsam la da lo sun 'byin pa'am rtsad nas spang ba ci 'dra 'dug gam/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa na ning zhi gnas pra prig las med pa la da lo lhag mthong gi rtog pa skyes 'dug gam/ shes rab kyi bslab pa na ning don spyi rags pa las mi go ba la da lo rgyu 'bras la 'phrig tshud par 'dug gam/ 'di rnams la snyom las su lus na 'o skol thog ma med pa'i sdug bsngal gyi bsu skyel/ 'dod pa'i khol po/ gzung 'dzin la sdug rgas/

bdag gi sdug bsngal dpang*/ gzhan gyi sdug bsngal khur/ rgyal khams kyi sdug bsngal la blo bkod nas dus da lta'i skad cig ma'ang sdug bsngal gyi bsu skyel min pa 'dug gam/ 'di thams cad kun slong bsam pa'i 'gro ldog dang blo sna'i bsgyur kha ma shes pas lan/ mi re'i blo 'gre ldog de 'ong na ni/ de med na ni/ de byung na ni/ de kha chad na ni snyam du sdug bsngal tshubs ril 'gro/ de tsa na ci dga' bgyis snyam du blo phyam gyis btang na blo bde 'bol gyis 'gro/ dga' mi dga'i byed mkhan thams cad rang gi sems yin pas dus rgyun du blo kun ne je re rtog ge rno se ba zhig gi kha na med/ sdug bsngal phar blangs pa ma gtogs tshur mchong nas mi 'dug pa/ des na blo 'tshub byung tsa na shes pa lod/ 'khris byung tsa na rgyangs la skyur/ blo gu gsum mi thug par ngal bso ru 'jug mi dga' ba bya don ci yod snyam du blo yangs phyed kyis btang nas dal 'byor gyi mi lus ni thob/ bla ma sangs rgyas rnams dang mjal/ bya rgyu ni chos las med do snyam du spros pa thams cad lings kyis btang nas blo bde lhod kyi sdod pas ye gdod ma nas dga' zhing skyid zin pa/ chos nyid kyi nyi ma shar/ bde chen gyi thang ma brdal/ dngos grub kyi 'bras bu smin/ de ltar go na blo bde 'bol le snying dga' yal le shes pa yangs phyod de 'gro/ spyir sangs rgyas pa la lam drang po nas 'gro dgos/ drang po'i lam gyis 'jig rten kun la bde// g.yo sgyu gya gyus mdza' bshes phung bar byed// ces gsungs pas rang sems drang zhing so thub pa zhig dgos/ dang po chos la 'jug pa'i dus su mkhas pa'am grub thob bam rtogs ldan nam dge bshes sam ci 'dra zhig bya snyam pa las dred po bya/ log sgrub bya/ chos pa ngan pa bya snyam pa su la'ang med de dang po'i bsam pa'i go cha de mthar ma thon pa kho nas lan pas de skyol na bzang ba'i phyir rgyal ba yang dgon pa'i pho tshug drug gsungs pa ltar blo rang tshug thub cing go cha'i 'phen pa ma nyams pa bya dgos zhes bka' brgyud gong ma rnams kyis gsungs so// sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus kyi skabs su 'o skol rnams 'bad pa don dang ldan pa yin pas sems can thams cad la rang bzhin gnas pa'i rigs zhes bya/

rang byung lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes zhes bya/ kha nas rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba ma sbas par mngon sum/ ma bral bar rang chas/ ma nor bar rjen pa/ sangs rgyas chos kyi sku dus gsum dus med du sems can gyi khams rgyud dang dbye ba med par bzhugs pa la/ mngon sum mthong yang ngo ma shes/ rang du 'dug kyang thag ma chod/ lhan cig bsdad kyang zhal ma mjal bar ha re long du song yod pa 'di bla slob gdams ngag gi rten 'brel gyi gnad 'dzom nas nyams khrid zab mo'i skya bar nas 'don te rtse gcig tu bsgom zhing tha mal gyi shes pa ngo sprad nas gang shar gyi snang rig gang skyes kyi dran rtog ci byed kyi spyod lam thams cad sgom thun gcig gi ngang nas sbyor bas cir snang ye shes kyi 'khor lo spang bya ma grub pa gser gyi gling nas sa rdo btsal gyis mi rnyed pa lta bu/ snang srid 'khor 'das gsal la ma 'gags par gnyug ma phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bor dag nas tshogs drug gi dbang pos bsgom rogs byed/ sgo lnga'i snang ba dpe char shar rkyen snang chos brgyad kyi bogs 'don zhing 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pas lam snying po'i rang 'gros la stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa/ gzhi 'khor 'das la mi gnas pa'i gnas lugs/ lam 'khor 'das la mi gnas pa'i zung 'jug 'bras bu 'khor 'das la mi gnas pa'i myang 'das te shes pa skad cig ma la'ang lam tshang la ma nor ba'i rang byung snying po'i rang 'gros bya ba bsgrub tu yod pa lags/ rje rgyal tshab byams pas/ de phyir sems can mir gyur pa// tshad med skad cig re re la// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob de'i phyir// zhum pa dang du blang mi bya// zhes dang*/ zhi ba lhas/ sbrang bu sha sbrang bung ba dang*// de bzhin srin bur gang gyur pa// des kyang brtson pa'i stobs bskyed na// byang chub rnyed dka' bla med 'thob// ces sogs dang*/

zhum bcas rtsol ba dor ba'i mis// phongs las thar pa ga la yod// ces gsungs pas ma zhum dman sa bzung ba'i snying stobs kun mthun kun las lhag pa'i rnam thar de la zug rngu med pa'i 'gran sems dang kun gzhi'i nus pa mig go cha'i yar dpe gyen la blta ba zer te de 'dra zhig bsgrub dgos te/ 'di lta bu'i 'khor 'das kyis rje len byed cing dal 'byor snying po len du yod pa'i dus khyis chu 'bog pa bzhin du mig mar la smad pas mi 'ong bas/ bya sdong khar 'dzeg pa bzhin mig 'phang yar gtod la grub thob gong ma'i rnam thar la blta zhing g.yeng ba'i bar chad bsrung dgos te/ nang rig pa'i khye'u chung 'di rkyen khar yang*// 'khrul pa'i snang ba 'dis brid pa mkhas// yid kyi rnam shes 'di col chung*// gzung 'dzin gyi rkun ma 'jab la mkhas// dug gsum gyi jag pa dpa' rtsal che// yengs med kyi dran pa thang lhod 'chor// gnyen po'i zug rngu dgra la 'chus nas yid bzhin gyi nor bu shor nyen yod pas de'i dus su snying rus dang brtson 'grus phur tshugs su dgos par gda'/ des na yid gnyis kyi shes pa 'khrul long che bas chos nyid kyi ngang du sdod mi zug par gzung 'dzin gyi steng du 'gro 'dug mang bas nyon yid kyi rdzun gyis mgo bskor nas gzung 'dzin gyi lcags su bcug pa'i dus su snga phyi'i 'bral mi tshol bar dus gsum gyi spros pa bcad nas sdod zug pa gcig dgos par gda' gsungs/ des na rje dam pa rgya gar gyi gsung las/ lus ngag gi dge sbyor brgya byas pa bas ting nge 'dzin thun gcig bsgom pa dga' ste de'ang bod rnams kyis ma go bar 'dug /dmigs bcas kyi ting nge 'dzin brgya bsgom pa bas dmigs med kyi ting nge 'dzin gcig sgom pa dga' ste de'ang bod rnams kyis ma go bar 'dug /zhi gnas lo brgyar bsgom pa bas thug phrad kyi shes pa skad cig ma gcig bsgom pa dga' ste de'ang bod rnams kyis ma go bar 'dug ces gsungs pa dang*/

sa ra has/ rtogs par gyur na thams cad de yin te// de las gzhan zhig sus kyang shes mi 'gyur// klog pa de yin 'dzin dang bsgom pa'ang de// bstan bcos snying la 'chang ba'ang de yin no// zhes pa dang*/ mdo brgyad stong pa las/ bskal pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi bar du sbyin pa btang ba dang tshul khrims bsrung ba bas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa se gol gtogs pa tsam du bsgoms na bsod nams che bar gsungs pa sogs mdo rgyud du ma nas mang du 'byung ba la yid ches par bya dgos te 'o skol dad pa chung la chos phul che ba snying sran chung la 'dod thag nye bas chos kyi pho sgo gang zag gi rtogs tshod du mi 'dod/ chos rdzogs pa chen pos mi phan gang zag rdzogs pa chen por 'gro dgos gsungs/ chos skad rta ri la gang zag khyi mi ri ba mi bya bar brtan pa ri rab lta bu/ rgya che ba nam mkha' lta bu/ gsal ba me long g.ya' dag pa lta bu/ dwangs pa sprin med kyi nam mkha' lta bu/ skyon drug

mchan/ ldeng rmugs bying rgod 'thas yengs dang bral ba yon tan bzhi rtsa ba brtan rtse mo rno rang bzhin gsal/ dmigs pa sna tshogs su bsgyur shes pa/ dang ldan par bsgom pas sgrib pa mtha' dag dag nas rang gzhan byang chub la 'god nus pa'i sgom gsha' ma gcig skye ba yin gsungs/ de ltar bsgom pa'i brtson 'grus la skad cig gi bar ma bcad cing thang lhod med par goms par bya dgos te/ grub chen u rgyan pa la/ slob ma gcig na re/ bdag gi sgrub pa'ang rgyun bsring*/ brtson 'grus kyang dga' tshad byas pa lags te mtshan mo'i dge sbyor la yad yud kye ma kye ma min pa srangs su tshud pa rang ma byung lags/ 'di sbyangs pa chung ba lags sam gang gis lan pa lags/ zhes zhus pa la 'di skad gsungs/ khyod kyi dge sbyor la nyin par rkyen gyis mi gnod pa yod las che gsungs/ nyin par dag chen po mi yengs par gda' lags/ zhes pa la/ de ka yod 'di 'dra'i rigs gcig la bsgom brtan por byas pa'i sgom chen de mang po zhig gda'/ khyod kyi sbrid pa dang g.yal byung ba'i dus su sgom byas sam gsungs/ sbrid pa la sgom byas lags/ g.yal la byas su'ang ma tshor zhes pa la bya rog dang bya bran la gtor zan byin pa'i dus su sgom ci 'dra byas gsungs/ de la ma yengs pa'i ngang nas bya rog dang bya bran yang sems kyi rang gzugs yin de la zan ster ba'ang sems kyi rang 'od yin snyam pa byas lags/ zhes pa la/ mtshan mo'i sgom 'ong ba la rnam rtog gi 'og 'gyu chod dgos pa yin/ khyod kyi rnam rtog 'og 'gyus su 'chor ba mi tshor bar yod pa yin/ sbrid pa 'ong ba'i dus su ji ltar byas gsung*/ dran pa ma yengs pa'i ngang nas 'ong bcug lags zhus pas/ de la dang po mgo brtsams pa'i dus su 'jug shes su ldang*/ sbrid pa byung ba'i dus su 'jug pa'i rnam shes drag po zhig 'char de'i rjes su'ang 'jug shes phra mo zhig yod de/

de gsum ka la bde nyams dang bcas rim par 'char/ g.yal ba la bde nyams cung zad dang bcas pa'i 'jug pa'i rnam shes 'char/ gtor zan byin pa'i dus su'ang gcig la byin pa gcig gis 'phrog pa dang rang gi yod pa mi chog gzhan srung ba dang*/ yang gtor theb sgyel ba la sogs mang po dag la chags sdang gi 'char sgo du ma 'ong gin yod de/ ngos ma zin yod pa yin/ de bzhin du cho gas drug gi steng na phar 'char sgo phra mo tshan che ba gcig yul la rgyug pa la khyod kyi ngo shes kyi dran pa de 'khyag thog tu chu rgyugs pa bzhin song nas ngos ma zin yod pa yin/ bya dang bya bran la ster ba yang sems yin snyam pa de kun go bas bkab pa'i spyi skad yin/ nyams myong gi skad cig gi rig pa de min/ nyin mtshan 'dres pa'i nyams myong mtshan nyid pa 'ong ba la dran 'dzin gyi rtsol ba 'dag dgos pa yin gsungs/ 'di bzhin du thabs shes kyi dge ba gang bsgrub kyang dmigs 'dun sems dang 'dres par sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus rnams kyang bshad pa ltar sgrub bo// chog par mi 'dzin pa la thos bsam sgom pa'i dge ba gang la'ang nan tan phyir snur med pa dgos te 'dir mtshon byed sgom pa la sbyar na rang gi tshod mthon po bzung ba byung yang da rung chog shes mi bya bar 'bad dgos te mtshal pa'i mkhan po bzod pas gtsang pa rgya ras la gdams pa'i spring yig la/ mnyam rjes med pa thugs la btags// 'on kyang phyi rol rkyen ngan gyi// chags sdang 'thad dam mi 'thad sogs// nang du rtog ngan 'gyu mi 'gyu// legs par gzigs dang rnal 'byor pa// de tshe rnam rtog zengs longs kyi// nam mkha'i nyams myong bral gyur na// de mnyam rjes lag pas dran pas bzung*// de sogs phyi rol rkyen ngan gyi// nam mkha'i nyams myong mi 'bral na// de bsgom med lags pas thugs la btags// yin lugs steng nas mi gzigs par// myong ba'i steng nas lta ba gces// lta sgom blo 'das yin lugs de// byin rlabs stobs kyis mngon sum myong*// nang nas rang shar rjen pa de// bsgom mkhan med par goms su chug

/mthong mkhan med par mthong ba de// ngam shod gtsang po'i gzhung bzhin du// rgyun chad med pa'i ngang nyid nas// skyong mkhan med par skyong la thong*// rtogs mkhan med pa'i rtogs pa de// phyin pa med par lam la bgrod// rtogs mkhan med par rtogs pa skyong*// bla ma rang sems gcig pa de// zung 'jug lags so bshes gnyen mgon// zung 'jug ngang nas gsol ba thob// cis kyang gsol 'debs mi 'gal gyi// 'debs mkhan med par gsol ba thob// khyod byas chos zhig pa'i sgom chen yin// sems la gzan pa'i las rnams spongs// byed spyod chos dang bstun lags kyang*// rang rgyud thul bar 'dug gam ltos// sangs rgyas sems can dbyer ma phyed// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal brjed nas thal// snying rje bsgom pa'i yul ma rnyed// 'gro don ji ltar byed gsungs pa// thams cad gcig pa'i gnyis med de// zung 'jug lags pas rjes yi rang*// skye mkhan med pa'i snying rje yis// 'gro ba med pa'i sdug bsngal la// bsran glag med pa'i snying rje spyod// bshes gnyen khyod la yang zhu ba// thams cad stong pa'i chos rnams la// ma rtogs sems can snying re rje// snyam pa'i snying rje spyi snyoms de// khyod kyis nam yang rtogs mod kyi// 'on kyang sha la babs pa yi// snying rje 'di la 'bung gsum thon// sha la bab pa'i snying rje ni// mdze sprang thu lum la sogs pa'i// spyan sngar gang bab sdug bsngal can// mthong tshe snying nas mi bzod pa'i// rang dbang med par 'bung gsum thon// rtsal mchog 'di la sbyong ba gces// phyag rgya chen po shor dwogs med// stong pas stong pa ga la phral// nam mkhas nam mkha' ga la phral// bcos mar song yang mi lto yi// snying rje 'di la rtsal mchog sbyong*// lus ngag gang byed sna tshogs kun// snying rje ye nas ma yengs mdzod// tha mar rkyang par 'chor nyen yod// gzob cig snying rje ma yengs sam// snying rje 'di la rkang gcig tshug

/rtogs ldan snying rje'i rkang med pa// re re gnyis gnyis srid nyen gda'// rang re pha pad 'di la 'bung*// lam dang 'bras bu dbyer ma phyed// sangs rgyas 'dod pa zad nas thal// bsgrub bya bsgrub pa'i mkhan po med// sku dang ye shes su la gnang*// gsungs pa gnas lugs dgongs pa lags// snying nas sangs rgyas sleb ma sleb// mdo rgyud man ngag nas gsungs pa'i// yon tan rgya mtsho ma lus kun// rang la cha gcig cang gda' 'am// yon tan dgos so rgya ras pa// grub thob gong ma'i rnam thar gyi// mchog thun dngos grub thob pa kun// rang la rdzogs sam legs par gzigs// gsungs pa'i yon tan gong ma rnams// nges par bden no rnal 'byor pa// bla ma rin chen zhal nas kyang*// cag cag nges nges sgom chen mtshangs// ma zin sgom 'thas sgom chen mtshang*// sa log gnam log gzhi rtsa 'khrug /gsungs pa thugs kyi dkyil du zhog /rkyag gtad med pa'i rtsed mo la// byis pa rnams ni bden du re// smra mkhas med pa'i ngag 'khyal la// sgom chen rnams ni bden du re// bsgrub la brtson pa'i rgya ras pa// tshe 'di'i rtags dka' lings kyis bor// rang mgo thon dang ma thon dang*// che thabs bzang thabs la sogs pa// zhi 'dod 'khri ba 'dug mi 'dug /gzigs shig bag zon mdzad par zhu// grub thob rnams la de mi srid// snyam du ma dgongs bya ra mdzod// thams cad nam mkhar song mod kyi// zhen 'khris rmang nas zhig lags kyang*// tshe 'di'i chos brgyad mthun 'jug la// zon chen mdzod cig rnal 'byor pa// bka' drin can gyi bla ma la// mos gus gsol 'debs 'bung zhig bu// de nyid sgrub pa'i snying yin pas// 'debs mkhan med kyang gsol ba thob// bya sa med kyang mos gus kyis// gnad du phab pa'i sgrub pa de// gdung sems lags pas gces par zungs// rtog pa ngan long song bar mchi'o// dran pa shes bzhin bya ra mdzod// re dwogs med pa mkhyen lags kyang*// yon tan sgrub cig rgya ras pa// zhes gsungs pa ji lta bar shes par byas la thos bsam sgom sgrub sogs dge ba la chog shes med par 'bad nas mthar sems can gyi don la brtson par bya'o// de dag gi rtsol ba'ang sems kyis byed pa ste/

sems gsal gcig bskyed 'bras bu yang*// tshangs la sogs pa yin pa ltar// lus ngag bcas pa'i 'bras bu yang*// spyod pa zhan pas de lta min// bzlas brjod dang ni dka' thub kun// yun ring dus su spyad byas kyang*// sems gzhan g.yengs par byas pa ni// de nyid rig pas don med gsungs// zhes pa lta bu ste sems la rag las pas sems kyi byed pa de'ang dmigs med du 'jog pa brtson 'grus kyi phar phyin du 'grub par 'gyur te/ mdo las/ gang tshe lus dang sems dang sems can 'du shes med// 'du shes rnam par log nas gnyis su med chos spyod// 'di ni byang chub zhi ba mi nyams mchog 'dod yin// brtson 'grus pha rol phyin ces phan par mdzad pas gsung*// zhes gsungs pas/ stong pa dang snying rjes zin na brtson 'grus dag par yang 'gyur ba/ mdo don snying por bsdu na yon tan thams cad bskyed par byed pas sa gzhi lta bu'i gdams ngag la don bzhi/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig la bsten dgos/ de la dang po thos dgos/ bar du sems dgos// tha ma bsgom dgos// zhes gsungs pa'i don ltar man ngag nyams len du dril nas sgrub pa lag tu len pa'i tshul thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro gsal btab la/ kun rdzob byang sems kyi skabs su mtshan ldan gyi bla ma bsten pa dang rang blo las su rung ba/ sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen 'dzom pa gsum gal che ste/ de dag lam gyi skyel ma dang*/ gdams ngag chud mi za ba dang*/ sdig grogs kyi dbang du mi 'gro ba gsum la dgos pa'o// yang bla ma la mos gus dang*/ thabs shes kyi blo sbyang ba dang*/ dge sdig gi srung sdom gsum srung ba dang*/ lus ngag yid gsum dge ba dang mi 'brel ba dang*/ sngar bshad ltar sems can thams cad la khyab pa'i byang sems tshig tsam du ma lus pa dang*/ lhag par blo sbyong skye dka' ba'i yul yid du mi 'ong ba la bkol nas bsgom pa dang*/

'dzom ma 'dzom gnod ma gnod/ khams bzang ngan/ gnas skyid sdug la ma ltos par rtag tu bsgom pa dang*/ dus da res chos kyi gtso bo bsgrub pa'i snying po byang chub kyi sems rin po che bsgom pa dang*/ chos kyi sdug bsngal mi bzod 'jig rten gyi sdug bsngal bzod pa/ chos la mi 'dun 'jig rten la 'dun pa/ nyams len gyi ro mi myong 'jig rten phan gnod kyi ro myong ba/ sdig can la snying rje mi bsgom dka' thub can la snying rje bsgom pa/ rang la ltos bcas chos la mi sbyor 'jig rten pa la sbyor ba'i gnyer sems/ gzhan skyid pa la yi rang mi bsgom dgra sdug pa la yi rang bsgom pa'i go log drug spang*/ chos la nges shes ma skyes pa'i res byed pa 'dra/ res mi byed pa 'dra mi byed par rgyun mi 'chad pa'i blo sbyong gsungs/ 'di rnams rtsa tshig las/ rgyu'i gtso bo rnam gsum blangs// nyams pa med pa rnam gsumabasgom// 'bral med gsum dang ldan par bya// yul la phyogs med dag tu sbyong*// khyab dang gting 'byong kun la gces// bskol ba rnams la rtag tu bsgom// rkyen gzhan dag la ltos mi bya// da res gtso bo nyams su blang*/ go log mi bya/ res 'jog mi bya/ zhes pa rnams kyi don ni/ de nas sngar bzhin gnad gsum gyi srang la 'grim zhing dmigs pa ting nge 'dzin gyi gnad la yid kyi chos la bsre ba'i gsum pa spyod lam rnam pa bzhi dang lung ma bstan gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag la bsre zhing sbyar ba ni/ sor 'jog ma shes bcos shing lod// 'jur la ma theb ngan lang 'chor// brtags dpyad bzang 'dod rtsol bas bslad// ngo ma shes na mtshan mas 'ching*// rnam rtog 'gog pa'i sgom chen sdug /ces gsungs pa rnams kyi gnad shes par byas la/ gang tshe gnyug ma'i sems ni sbyong gyur na// de tshe bla ma'i byin rlabs snying la zhugs par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas dran snang gang shar mi 'gegs par phyi snang ba gang shar dang nang rnam rtog gang shar gyi ngo bo la bltas nas cung zad yan du gzhugs te cir snang cir shar yang mi dgag mi sgrub par mkhas pas ba glang skyong ba ltar lhod kyis klod la bzhag go

/bde gsal mi rtog pa la sogs pa'i rtsol ba med par sems lhod kyis glod la bzhag /med med po stong stong po gsal gsal bde bde ba'i dmigs pa gang yang mi bya bar blo yi rtsol ba thams cad dor la btsan gyis 'jog pa'i ngang nas glod shes pa gcig kho na ga la/ glod ma shes par blos byas yid kyi bzo 'phro ma bcad par bsgom mtho mtho bzang bzang skad cig kyang ma yengs par 'dod 'dod pos chud gsan te shing gi pags pa bshus na 'jam pa slar de bas 'jam pa 'dod nas bzhog na rtsub par 'byung ba ltar yid byed kyi bzo bcos dang rtsol sgrub mang nas ting nge 'dzin rtsal mi rdzogs pas/ sems ma bcos na gsal/ chu ma rnyog na dwangs/ zhes gsungs pa ltar rnam rtog gang skyes rkyen snang gi dngos po gang shar de ga las sems mi phral mi bcos par gu yangs sing gi lhod kyis bshig la de 'dras rtsal cung zad blo tshod de dang dpag nas sbyong*/ yang rig thog kho na bde na'ang nam dran de gar glod kyis 'jog ste/ rgyal ba yang dgon pas/ blo rtog pa la skyon du mi lta bar// mi rtog pa ched du mi bsgom mdzod// sems rang lugs su zhog la rgyang so zhig tshug dang*// sgom zhi gnas kyi mthil du pheb pa gcig 'ong gi /zhes dang*/ ko'u shi kas zhus pa'i mdo las/ chu bo dag la brten pa'i rnyogs// ma bsgul bzhag na dwangs par 'gyur// de bzhin sems kyi rnam rtog kyang*// ma bsgul bzhag na dwangs par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ kun byed rgyal po las/ 'di ltar snang ba de bzhin nyid du gcig /'di la sus kyang bcos par ma byed cig /ma bcos mnyam pa'i rgyal po de la ni// mi rtog chos kyi sku yi dgongs pa gnas// zhes gsungs pas/ tshur la gang gi rkyen byed pa'i dran rtog gam/ tshur rkyen ma byas kyang spang gnyen bde sdug gi rtog pa sna tshogs pa bskyed cing bsgom la gang dang gang yin pa de ma shor bar bya/

de'i ngang la ma yengs par bya/ de la dmigs pa'i 'ben bya zhing de thog tu glod pas dran rtog ci skyes thams cad nyams len gyi grogs byed pas 'gyu ba dngos med stong pa'i rang bzhin du shes nas cir snang ci srid kyi chos thams cad ting nge 'dzin gyi grogs su 'char te bde gsal gyi ting nge 'dzin la rang dbang thob par byed do// kha cig spang bya'i rtog pa nan gyis bkag dgos zer yang de ltar byas na rtog pa mang bas sems mi gnas pa'i steng du slar gegs su 'gro zhing ting nge 'dzin skye dka' ba yin/ de'i phyir rtog pa gang skyes kyang skyon du mi blta bar sems 'dzin gyi 'dod thog tu byas la ma yengs par glod kyis rang thog tu bzhag pas sngar lta stangs kyi yul la lta ba dang rtog pa la lta ba khyad par med pa'i sems 'dzin mchog tu gyur pa ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ gang phyir chags sogs de nyid la// tshul bzhin 'jug pa de'i phyir// de las rnam grol 'gyur de bzhin// de yi de dag las nges 'byung*// zhes dang*/ he badzra las/ chags pas 'jig rten 'ching gyur na// 'dod chags nyid kyis rnam grol 'gyur// zhes dang*/ rgyal ba yang dgon pas/ blo rtog pa ru 'gyu ba gnas lugs kyi sgo// rang ngo shes pa nyams len gyi gnad// rang zhal dang mjal bas rang dang 'dres// rang min gyi dran rtog gcig 'dug gam ltos dang*// sgom gnas 'gyu'i bar lag 'dres pa gcig 'ong gi /zhes gsungs pa'i don no//

mchan/ 'di'i rgyab skyor sgom 'khor yug gi khrid dang ngo mthong yod pa la tshogs brgyad rang grol dang mnyam rjes dbyer med kyi ngo sprod bya ba'i skabs so// de ltar snang rig gsal la ma 'gag pa'i thog tu shar dran glod cing bshig nas lta ba la nan tan bskyed mdzod cig / byas la brda bkrol zhing maṇḍal gtor 'bul smon lam gdab pa sogs bya'o// nyin ya byas pa'i nyi ma so gcig chos thun bco brgyad do// ༈ chos thun bcu dgu pa la yang sngar bzhin tshig gi mtshams sbyor byas nas/ lnga pa bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sdom ni/ skyon yon rnam gnyis bsam pa dang*// ngo bo dang ni dbye ba dang*// phye ba so so'i mtshan nyid dang*// spel dang dag par bya ba dang*// 'bras bu dang ni don bdun gyis// bsam gtan pha rol phyin pa bsdus// zhes pa ltar rgyas par thar rgyan sogs ltar bshad pa las shes shing*/ mtshan nyid lag len du bsdu ba la/ bsam gtan dge la rtse gcig ste// 'du 'dzi rnam g.yengs kun spangs nas// gcig pu dben par gnas pas 'thob// khyim dang rnyed bkur la sogs pa// 'du 'dzir chags la nyes pa mang*// g.yeng bas tshe 'dir don med byed// de bas sgo gsum dben par bya// rdzogs sangs rgyas la yo byad tshogs// kun gyis bsnyen bkur byas pa bas// bsgom par 'dod nas dgon pa'i phyogs// gom bdun bor la sangs rgyas mnyes// ngo bo'i sgo nas zhi lhag gnyis// yid byed sgo nas dbye ba bzhi// dman mchog sgo nas dbye ba gnyis// sgom tshul sbyor ba dngos gzhi gnyis// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang*// phrag dog nga rgyal cha mnyam dang*// drug gi gnyen por mi sdug byams// rten 'brel bdag gzhan mnyam pa dang*// bdag gzhan brje dang rlung la bslab// de yang bdag lus mi gtsang rdzas// so drug 'dus pa'i rang bzhin bsam// rnam par bam dmar rnam par sngo// rnag dang 'bus gzhig keng rus dang*// rus gong 'thor dang thi ba'i mdog

/blta zhing bdag la'ang 'di 'dra ba'i// gnas skabs 'gyur zhes shugs phyung bsgom// skyes pa bud med la sogs lus// de ltar bltas pas chags pa bzlog /zhe sdang shas che byams pa'i blo// yid du 'ong dang 'dris pa dang*// tha mal pa nas 'gro kun bar// rim pas bskyed la gcig tu 'bad// bying rmugs gti mug shas che na// rten cing 'brel 'byung bsgom pa ste// chu lud drod gsher dus sa bon// sa gzhi la brten myu gu nas// sā li'i bar du 'byung mod kyang*// re re'ang mi rtog byed po med// tshogs pa'i dbang las snang ba nyid// sa bon myu gur mi 'gyur te// sa bon gzhan la myu gu'ang gzhan// sa bon med las myu gu min// dpyad na mi bzod snang tsam pa// sgyu ma'i chu klung lta bu nyid// phyi yi rten cing 'brel 'byung yin// ma rig 'du byed rnam shes dang*// ming gzugs skye mched drug reg pa// tshor ba sred len srid pa skye// rga shi yan lag bcu gnyis te// snga ma la brten phyi ma skye// de la mya ngan smre sngags dang*// sdug bsngal sna tshogs 'byung bar 'gyur// de ltar lugs 'byung 'khor ba ste// lugs las bzlog pa myang 'das yin// re re'ang phyi ma bsgrub mi sems// byed po med cing bdag kyang med// snga ma phyi mar mi 'pho zhing*// snga ma med par yang mi 'byung*// snga ma gzhan la phyi ma'ang gzhan// dpyad na mi bzod sgyu ma tsam// de ltar shes pas srid pa bzlog /rgyu bcas nang gi rten 'brel lo// nang gi rten 'brel rkyen bcas ni// sa chu me rlung mkha' rnam shes// de ltar khams drug 'dus pa las// lus 'di mngon par grub mod kyang*// de dag re re'ang sems pa med// phan tshun gcig gi gcig mi shes// byed po med kyang 'dus tsam la// snang bar zad de dpyad mi bzod// des na bzod na stong nyid de// de nyid rten cing 'bral 'byung snang*// 'di ni nam yang dbyer med de// chu dang chu rlabs ji bzhin no// rten 'brel gang shes des chos shes// de yi sangs rgyas shes so zhes// rgyal ba nyid kyis rab tu bsngags// phrag dog shas che bdag dang gzhan// mtshungs pa'i byang sems bsgom bya ste// bde 'dod sdug bsngal mi 'dod mnyam// so sor gces par mtshungs phyir ro// rgyal sras rnams kyi gsang ba'i lam// bdag gzhan brje ba bsgom bya ste// bdag nyid gces 'dzin dor nas ni// gzhan la gces 'dzin goms par bya// 'di yi phan yon tshad med kyang*// lhag tu nga rgyal gnyen por gsungs// rnam rtog mang ba'i gnyen por ni// rlung gi rnal 'byor bsgom par bya// bgrang dang rjes 'gro 'jog pa dang*// rtog bsgyur yang dag drug tu gsungs// de ltar sbyor bas rnal du dbab// rtog bral shin sbyangs rab tu zhi// rlom sems ro myong mtshan ma med// 'di ni rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyi// mthong chos bder gnas bsam gtan yin// zad par zil gnon rnam thar sogs// nyan rang rnams dang thun mong dang*// nyan rang yul las ches 'das pa'i// ting 'dzin rgya mtsho bsgrub pa ni// yon tan bsgrub pa'i bsam gtan no// sna tshogs lus kyi bkod pa yi// gzhan don bcu gcig 'bad pa sogs// sems can don sgrub bsam gtan no// ji ltar bsgom par bya tshul ni// dben par skyil krung mnyam bzhag bcas// nang du mi g.yo bsdus te 'jog

/nyer 'jog dul byed zhi bar byed// nyer zhi rgyud gcig ting 'dzin byed// sems kyi 'jog thabs rnam pa dgu// 'di yis ting 'dzin rtse gcig skye// de nas shes rab dang ldan pas// mtshan nyid so sor rig pa dang*// mos pa rab tu dben pa dang*// dga' ba sdud dang dpyod pa dang*// sbyor ba'i mthar thug de yi 'bras// de ltar nyer bsdogs yid byed bdun// 'di yis bsam gtan dngos gzhi 'grub// de la rtog dpyod dga' dang bde// rtse gcig yan lag lnga ldan pa// 'di ni bsam gtan dang po yin// rtog dpyod bral ba gnyis pa ste// gsum pa bde ba kho na can// bzhi pa btang snyoms rtse gcig pa'o// de las mngon shes rnam lnga 'grub// de ltar 'dod gzugs bsam gtan ni// 'jig rten 'das pa'i shes rab dang*// 'bral bas yang dag lam du 'gyur// rgod 'gyod gnyid rmugs the tshom gyi// gnyen por zhi lhag rnam pa gnyis// yang na mi mthun phyogs drug gi /gnyen por spang ba'i 'du byed brgyad// bsdu na bsgom tshul sgrim lhod gnyis// yang na rgyal ba'i sku gzugs sogs// mnyam bzhag bsgom pas sems 'dzin te// gong nas gong du ting 'dzin 'grub// gus dang rgyun du sbyor ba yi// brtson 'grus la ni 'di skye ste// mdor na theg pa chen po ni// dge ba'i bshes kyi lag na gnas// de ltar bsam gtan ldan pa yis// sbyin sogs yon tan thams cad 'thob// ces bsam gtan gsum gyi rtsa tshig yin la/ dang po bsam gtan gyi mi mthun phyogs rnam g.yeng spang ba la lus ngag yid gsum dben pa bsten dgos te/ chos brgyad tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad rgyab tu skyur zhing tshe blos btang gi bya ba mthar 'don pa'i snying stobs rgya chen po bskyed de grub pa'i rgyal sa 'dzin pa la bka' brgyud gong ma'i gsung dang rnam thar la de'ang thog mar mi rgyu phun sum tshogs pa zhig byas/

de nas pha yul gyi chags sdang rgyab tu sings kyis skyur/ de nas nye 'brel gyi gdung sems bcad/ de nas nor longs spyod kyi 'khri ba skyur/ de nas kha zas dang grogs kyi zhen pa spangs/ de nas gnas dang lus kyi zhen chags spangs/ de nas bsam gtan gyi zhen pa mtha' dag spang dgos te/ dang po mi rgyu la bcad pa che ba rdo bcag pa 'dra ba zhig dgos/ 'phral bde la rting gcu ba g.yag rgan gyi 'gying ba 'dra ba gcig dgos/ mis zer la ched du mi 'dzin pa 'phyon ma rlung gis khyer ba 'dra ba gcig dgos/ 'dod yon la zhen pa log pa skyug nad can gyi sngas su zas bzhag pa 'dra ba gcig dag dgos/ 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba la 'jigs pa shwa ba rdzis phog pa 'dra ba gcig dgos/ rtsis gdab med pa nyes chen g.yang la mchong ba 'dra ba gcig dgos/ sdug thub pa yug sa mos bu phrug gso ba 'dra ba gcig dgos/ mi gzhi de lta bu'i steng du dad brtson shes rab nges 'byung skyo shas/ snying rus sdug sran sogs bsags pa mchog tu gyur pa zhig gi 'jig rten blos btang mthar 'don pa la pha yul ma spangs na btson rar lcags brgyab pa'i mis dgra la gnod pa skyel ba dang 'dra ste 'dod pa'i bya ba mi 'grub/ pha yul lcags sreg gi sa gzhi dang 'dra ste bde ba'i go skabs med/ pha yul ro myags kyi 'dam dang 'dra ste chags sdang gi sdug bsngal las mi thar/ pha yul mya ngan gyi thang dang 'dra ste thar pa'i gnas su sleb dus mi 'ong*/ pha yul mchil snabs bzhin du dor nas bas mtha' dang dben pa'i gnas su bsnyegs dgos// de nas gnyen gyi zhen pa ma spangs na dgra dang gshin rje'i lag tu rang lus chud pa 'dra bas chos bya ba'i skabs med de/ gnyen 'brel bdud kyi jag pa dang 'dra ste thar pa'i lam sgo bkag gnyen 'brel srog gcod kyi gshed ma dang 'dra ste dal 'byor gyi dgos don stor/ gnyen 'brel gshin rje'i pho nya dang 'dra ste rang dbang rang la mi 'ong bas gnyen 'brel rtsad nas spangs la mtshan ldan gyi bla ma bsten dgos/

de nas nor longs spyod kyi zhen pa ma spangs na 'khor bar skyar ba'i rting rdo chen po byed de nor longs spyod bsags na dgra 'dre'i g.yab mo yin/ nor longs spyod bsags na g.yeng ba'i rlung 'tshubs yin/ nor longs spyod bsags na sdig sdug gi rtsa ba yin pas nor rdzas mi gtsang ba bzhin du dor la 'phags pa'i nor bdun dang ldan da go /de nas zas gos kyi sred pa ma spangs na yi dwags su skye ba'i rtsa ba'ang kha zas la chags pa 'di yin/ zas kyi sred pa ma chod na tshol khrol gyi sdug bsngal dgos/ zas kyi sred pa ma chod na mi nag gi ngo bsrung dgos/ zas kyi sred pa ma chod na tshe sprang gi sdug 'gros dgos/ gos 'jam legs la blo sna shor na snang shas kyi me ro ldang*/ gos 'jam legs la blo sna shor na mi chen gyi hor btsun la smon pa shor/ gos 'jam legs la blo sna shor na sgrub pa'i yo byad sbrug dgos pas zas gos kyi sred zhen spangs la mi la ras pa'i rnam thar gyi zas su rlung dang bcud len gos su ras rkyang dang phyag dar khrod kyis 'tsho bas chog shes pa de thub pa'i brtul zhugs kyi zas gos yin/ de nas grogs kyi zhen pa ma spangs na rang gi mgo 'don grogs la re ba zhig byung na ri khrod dang nyams rtogs kyang gzhan dbang du 'chor ba zhig 'ong bas/ grogs ngan pas sems bskyed kyi blo sbyang dang phral/ grogs ngan pas ting nge 'dzin gyi chu rgyun gcod/ grogs ngan pas bslab pa'i dam tshig dkrug pas grogs ngan spangs la rang nyid gcig pur bsgrub pa de bar chad kyi srung ba'i mchog yin/ de nas gnas kyi zhen pa spang dgos te bdag tu bzung ba'i gnas phal cher bdag 'dzin gyi sred pa dang phrag dog gi khong srin 'phel bas spang dgos te/ rgya ras kyi zhal nas/ lha gnyan gnas pa'i gangs ri dang*// klu gnyan gnas pa'i mtsho 'gram dang*// rgyal srin gnas pa'i brag ri dang*// bla ma gong ma'i gdan sa dang*// mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dben gnas sogs// ma bsgom bgyi ba'i dgur bsgom kyang*// sems ma thul gyi sangs rgyas gang na'ang med// khyed gar sdod kyi gnas su rang rgyud thul// zhes gsungs pas zhen med kyi gnas dben par sgrub pa byed dgos/

de nas lus kyi zhen pa ma spangs na tshe blos btang yang sgrub pa mthar mi 'chol bas shi na'ang de rang gi sgrub pa mtha' ru 'don snyam nas lus srog thad la bor ba ma gtogs pa bdag na ni/ shi na ni/ ltog na ni snyam pa'i ltog snang dang skyid 'dod kyi gdung shugs nyams len gyi dwangs cha la phog pa'i bag chags kyi gong mi non pa'i blo sna bdud kyis khrid nas/ yang na bslab pa'i yon tan btsong*/ yang na bsgrub pa'i nus mthu sprug /yang na mgo bskor bzang rdzus bslu/ yang na med pa'i sdug yus ngoms nas mi gcig gi kha rgyab dang tshe phyid thabs la lha klu mi gsum tha na dgra 'dre yan la re ltos bca' dgos shing mthar su ngan re dang gong thang mnyam pa re byas shing da rung yang snyem med par 'di bas drag gcig tsug byed snyam nas mi tshe rlung la bskur ba'i bdud khyer de la sdug bsngal dang 'gal rkyen dang bar chad 'phags pas kyang mi sel/ yang na grong ltag gi dgon pa 'dod yon mod pa'am/ yang na pha zhing la yon bdag byas nas a khu tsha bo rnams kyi mdun gros kyi rkang btsug nas mi chos lha chos gnyis ka bsgrub tu re nas 'khrul pa'i yul phyir 'brang bas dge sbyor mi 'phel pa'i steng du sngar yod pa rnams kyang 'grib 'gro bas mdor na lus kyi gces spras su tshe gang 'chi ka 'chi rjes gsum gyi grab shom mang po bsags pa'i skyid thabs de la sdug bsngal gyi sems las mang po bsags dgos pas mdun ma byung rgyal/ 'tsho ba bya tshol/ rnyed pa rang yal zhig dgos gsungs/ de nas ting nge 'dzin gyi zhen pa ma spang na khams gsum du gol bas/ bde ba'i ting nge 'dzin la zhen pa 'ong*/ gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin la zhen pa 'ong*/ mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la blos byas sam stong lta 'byung nyen yod pas gol shor med pa'i ngo bo rjen par skyong dgos shing de la'ang blos byas yid kyi mkhan po zad pa zhig dgos/

de lta bu'i sgrub pa nyams su len pa la gegs sel bogs 'don thams cad kyi rtsa ba bla ma'i mos gus kyi gzhi bzung zhing bla ma sangs rgyas su mthong ba'i mos gus skyes na phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa tshad du skyel ba mi skye mi srid/ mos gus la sel btsud na thos bsam gyi brtags dpyad byas pa'i chos skad kyi rtog pa'i rbad khams dang phra zhib kyi rnam grangs mang po shes shing nyams rtogs kyi dbye ba rnal 'byor bzhi'i rim pa la sogs mang du bshad kyang blos byas kyi stong nyid dang rtog pa'i phreng ba brgyud pa las ma 'das pas des nyon mongs dang rnam rtog mi spangs shing 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho brgal mi nus/ che 'dod grags 'dod kyi bsgom la yang zob byas kyang gzhan yang yid mi ches shing rang kha skyengs pa las mi 'ong*/ 'chi ba'i dus su tha mal pas kyang zhi khrel ba zhig byas nas rang la tshe 'di phyi'i brten sa gcig kyang med pa la bstan pa spyi dang bye brag gi zhabs 'dren chen po byas pa de mi lus thob pa la gyong che bas nyams myong rgyud la skyes pa zhig dgos gsungs/ de la thog mar zhi gnas kyi bsam gtan khyad par can zhig brten dgos te/ de'ang zhi ba lhas/ zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis// nyon mongs rnam par 'joms par shes byas nas// thog mar zhi gnas btsal bya de yang ni// 'jig rten chags pa med la mngon dgas 'grub// ces dang*/ rje rang byung bas/ zhi gnas rgyu ni tshul khrims la brten te// ngo bo nyon mongs rtog pas dben pa yin// rkyen ni sems gnas khyad par la skye ste// phan yon nyon mongs sdug bsngal rag pa non// zhes gsungs pas de lta bu'i zhi gnas skye ba'i ring rgyu tshul khrims rnam par dag pa dang*/ dben pa bsten pa dang 'jig rten blos btang ba dang*/ nye rgyu bskyed rim dang sems 'dzin gyi dmigs bcas// zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin de la mthar gyi gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu ste srid rtse man chad kyi 'dod khams kyi rnam rtog spang ba la bsam gtan gyi snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi ste/

gzung 'dzin gyis rtog pa med la bsgom bya sgom byed kyi 'dzin pa tsam dang bcas pa bsam gtan dang po'o// rtog pa dang dpyod pa med la dga' bde'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ro myong ba'i 'dzin pa dang bcas pa ni bsam gtan gnyis pa'o// sems g.yo ba med pa la dbugs 'byung rngub dang bcas pa ni bsam gtan gsum pa'o// rnam rtog thams cad dang bral zhing gsal snang go ma 'gag pa nam mkha' stong pa'i dkyil lta bu rtog med rang gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni bsam gtan bzhi pa'i ting nge 'dzin no// gzugs khams kyi rnam par rtog pa spang ba la gzugs med kyi snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi ste/ rnam par shes pa mtha' yas shing phyogs med pa yin no snyam du blos brtags nas de la mnyam par bzhag pa ni rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched do// chos thams cad nam mkha' lta bu yin no snyam du blos brtags nas de la mnyam par bzhag pa ni nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched do// 'du shes kyi gsal rig yod pa'ang ma yin med pa'ang ma yin te blos byar mi btub pa yin no snyam du blos brtags nas de la mnyam par bzhag pa ni 'du shes med min gyi skye mched do// sems kyi ngo bo cir yang ma grub cing stong pa yin no snyam du blos brtags nas de la mnyam par bzhag pa ni ci yang med pa'i skye mched do// thams cad kyi rtog pa spang ba la 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa ste/ tshogs drug yul la 'jug pa nang du 'gog cing rlung sems kyi 'gyu ba chad pa la ji srid mnyam par bzhag pa'i bar du gnas pa ste zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin mthar thug pa yin/ shes rab kyi so sor brtags nas de la mnyam par 'jog pa ni/ shes rab kyi so sor brtag 'gog go /gshis kyi gzhol phyogs der song ba ni so sor brtags min gyi 'gog pa ste don dam pa'i lung ma bstan yin no// de ltar snyoms 'jug dgu po de la bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'jug bzhi ni lhag mthong skyed par byed pa'i zhi gnas te/

mdo la/ 'on kyang bsam gtan yan lag bcas pa bzhi po 'di// byang chub zhi ba mchog thob pa yi rten du 'gyur// zhes dang*/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni sems kyi rang gshis dang mthun zhing 'jig rten pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi nang nas 'phags lam mngon du byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin mchog tu gyur pa yin te/ de'i phyir ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba dang yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa ni ting nge 'dzin 'di la mnyam par bzhag pa yin no// gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug bzhi ni zhi gnas de la brten nas lhag mthong skye bar mi nus pas gol sa yin te/ gzugs med khams su skye ba don du gnyer mi byed// ces so// 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug ni nyon mongs zhi ba'i ting nge 'dzin yin te/ theg pa chen po'i lhag mthong skye ba'i rgyur ni ched du mi che ba ste/ de dag kyang 'phags pa'i sa thob pa yan chad kyi ting nge 'dzin la dbang bsgyur ba'i ting nge 'dzin mi 'dra ba re re la mnyam par bzhag cing de'i yon tan gyi nus pa ston pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam grangs yin la/ lam 'og mas gong ma bskyed pa'i lam gyi rim pa ni ma yin no// de rnams ngo shes pas ting nge 'dzin gyi bye brag phyed cing rang gi bsgom pa la de dag gi nang gses dbye bar bya ba'o// skabs 'dir zhi gnas kyi skyon bying rmugs sogs zhi gnas 'dra ba la dwangs cha med pa'i shes pa tshom mun pa dang ha cang bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nges shes drag po blos phral du mi btub pa 'byung bas de rnams la chags zhen dang mchog 'dzin zhugs na lam mi skye ba'i gegs su 'gyur bas gnas dus chags zhen med cing 'gyu ba'i rang ngo lta shes pa gal che/ skabs don da lta bsgom bzhin pa chos mchog bsam gtan gyi rgyu mthun zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin 'di dag gi rgyu mtshan ngo sprod pa ni sang bshad par bya zhing de ltar 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi bye brag thams cad kyang sems kyis byed pa nyid las gzhan du ma yin zhing*/

mdo sde rgyan las/ yang dag gnas pa la brten nas// sems la sems ni 'jog phyir dang*// chos rab rnam par 'byed pa'i phyir// zhi gnas dang ni lhag mthong yin// zhes gsungs pas/ sems mnyam par bzhag pa'i ting nge 'dzin de la brten nas yon tan gyi chos mtha' dag 'byung ba yin te/ sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa'i mdo las/ ting 'dzin bsgom pas the tshom gcod 'gyur te// de ma gtogs pa gzhan gyi nus ma yin// de bas ting 'dzin bsgom pa mchog yin gyi// mkhas pa dag gis de la mchod par bya// zhes dang*/ dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo las/ rnal 'byor chen po thams cad mkhyen// phyag rgya chen po'i yan lag bsgom// 'gyur med bde ba sgrub nas ni// tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas 'gyur// zhes dang*/ padma sambha was/ gal te bsam gtan 'di med na// rgya mtsho'i gting gi pha bong ltar// dpag tu med pa'i mdo bshad kyang*// don med kha ru thon mi 'gyur// zhes dang*/ rtse gcig bsgom pas grol bar 'gyur yin gyi// tshig tsam brjod pas thar pa ga la thob// drod chen ma 'phel lo thog mi skye ltar// ting 'dzin bsgom pa'i drod dang mi ldan na// sku dang ye shes 'bras bu ga la 'byung*// zhes gsungs pas yon tan thams cad bskyed pa'i gzhi ting nge 'dzin de'ang lhag mthong gi shes rab dri ma med pa dang 'brel dgos shing zhi lhag zung du 'jug pa de rgyal ba'i dgongs pa dngos yin la bsam gtan gyi ting nge 'dzin de stong nyid snying rjes zin pas bsam gtan dag par yang 'gyur la mdo don snying por bsdu na dri ma med pa lhan cig skyes pa'i don lta sgom spyod 'bras dri med kyi gtan la 'bebs par byed pa padma lta bu'i gdams ngag la don bzhi/ lta ba phyag rgya chen po gtan la phab pa dang gcig /bsgom pa 'od gsal dri med lam du khyer ba dang gnyis/ spyod pa cir snang thug phrad rang grol lam du khyer ba dang gsum/

'bras bu lhun grub re dwogs med pa'i gdeng tshud pa dang bzhi'o// zhes gsungs pa'i don ltar man ngag nyams len du dril nas sgrub pa lag tu blang ba'i tshul thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro gsal btab la/ kun rdzob byang sems kyi skabs su de ring nas bzung ste rjes thob kyi bya ba thams cad blo sbyong nyid la blo lhan gyis bkal nas dge sdig gi legs nyes spang blang gi 'jug ldog thams cad blo yi 'dzin stangs gcig la rag las pas de yi gnad go zhing 'dris par byas na sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab mdo rgyud man ngag gi snying po 'di snying phugs su btsud nas yid ches su bzung dgos te/ tha na 'jig rten pa'i nor sgrub dang gdams ngag gam thabs sngags tsam la'ang yid ches dgos pa dang 'dra/ yang sngar yid la gang gzan pa'i nyon mongs pa de bskyed cing da rung mi non par gda' na thabs shes gang khebs su 'gro bas bkar la sbyang*/ pha rol la phan pa'i drin rtsi dang*/ rang gi chos la byas yus dang*/ mkhas dang btsun pa'i khong yus bskyed nas rang che gzhan smod dang phrag dog gi nyon mongs pa mang po bskyed pa'i rgyu rnams spangs/ dam chos bdag 'dzin gyi gnyen por ma song bas bzod sran sha'u bas chung ko long gtsang btsan bas dam pa sogs kyi mang po 'dus sar sma phab kyang de la mched pa'i skyon yang mi slong*/ cung zad tsam la dga' sla la 'khang mgyogs pa'i rnam 'gyur mang ba de grogs la gzan pas mtshar na yang mi bya/ gzhan la phan btags pa'i 'or che dang rang gi chos legs par byas pa la dga' bo dang tshig gi gtang rag bzang po'i re bca' ba sogs mi bya zhing mdor na snyan grags la rtsis gdab mi bya'o// 'di rnams kyi don rtsa tshig las/ dol chod du sbyong*/ rtog dpyod gnyis kyi thar bar byed/ yus ma bsgom/ ko long ma bsdam/ yud tsam pa mi bya/ 'or che ma 'dod/ ces pa rnams kyi don no// de nas sngar bzhin gnad gsum gyi srang la 'grim zhing dmigs pa ting nge 'dzin gyi gnad la de ring phan chad brtan pa bogs dbyung ba'i dmigs pa yul kun dang bsres nas ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsal sbyang tshul bstan pa yin te/

de dag gi don yang*/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ phyi rol yul snang chos rnams ji snyed pa// rang sems yin phyir gzhan du grub pa med// 'khrul rtog gnyis 'dzin sna tshogs gang shar rnams// cir snang gzhi med rang byung rang dag ltos// zhes dang*/ tai lo pas/ snang ba dgag sgrub mi byed rang sar zhog /spang len med pa snang srid phyag rgyar grol// kun gzhi skye med bag chags sgrib g.yogs bral// snyems byed rtsis gdab mi bya skye med snying por zhog /snang ba rang snang blo yi chos rnams zad du chug /ces dang*/ rje dwags pos/ ma bcos bzhag pa'i sems ni sangs rgyas yin// 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug kun tu lhug par zhog /ces dang*/ sambu ṭi las/ gzugs rnams sna tshogs lta ba dang*// sna tshogs sgra ni nyan pa dang*// smra ba dang ni rgod pa dang*// las de rnams ni byed pa na// sems ni gzhan du mi 'gro bar// de nyid rig pa'i rnal 'byor pa// mnyam bzhag rgyun du skye bar 'gyur// ces gsungs pa'i don no// 'di ltar bsgoms pa'i phan yon log shes kun tu rtog pa'i blo spangs nas yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sems las su rung ba nyid do// des ni chos mchog bsam gtan gyi rgyu mthun zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgrub pa'i rim pa'o// spyi don gnyis pa lhag mthong lhan skyes ye shes kyi rgyu mthun shes rab dri ma med pas gnas lugs gtan la dbab par byed pa ste/ de la gsum/ 'khrul pa'i gzhi rtsa gcod pa dang*/ yin lugs gtan la dbab pa dang*/ bsam gtan gyi ngo bo la mnyam par 'jog cing ting nge 'dzin gyi ro snyoms pa'o// de la dang po ni/ rgyal ba'i dbang po'i khrid yig chen mor 'byung ba ltar gsum ste/ gnyis pa lhag mthong la ni sems ngo blta// gzhi rtsa bcad dang rig stong gtan la 'beb// dang po gnas 'gyu gnyis po so so yi// gar gnas gar 'gro'i skye 'gag gnas gsum ci// snyam du ngo bo legs par gtan la phab// gnyis pa de gnyis kha dog gzugs la sogs// ci ltar gnas shing ci ltar 'phro ba brtags// lta mkhan rang yang legs rtsad bcad par bya// gnas 'gyu gnyis kyang gcig dang tha dad brtags// ces gsungs shing*/

de yang sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i mdo las/ srid gsum thams cad sems las 'grub par 'gyur// sems de nyid kyang rtag tu bstan du med// gzugs med lung du ma bstan sgyu ma 'dra// mkhas pa de ni sems kyi chos nyid tshol// sems dang sems gang gis ni tshol byed pa// des ni sems kyi chos nyid mthong ba med// ces gsungs pas med pa yod par 'dzin pa kun brtags kyi sgro 'dogs sel ba'i phyir mtshan nyid la cung zad dpyad par bya ba yin zhing sems zhes bya ba'i dngos po zhig khyer la shog zer ba'ang min la/ lar yang nged kyi khrid srol 'di la sems tshol gyi 'dra min mang po bkod pa'i phyag len mi mdzad pas de'i lugs kyi rang re'i sgrim glod sogs la brten nas bsgom bzhin pa'i sems de'i ngo bo de la cung zad rtog dpyod byas na/ sems gnas pa de'i ngo bo la ji lta bu kha dog gzugs dbyibs 'dug gam mi 'dug dang de'i ngang nas thol skyes kyi rnam rtog 'phro ba de ga nas 'ong*/ gar gnas tha ma ci ltar 'gro/ rnam rtog yal ba'i tshe med nas 'gro'am gnas pa la thim pa ltar 'gro'am stong sing 'gro ji ltar yal ba 'di la nges pa gcig dang*/ mi dang rta glang sogs bag chags kyi gzugs shar ba de ji ltar shar ji ltar gnas tha mar 'gro tshul sogs la nges pa gcig dang*/ yang gnas bzhin pa de lhod mer mer bde ltem me sdod pa kho na red dam/ gsal la rjen lhang nge 'dug gam stong sang nge yod pa 'dra zhig red nges pa zhig dang*/ rang lugs su yod pa dang brtags dpyad byas pa'i ngo bo la khyad 'dug gam mi 'dug /'di rnams nges par mdzod la nged la smros mdzod/ gnyis pa gzhi rtsa bcad pa ni/ bye brag de thams cad gcig gam tha dad brtags pa dang*/ gtso bo lta byed kyi mkhan po tshol ba ste rjes nas kyang 'byung ngo*// 'di dag la phra zhib kyi rtog dpyod ji ltar byung ba dang*/ yang nyams len la'ang bde mi bde'i gnad 'gags dang bogs gang byung gi khyad par bzhag thabs kho na'i steng nas blo la ma bde ba'i ze tshom dang khu 'phrig sang phyis kyi bslab don sogs kyi zhu rgyu gang yod ma gsang bar nged la smros/

thar pa'i lam mkhan gyi bla ma dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang lam gyi gegs dang mi shes pa'i sgrib g.yogs bsal mkhan yin mod/ zhu rgyu mang yang smra ma phod zer ba dang*/ rtogs pa bzang ba'i rlom sems dang ngan pa'i sgyid lug gnyis la brten nas de 'dra bla ma la zhus khar med pas zhu ba rgyu mtshan chung snyam du gsang ba dang*/ sems slong 'dra la brten nas nga'i 'di 'dra la bla mas kyang bcos rgyu med snyam pa dang*/ yang dris pa'i bye brag 'di rnams ma yin pa'i rtogs 'bul zer ba'i ya mtshan can zhig 'bul dgos snyam pa sogs kyi sems las gtan nas mi dgos/ yar la'ang dris pa 'di rnams kyi lan thob/ phyir la'ang da lta nyams su len bzhin pa 'di la dpag pa'i skyong thabs slob pa yin pas/ de ltar blo la nges par byas la zhu ba'i grab mdzod/ yang*/ ma skyes rdzun gyi steng non 'ong*// sngar yod rdzun gyi gtam ngan sbed// rang che gzhan smad sgom chen bsreg /ces bshad pas kha cig gi mdo rgyud dang gong ma'i nyams mgur sogs lung 'dren byas des rtogs 'bul gyi go ded par byas pa dang*/ gzhan gyi legs po cig zhus pa'i dpe bzhag len nas zhu ba dang*/ da lta rang la nyams myong med kyang sngar bsgom byas dus bzang po tsho byung tshul gyi lo rgyus bshad pa dang*/ yang bla ma phal gyi ngo srung la yod lor bzhag pa'i rlom pas bla ma de la phul zin pa yin zer ba dang*/ dris pa'i lan med par ma dris pa'i ma la skyes dus tshun gyi rdzun mang pos bla ma dang dkon mchog mgo bskor zhing rang la nyes pa bsags pa la dgos pa til tsam yang med/ rtogs pa ngo 'phrod pa'i gang zag de sgom skyes bdag po med par ma song na thar pa'i lam yu zin pa yin pas dga' ba bsgom/ ngo ma 'phrod kyang 'phrod lo'i gtam snyan bsgrags nas sang phyis rang gi lta sgom spyod gsum gyi steng nas mtshang ston 'dod dang gzhan gyi sgom chen de'i kha don gnyis la bstun nas khrel dwogs yod pas de ltar dgongs par mdzod la do dgongs nas bzung ste rtogs 'bul byed dgos pa yin pas ma chags par rim bzhin nged kyi sar byon mdzod/

yang sang nas rtogs 'bul thon pas bag yang snyam du bkyigs bkrol ba ltar spyod lam gang bde dang mtshams 'don pa sogs ma byed par khar sang phan ltar du brtson 'grus drag pos yengs med mdzod dang khyed cag la sems kyi nyams rtogs gang yod la 'phrod pa'i ngo sprod dang rgyab chos dang zhal gdams rim bzhin 'ong ba'ang nyams len dang sbyar dgos pas rtsol ba thon pa gal che zhing sngon 'gro'i dus rang gar 'dug pa dang mi 'dra bas yengs med kyi dran pa brten dang zhag re re la'ang bogs chen po 'ong bas de ltar bsgom mdzod cig /

byas la de rnams kyi go don zhib tu bkol zhing maṇḍal gtor 'bul smon lam gdab pa sogs bya'o// nyin ya byas pa'i nyi ma so gsum chos thun bcu dgu pa'o// mchan/ ༈ de nas do dgong nas bzung ste ngo sprod gdab tshul gyi bar 'dir las dang po'i khrid pa gsar pa thams cad mjal thub pa byed/ khrid rnying pa nan tan dang dwogs sel 'dod pa tsho yang thams cad la zhus lan gang dgos gsar pa mjal ba'i gong du bya/ yang snying nas nyams rtogs kyi dwogs gcod la nan tan dang mos 'dun che ba rnams khrid kyi sngon 'gro'i dus nas bzung ste bzhag thabs bcos lugs sogs thang kha shas mjal bar byed/ gsar pa ni gegs sel 'dra ma gtogs de ring phan la mjal yang rgyu mtshan chung bas/ gtso bo don la lhag mthong gi rang zhal mthong ba'i rtogs 'bul dang de ngo sprod pa'i ngo sprod gnang ba'i lugs yin yang khrid phog re re la lhag mthong ji lta ba'i ngo sprod thub pa khrid pa brgya phrag gi nang na'ang mang po 'byung ba dka' zhing sngon bsags bzang po yod pa rnams la ni sngon 'gro'i dus nas kyang ngo mthong 'byung ba'ang ma nges pas de ltar nyams dang rtogs pa'i khyad par gyi mtshang khrid gnyer bas lon pa gal che zhing de ring phan 'dir khrid pa re re'i rtsar tha na'ang nyi ma gsum mtshams su sleb nges pa re byas nas bcos gang dgos bcos/ rtogs pa ngo mthong la rang shugs kyis 'phrig tshud na de lugs kyi skyong tshul bslab/ lar yang khrid phog re re gnyis gnyis tsam la ngo mthong gi skye tshul byung yang bla ma dang khrid gnyer gnyis kas 'di ltar red kyi ming btags mi mdzad pa phyag len gyi mthil yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan kho rang la'ang rlom sems kyi bdud dang gzhan la khyad gsod dang de bzang por rlom nas bsgom kha khyer byed cing stong lta had pos rgyu 'bras la mi brtsi ba dang*/ gzhan gyi'ang khong 'di lta bu'i sa mtshams la ngo sprod pa yin pa la zer te don phyin ci log tu bzung nas rtogs pa'i sa mtshams kyi ming la brtags nas khyad gsod sogs 'ong ba de gtso bo bdag rkyen bzang pos ma chun pa la byung ba yin yang gzhan rnams kyi rtogs pa bzang zer ba tsam gyi re ba chen po bca' ba dang mi mtshungs pa sogs la dgongs nas khyod rtse gcig spros bral sogs kyi rab 'bring 'di yin sogs dang ngo bo mthong ba yin no zhes sogs kyang gtan nas mi smra zhing*/
