skabs 'di rje bdud mo ba'i gsung las kha cig gi rgya nag ha shang gi bzang rtog ngan rtog thams cad bkag par dgos par bshad pa dang*/ bka' brgyud pas gang shar chos sku'i rol par khyer ba'i rnam rtog chos skur bshad pa gnyis gcig par 'dod na 'o na snang ba dang mun pa'ang gcig par 'dod dgos gsungs/ mchan/ gsum pa snang ba lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i 'od ces gsungs pa ni/ dper na rgya mtsho chen po gsal zhing dwangs pa la nam mkha' sogs gang shar gyi gzugs brnyan gsal bar snang ba ltar/ gnyug ma sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'i mdangs su 'khor 'das lam gsum gyi chos thams cad rang snang gzugs brnyan tsam du ma 'dres yongs rdzogs su gsal bar snang ba ste/ rdo rje gur la/ rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i// sangs rgyas med cing sems can med// ces dang*/ nā ro pa/ chos rnams thams cad rang gi sems// phyi rol don mthong 'khrul pa'i blo// rmi lam bzhin du ngo bos stong*// zhes gsungs pas ma bcos pa'i shes pa rang snang 'di la slar yang 'dzin pa'i shes pas 'khrul snang du bskyed nas ma dag pa'i snang ba la bden 'dzin a 'thas su 'dzin pa ste/ zhang rin po ches/ snang srid 'khor 'das ma lus sems la shar// rtogs dang ma rtogs khyad par gnyis su shar// rang sems ma rtogs phyir na log 'khrul gyi// dkrug pas 'khor ba'i snod bcud sna tshogs shar// zhes dang*/ lang kar gshegs pa las/ bag chags kyis ni dkrug pa'i sems// don du 'dzin pa sna tshogs byung*// don yod ma yin sems nyid de// phyi rol don mthong log pa yin// zhes gsungs so// 'on kyang rgya mtsho la gzugs brnyan sna tshogs snang ba tsam ngo bo rgya mtsho las ma gtogs pa'i gzugs brnyan gyi lhad med pa ltar snang dus nyid nas ngo bo skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral zhing mtshan nyid cir yang snang du rung zhing rgyu rkyen dang bden par ma grub pa'i ngo bo nyid rten 'brel ma 'gag pa'i tshul du snang ba ste/

brtag gnyis las/ rmongs phyir 'khor ba'i gzugs brnyan nyid// rmongs med 'khor ba dag pa ste// 'khor ba mya ngan 'das par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ gling ras kyis/ gzhi rtsa bral ba'i sems nyid la// mdangs rmi lam nyams su myong ba de// snang la sems su ngo sprod pa'i// slob dpon gcig lags te go lags sam// zhes dang*/ tshogs drug yul gyi snang ba 'di// chos sku yin par da bzod go /brtags shing dpyad pa ma lags te// gdod nas dag pa nyid du gda'// zhes dang*/ shes rab snying po las/ gzugs stong pa'o// stong pa nyid kyang gzugs so// zhes sogs mu bzhir gsungs pa ltar ro// yang lhad med pa'i rgya mtsho kho rang gzugs brnyan gyi gzhi dang lus yin pa ltar/ skye med 'gag med du 'char zhing 'gag med rten 'brel du snang tsam ma 'gag par gsal zhing gsal tsam skye med du rtogs pa'i dpe don 'di chos kyi sku yi 'od yin te/ nā ro pas/ snang ba rang grol chos kyi dbyings// rtog pa rang grol ye shes che// gnyis med mnyam pa chos kyi sku// chu bo chen po'i rgyun 'bab ltar// gang ltar gnas kyang don dang ldan// 'di ni rtag tu sangs rgyas nyid// 'khor ba yul med bde ba che// chos rnams rang rang ngo bos stong*// stong par 'dzin blo rang sar dag /ces gsungs pa'i don te/ rje dwags pos/ snang sems gcig yin te sems las ma gtogs pa'i snang ba log na med/ snang ba ni sems kyi 'od dam sems kyi chos nyid yin pas sems rtogs pa'i dus su snang ba/ sgrog rang rdol du 'gro/ sems nyid dang chos nyid gcig yin te sems nyid kyi 'od chos nyid yin pas sems nyid rtogs pas chos nyid rtogs pa rang rdol du 'gro ste/ dper na nyi ma song nas 'od phyir 'chad mi srid de nyi ma'i phyir 'od 'gro ldog nges pa yin/ de bzhin du sems nyid gcig pu rtogs pas chos nyid rang shugs la rtogs nas 'ong*/

sems dag pas snang ba rang shugs la dag /des na snang ba sems nyid la sogs pa rang sor bzhag la sems kyi ngo bo bsgom pas chog /bsgom pa'i dus su chos dang chos nyid kyi blos bzhag nas sems nyid kyi ngo bo'i thog tu yer gyis rgan mo mdzug tshugs su bsgom/ yang na phyi nang snod bcud thams cad sems nyid du gtan la wal gyis phab nas de'i ngo bo'i thog tu bsgom ste de gnyis 'dra/ chos nyid gzhi'i thog tu bsgom nas ngo bo ma rnyed par bsgom yang 'tshang mi rgya bas rlung sems gnyis gcig yin/ rlung gi g.yos pas sems kyi rnam rtog sna tshogs su 'char ba yin/ de nyid dang gzhan du brjod du med par gnas te sems rtogs pa'i dus nas snang ba rang sar dag nas 'gro/ gnyis med rig stong lhan cig skyes pa yin// zhes dang*/ kun rdzob rten cing 'brel 'byung 'di// rang bzhin med pa'i snang bar rtogs// me long nang gi gzugs brnyan 'dra// bla ma'i bka' drin bzhi pa yin// zhes dang*/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku dang snang ba lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i 'od gnyis tsandan dang tsandan gyi dri lta bur gsungs so// de ltar yun ring du bsgoms na sems nyid gnyug ma'i ngang la gnas pa'i tshe/ snang ba'i yul phyi na ma lus/ snang mkhan gyi sems nang na med par snang sems dbyer med du 'char te/ lhan cig skyes pa gsang ba bsam mi khyab pa'i rgyud las/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku// snang ba lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i 'od// lhan cig dbyer med lhan cig skyes pa ste// zhes dang*/ rab tu mi gnas pa'i rgyud las/ snang srid phyag rgya chen po ste// bde ba chen po kun tu bzang*// 'di ni sems kyi dkyil 'khor te// rnal 'byor dbang phyug lta bar byos// zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o// 'di dag gi don rje btsun mi las snang ba sku gsum du ngo sprad pa ni/

dang po mthong ba'i snang ba 'gag med kyi rol pa sprul sku/ bar du phrad pa'i snang ba ma 'gag pa snang thog tu rang ngo shes pa longs sku/ tha ma der 'dzin med cing yid la mi gnas pa chos skur ngo sprad par gsungs pa dang*/ de ltar snang rig stong gsum gshis gdang rtsal gsum ngo bo gcig pas bsgom tshul gcig la thams cad tshang yang*/ rnam pa tha dad kyi dbye ba la gshis kun gzhi gnyug ma'i steng du ma bcos par 'jog pa la rtog med rang gsal du rgya bskyed pa gnad/ rtsal dran rig ma 'gag pa'i steng du ma bcos par 'jog pa la phung po lnga bral du klod shes pa gnad/ gdangs sna tshogs su snang ba'i steng du ma bcos par 'jog pa la 'dzin med rang dag tu tshogs brgyad kyi dug dbyung ba gnad do// sgom tshul de rnams cung zad sgom pa'i skabs su bshad do// 'di rnams kyi don rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ sems nyid skye med stong pa chos kyi sku// 'gag med gsal mdangs gang shar sprul pa'i sku// gnas med zung 'jug bde chen longs spyod rdzogs// zhes sogs gsungs pa rnams dang*/ khrid yig chen mor/ yang na 'gyu snang gnyis kyi ngo sprod bya// 'gyu ba lha chen dus gcig spro ba dang*// dga' sdug dug lnga rnam rtog so sor lta// rnam rtog sku drin can du shes pa dang*// dri ba gegs sel bogs 'don 'di na yod// gnyis pa snang thog nyid nas ngo sprod pa// snang ba sems yin sems de stong pa dang*// stong pa lhun grub lhun grub rang grol te// bzhi las dang po dmigs rten la sogs pa// snang ba thams cad rmi lam ji bzhin du// sems snang ma gtogs logs su med pa dang*// lus sems gcig dang tha dad bral rig nas// snang ba sems su ngo sprod de bzhin btab// gnyis pa sems de chu nang zla ba ltar// stong pa skye 'gag gnas gsum bral bar mthong*// gsum pa stong yang rtsal snang ma 'gag 'char// bzhi pa snang stong chen por lhun grub pas// 'khor 'das bsdus pa'i chos la dgag sgrub bral// gdod ma'i byang chub mngon du gyur pa'o// de dag gis ni dngos gzhi dmigs pa bstan// zhes gsungs pa'i don yin te/

mchan/ chos thun 'di gsal zhing zab pas rtogs pa mngon gyur la rig thog tu ngo mthong gi ngo sprod byed pa ma gtogs gsar pa kho na shas gcig la dgos ched mi chi bar bsams nas rjes kyi rtsal sbyang gegs sel bogs 'don rnams gong du bstan pa yin la/ ngo sprod 'di rdzogs par gdab pa'i tshe skabs 'dir gdams na gzhung gi dgongs pa ltar yin pas de ltar shes dgos so// de dag gi don rnams ji lta ba bzhin shes shing rtogs par mdzod cig / byas la maṇḍal gtor 'bul smon lam gdab pa sogs bya'o// nyin ya byas pa'i nyi ma so bdun chos thun nyer gnyis pa'o// ༈ chos thun nyer gsum pa la yang sngar bzhin tshig gi mtshams sbyor byas nas/ de ltar sems nyid bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad de nyid las ma g.yos pa'i sku can mngon sum du rtogs pas dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhal mthong ba'ang de yin pas/ bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud las/ brtan dang g.yo ba thams cad kun// shes rab rang bzhin de nyid ni// lha yi ngo bo 'di gsal nyid// ma skyes rtog pa bral ba'i sku// brjod du med cing bsam mi khyab// brtag tu med pa nam mkha'i dbus// gnyis med bde ba'i rnam pa can// gsal ba'i rang bzhin g.yo ba med// gnyis su med pa bde ba'i mchog /'bras bu lam gyi rnal 'byor pa'o// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ phyag na rdo rje'i rdo rje rtse mo las/ sems nyid rig pa stong gsal du// rtogs na rdo rje gtum po 'grub// ces pa dang*/ gang dag nga la gzugs su mthong*// gang dag nga la sgrar shes pa// log pa'i lam du zhugs pa ste// skye bo de dag nga mi mthong*// sangs rgyas rnams ni chos nyid lta// 'dren pa rnams ni chos kyi sku// zhes gsungs pas 'od gsal chos kyi sku de nyid las ma gtogs pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i sku zhal phyag gi rnam pa can zhig logs su bsgom par 'dod na 'khrul pa'i blo ste/

'khor lo sdom pa ye shes rgyal po las/ rang rig gdod nas 'od gsal las// sku dmigs phyag mtshan la sogs la// rdo rje 'dzin par 'dod pa 'khrul// zhes gsungs pa'o// de lta bu'i don ni snga ma bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis ji lta ba bzhin du gtan la phab pa'i lta ba ste/ da lta nyid du mngon sum du rtogs pa yin pas lta ba rtogs pa dang 'brel ba zhes bya ba yin pas/ des na 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos mtha' dag 'od gsal chos kyi sku gdod ma nas yin pa la yin bzhin du mngon du gyur pa ste/ phyag rgya chen po tshig bsdus las/ gang gis de nyid mthong rtogs na// snang srid thams cad phyag rgya che// chos sku khyab bdal chen po'o// zhes gsungs pa'o// de ni phyin ci ma log pa lta ba'i mchog yin te/ 'khor lo sdom pa ye shes phreng ba las/ lta ba shes rab pha rol phyin// gdod nas spros bral lhun gyis grub// rang bzhin ye shes dbyings na gsal// ma rig mun pas bsgrib pa med// shes rab snying po cer byung ba// lta ba kun gyi yang rtse yin// zhes gsungs pa'o// de lta bu'i lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bla na med pa mngon sum gyi gnad de ni/ byis pa so so'i skye bo dag gi spyod yul ma yin te/ bde mchog gsang ba spyod pa las/ 'phags pa nyan thos rang rgyal dang*// byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang*// chos sku rtogs pa ma yin te// gting ring pa ru dgongs pas bshad// ces pa'o// des na de dag gi ni rim bzhin du gsang ba bla na med pa 'di nyid du 'jug pa'i lam stegs tsam du bshad pa'ang yin la/ de ci'i phyir na brgyud ldan gyi bla ma dam pa'i dus thabs kyi gsang dang bral zhing yid rtog ge la mngon par g.yeng ba'i phyir te/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa las/ bla ma dang bral chos med de// chos med pas na byang chub med// ces dang*/ ti lo pa chen po'i zhal nas/

'dul ba mdo sde sde snod la sogs pa// rang rang gzhung dang grub pa'i mtha' yis ni// 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po mthong mi 'gyur// zhe 'dod byung bas 'od gsal ma mthong bsgrib// ces dang*/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus thabs bsten pa dang*// bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes gsungs/ 'o na sde snod gsum gyi lung la brten pa'i lta ba de don med dam 'on te de dag dang mi mtshungs pa zhig yin nam zhe na/ de dag ma yin kyang lta ba mang po dag rang rang gi rkun nas brtags pa'i blos bsgrib pa'i shes rab ltar snang bas yang dag pa'i don rtogs ma nus pa yin te/ lta ba de dag gi tshul thar rgyan las shes rab le'ur 'byung ba'i rtsa ba tsam gcig bsdus nas brjod na gtan la phab bya'i shes yul la bzhi ste/ dang po shes bya rig pa'i gnas lnga yi/ bzhi ni gzhan tshar gcod dang rjes 'dzin gyi bya ba ste phyi nang gnyis thun mong du yod pa yin la/ lnga pa sde snod zab mo nang pa'i khyad chos so// shes yul gnyis pa bden pa'i dbang du na/ bka' 'khor lo dang po bden pa bzhi bstan te/ phung khams skye mched kyis bsdus pa'i snod bcud sdug bsngal gyi bden pa/ las dang nyon mongs skye ba kun 'byung gi bden pa/ sdug bsngal 'gag pa 'gog pa'i bden pa/ 'phags lam yan lag brgyad lam gyi bden pa'o// 'khor lo bar pa bden gnyis su bstan na'ang*/ rnam 'jog gi tshul du ma yod de/ 'jig rten pa dag rags pa don dam du 'dod pa dang*/ bye brag tu smra bas don byed nus chos don dam/ mi nus pa kun rdzob dang*/ mdo sde pas rkyen bcom gzhig gi 'jig pa kun rdzob/ mi 'jig pa don dam/ yang rdul phra rab don dam du 'dod pa dang*/ rnam rig pas yongs grub don dam/ kun btags kun rdzob gzhan dbang gnyis ka'i gzhir 'dod pa dang*/ don snang gi shes pa don dam du 'dod pa dang*/

rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma pas/ gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi shes pa rang rig rang gsal don dam bden par 'dod pa dang*/ thal rang gnyis kar mtha' dang bral ba'i med dgag don dam du 'dod pa yin kyang*/ dbu ma rang la'ang bdag med dris pa'i mdo ltar na 'jig rten las 'das pa don dam/ 'jig rten kun rdzob/ zhi ba lhas blo las 'das pa don dam blo yul kun rdzob dang*/ yang don dam la mnyam bzhag 'phags pa'i spyod yul rnam grangs min pa'i don dam/ stong nyid bco brgyad du dbye ba sogs dang med dgag ma yin dgag sogs rnam grangs kyi don dam dang*/ snang yang don byed nus pa yang dag kun rdzob dang mi nus pa log pa'i kun rdzob gnyis su dbye ba dang*/ yang na 'phags pa'i rjes thob yang dag byis pa mthong ba log par dbye ba sogs mang yang theg chen shing rta'i srol 'byed gnyis ka kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu don dam nam mkha' lta bur bzhed pa mnyam/ 'khor lo tha mar don dam pa chos kyi dbyings kho na bden pa gcig tu bzhag pa ste bden rdzun sogs btags te bzhag pa'i chos ma grub/ med bzhin du rten 'brel tsam du snang ba'i bden gnyis gcig dang tha dad bral ba'ang chos kyi dbyings las mi 'da' bas thar pa'ang sgro btags kyi nor sa zad tsam yin pas/ re zhig gzhan don tshogs gnyis rdzogs byed kyi dgos pa la brten nas bden gnyis su 'jog na'ang kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad rten 'brel sgyu ma lta bu yin pas rang bzhin gsum po'ang mtshan nyid dang skye ba dang don dam ngo bo nyid med pas skye mched gsum mam/ yongs grub kho na la don dam bden pa nam mkha' lta bu kho na nyid bzhed do// yang shes bya gsum pa grub mtha'i dbang du byas na phyi pa dang nang pa gnyis/ phyi pa la rtag chad gnyis sam bzhi'am/ de las lta log rnams 'byung ba'am bsdu na/ 'jig tshogs lta dang mthar 'dzin lta// tshul khrims brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin dang*// bdag tu lta ba rnam pa bzhi// shes nas spang bar bya ba'o// zhes gsungs pa sogs dang*/

nang pa la phyi don smra ba bye mdo gnyis/ rnam rig tsam smra ba sems tsam pa/ stong nyid mtha' bral smra ba dbu ma pa dang bzhi/ snga mas blo sbyong zhing phyi mas snga ma'i 'dzin pa sbyang nas blos btags kyi grub mtha' zad pa grub mtha'i grub don te/ lta ba mtha' bral chen po la// grub mtha'i zhen pas ma bslad par// yang dag nyid la yang dag lta// rang gi sems dang 'brel ba gces// zhes rje rang byung bas gsungs pa ltar shes par bya'o// yang shes bya bzhi pa stong nyid kyi dbang du byas na/ lta ba mtha' bral chen po la// zhes yang dag pa'i lta bar gsungs pa'i rang gi sems gzung 'dzin spros pa'i mtshan ma thams cad kyis dag pa stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo ste/ 'phags pa byams pas/ yod min med min de bzhin min gzhan min// skye dang 'jig med dbri bar mi 'gyur te// 'phel ba med cing rnam par dag pa med// rnam par dag gyur gang de don dam mtshan// zhes dang*/ klu sgrub kyis/ gang gi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung*// 'gag pa med pa skye med pa// chad pa med pa rtag med pa// 'ong ba med pa 'gro med pa// tha dad don min don gcig min// zhes gsungs pa mdo rgyud man ngag thams cad nas rgya cher bstan pa'i ming gi rnam grangs phyag rgya chen po dang*/ don dam bden pa dang*/ sher phyin dang*/ rang rig ye shes dang*/ zung 'jug lhan skyes dang*/ tshad ma'i bden pa/ chos nyid/ rnal 'byor mngon sum/ dbang bzhi pa/ de bzhin nyid/ yang dag pa'i mtha' dang*/ mtshan med gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi shes pa sogs kyi ming gi don gcig tu bstan pa yin pas rnam dbye dmigs su med pa'o// 'on kyang rnam 'jog cung zad la/ rnam kun mchog ldan dang rnam pa kun dpyad gnyis su'am/ yang na rnam thar sgo gsum mam bzhi dang*/ yang na mtshan nyid/ dngos po'i rang bzhin/ srid pa mi srid pa/ brjod med don dam/ nyi tshe'i stong pa bdun nam/ yang na nang stong pa nyid sogs bcu drug gam bco brgyad sogs mtha' yas su dbye yang rnam pa dmigs su med do// de dag shes byed kyi shes rab ni so skyes so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab dang 'phags pas so so rang rig pa'i ye shes te/

dngos po dang dngos med du 'dzin pa'i mtha' dang dbu mar yang mi 'dzin pa ni mtha' bral gyi lta ba ste 'dzin pa thams cad las log pa myang 'das dang*/ spang thob kyi 'du shes zad pa dam pa'o// dngos po'i 'du shes ni/ phung lnga'i rgyun la gang zag tu btags pa nyon mongs can gyi yid log shes kyi ngar 'dzin pas bdag dang yang dag ma yin kun rtog ces bya ba 'di la brten nas gzung 'dzin dang srid pa'i rtsa ba thams cad bskyed cing yang dag pa'i don mngon sum du mi 'gyur la bdag 'di rang dang gzhan dang gnyis ka dang gnyis min la mi skye zhing*/ lus dang sems dang ming dang phung po re re dang tshogs pa dang de nyid dang gzhan du dpyad na kun rdzob tu'ang med la/ gzhan yang chos kyi bdag la mu bzhi skye 'gog yod med skye 'gog rdo rje gzegs ma/ gcig dang du bral rten 'brel gyi rigs pa sogs gang gis dpyad kyang chos thams cad la'ang bdag ma dmigs la/ phyi nang gi dngos po'ang yod pa dang med pa dang*/ gnyis ka dang gnyis min gyi sgro skur dang bcos ma'i blo las log pa yang dag mthong bas chos kun ma bcings ma grol ba ste 'khor ba'i rang bzhin myang 'das sems can gyi rang bzhin sangs rgyas su bzod nas rnam par dag pa nyid do// bdag lta nyon yid dang bral ba'i tshe dri ma med pa'i yid dge ba'i gnyen po'i rtog pa dang 'brel ba yang dag pa'i rtogs par 'gyur te/ phyi rol mu stegs bdag rtog ni// thob byar 'dod pa 'khrul pa ste// bdag tu 'dod pa nyon mongs can// de spangs pa dag rtogs pa la// brten nas yang dag rtogs pa 'byung*// de la bdag med don du bshad// ces rang byung zhabs kyis gsungs pa ltar lta ba rtogs pa dang 'brel ba dang bdag tu 'dzin pa sogs sngar bshad pa de rnams kyis ma bslad cing 'khor 'das thams cad sems su shes/ sems spros bral du rtogs pas mtha' la mi gnas pa'i ye shes mngon du byed de/

spang bya dang*/ gnyen po dang*/ de bzhin nyid dang*/ 'bras bu rtogs pa'i mtshan ma bzhi spangs pa'o// mdo sde rgyan las/ sems las gzhan med par ni blos rig nas// des na sems kyang med pa nyid du rtogs// blo dang ldan pas gnyis pho med rig nas// de mi ldan pa chos kyi dbyings la gnas// blo dang ldan pas mi rtog ye shes stobs// rtag tu kun nas mnyam por sangs pa yi// de la brten nas nyes tshogs tshang tshing rnams// dug sman chen pos dug bzhin sel bar byed// ces gsungs pa dang*/ bka' brgyud rin po che'i dgongs don las de lta bu'i tshul gyis rtogs brjod mang du 'byung yang mdo tsam du/

rje btsun dbyangs can bzang pos bstsal pa'i phyag chen gyi zab gnad bkol ba zhig las/ spyir rje mi bskyod rdo rje dang por sems tsam rnam rdzun dang mthun pa'i lta ba la thugs dgyes pa zhig yod pa/ zhang g.yu brag pa'i lam mchog mthar thug gzigs pa la brten nas dpal ldan zla bas bkral ba'i dbu ma'i lta ba thugs la byon pas zhang rin po che la dngos su ma mjal yang rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin pa'i dbang du mdzad do// zhes gsungs pa snang ngo*// mchan/ zhang rin po ches/ nges don mthar thug snying po chos kyi sku// ngo bo nyid dag 'od gsal chos kyi dbyings// dus gsum sangs rgyas byon rung ma byon rung*// 'phags pa'i tshogs kyis rtogs rung ma rtogs rung*// thub pa rnams kyi gsungs rung ma gsungs rung*// zhes sogs nas/ kun gyi sa bon rang sems gnas lugs ni// rgyal ba sras bcas kun gyi thugs dang ni// ye nas khyad med skye med chos skur gnas// bem po ma yin rang rig rang gi gsal// dngos po ma grub mdog dbyibs tshad kyis stong*// dngos med ma yin rkyen gyis cir yang snang*// rtag par mi 'gyur ngo bo nyid kyis stong*// chad par mi 'gyur rang gsal ngo bo nyid// bdag tu ma grub brtag na snying po med// bdag med ma yin spros bral bdag nyid che// mtha' rnams ma grub 'dzin pa gang yang med// dbu mar ma grub ltos pa kun las dben// dpe yis mi mtshon mtshon bya'i ngos bzung med// dpe med ma yin nam mkha' lta bu'o// tshig tu ma grub brjod pas tha snyad med// tshig bral ma yin brjod pa kun gyi rgyu// yod dang med dang bden dang rdzun pa dang*// stong dang mi stong zhi dang ma zhi dang*// spros pa yod dang spros pa med pa dang*// bsam du yod dang bsam du med pa dang*// bde dang sdug bsngal dmigs su yod med dang*// gnyis dang gnyis min blo las 'das ma 'das// dben dang mi dben grub dang ma grub dang*// dag dang ma dag lhun gyis grub ma grub// 'di 'dra'i tshogs rnams kun la thug pa med// ji srid zab cing rno ba'i tshig tshogs kyi// rnam grangs du mas brjod par byas gyur kyang*// sems kyi gnas lugs thog tu phebs mi srid// ji tsam mkhas shing zab pa'i brtag dpyad kyis// bskal pa mang por brtags shing dpyad byas kyang*// rang bzhin gnyug ma brtag pa'i yul min phyir// sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa mi srid do// dper na rgya mtshor shar ba'i gza' skar de// dar tshag ji ltar zhib pas btsag byas kyang*// gza' skar dngos po dmigs su med pa'i phyir// gza' skar gcig kyang zin pa mi srid do// ji srid tshig tu brjod nus de srid du// ming 'dogs ji tsam legs kyang gnas lugs min// ji srid yid kyi dpyad bzod de srid du// ji tsam zab par rtogs kyang gnas lugs min// lta bya lta byed gnyis 'dzin de srid du// gnyis su med pa'i gnas lugs rtogs mi srid// yin snyam thams cad zhen pa'i rtsa ba ste// zhen pa'i rtsa bas 'khor ba mtha' dag spel// stong pa nyid yin snyam pa'i 'du shes dang*// mtshan ma med snyam smon pa med snyam dang*// ngos bzung med snyam rnam par dag snyam dang*// skye ba med snyam dmigs su med snyam dang*// rang bzhin med snyam spros pas dben snyam dang*// ngag dang yid kyi spyod yul min snyam dang*// ma byas lhun gyis grub snyam la sogs pa'i// ci tsam zab cing stong par 'du shes kyang*// rlom sems mtshan ma dag las ma g.yos pas// mtshan ma'i zhen pas phyir zhing mnar bar ltung*// dman pa'i las kyi rnam smin rgyun mi 'chad// 'khor gcong mi 'byin phyir zhing nad rab ldang*// blos byas lta ba mkhan gyi sgom chen rnams// phyogs 'dzin zhen pa'i nad gcong zhugs par mchi'o// snyems bral lhan cig skyes pa mkhyen par mdzod// drang ba'i don du sgro btags tsam du zad// gnas lugs nges don 'di yin zhes bya ba// thub pas yang ni gzigs pa yod mi srid// kho bos smras pa des kyang mi 'phogs te// mdzub mos zla ba mtshon pa bzhin du rtogs// de ltar shes na tha snyad tshig tshogs kyis// bsgrib par mi 'gyur tshig gi skyon mi dgos// de phyir tshig gi tha snyad mi spangs shing*// don du rlom pa zhen pa yang mi bya// de lta bu yi rang sems chos sku de// nyon mongs rnam rtog phung po khams dang ni// skye mched la sogs sems can khams dang ni// sa rdo rtsi shing snod bcud kun la khyab// nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems dpa' dang*// bde gshegs rgya mtsho ma lus kun la khyab// mdor na phyi nang dngos po la sogs pa// ma lus lus pa med pa kun la khyab// khyab bya dang ni khyab byed gnyis su med// bdag nyid chen po gcig gi cho 'phrul yin// rgya mtshor shar ba'i gza' skar thams cad la// rgya mtshos khyab cing gnyis su dbyer mi phyed// chu nyid 'khyams pa'i rba rlabs thams cad la// chu yis khyab cing gnyis su ji ltar phyed// bar snang dag la smig rgyu g.yo ba na// bar snang gis khyab gnyis su dbyer mi phyed// gser las byas pa'i rgyan ni sna tshogs la// gser gyis khyab mod ji ltar dbye ru med// bu ram las byas rigs drug gzugs brnyan la// bu ram dag gis khyab ste dbyer mi phyed// 'ja' tshon dag las nam mkha' gzhan ma yin// nam mkha' las kyang 'ja' tshon gzhan ma yin// 'ja' tshon mkha' 'o mkha' nyid 'ja' tshon no// tha dad ma yin dbyer med dpyad du med// de bzhin sna tshogs sems dang dbyer mi phyed// sems dang stong pa mi phyed stong pa dang*// bde ba chen po mi phyed mnyam pa nyid// de nyid srid dang myang 'das dbyer mi phyed// de ltar khyab pa'i sems nyid phyag rgya che// rang bzhin stong pas cir yang ngos bzung med// mtshan nyid rig pa'i cho 'phrul cir yang gsal// ngo bo dbyer med zung 'jug rdo rje sems// yon tan dpag med 'byung gnas rin chen sems// zad med gter chen brlag med sus kyang ni// 'phrog par mi nus nam mkha' mdzod kyi sems// dri mas ma gos shel sgong dag pa'i sems// rang rig rang gsal mar me lta bu'i sems// phyi nang med pa ye shes zang thal sems// 'khar gzhong gtsang ma chu yis bkang ba 'dra// bag chags sna tshogs gzugs brnyan 'char ba'i sems// me long g.ya' med phyis pa'i ngos dang 'dra// zhes gsungs pa ltar rtogs par bya ste de'ang sbyor lam du sgra yi rjes su song ba bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis rtogs par gyur pa ni sbyor lam gyi bzod pa'o// spang gnyen gzung 'dzin gyi mtshan ma dang bral ba mngon sum du mthong ba ni mthong lam/

de bzhin nyid la mtshan mar 'dzin pa phra'u yod pa ni ma dag sa bdun te nyon yid kyi lhag ma lus pa'i phyir/ de dag mnyam bzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes dang rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu'i sbyang bya mthar phyin par spangs pas yid 'dzin pa dang rnam par rtog pa gnas 'gyur ba na dag pa'i sa brgyad pa thob par 'gyur ro// da dung sa bon thams cad kyi cha yi dri ma dag pa sa gsum gyis spangs pas 'bras bu'i mtshan ma'ang zhi bas rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes zhes bya'o// de'ang yang dag pa la yang dag par lta ba yin gyi gzhan du bsal bzhag yod pa ma yin te/ rgyud bla ma las/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med// bzhag par bya ba cung zad med// yang dag nyid la yang dag lta// yang dag mthong na rnam par grol// rnam dbyer bcas pa'i mtshan nyid can// glo bur dag gis khams stong gi /rnam dbyer med pa'i mtshan nyid can// bla med chos kyis stong ma yin// zhes so// 'di lta bur don rang gi mtshan nyid kyi rtog pa dang ma 'bral bar/ yid la mi byed pa tsam dang*/ rtog dpyod nus pa tsam dang*/ 'du shes dang tshor ba zhi zhing mi rtog pa tsam dang*/ ngo bo mi rtog pa tsam dang*/ mi rtog de kho na'i don la bkra par 'dzin pa mchan/ pa la mngon rtags su byed pa dang lnga ni mi mthun pa'i phyogs te byis pa dang bsam gtan gnyis pa sogs dang gnyid 'thug dang*/ yul zas la sogs pa dang*/ de nyid 'dzin pa dang bcas pa lnga las byung ba ste/ 'di dag spang bar byas nas mdo don dril na/ bdag dang rtag chad lta ba mu stegs te// bdag med kho nar lta ba theg chung yin// rnam rtog mtshan mar lta ba byis pa ste// rtog med lnga por lta ba 'jig tshogs yin// ji skad bshad pa thams cad rtog pa ste// gnas 'gyur thob cing mtshan ma kun bral la// yul dang yul can gnyis kyi 'khrul pa zhig /zhi lhag 'dres pa lta ba'i mthar thug yin// de'ang bla ma'i byin rlabs gdams ngag dang*// blo dang ldan la mngon sum nyid du 'gyur// zhes rje rang byung zhabs kyis gsungs pa ltar shes par bya'o// lta ba de dang 'bral ba'i bsgom pa la// bsgom pa zhi lhag 'brel ba ste// mtha' gnyis phyogs su ma lhung ba// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi// nyams myong rtogs dang 'bral ba'o// zhes gsungs pa'i bsgom pa zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi nyams myong dang 'bral tshul cung zad sang rnal 'byor bzhi rim dang sbyar nas bshad cing 'dir ngo bo rang bzhin mtshan nyid gsum gyi gshis gdangs rtsal gsum spyi dang bye brag la phan pa'i 'jog tshul tsam zhig brjod na/

nyam nga med pa'i lta ba'i gdeng dang ldan pa seng ge lta bu'i gdams ngag la don bzhi/ thams cad chos nyid du shes pa rin po che gser gling du phyin pa lta bu/ mtha' dbus med cing spros pa thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu/ 'phel 'grib bam 'gyur ba med pa sa yi snying po gser lta bu/ gdod ma nas dag cing spros pa dang bral ba spang bya'i ming med pa nyi ma lta bu'o// zhes gsungs pas man ngag nyams len du dril nas sgrub pa lag tu blang ba'i tshul thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro gsal btab la bca' ba lus kyi gnad/ bla ma mos gus kyi gnad sngar bzhin la dmigs pa ting nge 'dzin gyi gnad la gnyug ma kun gzhi rtog med la rgya bskyed nas 'jog tshul/ rang rtsal 'jug sems gsal cha la glod nas 'jog tshul/ rang snang rgya yan bsam pa'i rang gzugs la rgya yan du 'khyer tshul/ thams cad chos sku'i rol pa zung 'jug tu la bzla tshul lo// dang po ni/ kun gzhi la phyogs ris med pas ma bcos phyogs ris dang bral ba'i ngang la 'jog /kun gzhi la ngos bzung med pas ma bcos ngos bzung med pa'i ngang la 'jog /kun gzhi la 'pho 'gyur med pas ma bcos 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ngang la 'jog /de ltar bzhag pas nyams myong ma thog tu bu phebs pa'i gnad yod/ phyag rgya chen po la go don rtogs rgyu med pas go rtogs kyi phyogs su ma yengs par bzhag /phyag rgya chen po la don la bsam brjod med pas bsam brjod kyi phyogs su ma yengs par bzhag /phyag rgya chen po la don dmigs su med pas dmigs med kyi phyogs su ma yengs par bzhag /de ltar bzhag pas myong 'dod kyi shes pa ma thog tu bu 'phrod pa'i gnad yod/ chos nyid kyi don la brjod du med pas brjod bya'i tshig la ma ltos par bzhag /chos nyid kyi don la rtogs su med pas bzang rtog gis ma bslad par bzhag /chos nyid kyi don la 'du 'bral med pas dran snang la dgag sgrub kyis ma bslad par bzhag go

/de ltar bzhag pas mnyam bzhag gi yon tan ma thog tu bu smin pa zhig 'ong bas na rje rgod tshang pas phyal gyis btang la mi bzhag gam// zhes dang*/ yang dgon pa/ bsgom dum bu ru ma bcad phyal bar zhog /ye bsgom la blo yi ma bcos par// rang bab la bzo yi ma bsgom mdzod// ces gsungs mchan 'di rnams la nyams myong gnad du 'gro ba la dran rig rtsa bral du rtogs cing snang thog tu 'phrig tshud pa'i dus su bsgom 'khor yug gi khrid skyang bas mnyam rjes 'dres sla ba gal shin tu che/ rgyun khyer du rje rgod tshang pa'i rten 'brel rab bdun yang zab bo// pa ltar bsgom zhing de yi ngang nas ma 'gag pa'i dran rtog sna tshogs su 'phro zhing rang rtsal gyi 'jug sems yul la rgyug par cha na/ de'i bsgom thabs mang du 'byung yang mdo tsam/ zhang rin po che'i gsung las/ de ltar bzhag pa'i ngang nyid la// rnam rtog thol gyis sang ba de// de nyid 'od gsal chos sku las// gzhan zhig yin snyam ma sems shig /g.yo med rgya mtsho dwangs pa la// rba rlabs chil gyis langs pa ni// de nyid rgya mtsho dwangs pa las// gzhan zhig min pa ci bzhin no// rtog pa'i gzhi ma sems yin la// sems kyi mtshan nyid gsal rig yin// gsal pa'i rang bzhin stong pa ste// stong pa'i ngo bo bde chen yin// sems kyi rang bzhin de la ni// mtshan ma'i mun pa gtan med pas// 'od gsal bya ba'i ming du btags// rig dang stong pa dbyer med pas// zung 'jug bya ba'i ming du btags// chos rnams kun gyi bdag nyid de// rang sems rig pa'i ngo bo yin// rang sems rig pa'i ngo bo de// mtshan ma'i lus kyi stong pas na// lus med lus de lus kyi mchog /lus med chos nyid lus yin phyir// chos kyi sku zhes btags pa yin// de phyir rnam rtog 'phro ba de// stong nyid la ni stong nyid 'phro// 'od gsal la ni 'od gsal 'phro// bde chen la ni bde chen 'phro// chos sku la ni chos sku 'phro// zung 'jug la ni zung 'jug 'phro// chos dbyings la ni chos dbyings 'phro// rnam dag la ni rnam dag 'phro// rdor sems la ni rdor sems 'phro// byang chub la ni byang chub 'phro// gdams ngag gsha' mas ma zin cing*// sbyangs pa'i 'phro med rmongs pa yis// 'phros pa dang ni ma 'phros dang*// rtog pa dang ni mi rtog dang*// sems dang chos sku gnyis su phye// rnam rtog skyon du bltas shing bkag

/mi rtog 'dod cing ched du bsgrub// chu rlabs phyag pas phyir phyir 'khyams// rtog pa bkag pa'i mi rtog pa// de nyid rnam rtog 'khrul pa ste// chos sku bsgrib pa'i mun chen yin// rtog pa 'phro bar mi 'dod dang*// mi rtog gnas par 'dod pa yi// zhe 'dod 'gong po phugs su bcug /gnyug ma'i dkor mdzod zad par byed// rnam rtog bkag pa'i sgom chen de// mar 'dod chu la bsrub pa bzhin// bskal par bsgoms kyang don mi mthong*// de phyir rnam rtog bkag mi dgos// 'dug na ched du spro mi dgos// 'phros kyang chos sku 'dug kyang ni// chos kyi sku la g.yo ba med// bla ma'i gdams pas zin gyur na// 'phros kyang grol la 'dug kyang grol// bla ma'i gdams pas ma zin na// 'phros kyang 'ching la 'dug kyang 'ching*// de phyir gdams pas zin par mdzod// grogs su 'char ba gdon mi za// brtag dpyad tshab tshub ma mang par// klad kyis klod la lhan gyis zhog /phyin log rjes su ma 'brang bar// shes pa ci dgar thong la thong*// phyi rol yul la ma lta zhig /nang gi sems la ma lta zhig /yul rnams stong pa sems kyang stong*// nyam nga bag tsha bya mi dgos// 'di yin snyam pa gang byung yang*// dmigs zhen sa bon thebs pa yin// rlom sems myu gu skyes gyur na// 'khor ba'i sdong po 'phel bar mchi'o// sems nyid ye dag 'od gsal la// bsgom pa'i mun pas ma sgribs shig /rtsol med 'bras bu stor ba mchi'o// sems nyid rgya mtsho dwangs pa la// zhe 'dod rnyog ma ma slong zhig /chos sku'i nor bu sgrib par mchi'o// sems nyid me long g.ya' dag la// bsam gtan dri mas ma byugs shig /ye shes gzugs brnyan mi mthong ngo*// sems nyid nor bu rin chen de// mtshan ma'i 'jim pas ma btums shig /'bras bu dgos 'dod 'gag par mchi'o// mdor na yin bsam med par zhog /ma yin snyam pa'ang med par zhog

/yin snyam sems dang min snyam sems// phan tshun ltos pa'i 'dzin pa yin// min pa gang yang med pas na// ma yin pa yang gang yang med// snyems bral ngang du phyam gyis zhog /bzhag dang mi bzhag mi bsam zhing*// btang dang mi btang yang mi bsam// bsam dang mi bsam yang mi bsam// 'gro'am 'dug gam 'greng yang rung*// bsgom mam nyal lam za yang rung*// cal col smra dang gtam yang rung*// gnyug ma'i yid kyis zin pa gces// zhes gsungs pas/ de'ang dang po'i dus su shes pa lhod klod nas rang sar 'jog pa gal che/ rnam par rtog pa sra ram pa skyes pa'i dus su'ang ngo bo ngos bzung la de thog 'dzin med du lhod glod la 'jog /nyon mongs pa 'khrug gtum pa skyes pa'i dus su lhod glod la 'jog /mi dga' ba tsha gyu ba byung ba'i dus su'ang lhod glod la 'jog ste/ phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la// 'di bya'i tig po mi bdog gi /nam dran dus su klod la zhog /ces gsungs/ zhog bya ba 'di yang tshig yin/ don bzung nas bzhag rgyu'am btegs nas bzhag rgyu'am bcos nas bzhag rgyu'am blos bsgom rgyu spu tsam med/ lha mi gsal ba/ sngags mi gcog pa/ thabs lam mi chun pa rnams bcun rgyu med/ kho rang rang bab bzo med gnyer med so ma nyid du te lo'i chos drug ltar 'jog ste/ 'das pa mi mno/ ma 'ongs pa mi bsam/ da lta ba mi sems/ blos byas mi bsgom/ yin min gyi brtags shing mi dpyad/ sems kho rang rang lugs su bzhag ste/ rgyal ba yang dgon pas/ blo rtog pa la skyon du mi lta zhing*// mi rtog pa ched du mi bsgom par// sems rang lugs su zhog la rgyang so zhig tshug dang*// zhes gsungs pa ltar shes par bya'o//

mchan 'di'i nyams len la rkyen snang phal cher rang grol du shar tsam nas ro snyoms drug skor dang gsang spyod zlog sgom sogs ro snyoms spyod pa'i khrid kyi bogs 'don rnams shin tu gal che'o// de'i ngang nas rang gi rig pa 'di tshogs drug gi steng du so sor 'char zhing res 'ga' yul la mi 'jug par rtog med du gnas/ de la mi gnas pa na gang shar ba'i thol skyes kyi shes pa ngos bzung nas de nyid kho rang gi steng du klad pas rig pa dang dran pa rang dwangs la 'gro ba yin/ phyi rol gyi yul snang 'di yang mad nga gsum gyi rmi lam dang sgyu ma 'dra ba yin pas yul 'dzin gyi zhen pa btang nas snang thog tu ma bcos pa 'jog pas phyi nang gi chags zhen dang 'dzin pa 'jig pa yin/ dgra gnyen dang bde sdug sogs gnyis 'dzin gyi rtsa ba bcad pa chos nyid kyi rtogs pa'i ngo bo rang rdol du 'ong ba yin/ sgo lnga dbang po'i rtsal 'dags pas chos sku'i mdangs thon nas stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa 'char ba yin/ ma yengs dran pa'i rgyun mthud pas las sogs pa'i mkhan po med pa yin/ de'i phra zhib snang thog tu tshogs brgyad kyi dug dbyung la kun gzhi'i dug rang ngo ma shes pa/ sgo lnga'i dug gzugs lta bu mthong ba la snang 'dzin byung ba/ yid shes kyi dug yul gcig spu ris 'byed pa/ nyon yid kyi dug de la chags sdang skye ba yin pas de lta bu'i tshe na kun gzhi'i yul med 'char sgo rang ngo shes pa/ sgo lnga yul med gsal stong du 'char ba yid byed kyi der 'dzin 'gyu ba dag pa/ nyon yid rang rtsal rtog med du ngo shes par byas la gang shar gyi ngo bo ma 'gag par shar/ ma yengs par bltas/ ma 'khrul bar mthong*/ ma bcings par grol ba dgos/ gsungs pa bka' brgyud gong ma'i gdams ngag la nges shes tshud par bya dgos 'di'i rgyab skyor du blo 'das la bzla'i skor gyi khrid gal che/ mchan/

pas de ltar gal che'o// zung 'jug du la bzla ba ni lta byed kyi mkhan po dbyings su bsgyur la gnyis snang gi 'dzin pa rang sar bshig pa'o// de dag sgom pa nyams myong dang 'bral bar bya ba'i tshul yin la/ spyod pa dus tshod dang 'brel ba ni/ theg gsum gnas skabs so sor spyad// theg chen lam gyi rim pa bzhin// rang gzhan smin par byed pa yi// spyod pa dus dang 'brel ba gces// zhes gsungs pas/ phyi rol pa ni spang bya dngos/ nyan rang gi spyod pa'ang*/ de rigs kyi spyad bya tsam dang*/ theg chen pas rang gi rgyud tshod dang bstun par byas la/ las dang po pa dang*/ brtan pa dang*/ spyod pa la zhugs pa dang mthar thug gi spyod pa rnams bsre bar mi bya ste/ spyan ras gzigs kyi/ las dang po pas rnal 'byor pa'i spyod pa mi bya'o// rnal 'byor pas grub thob kyi spyod pa mi bya'o// grub thob kyis byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mi bya'o// byang chub sems dpas sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa mi bya'o// zhes gsungs pas/ spyod pa mtha' gnyis spangs pa ste// 'dod pa'i bsod nams mi bsgrub cing*// ngal zhing dub pa'i mtha' spangs pa// 'tsho ba dag pa'i spyod pa yin// khams gsum nyon mongs spong byed cing*// snying rjes gzhan la phan byed pa// dang po'i las kyi spyod pa yin// mnyam bzhag dam bca' mi gtong zhing*// shes rab snying rjes rjes thob skyong*// ma zhen spel sbyang byed pa ni// yon tan 'phel ba'i spyod pa yin// rnam mi rtog cing zhi ba spang*// gzhan don spyod cing srid mi chags// sems dpa' chen po'i spyod pa yin// ma dag tshul 'chos spyod pa dang*// log pa'i brtul zhugs spyod pa dang*// shes bzhin mi ldan tho co spyod// de gsum phyogs mthun spang bar bya// zhes rje rang byung zhabs kyis gsungs shing spyod pa rgya cher bshad pa kho bos dam tshig rgya mtshor bshad pa bzhin shes par gyis shig

/ces gsungs/ de'ang las dang po pa theg pa spyi dang mthun zhing yon tan 'phel ba'i spyod pa la stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyi sbyin sogs bsod nams dang ye shes sgrub pa'i bsam gtan de rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong nyid sgrub pa yin par gtsug na rin chen gyis zhus pa'i mdo las gsungs shing*/ rgyud bla mar yang*/ sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod la sogs// rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa// stong pa nyid ni gzugs su brjod// ces dang*/ rgyan las kyang*/ rgyal sras spyod tshe ji lta ji lta bu// dbang po'i spyod yul sna tshogs 'jug 'gyur ba// de dang de la rigs pas mthun tshig gis// sems can phan phyir de mngon 'du byed do// zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pa ltar sngar ji skad bshad pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bslab bya la slob cing 'dir ni skabs don nyams len kho na dang 'brel ba bsre ba ro snyoms kyi spyod pa la grub thob gong ma'i dgongs pa snyan brgyud rin po che'i khyad chos yin la/ rje mi la'i gsung las/ snga phyi bsre ba'i gnad kyis dngos po kun la ro snyoms pa la gnyis/ gang shar gnyis med du bsres la zung 'jug tu ro snyoms pa dang*/ shugs 'byung zhen pa rang grol gyi spyod pa la ro snyoms pa'o// dang po la gzhi lam 'bras gsum dbyer med du bsre la zung 'jug tu ro snyoms pa/ bde gsal mi rtog pa dbyer med du bsre la zung 'jug tu ro snyoms pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang sems can gnyis med du bsre la zung 'jug tu ro snyoms pa dang*/ 'khor 'das gnyis med du bsre la zung 'jug tu ro snyoms pa dang*/ dge sdig gnyis med du bsre la zung 'jug tu ro snyoms pa dang*/ 'jig rten chos brgyad gnyis med du bsre la zung 'jug tu ro snyoms pa'o// shugs 'byung zhen pa rang grol gyi spyod pa la ro snyoms pa ni bcu/ tshe 'di la zhen pa'i blo byung na sgyu ma mkhan gyi spyod pa bya/

snang ba'i yul la bden 'dzin gyi blo byung na smyon pa lta bu'i spyod pa bya/ nor rdzas la zhen pa'i blo byung na bu chung lta bu'i spyod pa bya/ gtsang mi gtsang gi blo byung na khyi phag lta bu'i spyod pa bya/ yul dang gnyen bshes la gdung ba'i blo byung na ri dwags rmas ma lta bu'i spyod pa bya/ nad dang gdon gyi bar chad byung na dpa' bo g.yul du zhugs pa lta bu'i spyod pa bya/ bsod chung bdud kyi bslu brid byung na bya sgro rlung gis khyer ba lta bu'i spyod pa bya/ btsun mo padma'i phreng ba can gyi bar chad byung na bse ru lta bu'i spyod pa bya/ sdug bsngal dang skyo ba'i blo byung na lha yi rol mo mkhan gyi spyod pa bya/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad du nam mkha' gos su gyon pa'i spyod pa bya'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar zhib tu shes shing nyams su len par bya ba de lta bu'i ngang nas 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug thams cad kyi dus rjes thob kyi ting nge 'dzin gang shar gang byung gi steng du bsre nas 'khyer dgos pa yin te/ gang dang gang du 'gro ba'i dus na yul snang gang yin pa de la nyams len gyi mthil byas nas 'dzin med gang shar gyi steng du 'jog /gang du 'chag pa'i dus su lta sgom gyi don dang ma bral bar dgag sgrub dang bral ba'i ngang nas 'chag /gang du nyal ba'i dus su gti mug 'od gsal dang bsre ste rang rig rang gsal gyi sgron me 'deg /gang du 'dug pa'i dus su chos sku'i rang so bzung nas dus gsum gyi spros pas mnyam gzhag las ma g.yos pa'i ngang du rjes thob kyi rtsal sbyong bas rgyu 'bras rten 'brel gyi yin lugs ci bzhin 'char ba'o// de lta ma yin na spyod lam legs kyang grol ba mi thob ste/ zhang rin po ches/ gnyis med rtogs pas ma zin pa'i// btsan thabs bcos ma tho co yin// dgra zin gser dang bong ba mnyam// ya tshul phyi tshis ma byas kyang*// grol na bu chung cis mi grol// gnyis med rtogs pas ma zin pa'i// gza' gtad med pas grol gyur na// smyon pa thams cad grol bar rigs// gnyis med rtogs pas ma zin pa'i// gtsang btsog med pas grol gyur na// khyi phag rnams kyang grol bar rigs// gnyis med rtogs pas ma zin pa'i// spyod lam mkhas pas grol gyur na// bag ma rnams kyang grol bar rigs// gnyis med rtogs pas ma zin pa'i// rang byung lhug pas grol gyur na// glang glen rnams kyang grol bar rigs// gnyis med rtogs pas ma zin na// zhib rung rtsing rung 'ching bar 'gyur// gnyis med rtogs pas zin gyur na// spyod pa rtsing rung mi rtsing rung*// ci ltar byas kyang grol bar 'gyur// phyogs med snying rjes zin gyur na// ci ltar byas kyang mchog gi lam// phyogs med snying rjes ma khyab na// ji ltar byas kyang dman pa'i lam// zhes gsungs/

de rnams la lta ba mthar phyin chos sku phyag rgya chen po/ bsgom pa mthar phyin longs sku phyag rgya chen po/ spyod pa mthar phyin sprul sku phyag rgya chen po zhes gsungs pa'ang don dbyings rig dbyer med kyi tshul la mi shes pa'i sgrib g.yog sel ba tsam gyis gzhi thog tu 'bras bu slebs pa dang*/ blo zad chos zad dang*/ 'bras bu mthar phyin pa sogs su btags pa ste gzhi 'gyur med nam mkha' lta bu gang stong phyogs ris 'phel 'grib med pa de la rnal 'byor pas thos pas phyi'i sgro 'dogs bcad/ bsam pas nang gi sgro 'dogs bcad/ bsgoms pas gnas lugs gtan la phab kyang*/ blo las 'das pa'i chos sku gzhi dus kyi ma bcos pa de ga'i steng du lhan gyis phebs pa ma gtogs rnyed rgyu dang mthong rgyu ma byung ba lta ba snga thog tu ldog pa gzing gi bya rog lta bu yin/ bsgom pa nyams myong gi gtan tshigs dang dmigs gtad ci ltar byas kyang skye med kyi don la gang yang byar med pas dngos 'dzin gyi zhen pa dang bral ba ste tha mal gyi shes pa rjen pa ma bcos pa de'i steng du 'khor yong bas bsgom pa sngar shul du ldog pa ri dwags khyis ded pa lta bu yin/ spyod pa dge sdig gi bsrung bya tshogs gnyis kyi bsags thabs sogs gal che che po gza' gtad yod pa bzhin byas nas mthar don gyi ngo bo klong du gyur tsam na spyod bya spyod byed gza' gtad bral ba'i gzhi thog tu 'khor nas spyod pa nges med bu chung gi bya byed lta bu yin/ lam lta sgom spyod pa'i phyogs su 'bad cing spyod pa'i 'bras bu la glo bur gyi dri ma dang bral ba'i khyad par tsam las ngo bo bzang ngan med par gzhi'i gnas lugs de ga mngon du byas pa 'bras bu slar log zhing pa'i ston thog lta bu yin gsungs/ de lta bu'i lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes zab cing rgya che ba'i don 'di ni ston pa dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bstan pa gcig pu 'di nyid rtogs pas chos thams cad kyi don rtogs shing*/

chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong ji snyed du grags pa thams cad 'dir ma 'dus pa med de/ bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las ji ltar sa gcig thob pa yi// sa ni thams cad thob par 'gyur// de bzhin man ngag thams cad kyang*// man ngag gcig gis thob par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ dpal nā ro pa'i lta ba mdor bsdus las/ stong pa de nyid rig pa sems// byang chub sems kyang de nyid do// sangs rgyas rigs kyang de nyid do// bde gshegs snying po de nyid do// ci bzhin pa yi ro myong ba// bde ba chen po de nyid do// gsang sngags zhes bya de nyid do// thabs dang shes rab de nyid do// zab dang rgya che de nyid do// kun bzang yab yum de nyid do// snang stong dbyings dang ye shes la// ye sangs rgyas zhes de la bya// zhes gsungs pas/ de ltar zab mo bla na med pa'i don phyin ci ma log pa thugs su chud par bya'o// rjes snga ma ltar la khyad par du spyod lam kun tu rtogs pa'i ngo bo nyid dang ma bral bar mdzod cig / byas la maṇḍal gtor 'bul smon lam gdab pa sogs bya'o// nyi ma so brgyad chos thun nyer gsum pa'o// ༈ chos thun nyer bzhi pa la yang sngar bzhin tshig gi mtshams sbyor byas nas/ de ltar yin lugs lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ngo sprad pa song nas don gnyis pa thabs shes zung 'jug gi sgo nas lam du byed pa la/ de ltar 'bras bu mngon sum du rtogs pa chos kyi dbyings de nyid kyi ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du/ rtse gcig gi bsgom pa dang*/ sgom la mthun pa'i rkyen spyod pa dam tshig la tshul bzhin gnas pas glo bur gyi dri ma phra zhing phra ba yan chad sbyong nas mthar thug blo zad chos zad gzhi thog tu 'bras bu sleb pa'i bar la brtson pa mi 'dor ba gal che/ nā ro pa'i lta ba mdor bsdus las/ de ltar lta ba ma nor bar// sgom pa dang ni spyod pa dang*// dngos dang mthun pas byang chub thob// ces gsungs pas/

'dir lta bsgom pa spyod pa dam tshig gnad gcig tu dril nas zung 'jug tu nyams su len dgos pa ste/ 'od gsal lhan cig skyes pa'i ngo bo de shes rab chos kyi sku yin la de la goms shing 'dris nas mngon du byed pa'i sgom pa spyod pa dam tshig rnams ni thabs kyi mchog bla na med pa nyid do// de lta bur lta spyod dam tshig zung 'brel du bsgrub pas nyams rtogs kyi drod tshad 'dzin pa zhing sa lta bu'i gdams ngag la don bzhi/ snang ba sems su shes pa dang*/ snang ba sgyu ma lta bur shar bas snang ba la zhen pa rang grol du song ba gnyis dus gcig la 'byung ba yin/ sems nyid stong pa ru gtan la 'bebs pa dang*/ chags sdang gi gnod pa zhi ba dus gcig la 'byung ba yin/ shes bya la sgro 'dogs chod pa dang gnas lugs kyi ngang la rang sar gnas pa gnyis dus gcig la 'byung ba yin/ gnyis med kyi don rtogs pa dang gnyis snang gi rtog pa dag pa dus gcig la 'byung ba yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar man ngag nyams len du dril nas sgrub pa lag tu len pa'i tshul thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro gsal btab la/ snga ma ltar lus drang por bsrang zhing bla ma mos gus kyi gzhung bsrangs nas ting nge 'dzin gyi gnad la mtshan ma'i g.yeng ba spang bar bya ba'i phyir thun chung ngu chung ngur gcod pa gal che ste/ nyin zhag phrug gcig la thun bzhi ru phye/ thun re re la sum brgya drug cu las mi nyung bar bcad nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom zhing bla ma la mos gus kyis byin rlabs kyi ngar blud cing gsal dwangs chos nyid kyi ngang las ma g.yos par bya'o// gzhan du na thig le nā da sogs mtshan ma can nam blo yis byas pa gcig bsgom rgyu med de/ tshig bsdus las/ rang bzhin ma bcos rnal mar bzhag /bsam du med pa chos kyi sku// ma btsal bzhag la bsgom pa ste// btsal zhing bsgom pa 'khrul pa'i blo// zhes gsungs pas rig pa la hur 'don zhing lta stangs nam mkha'i dbyings su gtad nas ma yengs par byed pa kho na ste/

tai lo pa chen po'i zhal nas/ dmigs pa yul med sems kyi rang bzhin gsal// bgrod pa'i lam med sangs rgyas lam sna zin// bsgom pa'i yul med goms na byang chub thob// ces gsungs pa dang*/ 'khor lo sdom pa gsang ba dur khrod las/ bsgom du med pa'i don bsgoms na// ma bsgom na yang bsgom pa'i mchog /de ltar gyur pa'i mkhas pa la// stong par mi 'gyur gang yang med// de las mya ngan 'das pa 'byung*// sku dang stobs la sogs pa kun// nor bu'i tshul du rab tu 'byung*// ces gsungs pa'i phyir na/ chos rje rang byung ba'i zhal nas/ gsal dwangs kyi shes pa la ngar thon dang*/ phra rags kyi rtog pa rang 'gag tu 'gro ba'i gnad du gda'/ zhes gsungs pa'ang thun gcod pa kho na la dgongs pa ste/ rang bzhin phyag rgya chen po la thun dang dum bu med kyang 'o skol thog ma med pa'i bag chags la goms drag de'i rgyun bsog pa'i glo bur gyi dri ma 'thug drag pas go nyams rtogs gsum la nges shes ji ltar skyes kyang phying pa la bskung bu brgyab pa bzhin sub 'gro ba 'di da phan gyi tshe rabs thams cad du goms goms pa gcig bsgyur nas ma goms pa gcig la blo 'jog dgos pas nyams rtogs mthar 'don mi nus pa yin te/ grub thob gtsang pa rgya ras kyis/ blo ngan goms kyi bag chags shog dril 'dra// nyams gsar bu zhig skyes kyang rkyen gyis 'jigs// dus yun thung gi 'khrul pa mi chod kyi// sgom yun du bsring dang sgom chen kun// zhes dang*/ gtsang pa mi bskyod pas/ nyams la yar skyed med pa de// zla ba nyi mas non pa 'dra// de gnyis snang gi yul la zhen pas lan// sems 'khri ba chod dang sgom chen kun// zhes gsungs pa ltar lta sgom spyod pa 'bras bu lag tu ma khel bar gang zag gi mthong tshul la chos dang mi mthun pa'i skyon yod pa 'dra ba rnams kyang phyag rgya chen pos go ma chod pa min/

gang zag gi go ma chod pa dang*/ don la bstan pa snyigs pas lan pa yin/ sngon rgya gar gyi mkhas grub chen po rnams kyi dus dang bod kyi lo paṇa byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bstan pa dar bar mdzad pa'i thog ma de bzhin byung ba min/ deng sang gi dus 'di na la lar bla mas go ma chod par khrid ma thebs pas ngo ma 'phrod/ la lar khrid gnyer bas go ma chod par dad pa can gyi kha 'khyag tu bcug /la lar slob mas go ma chod par gdams ngag gi gnad ma zin/ la lar mched grogs kyis go ma chod pas stong skad 'don shes na des chog pa'i lag len tsho bslab/ des sdug pa kun la dad pa brtson 'grus su 'dzom pa'i gzhi yod kyang rkyen de rnams kyis snod ldan gyi slob ma kha sa la lhan gyis btang nas/ de sbang ma la phab rdog brgyab pa bzhin du gang gi'ang gtad so med par mgo zi tham gyis btang nas/ kha rgyug gi stong skad 'dra ba lab pa gcig 'ong ba yin/ kha cig phyogs mthun tsam gyi khrid skyes kyang rnam rtog 'og 'gyus su 'gro ba ma tshor bar nyams myong bzang por rlom pa byas nas spom me yo re ba byas/ dad zas kyi pho ba brgyangs pa tsho la'ang de bzhin 'ong ba yin/ 'ga' zhig thog mar myong ba dga' tshad yod kyang mthun phyogs kyi bdud kyis khyer nas 'tsheng med kyi sku bsod la shor ba tshos kyang 'og 'gyus kyi rkun bu ngos ma zin pa de 'ong ba yin/ 'ga' zhig dga' rab dbang phyug gi dbang du song nas ming chos rje'am rin po cher btags te gos bzang gi sbubs su zhugs/ 'phral grub thob gong ma rnams kyi lad mo byed/ zhe phug na khral bu smad gso ba dang khyad med pa'i yon bdag gi skyong bran la 'bad pa'i dge bshes la'ang de 'ong ba yin/ mdor na skyon de rnams thams cad rnam rtog gi rkun ma ma tshor bas lan gyi phyag rgya chen po la log lta ma bsgom zhes pa rgyal ba u rgyan pas gsungs pa ltar yin pas gnyis snang gi 'khrul pa ma dag gi bar du de ltar thun du bcad nas chos nyid 'od gsal ba chen po ni nam mkha' lta bu steng 'og phyogs mtshams phyi nang med par sing thag chad pa'i ngar thog nas bsgom pas tham thum gcig tu 'dres bar lag rming nas 'gyel ba'i tshe gdeng thob nas gti mug gnyid 'od gsal du 'gyur/

bying rgod phra rags kyi rtog pa thams cad rang sangs rang grol tu 'gro ba'o// de ltar sgom par byed pa la mthun rkyen gyi spyod pa dang*/ dam tshig shin tu gal che ba ste 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dran par byas la tshe 'di'i bya ba lings kyis bor/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa dran par byas le lo spang phyir brtson 'grus drag po bskyed/ sa lam myur du bgrod par byed cing phyir mi ltung bar byed pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig rang sems dpang por btsug pas bsrungs/ dad zas dang dkor zas dang grib zas dang snyan grags dang bkur sti thams cad bdud kyi cho 'phrul yin pas 'khri ba rbad kyis bcad mthun rkyen dang 'gal rkyen gang yang mi 'byung ba'i dben pa'i gnas/ gangs khrod/ ri khrod/ nags khrod thams cad 'grim zhing bsdad/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byang chub bsgrub pa'i 'tsho ba yin pas dka' thub la 'bad cing*/ bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi byang chub mchog gi spyod pa spyad pa'i rnam thar rnams yang dang yang du dran par byas la tshe 'di phyi'i 'dun ma thams cad kyi dpang por blo lings kyis bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang dkon mchog gsum la gtad cing g.yel ba med par gsol ba 'debs par bya'o// de ltar du yang 'khor lo bde mchog lu gu rgyud las/ lhag par 'du 'dzi rnam spangs nas// spyod pa mthun pa'i grogs dang ni// bde bar byang chub bsgrub par bya// 'on kyang gnas dang grogs la sogs// rnal 'byor yid 'jug phyir btsal te// mtha' dag spangs pa'i pha rol na/ lhag pa'i byang chub ma mchis so// bde dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs rnams// rang gi sems las byung mod kyi// sems rtog ma lus spangs pa las// ngas ni chos gzhan 'ga' ma bshad// ces gsungs pa'o// de ltar byas shing bsgom pas gtor mchod la sogs bya cha'i chos spyod/ lha bsgom/ sngags bzla/ rtsa rlung thig le sems bskyed sogs de ru ma 'dus pa med pas 'dus ma byas pa don dam gyi chos spyod du 'gyur te/

'khor lo sdom pa gsang ba bdud rtsi las/ mchod dang gtor ma la sogs pa'i// las dang bya ba sna tshogs kun// sems kyi de nyid shes gyur na// thams cad 'di la sdud par nges// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ kyai rdo rje las/ dmigs pa med pa'i rang bzhin la// lha dang sngags ni yang dag gnas// zhes gsungs/ yang 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i don 'di lta bu'i gnas lugs ma rtogs na de ltar du mi 'jug pa'i thabs med de rtogs pa skye bar byed pa'i dri ma sbyong zhing tshogs gnyis bsags dgos pa'i phyir ro// 'di ltar rang byung gi ye shes mngon sum du rtogs nas 'di'i nyams len bor te/ gzhan thun mong gi las phran tshegs gam/ 'dus byas kyi tshogs la nan gyis 'jug pa ni bdud kyi las su rig par bya ste/ slob dpon bram ze chen po'i zhal nas/ spros pa rnams dang bral ba'i rang gi sems mthong nas// spros pa rnams la ched du 'bad pa'i rnal 'byor ni// nor bu rin chen rnyed nas 'ching bu tshol ba ltar// zad mi shes pa'i bde ba chen po nyid spangs nas// 'khor ba'i bde ba dag la reg pa'i 'ching bu mtshar// zhes gsungs pa'o// de lta bu'i bye brag phyed cing snga ma ltar nyams su blangs pas gnas lugs chos nyid kyi ngo bo la dwangs snyigs phyed nas/ lus la bde drod 'bar te tsha grang bkres skom gyi mi gnod cing bro dang gar byed snying 'dod pa dang*/ ngag la nus pa 'bar zhing bar chad dngos grub tu gyur nas nyams dang rtogs pa'i glu chung len snying 'dod pa dang*/ sems la rtogs pa 'bar te chos thams cad 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po ru 'gyur zhing bla ma sangs rgyas su mngon sum du mthong nas mi phyed pa'i mos gus sa skye/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dran zhing zhen pa gting nas log dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje rang shugs kyis skye zhing gzhan phan gyi sa bon thebs/ chos thams cad kyi don shes pa skad cig ma'i rang gzugs su 'dug snyam pa'i rten 'brel phyogs med 'char/

rtags dang mngon par shes pa la sogs cho 'phrul du ma 'byung yang thams cad stong nyid spros bral du lam du 'khyer zhing rlom sems dang zhe 'dod med par byung rgyal du skyong bas 'khrul pa'i bag chags rtsad nas spangs pas grub pa'i rgyal sa zin par 'gyur ro// de ltar thabs shes zung 'jug gi lam la nyin mtshan kha sbyor du nyams su blangs pas 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid spang blang med par rtogs nas dbang po rab lo gsum mam drug tu grol/ dbang po 'bring lo bcu gnyis sam lo nyi shu gcig nas grol/ dbang po dman pa'i gang zag kyang tshe gcig lus gcig gis rtse gcig spros bral ro gcig bsgom med kyi ye shes mthar phyin nas phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku nam mkha' lta bu thob nas mchog dang dman pa la sogs pa sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa dpag tu med pa 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du 'gro ba'i don byed par 'gyur ro// de lta bu'i sa dang lam gyi bgrod tshul mdo phyogs dang mthun par thar pa rin po che'i rgyan las gsungs pa ji lta ba bzhin shes par byas la/

spro na thar rgyan gyi lam lnga dang sa bcu'i le'u sogs sa lam gyi rnam bzhag ci rigs bshad do// mchan/ 'dir yang gsang sngags thabs kyi khyad par gyi dbang po dman pa'ang tshe gcig lus gcig gis mchog gi dngos grub grub pa'i lam gyi tshod 'dzin rnal 'byor bzhi yi rim pa mdo tsam bshad pa la/ rgyal ba mchog gi khrid yig chen mo las/ bzhi pa lam ni rnal 'byor bzhi yis bgrod// rtse gcig zhi lhag dbyer med don la gnas// spros bral chos rnams stong pa nyid du rtogs// ro gcig 'khor 'das chos rnams ro gcig 'dres// sgom med bsgom bya sgom byed kun dang bral// de rnams mi brtan brtan dang rab tu brtan// cung zad phal cher ma lus rtogs pa la// chung 'bring chen po bcu gnyis sogs su gsungs// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ rje nā ro paṇa chen gyi zhal nas/ dang po rtse gcig nyams su myong*// gnyis pa spros bral 'char bar 'gyur// gsum pa ro gcig rnal 'byor 'char// bzhi pa bsgom med rnal 'byor 'char// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ rang rang gi ngo bos bzung na rnal 'byor bzhi yi don bsdu zhal gdams mar grags pa ltar bya ste/ dang po ting nge 'dzin gyi ngos 'dzin bzhi ni/ ngang la gsal stong nam mkha' lta bu/ gnas pa rtse gcig yin// sgro 'dogs phyi nang gi chos thams cad spros pa dang bral bar/ chod pa spros bral yin// spang blang med pa gang snang gang shar thams cad bsgom du shar bas/ ro gcig yin// myong ba dag pa stong pa nyid la sogs nyams gyi myong tshor thams cad dag pa/ bsgom med yin// mnyam bzhag gi rtogs pa bzhi ni/ rtse gcig dus su ngo bo bde gsal gyi nyams kyi ngo bo gsal sdang nam mkha' lta bu/ rtogs// spros bral sems kyi rang bzhin spros pa thams cad dang bral ba/ dus su rang bzhin rtogs// ro gcig dus su sems nyid 'khor 'das sna tshogs su snang ba/ mtshan nyid rtogs// bsgom med rtogs pa'i 'khor yug

mnyam nyid kyi rtogs pa nyin mtshan med pa ma'o// rtogs pa'i 'khor sa bzhi ni/ rtse gcig mun pa'i gsal stong nam mkha' lta bu la nges shes kyi lhag mthong ma shar ba/ khyi sna 'khyams// spros bral med pa'i stong nyid yin pas ci yang med snyam nas kun rdzob khyad du gsod/ stong rdzis khyer// ro gcig gnyis su med par rtogs nas mos gus snying rje la sogs khyad du gsod na/ 'dres pa'i rba la g.yengs/ bsgom med nyi ma sprin gyis mnyam bzhag 'ba' zhig tu gyur kyang gnyis 'dzin phra mo dang mi rtog ngo ma shes nas ma dag na/ bsgribs/ rjes shes kyi skye tshul bzhi la/ rtse gcig gi rjes shes tha mal dngos 'dzin du skye bas/ a 'thas/ spros bral gyi rjes shes yul lam yul can du snang yang snang la rang bzhin med pas/ sgyu ma/ ro gcig gi rjes shes gnyis med du rang ngo ma shes pas stong pa phyogs gcig tu skye pas/ stong pa/ bsgom med kyi rjes shes gnyis snang gi rjes med kyang dmigs med kyi/ snying rjer skye'o// rjes shes kyi dri ma bzhi la/ rtse gcig mnyam bzhag tu gsal stong rig kyang rjes shes tha mal gyi 'khrul par 'ong bas/ dngos 'dzin gyi dri ma/ spros bral ngo ma shes kyi dngos po bden 'dzin med kyang snang la ma nges pas/ dri ma/ ro gcig nyams kyi stong 'dzin dang rang yul du ma shes/ dri ma/ bsgom med shes bya'i mi rtog ngo ma shes des gnas lugs la bsgribs pas/ dri ma'o/ rjes thob kyi dag tshul bzhi la/ rtse gcig las kyi dri ma dag /spros bral nyon mongs kyi dri ma dag /ro gcig bag chags kyi dri ma dag /sgom med shes bya'i dri ma dag /rjes shes kyi bral thob bzhi la/ rtse gcig bral ba yod la ma dran pa na bsgom dang bral dran yang ngo bo mi mthong bas thob pa med/ spros bral yengs med kyi dran pas ma zin na sgom dang bral la zin pa dang gang shar gyi ngo bo mthong bas/

bral thob gnyis ka yod/ ro gcig bral ba med la dran pas ma zin yang rtog pa rgyun chod pa'i ngos bzung med zin pa dang ngo bo rang gsal du 'char bas/ thob pa yod/ bsgom med dran pas ma zin pa dang ngo bo mthong ma mthong med pas bral thob gnyis ka med do// mnyam rjes kyi sa mtshams bzhi la/ rtse gcig mnyam rjes mtshan nyid pa rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes med pas mnyam bzhag mtshan nyid pa med la rjes snang sgyu mar mi 'char bas rjes thob mtshan nyid pa med/ med la rang sa'i mtshan nyid yod// spros bral gyi dus su mnyam rjes gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa yul med du shar ba rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes dang rjes shes sgyu ma lta bur/ gnyis shag phye ste bye/ ro gcig dus su dran rtog bsgom du shar nas sgom dang bral ba'i ngos 'dzin med pa/ mnyam rjes 'dres/ bsgom med rtogs pa'i ye shes 'khor yug tu gyur pa/ mnyam bzhag 'ba' zhig yin no// yang rtse gcig sems nyid nyams la sgro 'dogs ma chod bsgom bya sgom byed dang bcas pas/ a 'thas su bsgom pa'i dus/ spros bral mnyam bzhag tu ngo bo yul med du rtogs pa'i rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes bsgom la rjes shes su bden med sgyu ma lta bur bsgom/ sems nyid mnyam rjes su bsgom pa'i dus/ ro gcig sems nyid zung 'jug tu bden pa gnyis dang mnyam rjes 'dres pa/ bsgom pa'i dus/ bsgom med sems nyid dus thams cad du gnyug ma mnyam pa nyid kyi dbyings su yul med du rtogs pas/ mngon du gyur pa'i dus so// mnyam bzhag gi rtogs pas sgrib pa 'dag lugs la rtse gcig gi dus su gzugs kyi ngo bo ma grub pas/ phung po dang rang stong du rigs pas/ sgo lnga'i rnam par shes pa 'dag /spros bral gyi dus su tshor ba myong rig gi 'dzin pa dag pa/ dang 'du shes kyi phung po tha snyad kyi gdags pa med pa/ dang yid kyi rnam par shes pa

yid dang chos spros bral du rtogs pas/ 'dag /ro gcig gi dus su 'du byed kyi phung po kun sbyor gyi sems pa med pas dang nyon mongs pa can nga dang nga yir 'dzin pa gzhi med du rtogs pas/ gyi yid 'dag /bsgom med kyi dus su nges shes kyi yul 'dzin med pas/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang kun gzhi'i rtog med lung ma bstan 'dag pas rnam par shes pa 'dag /nyams rtogs kyi sa mtshams bzhi la/ rtse gcig nyams rtogs 'dzin pa dang bcas pa 'ba' zhig yin pas/ dri ma can/ spros bral nyams rtogs nyams myong dag nas rtogs pa yul med du shar nyams rtogs ma 'dres par rig pas/ shan 'byed// ro gcig nyams rtogs nyams myong nyid rtogs par shar nas dbyer med pas/ zung 'jug bsgom med gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rgyun mi 'chad pas/ rtogs pa'i 'khor yug ma'o// kun rdzob rgyu 'bras kyi mkhyen tshul bzhi la/ rtse gcig dus su rgyu 'bras rig pa dwangs pa'i 'char sgo la rgyu 'bras phra rags la 'phrig tshud kyang dngos 'dzin du yod pas/ a 'thas/ spros bral gyi dus su stong pa nyid kyi rtsal rten cing 'bral bar 'byung ba sgyu ma lta bu'i sgyu 'bras go bas/ sgyu ma lta bu/ ro gcig gi dus su rgyu chos dbyings stong pa las rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i chos stong par 'byung bas/ 'bras nam mkha' lta bu/ bsgom med kyi dus su dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba ji snyed pa thams cad ji lta ba mngon du gyur kyang gnyis snang med pas/ gzhi med cing rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba mkhyen pa'o// zhes gsungs so// yang rtse gcig dang spros bral gyi khyad par rnam rtag sgom du shar ma shar/ spros bral dang ro gcig gi khyad par zung du chud ma chud/ ro gcig dang bsgom med kyi khyad par gnyis snang phra mo dang dran pa'i rtsol ba dag ma dag yin no// mchan 'di rnams kyang rgya ston chos kyi bzang pos mdzad pa yin no// yang rtse gcig gi mnyam rjes yeng ma yeng*/

spros bral gyi mnyam rjes dran ma dran/ ro gcig gi mnyam rjes 'dzin mi 'dzin/ bsgom med la mnyam rjes med/ rtse gcig tu 'dod yon la zhen pa mngon gyur ldog /spros bral du tshe 'di blos thong*/ ro gcig tu chos brgyad mgo snyoms/ bsgom med du gnyis snang phra zhing phra ba gnas ngan len dang bcas pa 'dag pa yin gsungs/ de'ang rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor gyi dus su 'du 'dzi spangs nas brtson 'grus pa skyed pa gal che/ de nas spros bral gyi rnal 'byor gyi dus su btang snyoms su ma lus par shes pa ngar dang bcas pa gal che/ du ma ro gcig gi rnal 'byor gyi dus su go yul don spyi'i rnam pa dang rtogs pa'i nyams myong ma nor zhing ma 'dres pa gal che/ bsgom du med pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dus su nyams myong gi rtsi la ma 'byar ba gal che/ nyams len man ngag gi gnad rnams ni dus gnad kyi gdams pa la mkhas pa'i bla ma dam pa mnyes par byas pa'i brda thabs la rag pa nyid do// yang rtse gcig gi dus su mtshan 'dzin spangs te blo bral gyi ngang nas zhi gnas gtso bor bsgom/ gsal sdang gi rang ngo shes pa'o// spros bral gyi dus su mtshan ma'i rtog pa rang grol gyi ngang nas stong nyid gtso bor bsgom/ rnam rtog gi rang ngo shes pa'o// ro gcig gi dus su tshogs drug rgya yan zung 'jug yangs pa'i ngang nas zung 'jug gtso bor bsgom/ snang ba'i rang ngo shes pa'o/ bsgom med kyi dus su dran 'dzin thams cad zhig pa'i ngang nas gnyis med gtso bor bsgom/ lhun grub kyi rang ngo shes pa yin gsungs/ yang rje dwags po rin po ches/ rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor ni gsal la ma 'gag pa skad cig ma'i shes pa de yin/ spros bral gyi rnal 'byor ni rig pa'i ngo bo skye med du mthong bas/ yar sangs rgyas la mi re/ mar 'khor ba la mi dogs/ bar snang ba la mi 'dzin/ gzhan gyis bsgyur du mi btub pa'o// ro gcig gi rnal 'byor ni snang stong dbyer med du rtogs pa'o// bsgom med kyi rnal 'byor ni ci snang ci skyes ngo bo gcig tu shar bas dran rtog thams cad sgom du song ba yin gsungs/

de'i don gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyud las/ seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa'i ting 'dzin gyis// rtse gcig mi g.yo dwangs pas shes pa gsal// rang byung ye shes khong nas sad par byed// bzod pa brtan pas ngan song sdug bsngal spangs// gnyis pa sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyi// spros dang bral ba'i mnyam bzhag chen po la// bsam gyis mi khyab ting 'dzin rtsal du shar// drod thob nas ni skyes la rang dbang bsgyur// gsum pa dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin gyis// du ma ro gcig sa bcu'i rtogs pa 'char// dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras pos 'gro don mdzad// rtse thob nas ni 'phel pa 'chad// bzhi pa rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis// bsgom du med pa'i nyams len brtson pa la// rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas zhing khams dpag med mthong*// ma brtsams lhun grub chos mchog chen po yin// zhes gsungs par grags la mdor na sngar bshad pa'i sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku ni rgya mtsho chen po dang 'dra ste kun gyi gzhi yin/ de'i gnas lugs rtogs pa la rtse gcig tu bzhag /rnam rtog lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i rtsal ni rgya mtsho'i rlabs dang 'dra ste chos sku'i rang rtsal yin/ de'i gnas lugs rtogs pa la spros bral du bzhag /snang ba lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i 'od ni rgya mtsho'i nang du gzugs brnyan sna tshogs shar ba dang 'dra ste bsam pa'i rang gzugs yin/ de'i gnas lugs rtogs pa la ro gcig tu bzhag /rtogs pa de gsum mthar phyin nas 'bad rtsol gyi bsgom du med pa ni mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas pa ste bsgom med du bzhag pa yin gsungs pa ste/ de bas na bka' dang bstan bcos rgyud dang man ngag zab dgu thams cad rnal 'byor bzhi la skyel ba dang snying por mi byed pa med cing rnal 'byor bzhi yi rim pa thugs nyams su ma bstar ba'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang grub pa'i skyes mchog gang yang yod pa ma yin pas/

mdo las/ chu rnams thams cad rgya mtshor phyin pa na/ lan tsha'i ror ro gcig pa ltar theg pa thams cad theg pa chen por ro gcig par gsungs pa ltar yin no// khyad par du bram ze chen po 'chi med rdo rje'i klu las/ dran pa med par 'jug pas rtog pa mi dgag par// shes pa rang lugs bzhag na gnas par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ 'di la gnas na bde chen nyams 'byung ste// dang po snang ba stong par myong ba'i sems// chab ram snang yang chu ru ngo shes bzhin// gnyis pa dran pa'i snang ba ma 'gag par// stong pa bde ba tha mi dad pa 'byung*// chab ram chu ru zhu ba'i gnas skabs bzhin// gsum pa dran med skye pa med la thim// thams cad tha mi dad pa bde ba chen por gcig /de nyid chab ram thams cad chu dang dbyer med bzhin// zhes dang*/ blo 'das 'bras bu 'dod pa med 'grub pas// sman mchog nang nas pe ta ji bzhin no// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ klu sgrub kyis rim lngar gsungs pa'i sems dben dang rtse gcig don gcig /'od gsal dang spros bral don gcig /slob pa'i zung 'jug dang ro gcig don gcig /mi slob pa'i zung 'jug dang bsgom med don gcig /grub chen la ba pas/ lhun gyis grub pa dang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ zung du 'jug pa dang*/ rnam par dag pa dang*/ zhes pa'i ming gi rnal 'byor bzhi gsungs/ sha ba ri pas/ ting nge 'dzin nyams su myong ba dang*/ rnal 'byor dang*/ shin tu rnal 'byor dang*/ rnal 'byor chen po'i ming gi rnal 'byor bzhi gsungs/ me tri pas/ sgro 'dogs chod pa'i dus dang*/ dbang thob pa'i dus dang*/ gdeng thob pa'i dus dang*/ rig pa de nyid du grol ba'i dus bzhi la nang tshan dgu re gsungs/ gzhan yang lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo las/ bdag med kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ gzung med kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ 'dzin med kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ spros med kyi rnal 'byor dang bzhir gsungs pa'i lung dang gong ma rnams kyis sbyor ba'ang mdzad do// gzhan yang ye shes gsang ba'i rgyud las/

dang po gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin// gnyis pa la ni mi g.yo ba// gsum pa mnyam pa nyid du sbyor// bzhi pa ye shes lhun gyis grub// ces dang*/ yang lang kar gshegs pa las/ byis pa nyer spyod bsam gtan dang*// don rab 'byed pa'i bsam gtan dang*// de bzhin nyid dmigs bsam gtan dang*// de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsam gtan bzhi/ rnal 'byor can gyi bsgom byas pas// zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang rnal 'byor bzhi po re re yang bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams gsum du 'byung ba ste/ de yang bde ba'i bye brag la dga' ba mchog dga' dga' bral gyi dga' ba dang lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba ste mas brtan pa'i dga' ba bzhi dang*/ gsal pa'i bye brag /snang ba mched pa thob pa nyer thob kyi 'od gsal te gsal snang gi rim pa bzhi dang*// mi rtog pa'i bye brag /stong pa shin tu stong pa stong pa chen po thams cad stong pa ste stong pa bzhi dang*/ chos drug pas zin brtan dbang 'byor bzhi dang*/ lam 'bras pas dbang bzhi'i lam gyi 'gros dang sbyar ba sogs dang yang shin tu 'bral zhing dbang bzhi'i 'gros su rje nā ro pas kyang bzhed de/ pandha pa rol pa'i rdo rje la gsungs pa/ phyag rgya chen po rtogs pa yi// dang po rnam rtog glo bur ba// de nyid la ni lta ba yis// ma rig pa las ldog pa ni// rig pa gsal la 'dzin med du// rtogs na rig pa'i dbang zhes bya// dug lnga ye shes lngar gnas na// bum pa'i dbang du 'dod pa'o// de la dgag pa med pa'i rtsal// phyogs cha med pa 'char bas na// stong pa'i ngang nas bde bar 'char// gsal ba gnyis pa'i dbang du 'dod// lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ni// bde stong dbyer med nam mkha'i ngang*// zung 'jug ro gcig chen po la// snang sems bde ba chen po myong*// shes rab ye shes dbang du bshad// dbang gsum dbyer med sems su 'dus// sems nyid mkha' ltar dag pa na// mnyam bzhag rjes 'jog med pa nyid// bden gnyis zung 'jug bzhi pa yin// zhes gsungs pa dang*/

rgyal po'i btsun mo ka pa ra bhū dza yis/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha la zhus pa la gsungs pa/ rig pa rtse gcig bum pa'i dbang*// bde ba spros bral gsang ba'i dbang*// bde stong ro gcig gsum pa'i dbang*// bsgom du med pa bzhi pa'o// zhes kyang gsungs la/ mdor na thabs lam pas 'khor lo bzhi yi rtsa mdud dral zhing thig rlung 'ching ba'i rim pas rnal 'byor bzhi rim du na 'pho bar gsungs pa rje btsun mi la'i rnam thar du bha bram pa sogs kyis gsungs pa'i lam rtags kyi nyams snang lan bzhir shar tshul dag tshul de lta bu'i sgo nas sngags lam gyi 'gros dang yang nges par mthun pa go dgos pa yin no// tshul 'di la rje rang byung zhabs kyis thog mar gdams pa dang rjes su bstan pa thob nas theg pa thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa ci ltar thos pa dang shes pa la brtson pas sems shing yid la rgyun chags su byed pa la mos pa dang dga' ba ni tshogs kyi lam ste zhe thag pas bsgrub pa ni nyams myong rtags dang 'bral ba'o// gzhan gyi ngo dang zhor byung gi ni ma yin no// de ltar rgyud la yod pa'i mi dge ba spong*/ dge ba'i ting nge 'dzin shes rab dang bcas pa spel nas nges 'byung drag pos stong nyid snying rje'i rgyus zin zhing bsam gtan dgu la sogs pa'i yan lag mngon shes drug dang bcas pa 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rgyu mtshan shes shing ci lta ba bzhin rtogs shing brten par bsgrubs nas bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams myong la ma chags shing spel bar byed/ thams cad byang chub chen po'i lam du bsgrub cing bsngo ba ni rtags dang 'brel ba yin la/ shes pa dang nyams myong la rlom pa dang*/ zhen pa med pa ni sbyor ba'i lam ste 'di la sngon gyi bla ma rnams nyams dang rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi so sor 'byung bar gsungs pa'i don/ dang po nyams kyi rnal 'byor la/ de ltar bsam gtan gyi bde gsal mi rtog pa 'dres shing ji tsam 'jog la dbang thob pa nyams kyi rtse gcig

/de'i ngang nas ngo bo stong nyid du bzhugs pa la blos ma bcos par stong pa dang 'dres na nyams kyi spros bral/ rjes thob spyod lam la rkyen gyis ma chod par ro snyoms pa nyams kyi ro gcig /de nas ring por mi thogs par khor yug tu bsgom med 'byung ba rnams sbyor lam yin la/ de nas 'jig rten las 'das pa ni mthong ba'i lam dang bsgom pa'i lam mo// sngar bsam gtan bzhi pa'i yang dag lta ba dang*/ bzhi pa'i nyams rtog dpyod dang dga' mi dga' dang*/ bde sdug dang dran rig g.yo ba dang rlung rgyu ba'i skyon brgyad dang bral zhing rtse gcig tu gyur pa dang 'dres pa skad cig gcig dang ldan pa/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi mngon sum du byed pa thob na nyams kyi bsgom med yin kyang*/ rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor yin no// skabs 'dir chos rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab ngo bo ting nge 'dzin dang 'dres pa thob la/ dran pa la gnas pa sangs rgyas kyi bar du rgyun mi 'chad par sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus dang 'bral ba/ lus dang sems shin tu sbyangs pa/ rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po grub pa'i dga' ba khyad par can/ le lo med pa'i btang snyoms chen po rnams gcig tu byung na nyams myong rtags dang 'bral ba'o// de rnams ma tshang na nyams yin gyi phyag rgya chen po rtogs pa ma yin no// de nas mthong lam thob cing mthong ba de nyid goms par byed pa ni bsgom pa'i lam ste/ srid zhi gnyis kyi mtha' spangs pa'i mnyam bzhag gi ngo bo nam mkha'i dkyil lta bur snang zhing*/ 'du byed sgyu ma dang rmi lam lta bur gyur nas rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin la brten nas mnyam par bzhag pas sangs rgyas kyi ci lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes sgrub cing rjes thob sgyu ma lta bur sems can yongs su smin pa dang zhing yongs su sbyong bar byed pas ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes sgrub/

sa drug pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rtsal rdzogs pa'i tshe rtogs pa'i spros bral te/ srid zhi gnyis la skrag pa dang 'gag pa'i sems bral bas so// gang gi tshe yid kyi dri ma drung nas phyung bas na sangs rgyas thams cad gyi gsang ba'i gnas la zhugs pas sa brgyad pa thob pa la srid zhi gnyis su mi rtog cing de bzhin nyid dang 'bras bu'i mtshan ma'i 'du shes gnyis kyis mi g.yo bas ro gcig chen po zhes bya'o// gang gi tshe sems la zag pa med pa'i las 'du byed dang bag chags phra mo'i nad dang*/ yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus dang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab par bsgyur ba'i 'chi 'pho'i rnam pa dang bral ba'i sangs rgyas kyi sa thob pa ni bsgom du med pa ste mthar thug pa'i phyir ro// don 'di ltar du thob na lam gyi ming du btags kyang rung ma btags kyang rung*/ rnal 'byor bzhi yi ming gis bshad pa yin no// mdor na/ so so'i skye bo'i sgom pa ni// rnam rtog lam du bslang ba ste// khams gsum spang bya mi rtog dang*// gnyen po'i rtog pa gnyis spel la// dran pas ma yengs brtag cing bsgom// bde gsal mi rtog ma skyes pa'i// shes bya shes kyang rgod 'thor te// rgyu 'bras rnam 'byed med pa yi// bsam gtan bzhi thob 'du shes bkag /mi khom du lhung phyir la lhung*// bdag med rkyang par rtogs gyur kyang*// rnam rtog rang dbang sgyur byed pa'i// nam mkha'i mdzod sogs ma sbyangs na// nyan thos zhi ba'i mtha' ru ltung*// chos kyi bzung don sbyong rtogs kyang*// snying rje chen po'i ting 'dzin gyis// 'gro ba'i don la ma sbyangs na// rang sangs rgyas kyi lam du 'gro// de phyir shes rab bdag med dang*// thabs sbyang snying rje chen po yis// bla med sangs rgyas bsgrub par bya// ma rtogs kha tshon mi bcad cing*// 'dzin pa'i thag pas 'ching mi bya// rgya chen bsgom pa gcig chod kyis// lam lnga sa bcu mthar phyin bya// zhes so// lam bgrod pa'i tshul 'di sngon gyi bla ma rtogs pa gcig chod du song ba rnams kyis gsungs pa la gzhan gyis dgag pa mdzad 'dug kyang dgag tu mi rung ste sgyu ma mkhan bzang po lung bstan pa'i mdo las/

sngar nyin de bzhin gshegs pa la ma dad pa'i so so'i skye bo phyir nyin sangs rgyas kyi rdzu 'phrul mthong bas sbyor lam gyi bzod pa thob/ de'i 'og tu chos bstan pas mthong lam thob la/ phyi dro bzhi pa sgrub pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs gsungs pa dang bzod pa chen po thob ste sa brgyad par gyur zhes gsungs te/ 'di la sa dang lam gyi yongs myong ma grub ces byar mi rung bas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas rtogs par bya'o// zhes rje rang byung zhabs kyis gsungs te rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi sa lam dang sbyor tshul 'di yang*/ khrid yig chen mo las/ rtse gcig tshogs sbyor spros bral mthong ba'i lam// ro gcig bsgom med 'bring man bsgom lam ste// bsgom med chen po rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas so// zhes gsungs pa ste gong ma rnams kyis bzhed pa so so dang bstun pa ni khrid yig nyid las rtogs par bya'o// de dag rnams kyi mdo don dril na rje phag gru'i gsung las/ gang zag dbang po'i bye brag gis// nyams kyi skyes tshul bsam mi khyab// de kun lam gyi bye brag ste// thabs la brten pa'i 'char lugs yin// dper na tshong dus chen po bzhin// mthar thug 'di la tha dad med// 'di la gnyis su yod min te// 'di la phyogs ris gang byed pa// khab mig nam mkha' ji bzhin no// de bzhin 'di la gzhi 'bras med// sa dang lam yang yod ma yin// nyams myong skye ba'i rim pa zhes// 'di la tha dad med gyur kyang*// 'on kyang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la// rang gi grib ma'i bye brag gi /zla ba 'phel dang 'grib par snang*// de bzhin kun gzhi chos kyi dbyings// ma chags rkyen gyis 'grib pa la// sna tshogs thabs kyis gdams pa yi// mthong dang shin tu mthong ba dang*// skyed du med pa'i rim pa yis// de yi dbye ba bstan par bya// rnal 'byor shin tu rnal 'byor dang*// rnal 'byor chen po'i rim pa yis// nyams kyi skye lugs rim par bstan// zhes dang*/

'di la the tshom mi dgos te// nyi ma shar ba tsam gyis ni// sa gzhi dro bar ma nus kyang*// rim gyis 'od zer rgyas nas dros// nor bu lon pa tsam gyis ni// dgos 'dod 'byung bar mi 'gyur te// mchod dang gsol ba btab na 'byung*// byis pa mi las ma 'das kyang*// skyes ma thag tu stobs ldan min// rim gyis bslab pas sna tshogs shes// de bzhin bden pa'i don mthong yang*// ma goms yon tan 'byung mi 'gyur// goms pa la ni mchog thob bo// thun mong grub chen brgyad la sogs// 'di kun rten cing 'brel ba'i mthus// nga rgyal rlom par bcas pa yis// mngon par shes pa 'char bas phung*// mchog la ma sleb de yis bsgribs// lha sogs 'gro ba ma lus la// las kyi rdzu 'phrul bsam mi khyab// de kun thar pa'i sgyur ma gsungs// yang dag bden rdzun zad pa la// rtags dang mtshan ma ga la yod// 'on kyang 'di la the tshom 'byung*// zhes sogs dang*/ rtags dang mtshan ma 'byung mi 'byung gi dwogs sel yang khrid yig tu 'byung ba ltar mang du gsungs so// de ltar don de lta bu'i tshul gyis shes rab dri ma med pas lhag mthong gi ye shes ji lta ba bzhin rtogs pa'i tshe chos lam du 'gro ba'am song ba zhes bya ste bla na med pa'i sngags kyi sgra don ji lta ba bzhin par song ba'i phyir ro// spyi don gsum pa lam 'khrul pa bsal ba ni rtse gcig spros bral gyi ting nge 'dzin mthar phyin te mthong nas spang bya'i spros pa thams cad rtsa ba nas bral ba la gnyen po'i spros pa rags pa dang yang bral ba'i phyir lam 'khrul pa sel ba zhes bya ste lho la yag pas mdzad pa'i chos bzhi chen mo las/ bde stong nang du gzung 'dzin dag cing*/ brtan dang g.yo ba'i dngos po 'di kun// kun rdzob lha dang gnas su snang zhing*// 'dod dang grol ba'i dngos grub thob tshe// lam gyi 'khrul pa sel ba de yin// zhes sogs gsungs pa lta bu'o// spyi don bzhi pa 'khrul pa ye shes su 'char pa zhes bya ba ni/

ro gcig bsgom med kyi ting nge 'dzin mthar phyin te chos thams cad lhan cig skyes pa bde ba chen po gsang ba bla na med pa'i sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings mngon du gyur te sgrib gsum bag chags kyi sa rnams ma spangs gnas su dag cing lhun grub rdo rje ye shes kyi phrin las 'gyur med rgyun gyi dag pa ni 'khrul pa ye shes su 'char ba zhes gsungs te/ snga ma las/ sgrib pa kun gyi dri ma bral ba// rang bzhin dag pa'i rang sems chos sku// dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa// dag pa gnyis ldan byang chub chen po// gnas gzhan gyur pas 'khrul pa nyid kyang*// kun mkhyen ye shes nyid du 'char te// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i don ji lta ba nyid do// rje dwags po rin po che nyid kyis kyang*/ yid 'byung ba tshad du skyo ba gcig gis blo chos su song nas chos lam du 'gro ba la byams snying rje bdag pas gzhan gces kyi blo kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems/ de'i steng du phyi nang gi chos thams cad rten 'brel tshogs pa'i snang ba rmi lam lta bur go na gdod chos lam du 'gro ba yin/ de ltar go nas lam gyi 'khrul pa sel bya ba/ dang po mi rtag pa bsgoms pas tshe 'di la zhen pa'i 'khrul pa sel/ las rgyu 'bras bsgoms pas lta ba ngan pa'i 'khrul pa sel/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgoms pas 'khor ba la chags pa'i 'khrul pa sel/ byams dang snying rje bsgom pas theg dman gyi 'khrul pa sel/ rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur bsgoms pas dngos por 'dzin pa'i 'khrul pa sel/ lar gong ma gong mas 'og ma 'og ma'i 'khrul pa sel gsungs/ de nas 'khrul pa ye shes su 'char bar bya ba don dam par chos thams cad skye 'gag dang bral bar bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis cir snang cir rtogs thams cad rang gi ngo bor chod tsam na 'khrul pa ye shes su 'char ba yin gsungs kyang mdor na de lta bu'i don rtogs shing khong du chud na sangs rgyas la skyabs su song ba yin/
