chos thams cad de nyid yin pas rtog pa lam du byed na chos la skyabs su song ba yin/ de ltar rtog pa lam du byed pa'i mkhan po de rten med pa'i rig pa las byung bas thogs pa med pa'i shes rab dge 'dun la skyabs su song ba yin/ de lta bu'i khyad par can gyi lam de la rtog pa ci skyes thams cad pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam du 'gro/ thabs su 'gro/ rtog pa nyid kyis bskul ma btab nas grogs su 'gro ste/ rtog pa rang gi mtshan nyid shes pa ni shes rab/ rtog pa thams cad lam du byung bas bsam gtan/ rtog pa skyes tshad lam nyid du skyes pas yongs su sbyong ba'i brtson 'grus/ chos nyid zab mo'i don la mi skrag pas bzod pa/ de lta bu'i bsam gtan de la nyon mongs pa'i sa bon med pas zag pa med pa'i tshul khrims/ de lta bu'i thabs shes kyi rten 'brel lag tu blangs pas de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rje ngang ngam shugs kyis skyes nas ci byed sems can gyi don du 'gro bas sbyin pa'o// de ltar sgrub pa'i lag char khyer bas phyir mi ldog pa thob ste sems rtag pa gnyis med sku bzhir khyer bas rnam mkhyen/ thams cad lam du shes pas lam shes/ gdod nas rtog pa rang gi mtshan nyid yin par shes pas gzhi shes/ rgyu lam 'bras bu ngo bo gcig tu sbyong pas rnam kun mngon rdzogs/ de ltar shes pa'i shes rab rno zhing rtsal sbyong ba la tshegs med pas rtse mo/ rtog pa mi spong bar mthar gyis sgrub pas mthar gyis pa/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du shes pas skad cig ma/ byang chub pa thams cad chos sku'i phrin las su longs spyod pas sku yongs rdzogs te skabs brgyad/ yang rtog pa dge sbyor gyi grogs su 'gro bas tshogs lam/ rtog pa la brten nas lam khyad par can skye bas sbyor lam/ rtog pa sku bzhir myong bas mthong lam/ rtog pa sku bzhi dang mi 'bral bas bsgom lam/

de las phul phyin gzhan med pas mthar phyin pa'i lam mo// yang dran pa gang byung lam du 'gro bas dran pa nye bar gzhag pa/ rtog pa mi spang bar mtshan nyid shes pa'i shes rab yang dag spong ba/ de la rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dad pas rgyu byas nas dran pas lam byas brtson 'grus kyi grogs byas pa'i thabs dang de ltar shes pa'i shes rab kyi rten 'brel gyi lha thams cad ting nge 'dzin du byung bas 'bras bu/ de ltar dbang po lnga lag tu blangs pas shes rab kyi rtsal dang byang chub kyi sems 'byongs pa la tshegs med pas stobs lnga/ de la brten nas dran rig thams cad byang chub kyi grogs su 'gro bas byang chub kyi yan lag thams cad byang chub kyi yan lag tu longs spyod pas rnam rtog gis mi gos pa de nyid 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad/ de ltar lta ba'i go chas chos kyi brdar sha bcad pas gol sa'i mtha' bkag nas shes rab kyi go chas rtog pa lam du khyer nas blo 'das bsgom pa'i shes rab kyi dran pa la dbang bsgyur zhing rtog pa yon tan gyi bdag nyid mi spong bar rang gi mtshan nyid shes pas sku bzhi ngo bo nyid kyis 'byung ste yon tan gyi chos thams cad 'gag med shugs kyis 'byung zhing mtshan ma'i rtog pa rang zhi rang dag mtsho la 'khyag pa zhu ba'am nam mkha' la sprin dengs pa bzhin song ba'i tshe na rnam rtog sku bzhir thul bas 'dul ba/ rtog pa chos nyid du mthong bas tshad ma/ rtog pa rtsa bral du shes pas mtha' bral dbu ma zhes kyang bya'o// zhes gsungs/ mchan/ 'di ni rje dwags po rin po ches kho bo mjal ba dang khyad med du gsungs par grags pa'i lam mchog rin chen phreng ba'i nang nas btus pa yin/ gzhan rgya ston pa sogs gong ma rnams pa phal cher gyi khrid yig tu gnyug ma ngo sprod kyi skabs der lam gyi chos mtha' dag nyams len gyi ngo sprod pa'i mdo rgyud kyi lung sbyor mang po mdzad snang bas de rnams su shes par bya zhing*/

gzhan yang chos rje rang byung pas mdzad pa'i mdo lung dang gzhan phyag chen lung sbyor gyi rigs mang du snang ba rnams rgyab chos 'di'i skabs gang 'gab tu bshad par bya'o// des dpyod ldan yid ches kyi gdengs dang ldan par 'gyur ro// mchan/

de ltar chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs mtha' dag rang sems 'od gsal chos kyi dbyings kho nar 'du ba'i yin lugs ji lta ba khong du chud nas nges shing rtogs la goms pa'i gdengs thob par bya'o// de ltar yang rje rang byung zhabs kyis/ tshogs drug shes pa gsal la mi rtog pa// mngon sum rtog bral shes shing goms pa la// brten nas rang rig yid kyi mngon sum ni// de ma thag bcas chu zla lta bur mthong*// de la brten nas sgrib bcas kun gzhi dang*// sgrib med me long lta bu'i ye shes ni// gnas lugs rjes su dpag pa'i tshul du mthong*// nyon mongs mngon gyur rags dang bag la nyal// gnyen po spang 'gyur rang ngo rtogs byas nas// spang gnyen gnyis kyi rtog tshogs ji snyed pa// so sor rtog pa'i shes rab dag pa dang*// de'i ting nge 'dzin la dbang thob pas// de tshe kun gzhi mngon sum snang bar 'gyur// de bzhin nyid dang 'bras bu'i rtog pa kun// grol ba'i skad cig de la kun gzhi dag /de tshe sangs rgyas byang chub thob pa yin// kye ma tshul 'di ma rtogs pas// byis pa bdag dang bdag gir bcings// nyan thos gang zag bdag med kyi// gnyen po'i 'ching bas bcings par 'gyur// chos kyi gzung rtog rtsal sbyong bas// rang rgyal thob kyang 'dzin pa'i cha// kun gzhi ma rtogs lam du lus// thams cad rtogs pa rdzogs sangs rgyas// yin phyir bla na med pa yin// zhes gsungs pa'i don shes shing rtogs par mdzod cig / byas la maṇḍal gtor 'bul sman lam gdab pa sogs bya'o// nyi ma so dgu chos thun nyer bzhi pa'o// ༈ chos thun nyer lnga pa la yang sngar bzhin tshig gi mtshams sbyor byas nas/ de ltar lam gyi rim pa rnams bgrod pas gzhi yi nyes pa rnams zad de mngon du gyur/ lam gyi nyes pa zad de mthar phyin/ gzhi thog tu 'bras bu slebs/ chos can gyi dngos po thams cad ma 'gag par snang bzhin du rang rig ngo bos stong*/

stong pa'i bzhugs tshul de nyid las chos can ji snyed gcig snang ba thams cad dang de las logs su ma grub cing gnyis su med pas gnyis 'dzin dang re dwogs 'khor ba las grol/ rtogs pa mthar phyin te stobs dang mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa yon tan du ma dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i don rtogs shing sku lnga ye shes lnga yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i bdag nyid can bsgom med mthar thug rtogs shing sgrib pa mtha' dag las grol lo// rtogs bya thams cad rtogs pa dang rnam par smin pa sogs kyi yon tan ma lus pa mngon du byas pa de la 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po zhes bya/ skabs 'dir spro na thar rgyan gyi 'bras bu phrin las dang bcas pa'i le'u bshad do // spyir phyi nang gi chos thams cad snang rig stong gsum las ma 'das pa sku gsum gyi ngo bo yin no// de dag gzhi lam 'bras bu dang sbyar na/ gzhi'i dus su rang sems cir yang ma grub pa spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i dbyings stong par 'char ba de chos sku/ dpe til la snum gyis khyab pa lta bu de'ang stong pa cang med bem po lta bu ma yin par stong pa rang rig rang gsal rang bzhin sna tshogs su rig pas longs sku dpe nor bu baiḍūrya lta bu/ stong nyid mdangs ma 'gag par rang gzugs yul sna tshogs su shar ba sprul sku dpe ma bcos smyag ma lta bu yin gsungs/ de bzhin du rje rang byung ba/ phag mo gru pa/ zhang rin po che rnams kyis gsung gi gzhi phyag rgya chen po gnyug ma don gyi ye shes la sku lnga ye shes lnga/ yon tan ma lus pa rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i tshul du ngo sprad tshul rgyas par 'byung ba khrid yig chen mor gsal ba ltar shes shing the tshom chod par bya ba gal che ste/ rtogs pa'i yin lugs rang ngo shes pa'i rnal 'byor mngon sum gyi spyod yul du de dag bsnyon med du mngon par grub la/ tshul mthong blo yi ra ris spyad pa rnams kyi ngor yid ches skye ba dka' na'ang gzhi gdod nas rang bzhin rnam dag la 'khrul pa med cing dbyer med lhan skyes gsum la brten nas chos thams cad bdag nyid dngos med dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin du bzhugs tshul sngar zhib tu bshad pa ltar 'dir yang 'bras bu gtan la dbab pa'i dbang du byas nas sngar bshad pa de rnams mtha' dag gi snying por bsdus nas nges pa'i don du bzung bya yin tshul cung zad bshad na rje btsun chen po mi la ras pa'i zhal nas/

phyag rgya chen po'i mtshan nyid bstan pa ni gsum ste/ gzhi phyag rgya chen po/ lam phyag rgya chen po/ 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po/ dang po ni dngos po gshis kyi gnas lugs sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa/ sems can gyi sems nyid/ kha dog dbyibs su ma grub/ mtha' dang dbus su ma grub/ rgya chad phyogs lhung dang bral ba/ yod ma myong*/ med ma myong*/ ma 'khrul/ ma grol/ rgyus ma bskyed/ rkyen gyis ma bsgyur/ sangs rgyas mkhas te ma mdzad/ sems can ngan te ma bcos/ rtogs pas bzang du ma song*/ 'khrul pas ngan du ma song ba de ni gzhi kun la khyab par gnas so// lam phyag rgya chen po ni gzhi de'i steng du nyams su blang bya'i chos/ 'jog dus dmigs med du 'jog /gnas dus yengs med du gnas/ khyer dus 'dzin med du khyer/ 'char dus chos nyid du 'char/ grol dus rang grol du grol ba gcig tu nyams su len pa'o// 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po ni/ grol bya grol byed dang bral ba/ re ba dwogs pa dang bral ba/ blo zad chos zad 'dzin zhen dang bral ba/ blo 'das bzlas brjod dang bral ba'o// zhes gsungs pas/ 'o na gzhi 'gyur med de ji ltar 'khrul pa yin na/ gnas lugs rang snang ngo bos stong zhing stong pa rig pa'i snying po can sku gsum dbyer med du gnas pa de rang dang lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pas ngo ma shes te/ gang ma shes na mig gis mig ma mthong ba ltar ngo bo rang gis rang ma shes/ gang gis ma shes na thag pa la sbrul du btags pa ltar rang rig 'khrul par shar nas ma shes/ ji ltar ma shes na mun nag la gzugs brnyan nam mar me'i rang grib bzhin du shes pa tshom mun pa gcig tu skyes nas rang ngo ma shes/ tshul ci'i phyir ma shes na de'ang gnas lugs de ngos bzung med pas ma shes te nam mkha' la ri mo ma btub pa dang 'dra/ yul yul can du ma gyur pas ma rig ste a yu ra'i mi lta bu'am rang gi gdong pas gdong pa mi mthong ba dang 'dra/

ngo sprod mkhan med pas ma rig ste rgyal bu rmongs su 'khyams pa dang 'dra/ dbyings stong nyid la cir yang 'char du btub pas ma rig ste sman dug tu song ba dang 'dra/ ngo bo rang rig tu gnas pa de phyin ci log tu btags pas 'khrul pa ste/ byi las mjug ma ded pa dang 'dra ba'o// yang nye drags pas ngo ma shes/ sla drags pas yid ma ches/ zab drags pas ngos ma zin/ bzang drags pas blor ma shong*/ zhes sogs gsungs pa lta bu'o// de la kun tu brtags pa'i ma rig pa ni/ lhan skyes kyi ma rig pa gti mug tshom mun pa de la de ma thag log pa'i rig pa khyur gyis ldang nas stong pa la spros pa byung*/ rig pa la bdag 'dzin bdag 'dzin las gzhan yul/ de las chags sdang rmongs pas las bsags pas rnam smin myong ba de yi skad cig ma rgyun dang bcas pa 'dra ba gzhan 'byung dang yod pa dmigs nas rtag chags zhen yul gyi 'khrul pa'i mthu brtas pas 'khor ba smin te kun gzhi lung ma bstan ma rig pa'i tshul du 'khor ba thog mtha' med par 'khor te/ rgyan las/ rgyun du mi bskor 'khor lo 'khor// zhes pa lta bu'o// de dag gi don 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal nas/ sgyu ma ji lta ji lta bar// de bzhin sems can yul la spyod// 'gro ba sgyu ma'i chos la spyod// de bzhin du ni brten nas 'byung*// ji ltar ri mo mkhan gyi gzugs// gnod sbyin 'jigs pa bris pa yi// de yi bdag nyid skrag pa ltar// mi mkhas 'khor bar de bzhin no// ji ltar rang gis 'dam g.yos par// byis pa 'ga' zhig byings pa ltar// de bzhin rtog pa'i 'dam byings pas// sems can rnams ni dbyung mi nus// dngos med dngos por lta ba yi// sdug bsngal tshor ba nyams su myong*// yul dang shes pa de dag tu// rnam par rtog pa'i dug gis bcings// zhes gsungs pas rten cing 'brel 'byung rkyen 'di nyid 'di pa tsam ma brtags gcig pu nyams dga' ba'i tshul la rmongs nas mthar ltung ba'i lta ba dang lta ba ma yin pa la der 'dzin zhugs nas bden gnyis 'khrul med kyi tshul la rmongs par gyur pas 'khrul pa de zad pa'i cha nas sangs rgyas thob pa btags par zad kyi/

de ltar 'khrul pa'i dus nyid na'ang sku gsum gyi ngo bo phyag rgya chen po'i rang rtsal kho na dngos min pa med de/ yum las/ ma rig pa rnam par dag pas/ gzugs rnam par dag pa/ gzugs rnam par dag pas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid rnam par dag pa ste/ de ltar na/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ma rig pa'ang ngos bzung med pa'i rang bzhin chos sku/ bdag tu bzung ba'i rig pa'i ngo bo longs sku// bdag gzhan sna tshogs su snang ba ni mtshan nyid sprul sku ste 'khrul pa ngo ma shes pa tsam ma gtogs ngo bo rang bzhin mtshan nyid gsum sku gsum du lam me/ las kyi mthar thug mtshams med pa'i mi dge ba spyad pa dang kun 'byung mthar thug nyon mongs pa dug lnga drag pos non pa'i tshe na'ang rang rig rang gsal rang snang skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral bar sku gsum du lam me/ 'khrul snang gi mthar thug dmyal ba tsha grang gi sdug bsngal shar dus kyang dmyal ba'i snang rig de ka sku gsum gyi bdag nyid du yod pa ngo ma shes nas dmyal snang du bzung bas len pa 'di la 'khrul lugs phyag rgya chen po bya ba yin gsungs/ don 'di la rje sgam po po pas/ rgyu 'bras dus mtshungs a mri ta// re dwogs med pas 'bras bu yin// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ 'di nyid 'khor ba zhes bya ste// 'di nyid mya ngan 'das pa'o// 'khor ba spangs nas gzhan du ni// mya ngan 'das pa rtogs mi 'gyur// zhes dang*/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te// gang la srid dang mya ngan 'das 'phro ba// 'dod pa'i 'bras bu ster bar byed pa yi// yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sems la phyag 'tshal lo// ces gsungs pa lta bu'i don no// lam phyag rgya chen po ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid lam// zhes dang*/ kun lam pha rol phyin pa 'di yin gzhan ma yin// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ 'di ni rnam dag legs pa'i lam// zhes gsungs pa dang*// spyir lam gyi 'dzam gling rol pa'i rdo rje'i zhal snga nas/

chos thams cad rgyas 'gyur gyi chos sku dang*/ bye brag tu 'o skol thar pa don gnyer gyi blo bskyed pa nas da lta rang ngo 'phrod pa'i nges pa rnyed cing mthar thug goms pa klong du ma gyur gyi bar mchan snying po de yi 'od zer ni// rgyas pa'i rigs zhes bya ba yod// dri ma sbyong byed lam bden yin// zhes dang*/ rgyud bla mar yang*/ chos sku rnam gnyis shes bya ste// chos dbyings shin tu dri med dang*// de yi rgyu mthun zab pa dang*// sna tshogs tshul ni ston pa'o// zhes gsungs pa las bod rnams sangs rgyas kyi sa gsungs pa'i theg chen zab pa dang sna tshogs pa'i chos rgya che ba la bstan pa chos sku zhes 'dod pa de lta bu ni ma yin par yang gong ma rnams bzhad do// mchan/ gyi thabs shes de rnams lam snying po'i rang 'gros yin pas tshul 'di/ rje rang byung zhabs kyis/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi// snying po dri med bden gnyis ldan// 'di ni ye shes rdo rje ru// kun rdzob gzung 'dzin snang ba ste// bden pa chu zla lta bu'o// don dam stong nyid bco brgyad po// bden pa gnyis med ye shes brjod// de rtogs byed pa'i rtogs pas bskyed// gnyen po sbyong byed yin par bshad// sbyong gzhi'i grangs bzhin chos kun bstan// zhes dang*/ de yang bsdu na chos sku mthong ba la sgrib byed bzhi'i gnyen po ste/ sgrib pa mthong yang bsgom spangs te// gnyen po mos dang bdag med dang*// ting 'dzin snying rje rnam pa bzhi// des sbyang*/ zhes gsungs pas theg chen la mos pa/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab/ nam mkha' mdzod la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ snying rje chen po dang bzhi ste/ rgyud bla ma las/ theg mchog la mos sa bon shes rab ni// sangs rgyas chos skyed ma dang bsam gtan gyi// bde ba'i mngal gnas snying rje'i ma ma can// gang yin de dag thub pa'i rjes skyes sras// zhes gsungs/

de'ang stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can la 'du ba'i phyir/ lam phyag rgya chen po dngos kyi ngo bo ni/ lam gyi bden pa 'phags lam yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i mnyam bzhag sgom tshul/ 'jog dus dmigs med la 'jog /ces sogs gsungs pa'i shes rab dang thabs dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen po kho na la lam mtha' dag gi sdud po yin pas de'i phyir/ gong ma rnams lam la sems nyid phyag rgya chen po dang*/ snang srid phyag rgya chen po dang gnyis su gsungs pa'i dang po la yin lugs shes pa'i lta ba dang yin bzhin bzhag pa'i sgom pa gnyis shes rab kyi cha sngar bshad pa ltar yin la/ snang rig stong gsum dbyer med zung 'jug tu ngo shes shing nyams su len pa snang srid phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba rang sems stong pa'i rang gzugs la shar ba'i 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor byings pa rnams khams gsum rgya theg chen por sgrol ba'i thabs kyi bya ba snying rje dang bcas pa gnyis po de lam du 'jog la/ skabs don 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po ni/ chos thams cad sku gsum gyi rang gzugs dang rang 'gros su bshad pa ltar lam dang 'bras bu so sor lung gi'ang sbyar du yod mod kyi 'bras bu mthar phyin pa'i sku gsum ni dbyings rang bzhin rnam dag ye shes kyi ngo bor shar bas gnyis chos thams cad de'i ngang du zhi bas spros pa thams cad dang bral ba de chos sku/ ye shes spros pa med pa zag med kyi bde bas longs spyod pa longs sku/ gdangs ma 'gag par smon lam dang thugs rje'i rang gzugs su snang ba sprul sku/ sangs rgyas kyi bzhugs tshul dbyer med des 'khor 'das kyi chos mtha' dag la mi gnas pa'i shes rab dang dmigs pa med pa'i snying rjes 'khor ba ji srid du 'gro don rgyun mi 'chad pa'i phrin las 'byung ba'o// de'ang de dag thob tshul la dbye na theg pa 'og ma gzhi spang ba'i lam gyi 'bras bu gnas skabs lha mi dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu dgra bcom pa thob la/

theg chen gzhi sbyang ba'i lam pas kun rdzob dang don dam gyi sems bskyed nas tshogs gnyis rgya chen po bsags pa'i nus pa mthar phyin nas bskal pa grangs med gsum la sogs pas sangs rgyas par bshad/ gsang sngags bla med gzhi bsgyur ba'i lam pas dbang 'og ma gsum la brten nas bskyed rim dang rtsa rlung dang bde ba'i rnal 'byor gyi nyon mongs pa dug lnga dug gsum sku dang ye shes phung khams skye mched lha dang lha mo'i rnam par bsgom nas gzugs snang stong zung 'jug lha yi sku/ ngag grags stong zung 'jug sngags kyi sgra/ yid rig stong zung 'jug chos nyid kyi mdangs su bsgyur nas bsgoms pas gzugs sku rdzogs par byed cing dbang bzhi pa la brten nas thabs shes kyi cha mthar phyin pas chos sku rdzogs pa ste/ dbang rab tshe gcig lus gcig /'bring skye ba gsum/ tha ma skye ba bdun nas dam tshig ma nyams na sangs rgyas te phrin las rab 'byams kyi sprul pa sna tshogs pas 'gro don mdzad phal che bar bzhed la/ phyag rgya chen po snying po'i don/ gzhi mtshan nyid yongs su shes pa'i lam pas dbang dus su dbang bzhi pa gtso bor byas/ lam dus su phyag rgya chen po gtso bor bya/ 'bras dus su sngon la chos sku rdzogs par thob nas gzugs sku gnyis de'i rang rtsal du lhun grub tu 'byung bar bzhed de/ tai lo pa/ blo yi chos kyis blo 'das don mi rtogs// byas pa'i chos kyis byar med don mi rtogs// zhes dang*/ do ha las/ gal te yid du 'ong ngo snyam pa'i sems// snying la 'bab cing gces par 'dzin pa yi// til gyi shun pa tsam gyi zhen pas kyang*// nam yang sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig skyed par byed// ces gsungs/ de'ang sngar bshad pa ltar shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ye gdod ma nas skye 'gag la sogs mtha' gang du'ang ma grub par dus gsum dus med du gnas shing rnam thar sgo bzhi'i rang bzhin smra bsam brjod bral gnyug ma gshis kyi gnas lugs ci lta ba rang thog tu phyin cing 'gag med kyi rtsal phyogs med du shar ba de la rang rig rnam par dag pa gnas tshul ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes zer te/

rma bya'i mdangs ni gcig pu la// rgyu yi dbye ba ji snyed pa// de mkhyen pa ni kun mkhyen te// kun mkhyen ye shes min pas min// zhes dang*/ mkhyen pa'i skad cig gcig gis ni// shes bya'i dkyil 'khor kun khyab can// zhes dang*/ rkang gnyis gtso la snang ba med// ye shes dbyings na thams cad mkhyen// ces gsungs pa lta bu'o// de la'ang gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i gzung 'dzin rnam par dag pas dngos mtshan du 'dzin pa gdod ma nas ma dmigs na yang snang tshul chos can ji snyed pa'ang rgyu rkyen 'bras bu'i gnas lugs ma 'dres yongs rdzogs su dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du ji snyed gzigs shing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes lhun gyis grub pas ye shes la dbang bsgyur nas skad cig ma bskal par byin gyis rlabs pa sogs ye shes rnam par dag pa'i rang gdangs shar ba'i thugs rje dang phrin las kyi gdul bya'i bye brag sna tshogs pa'i khams dang dbyer med du bzhugs pa ste/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub kyi spyod pa rlabs po che la zhugs nas ngal zhing dub pa med par sems can gyi don du shes bya mtha' yas pa la rtsal sbyang ba'i sems bskyed bzang po'i thugs dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dbyer med du bzhugs pa'i rang gzugs su nges pa lnga dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku gnas nges pa 'og min/ sku nges pa mtshan dpes brgyan pa/ 'khor nges pa sa bcu'i byang sems/ dus nges pa 'khor ba ma stong bar du/ chos nges pa theg chen ston bzhin par bzhugs pa'o// yang byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa dang nyan rang dang so skye las dag pa rnams kyi dad pa'i dbang po dang zhi bde'i myang 'das la mos pa'i blo rnams dang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dbyer med du bzhugs pa'i rang gzugs mchog gi sprul pa'i sku ma nges pa lnga dang ldan pa gnas ma nges pa rigs drug gi zhing khams/

sku ma nges pa gang la gang 'dul/ 'khor ma nges pa theg pa che chung gi dge 'dun dang rigs drug gi sems can/ chos ma nges pa theg pa sna tshogs pa'i chos/ dus ma nges pa rtsod ldan gyi dus sogs su 'byon zhing nyan rang sogs kyi spyod yul du mchog gi sprul pa nyon mongs dang 'dod yon spangs pa'i cha lugs can 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid ston zhing mya ngan las 'das pa sogs bstan nas theg pa de dag gi don mdzad/ rigs drug gi sems can so so'i las dang bsam pa'i bye brag sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang dbyer med du bzhugs pa'i rang gzugs so so'i skal pa dang mthun pa'i gang 'dul gyis sprul pa'i skur snang ba ste/ mdo phal po che las/ chos dbyings dam pa bde bar gshegs pa ste// sems can kun gyi khams dang mnyam par 'gyur// bsam pa sna tshogs rgyal ba'i chos nyid las// bsam gyis mi khyab dri med rab tu 'jug /ces gsungs/ gsang sngags snga 'gyur rnying ma'i rgyud sogs nas/ rigs drug 'dul ba'i don du sprul pa'i sku thub pa drug tu bzhugs nas dmyal bar zhe sdang gi bsam gzugs gshin rje chos kyi rgyal por shar nas rgyu 'bras tsha grang gi sdug bsngal la sogs pas sbyang nas mthar bde ba la 'god par mdzad cing rgyu 'bras mi bslu bar ston pa yin la/ yi dwags ser sna'i sems gzugs kha 'bar rgyal mor shar nas bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal sbyong nas bde ba la bkod pas/ rtsa rgyud gsang ba snying po las/ srid gsum 'gro ba bsam yas su// thugs rje'i bstan pa bsam mi khyab// don dang mthun pa 'ba' zhig ston// mi mthun 'khor ba'i zhags pa gcod// la lar rab byung dka' thub mdzad// la lar khab dang rgyal srid 'dzin// la lar mya ngan 'das tshul ston// khro la khro dang mun la mun// g.yem la g.yem ston de bzhin no// zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o// de dag kyang dbyings rang bzhin rnam dag chos sku las g.yo ba'i 'du 'dzi mdzad par rang snang la chos sku mtshan nyid bzhi ldan du bzhugs pa ste/

rgyud bla mar/ de ni rang bzhin dag phyir dang*// bag chags spang phyir gtsang ba yin// bdag dang bdag med spros pa dag /nye bar zhi ba dam pa'i bdag /yid kyi rang bzhin phung po dang*// de rgyu log phyir bde ba yin// 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das// mnyam pa nyid du rtogs phyir rtag /ces dang*/ gser 'od la/ sangs rgyas rnams ni chos kyi sku// 'dren pa rnams ni chos nyid lta// zhes pa lta bu'o// de ltar rang bzhin rnam dag 'di la ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang*/ zag pa med pa'i yon tan gyi chos rnams mngon du byas shing stobs sogs bral ba'i 'bras bu phrin las dang bcas pa ston pa la chos kyi sku zhes pha rol tu phyin pa las gsungs te/ thub pa'i ngo bo nyid sku ni// zag pa med pa'i chos gang dag /thob gyur rnam kun rnam dag pa// zhes dang*// chos sku mdzad pa dang bcas pa// zhes sogs gsungs/ tshul 'di sngags la chos dbyings shin tu dri ma med pa nam mkha'i sku can/ de'i rgyu mthun pa rab tu zab pas sgrub pa'i chos kyi sku ni ye shes gzhan bzhi po ste ye shes de'i sku la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo las nyi ma'i sku zhes gsungs pas/ rje rang byung zhabs kyis/ rgyal ba nam mkha'i sku can ye shes nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor las// zhes gsungs/ yang 'di dag kyang lhun grub mngon gyur du thob pa dang gnas 'gyur du gsungs pa'ang tha dad ma yin te/ gnas 'gyur gyi don dri bcas dri med du gyur pa la/ ngo bo gzhan du gyur pa ma yin te/ gnas ma lus pa gyur pa gang zhe na/ gang mi slob pa'i lam thob pa'i gnas gyur pa dang*/ lam gyi gnas gyur pa dang*/ gnas ngan len gyi gnas gyur pa'o// zhes gsungs pa'i dang po ni dag pa gnyis ldan du gyur pa dang*/ gnyis pa ni mthong lam mi slob pa'i lam du gyur cing lam rdzogs pa dang*/ gsum pa ni/ mngon brjod tshor ba nyon mongs las rnam smin// gsum gyi sgrib pa sgrib rtog zas 'khrig rmi// na rga 'chi dang yongs ngal brtan pa dang*// che sogs nyon mongs snyoms 'jug shes sgrib kyi'o// zhes ming la zhen pa mngon brjod kyi gnas ngan len sogs rnam grangs nyer bzhi tsam gyi gnas ngan len gyi sgrib pa rnams ma lus pa dag pa sogs la gnas 'gyur du bshad pa dang*/

yang*/ kun gzhi dag pa me long chos kyi sku// nyon mongs yid dang 'dzin pa rnam rtog dag /mnyam nyid so sor rtogs dang longs spyod rdzogs// sgo lnga yid kyi char bcas dag pa yi// bya ba grub dang sprul pa'i sku chen po// rang gi ngo bo 'dus ma byas pa yi// mtshan nyid lnga ldan rgyal ba'i snying po ni// mngon du gyur pa 'bras bu mthar thug yin// zhes sogs gnas 'gyur du gsungs pa'ang sngar bshad ltar blo bur dri bral nyid yin la/ 'di ltar klu sgrub kyis kyang*/ gnas ni yongs su gyur pa de// chos kyi sku zhes brjod pa yin// bag chags las grol bsam mi khyab// 'khor ba'i bag chags bsam du yod// khyod ni kun tu bsam mi khyab// gang gis khyod ni shes par nus// ngag gi spyod yul kun las 'das// dbang po kun gyi spyod yul min// yid kyi shes pas rtogs bya ba// gang yang rung la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs pa rnams ci lta bar bka' brgyud gong ma'i bzhed pa rtogs pa'i 'gros la'ang yin pa la gnas 'gyur ram glo bur dri bral la sems kyi dwangs snyigs phyed pa zhes gsungs te/ rje mi las/ sems dang nam mkha' khyad med na// chos sku klong du gyur pa yin// zhes dang*/ khrid yig las/ 'bras bu nam mkha' lta bu'i 'char tshul/ zhes gsungs pa sogs ni rang bzhin rnam dag dang*/ 'byung ba dwangs snyigs phyed tsam na// rang byung rig pa'i ye shes de// dngul dkar me long phyis pa 'dra// kun gzhi chos sku thim tsam na// skye gnas sred len phung po de// sgo nga ldog pas brdzis pa 'dra// zhes dang*/ grub thob gling gis/ sems nyid dwangs snyigs phyed pa dang*// gnyug ma rang sa zin pa dang*// mnyam rjes med par brten pa gsum// 'di gsum sgom pa'i mthar thug yin// sogs glo bur dri bral du gsungs pa dang*/ tshul 'di lta bur/ pha dam pas kyang*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa de// rtog med sa ler mkhyen pa la// dus da lta'i sgom chen pho mo rnams// rtog med dran med bdud kyis khyer// mkhyen pa'i ye shes bogs ma thon// sgom gyi zhen pa je cher song*// tha mal gyi gseb na nyu le ma// grub thob rje dang ma mjal bas// sems dwangs snyigs ma phyed 'o re brgyal// zhes gsungs/

rgyan las kyang*/ ji ltar chu rnyogs pa las dwangs pa ni// dwangs pa de nyid de las skyes min gyi// de ni de la dri ma bral bar zad// de ltar rang sems dag la tshul de nyid// sems nyid rtag tu rang bzhin 'od gsal 'dod// ces gsungs pa dang*/ phar phyin las/ chos rnams rang bzhin gcig par ni// shes pas chags pa spangs pa yin// zhes sogs gsung*/ de ltar spangs pa phun sum tshogs pa'i sangs rgyas de la mkhyen pa phun sum tshogs pa'i ye shes dang yang ldan pa de rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pas/ nyon mongs ma lus spang phyir dang*// shes bya la ni blo rgyas phyir// sangs rgyas pad ma ltar sangs rgyas// de phyir sangs rgyas de sangs rgyas// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ yang rgyan las/ 'dzin pa'i phyir dang sems mnyam phyir// yang dag chos rab ston phyir dang*// bya ba grub pa nyid kyi phyir// ye shes bzhi po yang dag 'byung*// zhes thob pa'i rgyu dang bral ba'i 'bras bu gnyis kyi ye shes yod par brjod kyang rtog bcas su mi 'gyur te/ rgyan las/ ji ltar nyi ma'i 'od zer dag /'jug la bdag gir bya ba med// de bzhin sangs rgyas ye shes kyang*// 'jug la bdag gir mdzad mi mnga'// zhes gsungs/ 'o na ye shes de ji lta bu zhe na/ mdo las/ zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas// bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos shig kho bos rnyed// ces dang*/ smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin// ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// so sor rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes sogs gsungs pa lta bu dang*/ sngags las/ so so rang rig mi g.yo ba// mchog gi dang po sku gsum 'chang*// sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid can// khyab bdag ye shes lnga yi bdag /ces gsungs pa lta bu'o// rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i 'bras bu mthar thug gi ye shes yang 'di lta bu 'byung bar 'dod de/

rje dwags pos/ rnam dag ye shes snying po can// lhun grub rgyu 'bras gnyis su med// sku gsum rang la tshang tsam na// bsgom med mtha' ru phyin pa yin// zhes dang*/ 'di ltar pha dam pas kyang*/ sku gsum dbyer mi phyed pa lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'ba' zhig tu gnas pa la mkhyen pa'i ye shes me long g.ya' dag pa la gzugs brnyan shar ba me long dang dbyer mi phyed pa bzhin du rtogs pa ni lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bsgom du med par rtogs pa'o// zhes gsungs mdor na spangs rtogs bden dngos su bshad pa de'ang 'jig rten grags ngo'am kun rdzob snang tsam du zad de/ rgyud bla ma las/ rnam kun mngon rdzogs byang chub dang*// dri ma bag chags bcas spangs pa// sangs rgyas mya ngan 'das pa ni// dam pa'i don du gnyis med nyid// ces dang*/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med// bzhag par bya ba cung zad med// yang dag nyid la yang dag lta// yang dag mthong na rnam par grol// zhes gsungs pa'i tshul shes par bya'o// 'o na lam sgrub pa'i rnam smin gyi 'bras bu las sku dang ye shes dang phrin las gzhan phan dang 'brel ba 'byung ba'ang ma yin nam zhe na/ de dag kyang tshul 'di dang mi 'gal te/ rgyan la/ zag med dbyings las sangs rgyas rnams// mkha' ltar lus ni med pa dang*// sngon gyi lus rjes 'brang ba'i phyir// sangs rgyas gcig min mang po'ang min// zhes pa ltar yin la/ tshul 'dir ni lta sgom phyin ci ma log par spyad pa'i gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu dang sbyar na/ rje rang byung bas/ 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi// rgyu la brten pa'i 'bras bu rnams// rang dang gzhan gyi don gyur pa// rgya chen sangs rgyas sa la sbyor// zhes gsungs pas gnas skabs sbyin pa dang tshul khrims/ bzod pa dang*/ brtson 'grus dang*/ bsam gtan dang shes rab spyad pa'i 'bras bu longs spyod 'byung ba dang*/

spyod pa phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ zhe sdang dang bral nas dgra rnams 'dud pa dang*/ yon tan myur du 'grub pa dang*/ nyon mongs zhi zhing mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul thob pa dang*/ chos rnams mkhas shing spobs pa thob nas bden gnyis kyi tshul rigs pa dang*/ de thams cad kyang rang dang gzhan la phan pa'i rgyu 'bras kyi mtha' mi ldog par byas te mthar thug tu/ gzhan gyur mi bdag mi zad chos ldan phyir// 'gro skyabs phyi ma'i mtha' med mur thug phyir// de ni rtag tu gnyis med mi ldog phyir// zhes dang de ni yid kyi rang bzhin gyi// lus kyi skye mched rtag pa'i phyir// bsam gyis mi khyab bsgyur ba yi// 'chi 'pho brtan phyir de mi 'chi// bag chags phra mo'i nad rnams kyi// gnod med zhi ba nyid kyi phyir// zag med mngon par 'du byed kyi// g.yung drung phyir na rga ba med// ces pa ltar rang don 'grub cing*/ yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing*// ji ltar re ba yongs skong ba// de bzhin gdul bya'i bsod nams kyi// dbang gi rgyal ba'i skur snang ngo*// zhes dang*/ rgyan las/ ji ltar nor bu 'bad med par// rang 'od gcig char ston pa ltar// sangs rgyas rnams kyang zin med par// de bzhin mdzad pa nges par ston// zhes gzhan don dang 'brel ba'i tshul te 'di rnams kyi don/ rgyal ba mchog gi khrid yig chen mo las/ bzhi pa de ltar 'bras bu nyams su blangs pas/ shes rab ral gris sgrib pa kun bcad nas// mngon par sangs rgyas sku dang mdzad phrin gyis// 'khor ba ma stongs bar du 'gro don mdzad// ces gsungs pas 'di ltar 'bad pa don dang ldan pa byed pa po la yod pa'i phrin las kyi rang don mthar thug grub nas/ bya ba yul la yod pa'i phrin las kyi 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du sems can gyi don rgyun mi 'chad par mdzad par 'gyur ro// de ltar gang zag dbang po'i rim pa dang bstun nas rim gyis lam la khrid de/

gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid can tshe 'di nyid tshe gcig lus gcig stan thog gcig tu/ mngon du gyur pa'i mchog tu gyur pa lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi sngon dngos rjes kyi sgo nas khrid kyi nyams su blang bya'i dmigs rim legs par grub pa yin no// des gdams ngag gdab pa song nas/ nyams len gnad nas bzung ba'i ngo sprod kyang phal cher bstan zin pas 'thus la/ da rung nyams la gnas pa la rtogs pa bskyed pa dang rtogs pa ldan pa'i bogs dbyung ba'i thun chos rnams rang rang blo skyed dang mthun par rjes nas gdab rgyu yod pas skal ba dang ldan pas cis kyang phyin chad zab khrid don du gnyer bar byos shig /bzhi pa sgrub pa gong 'phel gyi nyams rtogs mthar 'don pa ni/ tai lo pa chen po'i zhal nas/ rdo rje 'chang gi lung byin pas// dbang bskur bstan pa'i srog kyang gtad// de tshe bu yi dam bca' ni// tshe ring bsod nams rgyas bya'i phyir// dngos po gang la'ang ma chags par// rang gi rdo rje 'dzin pa mchod// rab 'bring lo yi grangs tshad kyis// sgrub pa'i dam bca' srog tu bzung*// bla mas ci gsungs sgrub byed cing*// zhes gsungs pas/ bka' brgyud gong ma'i phyag bzhes dang zhabs tog yin pas mi tshe hril por sgrub pa'i dam bca' 'am/ lo bcu yan chad dam tha na lo gcig gnyis yar bcad kyi dam bca' bzang po re khas longs la sgrub pa'i mchod pa mdzod/ de'i bslab ston ri chos kun tu bzang po sogs ri chos rnams las bshad pa ltar bya ste/ mdor bsdu na rje dwags pos/ las dang po pas thos bsam la nan tan bya/ nyams myong skyes nas sgom sgrub la nan tan bya/ brtan pa ma thob bar du dben pa la nan tan bya/ 'phro rgod shas che na rig pa gcun pa la nan tan bya/ bying rmugs shas che na rig pa bskrog pa la nan tan bya/ blo ma brtan bar du mnyam bzhag la nan tan bya/

mnyam bzhag brtan nas rjes thob la nan tan bya/ mi mthun pa'i 'gal rkyen mang na bzod pa gsum la nan tan bya/ 'dod 'dun chags zhen che na zhen pa btsan thabs su bzlog pa la nan tan bya/ byams pa dang snying rje shas chung na byang chub kyi sems sbyang ba la nan tan bya/ zhes gsungs pa ltar shes par bya'o// lnga pa chos bzhin gyi spyod lam skyong tshul ni/ rje dwags po'i bstan bcos gros 'debs bdud rtsi'i phreng bar gsungs pa ji lta bu 'thus la/ gzhan yang bka' brgyud gong ma'i zhal gdams rnams dang sgo bstun nas lta sgom spyod pa ya ma bral bar 'bras bu chud mi za zhing thos bsam sgom gsum la nyams len byas pa'i rtags ma bor bar mdzod/ mdor bsdu na/ rje mi las dwags po la gdams pa'i dug gsum rgyas pa'i mi dang ma 'grogs/ spyir yang ri dwags rmas ma'am bya bzhin du zon bag che bar bya/ zhi ba dul ba rtse reg chung bar bya/ bzod pa che bar bya/ thams cad dang mthun par bya/ gtsang sbra shin tu che bar bya/ rtog pa shin tu chung bar bya/ ri mtshams dang smra bcad dang 'dag sbyar gsum gyis dus 'da' bar bya/ rang sems sangs rgyas su rtogs kyang bla ma rdo rje slob dpon mi spangs pa la bslab/ bsags sbyang gnyis po rang sar dag kyang tshogs chung ngu chung ngu nas bsags/ las 'bras nam mkha' ltar go yang sdig pa chung ngu nas 'dzem/ mnyam rjes med pa'i nyams yod kyang thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor rgyun chad med par nyams su blangs/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid du go yang chos dang gang zag la skur pa mi btab/ ces gsungs pa ltar nyams su len par bya'o// de nas zhal gdams skyel chos su gdab pa ni/ so so'i nyams myong dang bstun pa'i bzhag thabs bslab don gang dgos so sor byed pa yin/ 'dir thun mong du gdams pa la/ rje dwags pos/ ma bsgom kyang 'ong zhing 'dug zer na khrid tshar ba yin/ gsal stong la blo 'byongs na ji ltar bzhag bzhag tu 'dug zer na nyams tshar ba yin/

sgom med rgyud la skyes na rtogs pa tshar ba yin/ zhes gsungs pa dang*/ gnad yig las/ rang sems so mar 'jog shes dang*// gsal stong rang ngo mthong ba dang*// rnam rtog rang ngo shes pa gsum// khrid tshar rab 'bring tha gsum yin// yid ches rdo rus thug pa dgos// 'khrul 'khor lta stangs kun tu gces// sgom pa dus ltos dgos mi slob// spyod lam ma 'dres yengs mi thub// goms 'dris chung na rkyen khar 'chor// lo gsum bla ma'i drung dru bsgom// nyams myong rdzun zhus med par 'bul// gol sa the tshom bdar sha bcad// gcig skya pher na ri khrod 'grim// snang rkyen thub na spyod pa bya// yon tan rdzogs na gzhan don 'byung*// tshe gcig sangs rgyas the tshom med// bsgom nyes pa dang sgrub nyes dang*// ngal ba don med ma byed cig /don ldan gdams pa'i nyams khrid 'di// rtogs ldan bla ma'i drung du skyong*// zhes gsungs pas khrid ni tshar ba'i lugs 'di ltar yin gtso bo khrid thob pa dang sgom skyes pas mi chog phyin chad skyong dgos te man ngag rtsa ba las/ sgom skyes bdag po med pa de// phyug po rlung gi khyer ba yin// yid bzhin nor bu 'dam du byings// seng ge khyi yi zla la shor// rgyal po 'bangs su bab pa 'dra// des na zhen log bdag po dgos// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan thos bsam sogs ci ltar brtson kyang sgom skyong ba'i do zlar min te/ phal po che las/ dper na long ba rol mo mkhan// gzhan dag de yi dga' byed kyang*// bdag nyid kyi ni ma mthong ba// ma bsgoms chos kyang de bzhin no// zhes sogs mang du gsungs pa khrid yig chen mor yang yod la/ yang nyams len 'di dang thabs shes zung 'brel bsgrub bzhin pas bsgom la gnod na mtshan bcas thabs kyi cha de yang spangs te/ chos kyi gegs su gyur na pha ma'i ngag kyang chog /bsgom gyi gegs su gyur na mtshan bcas dge sbyor spong*// zhes gsungs pas/

dus dang rnam pa thams cad du nyams len bzhag thabs kho na'i steng du dran pa yengs med dang ma bral ba gal che ste/ klu sgrub kyis/ dbang phyug lus gtogs dran pa bde gshegs kyis// bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam du nye bar bstan// de ni bsgrims nas mngon par srung bgyi ste// dran pa nyams pas chos kun 'jig par gyur// ces gsungs pa dang*/ dran pa yod na sgom yod/ dran pa med na sgom med pas rtogs pa'i ngo bo de rtse gcig pa'i dran pas skyong dgos te/ lam spyi la dang po tshogs lam du sems dran pa nye bar bzhag pa/ sbyor lam du dran pa'i dbang po/ mthong lam du dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag bsgom lam du yang dag pa'i dran pa/ sangs rgyas kyi sar ma 'dres bco brgyad la dran pa yongs su nyams pa mi mnga'/ zhes dang*/ bka' brgyud gong mas/ dus rgyun chad med pa'i dran pa de// dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi gzhung lam yin// zhes dang*/ mdo dkon mchog sprin las/ dran dang shes bzhin rtag brtan nas// log rtog mtshan mas nye mi nus// zhes gsungs pas/ dran pa yengs med kyi sgom skyes pa la bdag po mdzod/ dus tshod la ltos mi dgos/ za ba dang nyal ba 'chag pa 'gro ba 'dug pa'i dus gang shar gyi ngo bo tur gyis nam dran pa'i tshe na de thog tu shigs kyis glod la ltos nam dran tshe na glod la zhog /ces gsungs pa dang*/ mai tri pas/ dus kyi rgyal po dran pa'i tshe na yin// zhes gsungs pas// rjes la sgom bdag po la gtad ces bya ba khyed rnams la nges shes thob pa'i sgom dang gdams ngag gtad pas sgom lta thog tu skyol zhing gnad kyi gdams pa ma bor bar mdzod/ sgom gyi bdag po zhen log la chol bya ba tshe 'di'i snang shas la shor nas sgom yal du ma 'jug /sgom gyi bogs 'don gsol 'debs la chol bya ba nyams rtogs yon tan gyi bogs 'don mos gus la ma g.yel/ sgom gyi bya ra dran pa la chol bya ba mnyam bzhag rjes thob dal bral med par gang shar gyi rang ngo la ma yengs/

sgom gyi phrin las snying rje la chol bya ba snying rje byang chub kyi phan sems kyi blo sbyong dang ma bral/ sgom gyi skyong lugs ngo tsha la chol bya ba phyi grogs bshes nang rang sems bar bla ma dang dkon mchog ye shes kyi spyan gyis gzigs pas ma khrel ba dang ma bral/ sgom gyi ngo bo rang bzhin ma grub pa'i ngang la ma yengs bya ba chos thams cad snang tsam rig tsam sgyu ma tsam du shes par bya la dngos 'dzin ma bskyed/ yang dad pa la skyo dub med pa gcig dgos gsungs te bla ma la dang ba'i dad pa/ gdams ngag la 'dod pa'i dad pa/ nyams myong la yid ches pa'i dad pa dang ma bral/ dge sbyor la mngon lkog med pa gcig dgos gsungs te lta ba shes rab/ sgom pa zung 'jug /spyod pa thabs kyi lam nyams su len pa la mis tshor ma tshor/ mgu ma mgu/ rang skyid dang sdug tshogs dang dben/ mngon dang lkog la khyad par spu tsam med par nyams len dang ma bral/ dam tshig la zol zog med pa gcig dgos gsungs te bcas pa'i sdom pa srung ba'i dam tshig bla ma dang grogs kyi dag snang la kha zhe mngon lkog gi snang log gi rang dgra ma dar bar mdzod/ yang rkyen thub kyi lta ba gcig dgos gsungs te lta ba go yul dang pho tshod la brten nas skyid sdug legs nyes na tsha gyod rkyen gyi srang la dbab dus tha mal du shor na lto 'grang nyi mas gros pa'i chos pa'i gzugs brnyan du ma song ba dgos gsungs/ yengs thub kyi sgom pa gcig dgos gsungs te dal ba'i spyod lam bral dus la tshad len/ bral ba'i spyod lam khrom thub la tshad len/ khrom gyi g.yeng ba snang rkyen la tshad len nas rang nyid la nges shes skye bar bya dgos gsungs/ yan thub kyi spyod pa gcig dgos gsungs te rtogs pa nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang nas tshul chos tho co med pa/ blos byas yid kyi 'khri ba med pa'i ngang nas shugs 'byung gi spyod pa rang grol du spyod pa/

mtshan ma'i rtog pa med pa'i ngang la gtad med gtod med gcig tu gyur pa/ thun dang dum bu med pa'i ngang nas ye shes zang thal du 'gro ba gcig dgos gsungs yang sgom gyi mgo bo mos gus la gyis gsungs te thar pa'i lam mkhan bla ma la gdung sems ma chung*/ sgom gyi rkang pa zhen log la gyis gsungs pas 'khor ba'i gdos thag zas nor la sred zhen ma che/ sgom gyi dngos gzhi bcos min la gyis/ gsungs pas rkyen skyes chu bur rang yal bzang 'dod kyis ma bcos/ yang bsod nams dang tshogs bsags kyi gegs log lta yin pas rten 'brel khyad du mi gsod cing dag snang sbyong*/ gdams ngag dang dngos grub kyi gegs the tshom yin pas log rtog gi g.yang la mi shor bar nges shes bskyed/ yon tan skye ba'i gegs lha dang bla ma la 'dor len yin pas nges shes gang la skyes pa'i steng du phur tshugs su bsdad/ sgrib gnyis sbyang ba'i gegs btang snyoms lung ma bstan yin pas tshogs gnyis dang man ngag zab mos gnad du bsnun/ ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs pa'i gegs gzung 'dzin yin pas gnas lugs kyi nyams len la gnyug bsring*/ gzhan don gyi gegs rang gces 'dzin yin pas bdag 'dzin btang la snying rje phyogs med du sbyong zhing gzhan don gyi smon lam rgya chen po gdab bo// yang tshe 'di la zhen 'dzin skyes na thun mong gi sngon 'gros bogs 'don/ phan sems chung zhing tha mal gyi blo skyes na thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gros bogs 'don/ gdams ngag dang nyams len la nges shes chung na khyad par sngon 'gros bogs 'don/ rkyen dang sdug bsngal gyi gegs skyon byung na mos gus kyi bogs 'don/ thabs la zhen pa'i spros pa byung na shes rab la rtsal sbyangs pas bogs 'don/ stong pa'i nyams la khu 'phrig mang na sbyor ba thabs la mkhas pas bogs 'don/ rkyang ded kyi nyams myong la yang yar skyed med na gang shar rang grol du khyer la bogs 'don/

gnyen po dang mtshan 'dzin gyi zhen pa byung na rtsol bral yang dag gi dran pas bogs 'don/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad du rang blo rang gis bcos nas bogs 'don/ yang sgom pa bzang 'dod phug rtsol ngan bya ba lus sems bde zhing sos dal ba'i dus su nyams len lhang lang ba snang ba bde phyam phyam pa 'dra zhig byung nas blo khengs te nga la sgom de yod snyam pa'i blo bde'i ngang la snyoms las su lus na lo brgya song yang yar skyed mi 'byung bas nyams brtan nas ngo bo mthong dgos/ de nas ma yengs pa/ de nas snang sems 'dres pa/ mnyam rjes 'dres pa/ nyin mtshan 'dres pa/ las ngan gyi slong ro snyoms pa/ rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel rtogs pa/ dmigs med kyi snying rje 'byongs pa/ zhing khams sbyong ba rnams la rim bzhin goms 'dris brtan pa 'byung dgos gsungs/ yang*/ mi gtam nyan na yid gnyis skye// mi mthun the tshom 'dred pa'i rgyu// bslus kyis dwogs na sgom gnya' chag /dad pa chung na 'khrul ro ldang*// brtson 'grus yal na sgom pa 'thas// 'dod thag nye na sun pa skyen// brtags dpyad byas na don phyir 'chor// zhe 'dod mang na ngo mi 'phrod// 'phro na tshar bcad rjes su bzung*// gnas na rjes med rang sar bzhag /gsal na re 'dod sgom dang ldan// zhes gsungs pa nyid kyang shes par bya/ nyams len gyi phra zhib kyi gnad la mkhas par byas nas nyams su len par bya'o// man ngag rtsa ba las/ rtog pa shar ba'i rnal 'byor pa// ma sgom na ni las stabs tshar// lug rdzi lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa// mi tshe zangs kyi bsgom pa'am// dgu'am drug tu bsgom par bya// de yang mig rtsa rtags la lta// rtog pa sgyu mar ma shar bar// zhen log chos brgyad ma snyom bar// snying rje rang 'dod ma zad bar// thabs mkhas dus la ma bab bar// yon tan de tsho ldan pa ni// rin chen lta bu'i gang zag ste// kun gyi thod bzhin bskur ba'i gnas// che 'bring chung gsum gang 'bag 'ching*// zhes gsungs pa'i tshad dang ldan par byas la bsgom par bya'o// rgyal ba'i dbang po'i zhal snga nas kyang*/

'dir bka' brgyud gong ma'i gsung rnams nges shes 'grong phyir dang byin rlabs che bar bsam/ tshig tshogs la ma 'dzem par sgra drangs thad du lung drangs pa yin la nyams len skyong ba rnams kyis kyang tshig ris zin na byin rlabs che bas bzung chog la tshig ris gal te ma zin kyang de'i don rnams gsal btab nas rgyud la ci 'drer bsgom pas don 'grub bo// zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs don ltar 'dir yang rtogs par mdzod cig /de ltar zab mo nyams su len pa'i khrid rim mthar phyin pa yin pas skabs 'dir rgyu dus kyi gdams pa re zhig rdzogs pa'i phyir/ bka' drin gsol ba'i yan lag bya ste/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo brgya rtsa brgyad dang rin chen sna tshogs kyi 'dod yon gyi mchod sprin dpag tu med pas bla ma mkha' 'gro mchod cing rdo rje spun rnams dga' ston gyi mnyes par byas la phyag 'tshal zhing gsol pa/ ye shes chen po legs so legs// sangs rgyas byang chub bka' drin mchog /rdo rje theg pa'i tshul legs so// theg pa chen po bstan pa legs// gnyis med ye shes mchog gi ni// man ngag dam pa mchog gyur pa// legs so bla ma rdo rje kun// rgyud ston pa yi rnal 'byor ma// legs so 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams// deng nas bzung ste bdag bran du// khyed la yang ni 'bul bar bya// zhes lan gsum gyi gsol zhing dga' ba chen po tshad med pa'i longs spyod la gnas par bya'o// dge ba'i rtsa ba gang yod des sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes de nyid gegs med du skye bar gyur cig /ces sogs bstan pa spyi dang bye brag la gzhan phan mtha' yas su 'byung ba'i smon lam bzang po rnams rgya cher gdab cing bkra shis zab mo brjod nas bya ba mthar phyin pa'i rten 'brel gyi rang gzhan smin grol gyi bdud rtsi thob pa'i dga' ston la spyod par bya'o// kye ho gsang ba bla med rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i don// skye dgu'i rdul las lhan skyes 'dab stong can// zab don brlan gyis kun nas rab bskyed gang*/

bdag blo gnyen gyi rnam par 'byed pa'i rtsis// blo dman bung ba rab tu tshim byed 'di// bla ma'i sku drin mngon sum myong la snang*// zag med mkhyen gzigs spyan du ma gyur kyang*// cha shas rig las sbyar 'dis nor 'khrul gang*// chos rje bla ma mkha' 'gros bzod par 'tshal// rang 'dod med pa'i dge ba'i mthu stobs kyis// 'gro kun lhan skyes bde chen thob gyur cig /ces phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor zab don gyi chu bo zhes bya ba chos rje bla ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku drin la bsten pa'i me nyag blo gros rin chen gyis gong ma'i gzhung rnams blo dman rnams kyis rtogs par dka' ba'i phyir/ 'dir go bder byas nas gsal bar phyes pa 'di ni dben gnas dar zo sgang du sbyar ba'o// zhes gsungs so// smras pa/ rgyal dang de sras kun gyi bsgrod gcig pa// 'phags chen dam pa rnams kyi sgrub pa'i gnas// rgya bod grub thob du ma gshegs pa'i lam// 'di la yid ches skyed dang skal bzang dag /theg chen chos kyi rgya mtsho zab cing yangs// snying po sems kyi nor bu 'dod dgur ldan// lta sgom klu yi dbang po dpal 'byor rgyas// 'di la longs spyod mdzod dang skyes bu rnams// bsregs bcad brdar bzhin mkhas grub du mas 'bad// sngar 'dris 'phrad bzhin nor 'khrul bslu bas dben// ji ltar sgrub bzhin yon tan kun ldan pa// 'di la the tshom chod dang grogs po dag /bstan dang dal 'byor nyi ma la la nye// las dang rnam smin gcong rong g.yang sa zab// rmongs dang 'khor ba'i mun nag sgrib g.yog 'thug /'di dus snyoms las spyod dam thar 'dod rnams// dam pas rang nyid gcig pu ga la srung*// lung rtogs gnyis ka sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog /gdul bya'i las dus 'dzoms pa'ang da res tsam// 'di la dgag pa ma che bshad brgyud pa// 'gro ba'i las skal snyigs ma'i dra bar chud// thub pa'i bstan pa rtags tsam 'dzin la thug

/sgrub pa'i snying po ming gi mtshan mar lus// 'di 'dra 'dor phod yod dam sgrub brgyud pa// 'dren pa rgyal ba yab sras sangs rgyas dngos// gdams ngag phyag rgya chen po theg pa'i bcud// rang sems lta ba gzhan dring mi 'jog pa// 'di la don chung sgrub bam bka' brgyud pa// bdag 'dra yongs 'dzin mang pos rjes gzung zhing*// snying po'i gdams pa'i skal ba thob na yang*// las dus kyis bskal nges 'byung lhag bsam dman// ma rabs g.yon can kha don 'gal ba yi// gzhan bskul skyon sbed mang po ma lags kyang*// gong ma'i gsung 'dis snang ba 'gyur 'dug pas// mdor bsdus tsam re btus nas skabs 'gar brjod// mdo sngags chos tshul zab cing rgya che bas// tshig re'i don kyang gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir// shes bya'i mig mdangs bdag gi nor 'khrul gyi// tshig don go rim nyes pa ji srid pa// rgyal dang rgyal sras mkhas grub rnams kyi drung*// 'gro kun sdig dang lhan cig snying nas bshags// rnam dkar chos la 'bad pa'i bsod nams dang*// blo dman yid la 'bab phyir go bde ba// 'jug bde'i lam sel lta bur dmigs pa yi// dge 'dis ma rgan 'gro rnams grol gyur cig /khyad par skyabs gcig rgyal mchog karma pa// yab sras brgyud par bcas pa'i bstan pa'i dpal// rab yangs phyogs mthar rgyas pa'i chos tshul gyis// theg mchog rgya mtshor 'gro rnams zhugs gyur nas// las nyon srid pa'i tsha gdung myur bsal te// smin grol bdud rtsi'i dpal la spyod gyur cig /

ces pa 'di ni 'dren mchog sprul pa'i sku rin po ches kyang de ltar bgyid chog pa'i bka' gnang ba dang*/ snga nas kyang tshul 'dir mos pa'i mched po mang dag gis kyang rang re'i lugs kyi lag len bltas chog gcig gyis zhes nan tur bskul ba la brten nas grub chen rang gi gsung sgros sngon 'gro dang khrid yig gnyis la gzhi byas/ rgyal ba'i dbang po'i gsung gis khog phub/ snga phyi'i gdams pa 'bog tshul rnams kyi 'chad srol dmigs pa'i go rim lag len dang bcas pa rje legs bshad sgra dbyangs kyis skyo brag pa la gnang ba'i khrid kyi bshad thabs dang*/ gzhan yang gsung sgros dang phyag len ci lta bas dkyus bsrings/ 'thad 'os gzhung du mi gsal ba rnams bka' brgyud gong ma'i gsung sgros btus nas gtso bor las dang po pas go bde zhing blo sna 'gyur ba kho na la dmigs nas cung zad bkod pa la mkhyen ldan rnams kyi kho bo yin par rlom pa'i go rim sdeb pa gong ma'i zhabs tog tu ma song bar gyur na rang gzhan la las sogs dwogs yod pas dpe 'di shin tu dam par mdzod cig grub chen nyid kyi bstan pa srung ba'i chos skyong rnams kyis thub par srungs shig /nag po 'khor bcas lcam gcig dud sol ma// ral gcig chen mo srog bdag shan pa yi// thub par srung cig bka'i bya ra gyis// las can rgyud la phan pa'i phrin las mdzod// 'di la dal 'byor rnyed dka' sogs kyi chos thun rnams sngon 'gro rin phreng sor bzhag byas pa dang cung zad kha bskang nas bshad na legs par yod la/ gzhan phar phyin drug sogs kyang slob ma'i blo tshod kyi go nus dang bstun nas bshad srol ji ltar 'thad bya la/ gzhung gi sa bcad dmigs rim gdams ngag snga phyi'i 'bog rim zhag grangs gyi cha tshod sngon dngos kyi rgyun ring thung*/ gnas nyams skye ba dang bstun tshul sogs 'di ga sor bzhag byas na 'grig par yod snyam pa'ang mkhyen pa'i spyan ldan gyi skyes bu rnams kyis phyag len gyis gtan la phab nas dgod par zhu'o// bkra shis/
shumbha/ lhag mthong gi khrid zhib pa sogs rgyab skyor gyi khrid rim rnams gzhan du lhan thabs ltar shes par bya'o/// /
